`mixins/sunset/bind_state.rs`:

```rs
// Binds from Rust's pull request #5: key and mouse button names, and which binds are held down (a Hold bind keeps its
// module on only while its key or button is down). No game or window types here.

use std::collections::HashSet;

// Modules that only draw or read their own on state each frame: on and off again at once leaves nothing behind (no
// camera, abilities, mesh or engine setting to put back), so they can be held.
pub(super) fn holds(module: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        module,
        "Zoom" | "Radar" | "ESP" | "Tracers" | "Nametags" | "Storage ESP" | "Block ESP" | "HUD" | "Trajectories" | "Waypoints"
            | "Breadcrumbs" | "Logout Spots" | "Hole ESP" | "Tunnel ESP" | "Void ESP" | "Light Overlay"
    )
}

// A key or button typed in a command (`r`, `rshift`, `f6`, `mouse4`, `key.keyboard.r`) as the game names it.
pub(super) fn canonical(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let text = text.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    let mouse = match text.as_str() {
        "mouse1" | "mouseleft" | "lmb" | "key.mouse.1" | "key.mouse.left" => Some("left"),
        "mouse2" | "mouseright" | "rmb" | "key.mouse.2" | "key.mouse.right" => Some("right"),
        "mouse3" | "mousemiddle" | "mmb" | "key.mouse.3" | "key.mouse.middle" => Some("middle"),
        "mouse4" | "mouseback" | "key.mouse.back" | "key.mouse.4" => Some("4"),
        "mouse5" | "mouseforward" | "key.mouse.forward" | "key.mouse.5" => Some("5"),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(name) = mouse {
        return Some(format!("key.mouse.{name}"));
    }
    if let Some(number) = text.strip_prefix("mouse").or_else(|| text.strip_prefix("key.mouse.")) {
        let number = number.parse::<u16>().ok()?;
        return (number >= 4).then(|| format!("key.mouse.{number}"));
    }
    if text.starts_with("key.keyboard.") && text.len() > "key.keyboard.".len() {
        return Some(text);
    }
    let name = match text.as_str() {
        "rshift" | "rightshift" => "right.shift",
        "lshift" | "leftshift" | "shift" => "left.shift",
        "rctrl" | "rightctrl" | "rightcontrol" => "right.control",
        "lctrl" | "leftctrl" | "ctrl" | "control" => "left.control",
        "ralt" | "rightalt" => "right.alt",
        "lalt" | "leftalt" | "alt" => "left.alt",
        "return" => "enter",
        "caps" | "capslock" => "caps.lock",
        "pageup" => "page.up",
        "pagedown" => "page.down",
        "grave" | "`" => "grave.accent",
        "space" | "tab" | "enter" | "up" | "down" | "left" | "right" | "insert" | "home" | "end" | "delete" | "backspace"
        | "escape" => text.as_str(),
        _ if text.chars().count() == 1 => text.as_str(),
        _ if text.starts_with('f') && text[1..].parse::<u32>().is_ok() => text.as_str(),
        _ if text.starts_with("kp") => return Some(format!("key.keyboard.keypad.{}", &text[2..])),
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(format!("key.keyboard.{name}"))
}

// A module a Hold bind turned on, and whether it was on before.
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(super) struct Held {
    pub(super) module: usize,
    pub(super) key: String,
    pub(super) previous: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Inputs {
    down: HashSet<String>,
    // Down since a screen or the menu had it: not a fresh press until let go.
    blocked: HashSet<String>,
    // Pressed by the window coming back into focus, not by the player.
    synthetic: HashSet<String>,
    held: Vec<Held>,
}

impl Inputs {
    // Whether this is a fresh press (not a repeat, not one a screen had).
    pub(super) fn press(&mut self, key: &str) -> bool {
        !self.blocked.contains(key) && self.down.insert(key.to_owned())
    }

    pub(super) fn block(&mut self, key: &str) {
        self.down.insert(key.to_owned());
        self.blocked.insert(key.to_owned());
    }

    pub(super) fn synthetic(&mut self, key: &str) {
        self.block(key);
        self.synthetic.insert(key.to_owned());
    }

    pub(super) fn is_synthetic(&self, key: &str) -> bool {
        self.synthetic.contains(key)
    }

    pub(super) fn hold(&mut self, module: usize, key: &str, previous: bool) {
        self.held.push(Held { module, key: key.to_owned(), previous });
    }

    // Let go: the holds it made end.
    pub(super) fn release(&mut self, key: &str) -> Vec<Held> {
        self.down.remove(key);
        self.blocked.remove(key);
        self.synthetic.remove(key);
        self.take_where(|held| held.key == key)
    }

    // A screen, the menu or lost focus: every hold ends, and what is down needs a new press.
    pub(super) fn suspend(&mut self) -> Vec<Held> {
        self.blocked.extend(self.down.iter().cloned());
        std::mem::take(&mut self.held)
    }

    // Keys let go of where no release came (a screen took it): from what is physically down.
    pub(super) fn missing(&mut self, mut is_down: impl FnMut(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<Held> {
        let missing: Vec<String> = self.down.iter().filter(|key| !is_down(key)).cloned().collect();
        missing.iter().flat_map(|key| self.release(key)).collect()
    }

    pub(super) fn take_where(&mut self, mut predicate: impl FnMut(&Held) -> bool) -> Vec<Held> {
        let mut released = Vec::new();
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < self.held.len() {
            if predicate(&self.held[i]) {
                released.push(self.held.swap_remove(i));
            } else {
                i += 1;
            }
        }
        released
    }

    // The on state to save: a module on only because it is held is saved as it was before.
    pub(super) fn saved_on(&self, module: usize, current: bool) -> bool {
        self.held.iter().find(|held| held.module == module).map_or(current, |held| current && held.previous)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn aliases_match_the_game_names() {
        for (alias, expected) in [
            ("LMB", "key.mouse.left"),
            ("mouse2", "key.mouse.right"),
            ("mmb", "key.mouse.middle"),
            ("mouseback", "key.mouse.4"),
            ("mouseforward", "key.mouse.5"),
            ("key.mouse.back", "key.mouse.4"),
            ("mouse6", "key.mouse.6"),
            ("rshift", "key.keyboard.right.shift"),
            ("`", "key.keyboard.grave.accent"),
            ("r", "key.keyboard.r"),
            ("kp1", "key.keyboard.keypad.1"),
            ("f6", "key.keyboard.f6"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(canonical(alias).as_deref(), Some(expected), "{alias}");
        }
        assert!(canonical("mouse0").is_none());
        assert!(canonical("key.mouse.unknown").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_repeat_is_not_a_press_and_a_release_rearms() {
        let mut inputs = Inputs::default();
        assert!(inputs.press("r"));
        assert!(!inputs.press("r"));
        assert!(inputs.release("r").is_empty());
        assert!(inputs.press("r"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_hold_is_never_saved_and_its_release_puts_back_the_state_before() {
        let mut inputs = Inputs::default();
        assert!(inputs.press("mouse4"));
        inputs.hold(1, "mouse4", false);
        inputs.hold(2, "mouse4", true);
        assert!(!inputs.saved_on(1, true));
        assert!(inputs.saved_on(2, true));
        assert!(!inputs.saved_on(2, false));
        let released = inputs.release("mouse4");
        assert_eq!(released.len(), 2);
        assert!(released.iter().any(|h| h.module == 1 && !h.previous));
        assert!(released.iter().any(|h| h.module == 2 && h.previous));
    }

    #[test]
    fn suspending_ends_holds_and_needs_a_new_press() {
        let mut inputs = Inputs::default();
        assert!(inputs.press("r"));
        inputs.hold(0, "r", false);
        assert_eq!(inputs.suspend().len(), 1);
        assert!(!inputs.press("r"));
        inputs.release("r");
        assert!(inputs.press("r"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_press_a_screen_had_or_focus_made_is_no_press_until_let_go() {
        let mut inputs = Inputs::default();
        inputs.block("enter");
        assert!(!inputs.press("enter"));
        inputs.release("enter");
        assert!(inputs.press("enter"));
        inputs.synthetic("r");
        assert!(inputs.is_synthetic("r") && !inputs.press("r"));
        inputs.release("r");
        assert!(!inputs.is_synthetic("r") && inputs.press("r"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_missed_release_is_found_from_what_is_down() {
        let mut inputs = Inputs::default();
        inputs.press("r");
        inputs.press("mouse4");
        inputs.hold(0, "r", false);
        inputs.hold(1, "mouse4", false);
        let released = inputs.missing(|key| key == "r");
        assert_eq!(released.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(released[0].module, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_modules_that_only_draw_can_be_held() {
        assert!(holds("Zoom") && holds("ESP"));
        for module in ["Reach", "Air Place", "Flight", "Step", "Freecam", "Timer", "Xray", "No Render", "Fullbright"] {
            assert!(!holds(module), "{module}");
        }
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/block_overlay.rs`:

```rs
// Block Overlay: the block you look at, its own selection shape outlined and filled in a colour. Drawn with the rest
// of Sunset's overlays over the frame (so not hidden by terrain); the game's own outline is left out while it shows.

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Camera, Canvas, Category, Module, gui_open, line};
use super::sunset_block_overlay_math::{EDGES, FACES, bounded, box_edge, colour, translated, valid_box, visible};

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Module {
    Module::new("Block Overlay", Category::Render, "Colors the targeted block.")
        .colour("Color", "Gold")
        .bool("Outline", true)
        .num("Outline opacity", 0.9, 0.0, 1.0, 0.05)
        .num("Line width", 1.0, 0.5, 4.0, 0.25)
        .bool("Fill", true)
        .num("Fill opacity", 0.15, 0.0, 1.0, 0.05)
}

fn active(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> bool {
    m.on && visible(game.native_playing(), game.ui.hide_gui, gui_open(), game.may_build(), game.player.is_some())
}

/// For a hook at Game::render's native outline extraction. Do not apply this to
/// Game::pick itself: gameplay and our own current-target read must stay intact.
/// No state is changed, so disabling immediately restores the native stroke.
pub(super) fn suppress_native_outline(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on("sunset") {
        return false;
    }
    // gui_open() takes the same lock as with(), so evaluate visibility first.
    if !visible(game.native_playing(), game.ui.hide_gui, gui_open(), game.may_build(), game.player.is_some()) {
        return false;
    }
    super::sunset::with(|s| s.module("Block Overlay").is_some_and(|m| {
        m.on && ((m.b("Outline") && colour(0, m.n("Outline opacity")) >> 24 != 0)
            || (m.b("Fill") && colour(0, m.n("Fill opacity")) >> 24 != 0))
    }))
}

pub(super) fn overlay(game: &Game<'_>, cam: &Camera, mods: &[Module], out: &mut impl Canvas, lw: f32) {
    let Some(m) = mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Block Overlay" && m.on) else {
        return;
    };
    if !active(game, m) {
        return;
    }
    let rgb = m.c("Color");
    let outline = if m.b("Outline") { colour(rgb, m.n("Outline opacity")) } else { 0 };
    let fill = if m.b("Fill") { colour(rgb, m.n("Fill opacity")) } else { 0 };
    if (outline | fill) >> 24 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    // Use the engine's pick (and its cached tick hit when present), including
    // reach and contextual shapes. Never retain it across frames or world loads.
    let Some(hit) = game.pick() else {
        return;
    };
    let state = game.world.block(hit.pos[0], hit.pos[1], hit.pos[2]);
    let facts = game.res.facts();
    if facts.is_air(state) {
        return; // A previously picked block can have been removed this tick.
    }
    let fact = facts.get(state);
    let position = hit.pos.map(f64::from);
    let width = lw * bounded(m.n("Line width"), 0.5, 4.0, 1.0) as f32;

    // Held light/scaffolding and animated shulker shapes use the same context
    // bounds as the host. Draw these directly, without outline_boxes()'s Vec.
    if let Some(shape) = game.context_outline(hit.pos, state) {
        let b = translated(shape, position);
        if valid_box(b) {
            if fill >> 24 != 0 {
                fill_box(cam, out, b, fill);
            }
            if outline >> 24 != 0 {
                for corners in EDGES {
                    edge(cam, out, box_edge(b, corners), outline, width);
                }
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    let offset = if fact.outline_offset {
        game.pack.context.tables.offset(state, hit.pos[0], hit.pos[2]).unwrap_or([0.0; 3])
    } else {
        [0.0; 3]
    };
    let base = std::array::from_fn(|i| position[i] + offset[i]);
    if fill >> 24 != 0 {
        for &shape in fact.outline.iter() {
            let b = translated(shape, base);
            if valid_box(b) {
                fill_box(cam, out, b, fill);
            }
        }
    }
    if outline >> 24 != 0 {
        // These are the host's shape-union edges, not twelve edges per box.
        // Stairs, fences and panes retain their actual selection geometry.
        for &e in fact.outline_edges.iter() {
            edge(cam, out, translated(e, base), outline, width);
        }
    }
}

fn edge(cam: &Camera, out: &mut impl Canvas, e: [f64; 6], colour: u32, width: f32) {
    if !e.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
        return;
    }
    if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (cam.project([e[0], e[1], e[2]]), cam.project([e[3], e[4], e[5]])) {
        line(out, a, b, colour, width);
    }
}

fn fill_box(cam: &Camera, out: &mut impl Canvas, b: [f64; 6], colour: u32) {
    let lo = [b[0], b[1], b[2]];
    let hi = [b[3], b[4], b[5]];
    let points = cam.points(lo, hi);
    let eye = cam.eye();
    for (face, axis, high) in FACES {
        let facing = if high { eye[axis] > hi[axis] } else { eye[axis] < lo[axis] };
        if let (true, [Some(a), Some(b), Some(c), Some(d)]) = (facing, face.map(|i| points[i])) {
            out.quad([a, b, c, d], colour);
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
// Published afresh during HUD construction, before this frame is submitted,
// including disabled and hidden frames. draw_outline runs on the same thread.
// Other renderer entry points use loading_frame(), which has no outline edges.
use std::cell::Cell;

thread_local! {
    static ACTIVE: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
}

pub fn active() -> bool {
    ACTIVE.with(Cell::get)
}

pub fn publish(suppress: bool) {
    ACTIVE.with(|active| active.set(suppress));
}
```

`mixins/sunset/block_overlay_math.rs`:

```rs
// Block Overlay's rules and shapes: when it shows, valid settings, the outline's boxes moved to the block.

/// Unlike the host selection stroke, this optional HUD overlay hides in menus.
pub(super) fn visible(playing: bool, hide_gui: bool, menu_open: bool, may_build: bool, has_player: bool) -> bool {
    playing && !hide_gui && !menu_open && may_build && has_player
}

/// Reject malformed config values rather than passing NaNs into HUD vertices.
pub(super) fn bounded(value: f64, min: f64, max: f64, fallback: f64) -> f64 {
    if value.is_finite() { value.clamp(min, max) } else { fallback }
}

pub(super) fn colour(rgb: u32, opacity: f64) -> u32 {
    let alpha = (bounded(opacity, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0) * 255.0).round() as u32;
    (alpha << 24) | (rgb & 0x00FF_FFFF)
}

/// Outline coordinates are local to the block; keep f64 until projection.
pub(super) fn translated(shape: [f64; 6], base: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 6] {
    std::array::from_fn(|i| base[i % 3] + shape[i])
}

pub(super) fn valid_box(b: [f64; 6]) -> bool {
    b.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) && (0..3).all(|i| b[i] < b[i + 3])
}

pub(super) const EDGES: [(usize, usize); 12] = [
    (0, 1), (2, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7),
    (0, 2), (1, 3), (4, 6), (5, 7),
    (0, 4), (1, 5), (2, 6), (3, 7),
];

pub(super) fn box_edge(b: [f64; 6], (start, end): (usize, usize)) -> [f64; 6] {
    std::array::from_fn(|i| {
        let axis = i % 3;
        let corner = if i < 3 { start } else { end };
        b[axis + if corner & (1 << axis) == 0 { 0 } else { 3 }]
    })
}

// Index bit 0 selects high x, bit 1 high y, bit 2 high z.
pub(super) const FACES: [([usize; 4], usize, bool); 6] = [
    ([0, 2, 6, 4], 0, false),
    ([1, 3, 7, 5], 0, true),
    ([0, 1, 5, 4], 1, false),
    ([2, 3, 7, 6], 1, true),
    ([0, 1, 3, 2], 2, false),
    ([4, 5, 7, 6], 2, true),
];
```

`mixins/sunset/boat_hook.rs`:

```rs
// Entity Control: after the boat you drive has ticked, its move is made again with the motion Sunset gives it, and
// you sit in it where it now is.
fn sunset_boat_ride(this: &mut Game<'_>, keys: Keys) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<bool> {
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering::Relaxed};
    static BUSY: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
    if BUSY.load(Relaxed) || this.riding.is_none_or(|id| !this.boats.iter().any(|b| b.id == id)) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    BUSY.store(true, Relaxed);
    let value = this.remote_ride(keys);
    BUSY.store(false, Relaxed);
    let Some(i) = this.riding.and_then(|id| this.boats.iter().position(|b| b.id == id)) else {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(value);
    };
    let mut b = this.boats[i].clone();
    let cell = [b.position.x.floor() as i32, (b.position.y + 0.1).floor() as i32, b.position.z.floor() as i32];
    let f = crate::game::sunset_util::facts(this, cell);
    let in_water = f.fluid == crate::game::Fluid::Water || f.waterlogged;
    let Some((v, yaw)) = super::sunset_vehicle::boat(this, b.velocity, b.on_ground, in_water) else {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(value);
    };
    if let Some(yaw) = yaw {
        b.yaw = yaw;
    }
    let obstacles = this.boat_move_obstacles(&b);
    b.position = b.previous;
    let mut scene = horizon_client::collisions::EntityCollisions {
        blocks: horizon_client::collisions::SceneCollisions { world: &this.world, binding: this.collision, subject: None },
        entities: &obstacles,
        border: None,
    };
    if let Ok(moved) = scene.resolve(b.bounds(), v, 0.0, b.on_ground) {
        b.position = Vec3::new(b.position.x + moved.x, b.position.y + moved.y, b.position.z + moved.z);
        b.on_ground = v.y < 0.0 && moved.y > v.y;
        let keep = |want: f64, got: f64| if (got - want).abs() > 1.0e-7 { 0.0 } else { want };
        b.velocity = Vec3::new(keep(v.x, moved.x), keep(v.y, moved.y), keep(v.z, moved.z));
    }
    this.boats[i] = b;
    let seat = this.player_boat_seat(i);
    if let Some(p) = this.player.as_mut() {
        p.position = seat;
    }
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(value)
}
```

```rs
// The mouse buttons the game is pressed with: the combat macros see your right clicks. While the click GUI is open
// the buttons bound to attack and use do nothing; a release still lets go (a shield held up as the menu opened comes
// down when you let go in it).
fn sunset_buttons(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>, button: winit::event::MouseButton, pressed: bool) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<Result<()>> {
    crate::game::sunset_combat_macros::user_mouse(game, button, pressed);
    if pressed && crate::game::sunset::gui_open() {

}
```
