```rs
static USER_RIGHT: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool = std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);
pub(super) fn user_mouse(game: &Game<'_>, button: MouseButton, pressed: bool) {
    if button == MouseButton::Right {
        let user = !pressed
            || (super::sunset_combat_control::owner().is_none_or(|o| o == CRYSTAL || o == ANCHOR)
                && game.native_playing()
                && !gui_open());
        if user {
            USER_RIGHT.store(pressed, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        // Retain a guard-only quick edge even while inventory/lease conditions
        // pause macro startup. It can consume a protected anchor fallback, but
        // cannot become a delayed macro start after the pause clears.
        if pressed && game.native_playing() && game.native_on(sunset::ID) && !gui_open() {
            if let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() {
                state(|s| {
                    s.anchor_press = Some(AnchorPress {
                        tick: game.ticks,
                        session: remote.session.counters.clone(),
                        entity: remote.entity_id,
                        dimension: game.dim,
                        start_allowed: user && allowed(game) && anchor_can_click(game),
                    })
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
pub(super) fn focus_lost() {
    USER_RIGHT.store(false, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    state(|s| s.anchor_press = None);
}
fn physical_use(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let bound = game.settings.keys.get("key.use");
    if let Some(button) = horizon_client::keybinds::mouse_button(bound) {
        return game.physical_buttons.contains(&button);
    }
    horizon_client::keybinds::key_code(bound).is_some_and(|key| game.physical_keys.contains(&key))
}
fn down(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    // play_mouse receives canonical Right after native rebinding for keyboard,
    // mouse and ctl. Its shadow preserves quick edges without another key hook.
    physical_use(game) || USER_RIGHT.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
}

// The native use path reads canonical Sneak, which includes rebound keys and
// ToggleKeyMapping state. Raw physical Shift is a screen modifier, not this.
fn anchor_can_click(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    !game.keys.contains(&winit::keyboard::KeyCode::ShiftLeft)
}
fn allowed(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.native_window()
        && game.native_on(sunset::ID)
        && util::in_world(game)
        && !gui_open()
        && !game.spectator()
        && game.riding.is_none()
        && game.selected < 9
        && game.using.is_none()
        && game.mining.is_none()
        && !game.left
        && !super::sunset_player::gap_eating()
        && util::inventory_idle(game)
        && !with(|s| ["Blink", "Auto EXP"].iter().any(|n| s.is_on(n)))
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.health.health().is_finite() && p.health.health() > 0.)
        && game.mobs.len() <= 256
        && game.crystals.len() <= 256
}
fn same_session(game: &Game<'_>, run: &Run) -> bool {
    game.dim == run.dimension
        && game
            .remote
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == run.entity && Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, &run.session))
}
fn enabled(run: &Run) -> bool {
    macro_module(run.owner).is_some_and(|m| &m == run.settings.as_ref())
}

// Explicit OFF/ON transitions invalidate the previous accepted manual intent.
// Another macro's current sequence is independent and must retain its lease.
pub(super) fn toggled(game: &mut Game<'_>, name: &str, _on: bool) {
    let name = match name {
        CRYSTAL_MODULE => CRYSTAL,
        ANCHOR_MODULE => ANCHOR,
        _ => return,
    };
    if state(|s| s.run.as_ref().is_some_and(|run| run.owner == name)) {
        reset(game);
    }
    state(|s| {
        if name == ANCHOR {
            s.anchor_press = None;
            s.anchor_latched = false;
        }
        if name == CRYSTAL {
            s.retries.clear();
            s.last_deed = None;
            s.pace_gap = 0;
            s.main = None;
        }
    });
}

// GUI/death/world transitions cancel the transaction; restoration is allowed
// only while the same session and selected slot are still owned by this run.
pub(super) fn reset(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let run = state(|s| {
        s.token = s.token.wrapping_add(1);
        s.anchor_press = None;
        s.run.take()
    });
    sunset::cancel_turns(CRYSTAL);
    sunset::cancel_turns(ANCHOR);
    if let Some(run) = run {
        if super::sunset_combat_control::owns(run.owner)
            && same_session(game, &run)
            && game.using.is_none()
            && !super::sunset_player::gap_eating()
        {
            if let Some(previous) =
                policy::restore(run.previous, run.owned, game.selected, run.settings.b("Switch back"))
            {
                hold(game, previous);
            }
        }
        super::sunset_combat_control::release(run.owner);
    }
}
fn complete(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let anchor = state(|s| {
        s.run
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|r| r.sequence.kind == Kind::Anchor && r.sequence.step == Step::Done && same_session(game, r))
    });
    reset(game);
    if anchor {
        state(|s| s.anchor_latched = false);
    }
}
pub(super) fn active() -> bool {
    state(|s| s.run.is_some())
}

fn stack(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize, name: &str) -> bool {
    let stack = if slot == OFFHAND { game.offhand.as_ref() } else { game.inventory.get(slot).and_then(|v| v.as_ref()) };
    stack.is_some_and(|s| s.count > 0 && util::short(&s.item) == name)
}
fn item_slot(game: &Game<'_>, name: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    util::find_held(game, |n| n == name).filter(|&slot| stack(game, slot, name))
}

// Unknown runtime components cannot establish that main-hand use passes.
// Native item prototypes provide the ordinary component facts. Cosmetic and
// durability wire additions do not alter use; removals are conservatively unknown.
fn known_click_patch(stack: &horizon_client::items::ItemStack) -> bool {
    if stack.extra.as_ref().is_some_and(|extra| !extra.other.is_empty()) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(patch) = stack.wire_patch() else {
        return true;
    };
    use horizon_protocol::{buf::Reader, item::component as c};
    let mut reader = Reader::new(&patch);
    let Ok(added) = reader.count(64) else {
        return false;
    };
    if reader.count(64).ok() != Some(0) {
        return false;
    }
    for _ in 0..added {
        let Ok(kind) = reader.varint() else {
            return false;
        };
        if !matches!(
            kind,
            c::DAMAGE
                | c::ENCHANTMENTS
                | c::CUSTOM_NAME
                | c::ITEM_NAME
                | c::LORE
                | c::REPAIR_COST
                | c::ITEM_MODEL
                | c::CUSTOM_MODEL_DATA
                | c::TOOLTIP_DISPLAY
                | c::ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE
        ) {
            return false;
        }
        let Ok(length) = reader.count(reader.remaining()) else {
            return false;
        };
        if reader.bytes(length).is_err() {
            return false;
        }
    }
    reader.remaining() == 0
}
fn click_facts(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize) -> policy::ClickFacts {
    let Some(stack) = game.inventory.get(slot).and_then(|stack| stack.as_ref()).filter(|s| s.count > 0) else {
        return policy::ClickFacts { empty: true, ..Default::default() };
    };
    let Some(info) = game.items().get(&stack.item) else {
        return policy::ClickFacts::default();
    };
    let has = |name: &str| info.components.iter().any(|component| component == name);
    let tag = |name: &str| game.items().item_tags.get(name).is_some_and(|items| items.contains(&*stack.item));
    policy::ClickFacts {
        empty: false,
        known: known_click_patch(stack),
        consuming: has("minecraft:consumable"),
        blocking: has("minecraft:blocks_attacks"),
        kinetic: has("minecraft:kinetic_weapon"),
        equip_swap: info.equip_slot.is_some() && info.swappable,
        sword: tag("minecraft:swords"),
        axe: tag("minecraft:axes"),
        mace: util::short(&stack.item) == "mace",
        totem: util::short(&stack.item) == "totem_of_undying",
    }
}
fn crystal_route(game: &Game<'_>, name: &str, base: bool, preferred: usize) -> Option<policy::UseRoute> {
    policy::placement_route(
        game.selected,
        preferred,
        std::array::from_fn(|slot| stack(game, slot, name)),
        std::array::from_fn(|slot| policy::click_through(click_facts(game, slot), base)),
        stack(game, OFFHAND, name),
    )
}
fn crystal_use_action(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    run: &Run,
    step: Step,
    click: Click,
    name: &str,
    destination: [i32; 3],
) -> Option<Action> {
    let base = matches!(util::short(&util::facts(game, click.pos).name), "obsidian" | "bedrock");
    let route = crystal_route(game, name, base, run.previous)?;
    let selected = route.select.unwrap_or(game.selected);
    Some(Action::Use {
        step,
        click,
        select: route.select,
        slot: if route.offhand { OFFHAND } else { selected },
        destination,
        before: game.world.block(destination[0], destination[1], destination[2]).0,
    })
}

fn anchor_charge(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> Option<u8> {
    if !game.world.loaded(p[0], p[2]) {
        return None;
    }
    let b = game.world.block(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
    if !game.is_anchor(b) {
        return None;
    }
    game.pack.assets.registry.state(b)?.properties.get("charges")?.parse::<u8>().ok().filter(|n| *n <= 4)
}
fn center(p: [i32; 3], crystal: bool) -> [f64; 3] {
    [f64::from(p[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(p[1]) + if crystal { 1. } else { 0.5 }, f64::from(p[2]) + 0.5]
}
fn name_is(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], name: &str) -> bool {
    util::short(&util::facts(game, p).name) == name
}
fn inert(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    game.world.loaded(p[0], p[2])
        && util::facts(game, p).full_collision
        && matches!(
            util::short(&util::facts(game, p).name),
            "stone"
                | "cobblestone"
                | "obsidian"
                | "crying_obsidian"
                | "bedrock"
                | "deepslate"
                | "cobbled_deepslate"
                | "dirt"
                | "grass_block"
                | "netherrack"
                | "end_stone"
                | "netherite_block"
        )
}
fn visible(game: &Game<'_>, click: Click, budget: &mut Budget) -> bool {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(end) = policy::outside(click.hit, click.face) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some((range, _)) = super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game) else {
        return false;
    };
    game.world.loaded(click.pos[0], click.pos[2])
        && in_range(eye, click.hit, range)
        && clear_line(game, eye, end, None, budget)
}
fn support(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<Click> {
    if !game.world.loaded(p[0], p[2]) || !util::can_place(game, p, true) {
        return None;
    }
    for (d, face) in [([0, -1, 0], 1), ([0, 1, 0], 0), ([0, 0, -1], 3), ([0, 0, 1], 2), ([-1, 0, 0], 5), ([1, 0, 0], 4)]
    {
        let n = std::array::from_fn(|i| p[i] + d[i]);
        if !inert(game, n) {
            continue;
        }
        let hit = std::array::from_fn(|i| f64::from(n[i]) + 0.5 - f64::from(d[i]) * 0.5);
        let click = Click { pos: n, face, hit };
        if visible(game, click, budget) {
            return Some(click);
        }
    }
    None
}
fn sent_anchor_click(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<Click> {
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let (yaw, pitch) = super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game)?;
    if !yaw.is_finite() || !pitch.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(pitch).to_radians());
    let direction = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let (range, _) = super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game)?;
    let hit = game.clip_ray(eye, direction, range)?;
    if hit.pos != p {
        return None;
    }
    let click = Click { pos: hit.pos, face: policy::face(hit.face)?, hit: hit.point };
    visible(game, click, budget).then_some(click)
}
fn anchor_click(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<Click> {
    sent_anchor_click(game, p, budget).or_else(|| fallback_anchor_click(game, p, budget))
}
fn anchor_deed_click(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget, actual: bool) -> Option<Click> {
    if actual { sent_anchor_click(game, p, budget) } else { anchor_click(game, p, budget) }
}
fn fallback_anchor_click(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<Click> {
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let c = center(p, false);
    let axis = (0..3).max_by(|&a, &b| (eye[a] - c[a]).abs().total_cmp(&(eye[b] - c[b]).abs()))?;
    let positive = eye[axis] >= c[axis];
    let mut hit = c;
    hit[axis] += if positive { 0.5 } else { -0.5 };
    let face = match (axis, positive) {
        (0, false) => 4,
        (0, true) => 5,
        (1, false) => 0,
        (1, true) => 1,
        (2, false) => 2,
        _ => 3,
    };
    let click = Click { pos: p, face, hit };
    visible(game, click, budget).then_some(click)
}
fn crystal_room(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    crystal_space(game, p, true)
}
fn crystal_space(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], require_base: bool) -> bool {
    if p[1] < -64
        || p[1] >= 318
        || !game.world.loaded(p[0], p[2])
        || (require_base && !matches!(util::short(&util::facts(game, p).name), "obsidian" | "bedrock"))
        || !util::is_air(game, [p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2]])
    {
        return false;
    }
    let c = center(p, true);
    let hits = |b: horizon_core::geometry::Aabb| {
        let (a, z) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        a.x < c[0] + 0.5 && z.x > c[0] - 0.5 && a.y < c[1] + 2. && z.y > c[1] && a.z < c[2] + 0.5 && z.z > c[2] - 0.5
    };
    !game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| hits(p.bounds()))
        && !game.mobs.iter().any(|m| !m.removed && hits(m.bounds()))
        && !game.crystals.iter().any(|e| {
            (e.position.x - c[0]).abs() < 1.5
                && (e.position.z - c[2]).abs() < 1.5
                && e.position.y < c[1] + 2.
                && e.position.y + 2. > c[1]
        })
}
fn crystal_on(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> Option<u32> {
    let c = center(p, true);
    game.crystals
        .iter()
        .find(|e| e.id != 0 && !e.invulnerable && in_range(c, [e.position.x, e.position.y, e.position.z], 0.25))
        .map(|e| e.id)
}
fn direction(game: &Game<'_>) -> [f64; 3] {
    let (y, p) = (f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians());
    [-y.sin() * p.cos(), -p.sin(), y.cos() * p.cos()]
}
fn crosshair_crystal(game: &Game<'_>, budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<(u32, [f64; 3], [f64; 3])> {
    match cursor_entity(game).ok()?? {
        CursorEntity::Crystal { id, at, aim } => {
            let eye = game.eye_position()?;
            let end = std::array::from_fn(|i| aim[i] + (eye[i] - aim[i]) * 1.0e-5);
            clear_line(game, eye, end, None, budget).then_some((id, at, aim))
        }
        CursorEntity::Other => None,
    }
}
// Anchor intent deliberately uses a block-only outline ray. Crystal intent
// additionally refuses a nearer observed pickable entity through crystal_click.
fn camera_click(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<Click> {
    let (range, _) = super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game)?;
    let hit = game.clip_ray(game.eye_position()?, direction(game), range)?;
    Some(Click { pos: hit.pos, face: policy::face(hit.face)?, hit: hit.point })
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
enum CursorEntity {
    Crystal { id: u32, at: [f64; 3], aim: [f64; 3] },
    Other,
}
// No allocation: one bounded pass over the native pickable collections. An
// invalid observed box or overfull scene refuses the macro's crystal plan.
fn cursor_entity(game: &Game<'_>) -> Result<Option<CursorEntity>, ()> {
    let (blocks, entities) = super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game).ok_or(())?;
    let eye = game.eye_position().ok_or(())?;
    let dir = direction(game);
    if !eye.iter().chain(dir.iter()).all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
        return Err(());
    }
    let count = game
        .mobs
        .len()
        .saturating_add(game.crystals.len())
        .saturating_add(game.boats.len())
        .saturating_add(game.carts.len())
        .saturating_add(game.armor_stands.len())
        .saturating_add(game.cushions.len())
        .saturating_add(game.item_frames.len())
        .saturating_add(game.paintings.len())
        .saturating_add(game.creatures.projectiles.len());
    if count > 768 {
        return Err(());
    }
    // A wall beyond the block interaction range still occludes an entity
    // when a server grants a larger entity interaction range.
    let wall = game.clip_ray(eye, dir, blocks.max(entities)).map(|hit| util::dist(eye, hit.point));
    let mut best: Option<(f64, CursorEntity)> = None;
    let mut offer = |lo: [f64; 3], hi: [f64; 3], what: CursorEntity| -> Result<(), ()> {
        if !(0..3).all(|i| lo[i].is_finite() && hi[i].is_finite() && lo[i] <= hi[i]) {
            return Err(());
        }
        if let Some(hit) = policy::ray(eye, dir, lo, hi, entities) {
            let distance = util::dist(eye, hit);
            if wall.is_none_or(|d| distance < d) && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|(d, _)| distance < *d) {
                let what = match what {
                    CursorEntity::Crystal { id, at, .. } => CursorEntity::Crystal { id, at, aim: hit },
                    other => other,
                };
                best = Some((distance, what));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    };
    let corners = |b: horizon_core::geometry::Aabb| {
        let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        ([lo.x, lo.y, lo.z], [hi.x, hi.y, hi.z])
    };
    // Offer non-crystals first so an exact tie cannot click through one.
    for mob in &game.mobs {
        if mob.removed
            || !mob.alive()
            || Some(mob.id) == game.riding
            || super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::player_mode(game, mob.id) == Some(3)
        {
            continue;
        }
        let (lo, hi) = corners(mob.bounds());
        offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
    }
    for stand in &game.armor_stands {
        if !stand.marker && stand.health > 0.0 {
            let (lo, hi) = corners(stand.bounds());
            offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
        }
    }
    for boat in &game.boats {
        if Some(boat.id) != game.riding {
            let (lo, hi) = corners(boat.bounds());
            offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
        }
    }
    for cart in &game.carts {
        if Some(cart.id) != game.riding {
            let (lo, hi) = corners(cart.bounds());
            offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
        }
    }
    for cushion in &game.cushions {
        if Some(cushion.id) != game.riding {
            let (lo, hi) = cushion.bounds();
            offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
        }
    }
    for frame in &game.item_frames {
        let (lo, hi) = frame.bounds();
        offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
    }
    for painting in &game.paintings {
        let (lo, hi) = painting.bounds();
        offer(lo, hi, CursorEntity::Other)?;
    }
    for projectile in &game.creatures.projectiles {
        if super::deflect::redirectable(projectile) {
            let (lo, hi) = corners(projectile.aabb());
            offer(lo.map(|n| n - 1.0), hi.map(|n| n + 1.0), CursorEntity::Other)?;
        }
    }
    // Native dragon helper already accepts the caller's actual reach.
    let dragon = game.remote_dragon_part_hit(eye, dir, entities).map(|(_, distance, _)| distance);
    drop(offer);
    if let Some(distance) = dragon {
        if distance.is_finite()
            && wall.is_none_or(|d| distance < d)
            && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|(d, _)| distance <= *d)
        {
            best = Some((distance, CursorEntity::Other));
        }
    }
    for crystal in &game.crystals {
        if crystal.id == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let at = [crystal.position.x, crystal.position.y, crystal.position.z];
        if !at.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
            return Err(());
        }
        if let Some(aim) =
            policy::ray(eye, dir, [at[0] - 1., at[1], at[2] - 1.], [at[0] + 1., at[1] + 2., at[2] + 1.], entities)
        {
            let distance = util::dist(eye, aim);
            if wall.is_none_or(|d| distance < d) && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|(d, _)| distance < *d) {
                best = Some((
                    distance,
                    if crystal.invulnerable {
                        CursorEntity::Other
                    } else {
                        CursorEntity::Crystal { id: crystal.id, at, aim }
                    },
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(best.map(|(_, entity)| entity))
}
fn crystal_click(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<Click> {
    if cursor_entity(game).ok()?.is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    camera_click(game)
}
fn crystal_intent(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    settings: &Module,
    preferred: usize,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<([i32; 3], Step, Option<u32>)> {
    if let Some((id, at, _)) = crosshair_crystal(game, budget) {
        return Some((
            [at[0].floor() as i32, at[1].floor() as i32 - 1, at[2].floor() as i32],
            Step::CrystalBreak,
            Some(id),
        ));
    }
    let click = crystal_click(game)?;
    if matches!(util::short(&util::facts(game, click.pos).name), "obsidian" | "bedrock") {
        return (crystal_room(game, click.pos) && crystal_route(game, "end_crystal", true, preferred).is_some())
            .then_some((click.pos, Step::CrystalPlace, None));
    }
    if !settings.b("Auto obsidian")
        || !inert(game, click.pos)
        || crystal_route(game, "obsidian", false, preferred).is_none()
        || crystal_route(game, "end_crystal", true, preferred).is_none()
    {
        return None;
    }
    let normal = match click.face {
        0 => [0, -1, 0],
        1 => [0, 1, 0],
        2 => [0, 0, -1],
        3 => [0, 0, 1],
        4 => [-1, 0, 0],
        5 => [1, 0, 0],
        _ => return None,
    };
    let target = std::array::from_fn(|i| click.pos[i] + normal[i]);
    (util::can_place(game, target, true) && crystal_space(game, target, false) && visible(game, click, budget))
        .then_some((target, Step::Base, None))
}
fn random(s: &mut State) -> u64 {
    s.random = s.random.wrapping_add(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15);
    let mut n = s.random;
    n = (n ^ (n >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9);
    n = (n ^ (n >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94d049bb133111eb);
    n ^ (n >> 31)
}
// The nearest enemy player within 10 blocks is still in hurt time.
fn enemy_hurt(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(me) = util::player_pos(game) else {
        return false;
    };
    game.mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| util::player_enemy(game, t))
        .map(|t| (t.hurt_time, util::dist(me, [t.position.x, t.position.y, t.position.z])))
        .filter(|(_, d)| *d <= 10.0)
        .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
        .is_some_and(|(hurt, _)| hurt > 0)
}
fn delay_for(run: &Run, step: Step) -> f64 {
    match step {
        Step::Base => run.settings.n("Obsidian delay"),
        Step::CrystalPlace => run.settings.n("Place delay"),
        Step::CrystalBreak => run.settings.n("Break delay"),
        _ => run.settings.n("Delay"),
    }
}
pub(super) fn note_main(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let current = &game.inventory[game.selected];
    state(|s| {
        if s.main
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|(slot, stack, tick)| *slot != game.selected || stack != current || game.ticks < *tick)
        {
            s.main = Some((game.selected, current.clone(), game.ticks));
        }
    });
}
pub(super) fn enchant_damage(game: &Game<'_>, stack: &horizon_client::items::ItemStack) -> bool {
    let mut sum = 0.0f32;
    for (id, level) in stack.enchantments() {
        let Some(enchantment) = game.items().enchantments.get(id) else {
            return false;
        };
        for effect in enchantment.effects["minecraft:damage"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
            if effect.get("requirements").is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null()) || effect["effect"]["type"] != "minecraft:add" {
                return false;
            }
            sum += horizon_client::enchant::level_value(&effect["effect"]["value"], *level);
        }
    }
    sum.is_finite() && sum > 0.0
}
pub(super) fn weapon_route(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    let bare = 1.0 + game.effect_attack_bonus();
    let mut fallback = None;
    for slot in std::iter::once(game.selected).chain((0..9).filter(|slot| *slot != game.selected)) {
        let Some(stack) = game.inventory[slot].as_ref() else {
            if bare > 0.0 {
                if slot == game.selected {
                    return Some(slot);
                }
                fallback.get_or_insert(slot);
            }
            continue;
        };
        let Some(info) = game.items().get(&stack.item) else {
            continue;
        };
        if stack.count == 0
            || horizon_client::spear::Kinetic::of(&stack.item).is_some()
            || game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown(&horizon_client::cooldowns::group(stack, info.use_cooldown.as_ref()))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if enchant_damage(game, stack) {
            return Some(slot);
        }
        if (bare + info.attack_damage).is_finite() && bare + info.attack_damage > 0.0 {
            if slot == game.selected {
                return Some(slot);
            }
            fallback.get_or_insert(slot);
        }
    }
    fallback
}
pub(super) fn weak_settling(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let bare = 1.0 + game.effect_attack_bonus();
    bare <= 0.0
        && !game.inventory[game.selected].as_ref().is_some_and(|s| enchant_damage(game, s))
        && state(|s| s.main.as_ref().is_none_or(|(_, _, since)| game.ticks < *since || game.ticks - *since < 2))
}
fn planned_blast(kind: Kind, pos: [i32; 3]) -> Blast {
    match kind {
        Kind::Anchor => Blast::anchor(pos),
        Kind::Crystal => {
            Blast::explosion([f64::from(pos[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(pos[1]) + 1.0, f64::from(pos[2]) + 0.5], 6.0)
        }
    }
}
fn loot_allowed(game: &Game<'_>, run: &Run) -> bool {
    super::sunset_loot_guard::allows(game, planned_blast(run.sequence.kind, run.pos), run.settings.b("Protect loot"))
}
fn safe_blast(
    game: &mut Game<'_>,
    settings: &Module,
    kind: Kind,
    blast: Blast,
    detonation_slot: Option<usize>,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> bool {
    if !super::sunset_loot_guard::allows(game, blast, settings.b("Protect loot")) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(player) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let health = f64::from(player.health.health() + player.health.absorption());
    if !health.is_finite() || health <= 0.0 {
        return false;
    }
    // Use the hand that this accepted deed will actually select, rather than
    // a different currently-held item before a Double replacement selection.
    if kind == Kind::Anchor
        && (detonation_slot.is_some_and(|slot| stack(game, slot, "totem_of_undying"))
            || stack(game, OFFHAND, "totem_of_undying"))
    {
        return true;
    }
    let Some(own) = observed_local_damage(game, blast, budget) else {
        return false;
    };
    if super::sunset_explosive_tactics::endangered(own, health, game.creative) {
        return false;
    }
    kind != Kind::Crystal || own <= settings.n("Max self damage")
}

fn body_points(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<Vec<[f64; 3]>> {
    let b = game.player.as_ref()?.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    super::sunset_explosive_policy::samples(lo.components(), hi.components())
}
fn guard_open_points(game: &Game<'_>, anchor: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<(usize, Vec<[f64; 3]>)> {
    let points = body_points(game)?;
    let total = points.len();
    let blast = center(anchor, false);
    let mut open = Vec::with_capacity(total);
    for point in points {
        match super::sunset_explosive_damage::known_line(game, point, blast, Some(anchor), budget)? {
            true => open.push(point),
            false => {}
        }
    }
    Some((total, open))
}
fn covered(game: &Game<'_>, anchor: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> bool {
    guard_open_points(game, anchor, budget)
        .is_some_and(|(total, open)| policy::guard_already_covered(total, open.len()))
}
fn guard_slot(game: &Game<'_>, run: &Run) -> Option<usize> {
    guard_slot_at(game, run.pos, run.settings.p("Mode") == "Double")
}
fn guard_slot_at(game: &Game<'_>, anchor: [i32; 3], double: bool) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut weaker = None;
    for slot in 0..9 {
        let Some(stack) = game.inventory[slot].as_ref().filter(|s| s.count > 0) else {
            continue;
        };
        if util::short(&stack.item) == "glowstone" {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(state) = game.items().get(&stack.item).and_then(|i| i.block) else {
            continue;
        };
        let facts = game.res.facts().get(state);
        if !facts.full_collision
            || facts.block_entity
            || matches!(util::short(&facts.name), "tnt" | "respawn_anchor")
            || facts.classes.iter().any(|c| c.ends_with("FallingBlock"))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if facts.explosion_resistance >= 600.0 {
            return Some(slot);
        }
        weaker.get_or_insert(slot);
    }
    if weaker.is_some() {
        return weaker;
    }
    let needed = u32::from(anchor_charge(game, anchor).unwrap_or(0) == 0) + u32::from(double);
    let count = game.inventory[..9]
        .iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter(|s| util::short(&s.item) == "glowstone")
        .fold(0u32, |n, s| n.saturating_add(s.count));
    (count > needed).then(|| util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "glowstone")).flatten()
}
fn guard_place(game: &Game<'_>, anchor: [i32; 3], budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<([i32; 3], Click)> {
    let feet = util::block_pos(game)?;
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let player = game.player.as_ref()?.bounds();
    let (_, points) = guard_open_points(game, anchor, budget)?;
    let needed = policy::guard_shade_needed(points.len())?;
    let blast = center(anchor, false);
    let mut cells = Vec::with_capacity(12);
    for dx in -1..=1 {
        for dz in -1..=1 {
            if dx != 0 || dz != 0 {
                cells.push([feet[0] + dx, feet[1], feet[2] + dz]);
            }
        }
    }
    for d in [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]] {
        let p = [anchor[0] + d[0], anchor[1], anchor[2] + d[1]];
        if !cells.contains(&p) {
            cells.push(p);
        }
    }
    let mut ranked = Vec::with_capacity(12);
    for cell in cells {
        let lo = cell.map(f64::from);
        let hi = lo.map(|n| n + 1.0);
        let box_ = horizon_core::geometry::Aabb::new(
            horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(lo[0], lo[1], lo[2]),
            horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(hi[0], hi[1], hi[2]),
        );
        if cell == anchor
            || box_.intersects(player)
            || policy::ray(eye, std::array::from_fn(|i| blast[i] - eye[i]), lo, hi, util::dist(eye, blast)).is_some()
        {
            continue;
        }
        let shade = points
            .iter()
            .filter(|point| {
                policy::ray(**point, std::array::from_fn(|i| blast[i] - point[i]), lo, hi, util::dist(**point, blast))
                    .is_some()
            })
            .count();
        if shade < needed {
            continue;
        }
        ranked.push((cell, shade, util::dist(center(cell, false), blast)));
    }
    ranked.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1).then(a.2.total_cmp(&b.2)));
    for (cell, _, _) in ranked {
        if let Some(click) = support(game, cell, budget) {
            return Some((cell, click));
        }
    }
    None
}
fn use_action(game: &Game<'_>, step: Step, click: Click, slot: usize, destination: [i32; 3]) -> Action {
    Action::Use {
        step,
        click,
        slot,
        select: None,
        destination,
        before: game.world.block(destination[0], destination[1], destination[2]).0,
    }
}
fn detonator(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    // Partial charged anchors pass to offhand glowstone; never accidentally
    // charge during a transaction that was approved as a detonation.
    if stack(game, OFFHAND, "glowstone") {
        return None;
    }
    util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "totem_of_undying")
        .or_else(|| (0..9).find(|&slot| combat_item(game, game.inventory[slot].as_ref())))
}
fn melee_item(game: &Game<'_>, stack: &horizon_client::items::ItemStack) -> bool {
    util::short(&stack.item) == "mace"
        || ["minecraft:swords", "minecraft:axes"]
            .iter()
            .any(|tag| game.items().item_tags.get(*tag).is_some_and(|items| items.contains(&*stack.item)))
}
fn combat_item(game: &Game<'_>, stack: Option<&horizon_client::items::ItemStack>) -> bool {
    stack.is_none_or(|stack| {
        stack.count == 0 || util::short(&stack.item) == "totem_of_undying" || melee_item(game, stack)
    })
}
fn recognized_hand(game: &Game<'_>, kind: Kind) -> bool {
    let held = game.inventory.get(game.selected).and_then(|s| s.as_ref());
    match kind {
        Kind::Crystal => {
            stack(game, game.selected, "end_crystal")
                || (stack(game, OFFHAND, "end_crystal") && combat_item(game, held))
                || (held.is_some_and(|s| melee_item(game, s))
                    && (game.offhand.is_none() || stack(game, OFFHAND, "totem_of_undying"))
                    && util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "end_crystal").is_some())
        }
        Kind::Anchor => true, // Actual ray intent and detonator preflight decide.
    }
}

// Called immediately before vanilla's native use-item operation. True consumes
// that one operation, including repeats during an owned manual sequence.
pub(super) fn intercept_use(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    // Native use clicks are consumed on an input tick, after a quick release
    // may already have cleared held state. Retain only one fresh press in the
    // same remote session; consuming it here never starts a held Crystal run.
    let press = state(|s| s.anchor_press.take()).filter(|press| {
        game.ticks >= press.tick
            && game.ticks - press.tick <= 2
            && game.dim == press.dimension
            && game
                .remote
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == press.entity && Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, &press.session))
    });
    let held = down(game);
    if !held && press.is_none() {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(kind) = state(|s| s.run.as_ref().map(|r| r.sequence.kind)) {
        return held || kind == Kind::Anchor;
    }
    let anchor = macro_module(ANCHOR);
    if state(|s| s.anchor_latched) && anchor.is_some() {
        return true;
    }
    let pick = game.pick().map(|hit| (hit.pos, hit.face));
    if game.native_window() && game.native_on(sunset::ID) && util::in_world(game) && !game.anchor_works() {
        if let (Some(m), Some((p, _))) = (anchor.as_ref(), pick) {
            if anchor_charge(game, p).is_some()
                && !super::sunset_loot_guard::allows(game, Blast::anchor(p), m.b("Protect loot"))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    if !held && !press.is_some_and(|p| p.start_allowed) {
        return false;
    }
    if !allowed(game) {
        return false;
    }
    let crystal = macro_module(CRYSTAL);
    if anchor.is_none() && crystal.is_none() {
        return false;
    }
    if !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::refresh(game) {
        return false;
    }
    let pick = camera_click(game).map(|click| {
        (
            click.pos,
            match click.face {
                0 => [0, -1, 0],
                1 => [0, 1, 0],
                2 => [0, 0, -1],
                3 => [0, 0, 1],
                4 => [-1, 0, 0],
                _ => [1, 0, 0],
            },
        )
    });
    let mut budget = Budget::new(16);
    let on_anchor = pick.is_some_and(|(p, _)| anchor_charge(game, p).is_some());
    let anchor_intent = on_anchor || stack(game, game.selected, "respawn_anchor");
    if !held && !anchor_intent {
        return false;
    }
    let (settings, kind, pos, step, cid) = if anchor_intent {
        let Some(m) = anchor else {
            return false;
        };
        if game.anchor_works() || !anchor_can_click(game) {
            return false;
        }
        let Some((p, face)) = pick else {
            return false;
        };
        let target = if on_anchor {
            p
        } else {
            if !inert(game, p) || policy::face(face).is_none() {
                return false;
            }
            std::array::from_fn(|i| p[i] + face[i])
        };
        if !on_anchor && support(game, target, &mut budget).is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        if !super::sunset_loot_guard::allows(game, Blast::anchor(target), m.b("Protect loot")) {
            return true;
        }
        if !recognized_hand(game, Kind::Anchor) || stack(game, OFFHAND, "glowstone") {
            return false;
        }
        if !policy::anchor_supplied(
            anchor_charge(game, target).is_some_and(|charge| charge > 0),
            util::find_hotbar(game, |name| name == "glowstone").is_some(),
            detonator(game).is_some(),
        ) {
            return false;
        }
        if m.b("Safe anchor")
            && m.p("If unguarded") == "Cancel"
            && guard_slot_at(game, target, m.p("Mode") == "Double").is_none()
        {
            return false;
        }
        (m, Kind::Anchor, target, if on_anchor { Step::Guard } else { Step::AnchorPlace }, None)
    } else {
        let Some(m) = crystal.filter(|_| recognized_hand(game, Kind::Crystal)) else {
            return false;
        };
        if let Some((cid, at, _)) = crosshair_crystal(game, &mut budget) {
            let p = [at[0].floor() as i32, at[1].floor() as i32 - 1, at[2].floor() as i32];
            (m, Kind::Crystal, p, Step::CrystalBreak, Some(cid))
        } else {
            let Some(click) = crystal_click(game) else {
                return false;
            };
            let p = click.pos;
            let face = match click.face {
                0 => [0, -1, 0],
                1 => [0, 1, 0],
                2 => [0, 0, -1],
                3 => [0, 0, 1],
                4 => [-1, 0, 0],
                _ => [1, 0, 0],
            };
            if matches!(util::short(&util::facts(game, p).name), "obsidian" | "bedrock") {
                if !crystal_room(game, p) {
                    return false;
                }
                (m, Kind::Crystal, p, Step::CrystalPlace, None)
            } else {
                if !m.b("Auto obsidian") || !inert(game, p) || item_slot(game, "obsidian").is_none() {
                    return false;
                }
                let target = std::array::from_fn(|i| p[i] + face[i]);
                if support(game, target, &mut budget).is_none() {
                    return false;
                }
                (m, Kind::Crystal, target, Step::Base, None)
            }
        }
    };
    if kind == Kind::Crystal && step != Step::CrystalBreak {
        let Some(click) = crystal_click(game) else {
            return false;
        };
        let base = matches!(util::short(&util::facts(game, click.pos).name), "obsidian" | "bedrock");
        let item = if step == Step::Base { "obsidian" } else { "end_crystal" };
        if crystal_route(game, item, base, game.selected).is_none()
            || (step == Step::Base && crystal_route(game, "end_crystal", true, game.selected).is_none())
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if !super::sunset_loot_guard::allows(game, planned_blast(kind, pos), settings.b("Protect loot")) {
        return true;
    }
    let owner = if kind == Kind::Anchor { ANCHOR } else { CRYSTAL };
    if !super::sunset_combat_control::claim(owner) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        super::sunset_combat_control::release(owner);
        return false;
    };
    state(|s| {
        if s.last_session.as_ref().is_none_or(|old| !Arc::ptr_eq(old, &remote.session.counters)) {
            s.retries.clear();
            s.last_deed = None;
            s.pace_gap = 0;
            s.main = None;
            s.last_session = Some(remote.session.counters.clone());
        }
        s.token = s.token.wrapping_add(1);
        if kind == Kind::Anchor {
            s.anchor_latched = true;
        }
        s.run = Some(Run {
            owner,
            sequence: Sequence::new(kind, step, settings.p("Mode") == "Double"),
            settings: Arc::new(settings),
            pos,
            previous: game.selected,
            owned: game.selected,
            session: remote.session.counters.clone(),
            entity: remote.entity_id,
            dimension: game.dim,
            pending: None,
            ready: game.ticks,
            crystal: cid,
            guard: None,
            token: s.token,
            queued_at: None,
            deadline: game.ticks.saturating_add(if kind == Kind::Anchor { 5 } else { 60 }),
            replace_click: None,
            guard_block: None,
            guard_tries: 0,
            guard_confirmed: false,
        });
    });
    // Ownership starts before the intercepted vanilla packet could be sent.
    true
}

fn observed(game: &Game<'_>, action: Action, run: &Run) -> bool {
    match action {
        Action::Attack { id, .. } => !game.crystals.iter().any(|c| c.id == id),
        Action::Use { step, destination, before, .. } => match step {
            Step::Base => name_is(game, destination, "obsidian"),
            Step::Guard => run.guard_block.is_some_and(|expected| {
                game.res.facts().get(horizon_world::registry::BlockStateId(expected)).name
                    == util::facts(game, destination).name
            }),
            Step::CrystalPlace => crystal_on(game, destination).is_some(),
            Step::AnchorPlace => anchor_charge(game, destination).is_some(),
            Step::Charge => {
                game.world.block(destination[0], destination[1], destination[2]).0 != before
                    && anchor_charge(game, destination).is_some_and(|n| n > 0)
            }
            Step::Detonate => !game.is_anchor(game.world.block(destination[0], destination[1], destination[2])),
            _ => false,
        },
    }
}
fn next_action(game: &mut Game<'_>, run: &Run, budget: &mut Budget, actual: bool) -> Option<Action> {
    if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Anchor && !anchor_can_click(game) {
        return None;
    }
    let p = run.pos;
    let step = run.sequence.step;
    match step {
        Step::Base | Step::Guard => {
            let destination = if step == Step::Guard { run.guard? } else { p };
            let click = if step == Step::Base {
                let click = crystal_click(game)?;
                if crystal_intent(game, &run.settings, run.previous, budget)?.0 != p || !visible(game, click, budget) {
                    return None;
                }
                let normal = match click.face {
                    0 => [0, -1, 0],
                    1 => [0, 1, 0],
                    2 => [0, 0, -1],
                    3 => [0, 0, 1],
                    4 => [-1, 0, 0],
                    5 => [1, 0, 0],
                    _ => return None,
                };
                let route = crystal_route(game, "obsidian", false, run.previous)?;
                let slot = if route.offhand { OFFHAND } else { route.select.unwrap_or(game.selected) };
                let native =
                    super::remote::sunset_aura_base::BaseClick { clicked: click.pos, normal, point: click.hit };
                let range = super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game)?.0;
                let mut rays = 12;
                if !super::remote::sunset_aura_base::valid(game, p, slot, native, range, &mut rays) {
                    return None;
                }
                click
            } else {
                support(game, destination, budget)?
            };
            if step == Step::Base {
                crystal_use_action(game, run, step, click, "obsidian", destination)
            } else {
                Some(use_action(game, step, click, guard_slot(game, run)?, destination))
            }
        }
        Step::CrystalPlace => {
            if !crystal_room(game, p) {
                return None;
            }
            let click = crystal_click(game)?;
            if click.pos != p {
                return None;
            }
            // Placement is not a detonation. Its geometry and native loot
            // veto remain required; a later break reevaluates actual damage.
            if !visible(game, click, budget) {
                return None;
            }
            crystal_use_action(game, run, step, click, "end_crystal", p)
        }
        Step::CrystalBreak => {
            if !super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::sprint_synced(game) {
                return None;
            }
            // Perfect timing: the break waits for the nearest enemy's hurt time to run out, so the blast counts.
            if run.settings.b("Perfect timing") && enemy_hurt(game) {
                return None;
            }
            let id = run.crystal.or_else(|| crystal_on(game, p))?;
            if !state(|s| s.retries.allows(id, game.ticks)) {
                return None;
            }
            // The manual crystal must remain on the real camera ray. Silent
            // automation never searches for a different nearby crystal.
            let (hit_id, at, aim) = crosshair_crystal(game, budget)?;
            if hit_id != id || !safe_blast(game, &run.settings, Kind::Crystal, Blast::explosion(at, 6.0), None, budget)
            {
                return None;
            }
            let slot = weapon_route(game)?;
            if slot == game.selected && weak_settling(game) {
                return None;
            }
            Some(Action::Attack { id, at, aim, slot })
        }
        Step::AnchorPlace => {
            if game.anchor_works() {
                return None;
            }
            let click = if let Some(click) = run.replace_click.filter(|_| run.sequence.refilled) {
                let eye = game.eye_position()?;
                let (yaw, pitch) = super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game)?;
                let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(pitch).to_radians());
                let direction = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
                let lo = p.map(f64::from);
                let hi = lo.map(|n| n + 1.0);
                policy::ray(eye, direction, lo, hi, super::sunset_explosive_tactics::interaction_ranges(game)?.0)?;
                if !visible(game, click, budget) {
                    return None;
                }
                click
            } else {
                support(game, p, budget)?
            };
            Some(use_action(game, step, click, item_slot(game, "respawn_anchor")?, p))
        }
        Step::Charge => {
            if game.anchor_works() || anchor_charge(game, p).is_none_or(|n| n >= 4) {
                return None;
            }
            Some(use_action(game, step, anchor_deed_click(game, p, budget, actual)?, item_slot(game, "glowstone")?, p))
        }
        Step::Detonate => {
            if game.anchor_works() || anchor_charge(game, p).is_none_or(|n| n == 0) {
                return None;
            }
            if run.settings.b("Safe anchor")
                && run.settings.p("If unguarded") == "Cancel"
                && !run.guard_confirmed
                && !covered(game, p, budget)
            {
                return None;
            }
            let slot = if run.sequence.remaining > 1 {
                util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "respawn_anchor")?
            } else {
                detonator(game)?
            };
            if !safe_blast(game, &run.settings, Kind::Anchor, Blast::anchor(p), Some(slot), budget) {
                return None;
            }
            Some(use_action(game, step, anchor_deed_click(game, p, budget, actual)?, slot, p))
        }
        Step::Done => None,
    }
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, modules: &[Module], _ticks: u64) {
    if !active() && !modules.iter().any(|m| m.on && (m.name == CRYSTAL_MODULE || m.name == ANCHOR_MODULE) && m.b(MACRO)) {
        return;
    }
    if game.selected < 9 {
        note_main(game);
    }
    if !game.native_playing() || gui_open() {
        focus_lost();
    }
    if game.ticks % 20 == 0 {
        state(|s| s.retries.retain(|id| game.crystals.iter().any(|c| c.id == id)));
    }
    if !down(game) {
        state(|s| s.anchor_latched = false);
    }
    let Some(mut run) = state(|s| s.run.clone()) else {
        return;
    };
    if !allowed(game)
        || (run.sequence.kind == Kind::Anchor && !anchor_can_click(game))
        || !same_session(game, &run)
        || !enabled(&run)
        || !loot_allowed(game, &run)
        || game.selected != run.owned
        || game.ticks >= run.deadline
        || (run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal && !down(game))
        || !super::sunset_combat_control::claim(run.owner)
    {
        reset(game);
        return;
    }
    if let Some((action, sent)) = run.pending {
        let Some(sent) = sent else {
            if run.queued_at.is_some_and(|t| t.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(200)) {
                reset(game);
            }
            return;
        };
        let observation = observed(game, action, &run);
        let timeout = if action.step() == Step::Guard {
            run.ready.saturating_sub(sent).max(1)
        } else if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
            u64::from(super::sunset_prediction::rtt(game).saturating_add(2).clamp(4, 20))
        } else {
            run.deadline.saturating_sub(sent)
        };
        let wait = policy::wait(sent, game.ticks, observation, timeout);
        match wait {
            Wait::Pending => return,
            Wait::Expired => {
                if action.step() == Step::Guard && run.guard_tries < 2 {
                    run.pending = None;
                    run.guard = None;
                    state(|s| s.run = Some(run));
                    return;
                }
                reset(game);
                return;
            }
            Wait::Acknowledged => {
                if action.step() == Step::Guard {
                    run.guard_confirmed = true;
                }
                if action.step() == Step::CrystalPlace {
                    run.crystal = crystal_on(game, run.pos);
                }
                run.sequence.acknowledged(action.step());
                run.pending = None;
                state(|s| {
                    if s.run.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.token == run.token) {
                        s.run = Some(run.clone());
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    if !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::refresh(game) {
        reset(game);
        return;
    }
    if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
        let mut budget = Budget::new(8);
        if let Some((pos, step, cid)) = crystal_intent(game, &run.settings, run.previous, &mut budget) {
            run.pos = pos;
            run.sequence = Sequence::new(Kind::Crystal, step, false);
            run.crystal = cid;
        } else {
            run.deadline = game.ticks.saturating_add(60);
            state(|s| s.run = Some(run));
            return;
        }
        // The held ray is replanned only after any real prior transaction was
        // observed; it never continues a pinned old base after the camera moved.
        run.deadline = game.ticks.saturating_add(60);
        state(|s| s.run = Some(run.clone()));
    }
    if run.sequence.step == Step::Done {
        complete(game);
        return;
    }
    if game.ticks < run.ready {
        return;
    }
    if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal
        && !state(|s| policy::action_due(s.last_deed, game.ticks, delay_for(&run, run.sequence.step), s.pace_gap))
    {
        return;
    }
    // Wait for hurt time: the second anchor of a Double waits (half a second at most) for the nearest enemy's hurt
    // time to run out, so its blast counts.
    if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Anchor && run.sequence.step == Step::AnchorPlace && run.sequence.refilled && run.settings.b("Wait for hurt time") {
        let since = state(|s| match s.hurt_wait {
            Some((token, tick)) if token == run.token => tick,
            _ => s.hurt_wait.insert((run.token, game.ticks)).1,
        });
        if enemy_hurt(game) && game.ticks < since + 10 {
            return;
        }
    }
    let mut budget = Budget::new(24);
    if run.sequence.step == Step::Guard {
        if !run.settings.b("Safe anchor") || covered(game, run.pos, &mut budget) {
            run.sequence.acknowledged(Step::Guard);
        } else if run.guard.is_none() {
            run.guard = guard_place(game, run.pos, &mut budget).map(|(p, _)| p);
            if run.guard.is_none() || guard_slot(game, &run).is_none() {
                if run.settings.p("If unguarded") == "Cancel" {
                    reset(game);
                    return;
                }
                run.sequence.acknowledged(Step::Guard);
            }
        }
    }
    if run.sequence.step == Step::Charge && anchor_charge(game, run.pos).is_some_and(|n| n > 0) {
        run.sequence.acknowledged(Step::Charge);
    }
    if run.sequence.step == Step::Detonate && run.sequence.remaining > 1 {
        let eligible = sent_anchor_click(game, run.pos, &mut budget).is_some_and(|click| {
            policy::double_eligible(
                run.settings.p("Mode") == "Double",
                click.face,
                run.pos[1],
                game.player.as_ref().map_or(i32::MAX, |p| p.position.y.floor() as i32),
                util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "respawn_anchor").is_some(),
                util::find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "glowstone").is_some(),
            )
        });
        if !eligible {
            run.sequence.remaining = 1;
        }
    }
    state(|s| {
        if s.run.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.token == run.token) {
            s.run = Some(run.clone());
        }
    });
    let Some(action) = next_action(game, &run, &mut budget, false) else {
        if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
            return;
        }
        reset(game);
        return;
    };
    if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal
        && !state(|s| policy::action_due(s.last_deed, game.ticks, delay_for(&run, action.step()), s.pace_gap))
    {
        return;
    }
    queue(game, &run, action);
}

fn queue(game: &mut Game<'_>, run: &Run, action: Action) {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        reset(game);
        return;
    };
    let token = run.token;
    let owner = run.owner;
    let queued = Instant::now();
    state(|s| {
        if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
            r.pending = Some((action, None));
            r.queued_at = Some(queued);
        }
    });
    let (yaw, pitch) = sunset::look_at(eye, action.aim());
    let accepted = sunset::try_turn_then(owner, yaw, pitch, move |game| {
        let Some(run) =
            state(|s| s.run.clone()).filter(|r| r.token == token && r.pending.is_some_and(|(_, sent)| sent.is_none()))
        else {
            return;
        };
        if queued.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(200)
            || !allowed(game)
            || (run.sequence.kind == Kind::Anchor && !anchor_can_click(game))
            || !same_session(game, &run)
            || !enabled(&run)
            || !loot_allowed(game, &run)
            || game.selected != run.owned
            || !super::sunset_combat_control::owns(owner)
            || !game.eye_position().is_some_and(|now| in_range(now, eye, 0.5))
            || (run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal && !down(game))
        {
            reset(game);
            return;
        }
        if !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::refresh(game) {
            reset(game);
            return;
        }
        let mut budget = Budget::new(24);
        let Some(fresh) = next_action(game, &run, &mut budget, true) else {
            reset(game);
            return;
        };
        // A stale look must never be reused for a changed hand, face or entity.
        let same = match (action, fresh) {
            (Action::Attack { id, at, slot, .. }, Action::Attack { id: b, at: c, slot: d, .. }) => {
                id == b && slot == d && in_range(at, c, 0.01)
            }
            (
                Action::Use { step, click, slot, select, destination, before },
                Action::Use { step: b, click: c, slot: d, select: selected, destination: e, before: f },
            ) => {
                step == b
                    && slot == d
                    && select == selected
                    && destination == e
                    && before == f
                    && click.pos == c.pos
                    && click.face == c.face
                    && in_range(click.hit, c.hit, 1.0e-4)
            }
            _ => false,
        };
        if !same {
            reset(game);
            return;
        }
        // Native f32 sent angles can shift a same-face contact by tiny roundoff.
        // Send the newly clipped cursor, never the queued old point.
        let action = fresh;
        match action {
            Action::Attack { id, slot, .. } => {
                if slot != game.selected {
                    hold(game, slot);
                    state(|s| {
                        if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                            r.owned = slot;
                        }
                    });
                    note_main(game);
                }
                if weak_settling(game) {
                    state(|s| {
                        if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                            r.pending = None;
                            r.queued_at = None;
                            r.ready = game.ticks.saturating_add(1);
                        }
                    });
                    return;
                }
                game.send(S::Attack(play::Attack { id: id as i32 }));
                game.reset_attack_strength();
                state(|s| s.retries.sent(id, game.ticks));
            }
            Action::Use { click, slot, select, step, .. } => {
                // Reselecting a pass-through main hand is part of the accepted
                // deed, not planning; preserve the existing session/slot lease.
                if let Some(selected) = select {
                    hold(game, selected);
                    note_main(game);
                    state(|s| {
                        if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                            r.owned = selected;
                        }
                    });
                }
                if slot != OFFHAND {
                    hold(game, slot);
                    note_main(game);
                    state(|s| {
                        if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                            r.owned = slot;
                        }
                    });
                }
                let sequence = util::sequence(game);
                game.send(S::UseItemOn(play::UseItemOn {
                    hand: i32::from(slot == OFFHAND),
                    pos: click.pos,
                    face: click.face,
                    cursor: std::array::from_fn(|i| (click.hit[i] - f64::from(click.pos[i])) as f32),
                    inside: false,
                    world_border: false,
                    sequence,
                }));
                state(|s| {
                    if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                        if step == Step::Guard {
                            r.guard_tries = r.guard_tries.saturating_add(1);
                            r.guard_block = game
                                .stack_in(slot)
                                .and_then(|stack| game.items().get(&stack.item))
                                .and_then(|i| i.block)
                                .map(|id| id.0);
                        }
                        if step == Step::Detonate && r.sequence.remaining > 1 {
                            r.replace_click = Some(click);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        game.swing_arm();
        game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
        let delay = delay_for(&run, action.step());
        state(|s| {
            if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
                s.last_deed = Some(game.ticks);
                s.pace_gap = if run.settings.b("Human pace") { policy::human_gap(random(s)) } else { 0 };
            }
            if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                r.pending = Some((action, Some(game.ticks)));
                if action.step() == Step::Guard && r.settings.p("If unguarded") == "Detonate" {
                    r.pending = None;
                    r.sequence.acknowledged(Step::Guard);
                }
                r.queued_at = None;
                r.ready = game.ticks.saturating_add(if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
                    1
                } else {
                    delay.clamp(0., 5.) as u64 + 1
                });
                let window = if run.sequence.kind == Kind::Crystal {
                    60
                } else if action.step() == Step::Guard && run.settings.p("If unguarded") == "Cancel" {
                    u64::from(super::sunset_prediction::rtt(game).saturating_add(2).clamp(4, 20))
                } else {
                    5
                };
                r.deadline = r.ready.saturating_add(window);
            }
        });
    });
    if !accepted {
        state(|s| {
            if let Some(r) = s.run.as_mut().filter(|r| r.token == token) {
                r.pending = None;
                r.queued_at = None;
            }
        });
    }
}

```

`mixins/sunset/combat_remote.rs`:

```rs
// Bits of the connection the combat modules read and send: the ping, the server's sprint, a player's game mode, a
// menu's state, a swap click.
pub(crate) fn latency(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>) -> Option<i32> {
    let remote = game.remote.as_ref()?;
    let milliseconds = remote.tab_players.get(&remote.profile)?.latency;
    (milliseconds >= 0).then_some(milliseconds)
}
pub(crate) fn sprint_synced(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|player| player.sprinting == crate::game::sunset_combat_wire::sent_sprinting(game))
}

// The entity is a player the server told of (not you).
pub(crate) fn is_player(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>, id: i32) -> bool {
    game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|remote| id != remote.entity_id && remote.level_players.contains_key(&id))
}

// Kept profile names outlive tab-list removal, so they cannot establish that
// a player is still listed or that their current mode permits targeting.
pub(crate) fn player_mode(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>, id: u32) -> Option<i32> {
    let remote = game.remote.as_ref()?;
    let uuid = remote.level_players.get(&(id as i32))?;
    Some(remote.tab_players.get(uuid)?.game_mode)
}

// The menu's state id, as the last server packet left it.
pub(crate) fn container_state(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>) -> Option<i32> {
    Some(game.remote.as_ref()?.state_id)
}

// The last input sent had no movement keys and no sprint: a menu click now is one a standing player makes.
pub(crate) fn quiet(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|remote| !remote.was_sprinting && remote.last_input & 0b0011_1111 == 0)
}

// A swap click (inventory slot `from` with hotbar slot `to`, or the offhand as 504) in `menu`, sent without changing
// the slots here first: the server's slot packets then say what really happened.
pub(crate) fn swap_unpredicted(game: &mut crate::game::Game<'_>, menu: &(i32, String), from: usize, to: usize) -> bool {
    let locked = |slot: usize| crate::game::sunset_loadouts::locked(slot);
    if game.carried.is_some() || from == to || &game.remote_menu() != menu || !(to < 9 || to == 504) || locked(from) || locked(to) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(state) = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.state_id) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(slot) = crate::game::Game::menu_slot_index(&menu.1, from).and_then(|slot| i16::try_from(slot).ok()) else {
        return false;
    };
    game.send(horizon_protocol::packets::play::Serverbound::ContainerClick(horizon_protocol::packets::play::ContainerClick {
        container: menu.0,
        state,
        slot,
        button: if to == 504 { 40 } else { to as i8 },
        input: super::input_ordinal(horizon_client::menu::Input::Swap),
        changed: Vec::new(),
        carried: None,
    }));
    true
}
```

`mixins/sunset/combat_use.rs`:

```rs
// A right click: No Interact stops it on what it lists and by Anti action; a combat macro takes it when you click with a crystal or an
// anchor; Fast Use's Throwables hold one back, and with Burst add more of the same use before it (each re-enters here
// and goes through).
fn sunset_combat_use(game: &mut crate::game::Game<'_>) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<()> {
    use crate::game::sunset_combat_inventory as inventory;
    if inventory::bursting() {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    if crate::game::sunset_parity::use_blocked(game)
        || crate::game::sunset_click_fix::use_blocked(game)
        || crate::game::sunset_combat_macros::intercept_use(game)
        || inventory::intercept_use(game)
    {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(());
    }
    while inventory::burst_more(game) {
        game.remote_use();
    }
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(())
}
```

```rs
fn sunset_combat_use_hand(

    }
```

`mixins/sunset/combat_wire.rs`:

```rs
// What went on the wire last (after Sunset changed it): the look and the sprint the server has.
use super::{Dim, Game};
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::Serverbound as S;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
type Session = Arc<Mutex<Option<Arc<horizon_protocol::connection::Counters>>>>;
static LOOK: Mutex<Option<(Session, Dim, (f32, f32))>> = Mutex::new(None);
static SPRINT: Mutex<Option<(Session, Dim, bool)>> = Mutex::new(None);
pub(super) fn sent_look(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    LOOK.lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|(session, dim, _)| {
            *dim == game.dim
                && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|remote| Arc::ptr_eq(session, &remote.session.counters))
        })
        .map(|(_, _, rotation)| *rotation)
}
pub(super) fn sent_sprinting(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    SPRINT
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|(session, dim, _)| {
            *dim == game.dim
                && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|remote| Arc::ptr_eq(session, &remote.session.counters))
        })
        .is_some_and(|(_, _, sprinting)| *sprinting)
}
pub(super) fn forwarded(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) {
    if let (S::PlayerCommand(command), Some(remote)) = (packet, &game.remote)
        && command.id == remote.entity_id
        && matches!(command.action, 1 | 2)
    {
        *SPRINT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) =
            Some((remote.session.counters.clone(), game.dim, command.action == 1));
    }
    let rotation = match packet {
        S::MovePlayerPosRot(p) => Some((p.yaw, p.pitch)),
        S::MovePlayerRot(p) => Some((p.yaw, p.pitch)),
        S::AcceptTeleportation(p) => Some((p.yaw, p.pitch)),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let (Some(rotation), Some(remote)) = (rotation, &game.remote) {
        *LOOK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some((remote.session.counters.clone(), game.dim, rotation));
    }
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on(super::sunset::ID) {
        return;
    }
    if let S::Attack(p) = packet {
        attack_slow(game, p.id);
    }
    super::sunset_prediction::forwarded(game, packet);
    super::sunset_melee::forwarded(game, packet);
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::forwarded(game, packet);
}

pub(super) fn reset_look() {
    *LOOK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = None;
    *SPRINT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = None;
}

// Player.attack's own side, on the attacking client: a hit on a player with a sprint and over 0.9 of the charge
// knocks back, and the attacker's speed across is cut to 0.6 and the sprint stops. The game's remote attack (and every
// Sunset hit) sends the packet only, but Grim counts the cut as certain then (PacketPlayerAttack: minAttackSlow) and
// keeps no uncut move, so the next movement takes it, before it runs (motion_flags' attack slow).
// The charge is the game's own (getAttackStrengthScale): the attack speed of the item the last tick held
// (`attack_item`), not of one switched in for this hit. Its modifiers come with the player's tick, on the server too,
// so a sword charged long ago swapped for a mace still hits charged, and the cut is due.
fn attack_slow(game: &Game<'_>, id: i32) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let charge = game.hand_strength.scale(0.5, game.main_hand_attack_speed());
    let player = super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::is_player(game, id);
    let cut = p.sprinting && charge > 0.9 && player;
    if cut {
        horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::add_attack_slow(game.ticks);
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/crit_hook.rs`:

```rs
// Criticals: your own hit on a mob waits for the hop or the fall that makes it critical. While a combat macro runs,
// clicks do nothing, nor those No Interact stops (its lists, Hit fix, Sword on shield); Aim Assist's Silent aim and Hit
// flick take a miss or a hit next, then No miss delay drops a swing at nothing; Packet Mine takes a click on a block;
// Friend Guard and Auto Weapon's Reach poke see the click first.
fn sunset_crit_click(game: &mut crate::game::Game<'_>) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<bool> {
    if crate::game::sunset_combat_macros::active()
        || crate::game::sunset_parity::hit_blocked(game)
        || crate::game::sunset_click_fix::hit_blocked(game)
    {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(false);
    }
    if let Some(instant) = crate::game::sunset_click_fix::aim_click(game) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(instant);
    }
    if crate::game::sunset_click_fix::miss_blocked(game) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(false);
    }
    if crate::game::sunset_packet_mine::click(game, true) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(false);
    }
    if let Some(instant) = crate::game::sunset_melee::before_click(game) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(instant);
    }
    match crate::game::sunset::crit_click(game) {
        Some(instant) => std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(instant),
        None => std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(()),
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/crosshair.rs`:

```rs
// Crosshair: Sunset's own crosshair, drawn as shapes. Each hud_layers call hands the frame to the hud crate's hook,
// which draws it only where the game draws its own crosshair.

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Category, ID, Module};
use super::sunset_crosshair_math::{Style, geometry};
use horizon_client::hud::sunset_crosshair::{self as bridge, Frame};
use horizon_client::hud::HudBatch;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![Module::new(
        "Crosshair",
        Category::Render,
        "Custom crosshair.",
    )
    .pick("Mode", &["Cross", "Dot"])
    .num("Length", 6.0, 1.0, 32.0, 1.0)
    .num("Gap", 3.0, 0.0, 32.0, 1.0)
    .num("Thickness", 1.0, 1.0, 8.0, 1.0)
    .bool("Center dot", false)
    .num("Dot size", 2.0, 1.0, 8.0, 1.0)
    .num("Outline", 1.0, 0.0, 4.0, 1.0)
    .colour("Color", "White")
    .colour("Outline color", "Black")]
}

// Called at HEAD Game::hud_layers. Reset before every gate, including an early
// screen/loading exit, so a previous enabled frame cannot suppress vanilla.
pub(super) fn prepare(game: &Game<'_>, size: [u32; 2]) {
    bridge::set_frame(Frame::empty());
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on(ID) || !game.native_playing()
        || game.player.is_none() || game.ui.hide_gui || !game.camera_type.first_person()
        || game.debug_crosshair() || (game.spectator() && !game.spectator_crosshair())
    {
        return;
    }
    super::sunset::ensure_loaded(game);
    // Sunset leaves Screen::Playing active while its pointer-driven ClickGUI
    // is open. This extra gate covers that overlay, including its close frame.
    if super::sunset::gui_open() {
        return;
    }
    // Borrow settings under the existing state lock, copying only scalar
    // values. Unlike snapshot()/Module::clone(), this allocates nothing.
    let settings = super::sunset::with(|s| {
        let m = s.module("Crosshair").filter(|m| m.on)?;
        Some((Style {
            dot_only: m.p("Mode") == "Dot",
            center_dot: m.b("Center dot"),
            length: m.n("Length"),
            gap: m.n("Gap"),
            thickness: m.n("Thickness"),
            dot_size: m.n("Dot size"),
            outline: m.n("Outline"),
        }, m.c("Color"), m.c("Outline color")))
    });
    let Some((style, color, outline_color)) = settings else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(shape) = geometry(size, 1.0, style) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut frame = Frame::empty();
    let Some(mark) = game.gui.atlas.sprites.get("gui/sprites/hud/crosshair") else {
        return;
    };
    frame.set_crosshair([mark.u0, mark.v0, mark.u1, mark.v1]);
    // All outlines precede all foreground bars, so neighboring outlines
    // never cover the cross itself at small gaps or large thicknesses.
    if shape.outline > 0.0 {
        for rect in shape.rects() {
            frame.push(rect.expanded(shape.outline).gui(1.0), outline_color);
        }
    }
    for rect in shape.rects() {
        frame.push(rect.gui(1.0), color);
    }
    bridge::set_frame(frame);
}

// Runs after vanilla's mark and indicators, within the host show_hud branch.
// The bridge draws only if that mark was actually suppressed this frame.
pub(super) fn draw(game: &Game<'_>, batch: &mut HudBatch) {
    bridge::draw(batch, &game.gui.atlas);
}
```

`mixins/sunset/crosshair_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Public bridge in horizon_client::hud. The renderer thread publishes one
// small fixed frame at hud_layers HEAD; HUD emission consumes no game locks.

use super::{HudAtlas, HudBatch, Rect, rgba};
use std::cell::Cell;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Frame {
    rects: [[f32; 4]; 10],
    colors: [u32; 10],
    len: usize,
    crosshair_uv: Option<[f32; 4]>,
}

impl Frame {
    pub const fn empty() -> Self {
        Self { rects: [[0.0; 4]; 10], colors: [0; 10], len: 0, crosshair_uv: None }
    }

    pub fn set_crosshair(&mut self, uv: [f32; 4]) {
        self.crosshair_uv = Some(uv);
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, rect: [f32; 4], argb: u32) {
        if self.len < self.rects.len() {
            self.rects[self.len] = rect;
            self.colors[self.len] = argb;
            self.len += 1;
        }
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static FRAME: Cell<Frame> = const { Cell::new(Frame::empty()) };
    static ACTIVE: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    static MARK: Cell<Option<[f32; 4]>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    static PENDING: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
}

pub fn set_frame(frame: Frame) {
    FRAME.with(|current| current.set(frame));
    MARK.with(|mark| mark.set(frame.crosshair_uv));
    PENDING.with(|pending| pending.set(false));
    ACTIVE.with(|active| active.set(frame.len != 0 && frame.crosshair_uv.is_some()));
}

// The vanilla mark is the white 15x15 sprite at this integer GUI origin.
// UV comparison uses the actual resource atlas. Suppressing zero vertices
// leaves invert_since(start) empty; attack-indicator ranges stay untouched.
pub fn suppress_mark(batch: &HudBatch, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, rect: Rect, color: u32) -> bool {
    if !ACTIVE.with(Cell::get) || w != 15.0 || h != 15.0 || color != u32::MAX
        || x != ((batch.width as i32 - 15) / 2) as f32
        || y != ((batch.height as i32 - 15) / 2) as f32
        || !batch.scale.is_finite() || batch.scale <= 0.0
    {
        return false;
    }
    if MARK.with(Cell::get) != Some([rect.u0, rect.v0, rect.u1, rect.v1]) {
        return false;
    }
    PENDING.with(|pending| pending.set(true));
    true
}

pub fn draw(batch: &mut HudBatch, atlas: &HudAtlas) {
    if !PENDING.with(|pending| pending.replace(false)) {
        return;
    }
    // Later HUD sprite calls take the inactive fast path. Every frame resets
    // both flags before any eligibility gates, including early screen exits.
    ACTIVE.with(|active| active.set(false));
    let frame = FRAME.with(Cell::get);
    for i in 0..frame.len {
        let [x, y, w, h] = frame.rects[i].map(|v| v / batch.scale);
        let [a, r, g, b] = frame.colors[i].to_be_bytes();
        batch.fill_quad(atlas, [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + h], [x, y + h]], rgba(r, g, b, a));
    }
}
```
