`mixins/sunset/dashboard.rs`:

```rs
// The Dashboard style of the click GUI: one solid panel with the categories, a list of modules and the settings of the
// one chosen. Its rows are the menu's own, so draw_gui draws them and gui_press clicks them as ever; this file places them
// and draws around them. A left click on a module turns it on or off, a right click shows its settings.

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{CATEGORIES, Hit, Shape, State, accent, aliases, dash_menu, dash_search_clear, fit_to, norm, panel_radius, row_h, row_hh, snap_scroll, text_y, wanted_panel_w};
use super::sunset_smooth as smooth;
use horizon_client::hud::HudBatch;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::Instant;

// What can be clicked around the rows: anywhere on the panel, a category.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Part {
    Frame,
    Page(usize),
}

// The modules a category and search list, kept until those change.
struct Listed {
    page: usize,
    query: String,
    count: usize,
    // The extras Extra Modules left out.
    hidden: Vec<&'static str>,
    ids: Vec<usize>,
}

// One scrolling column: where the wheel put it, its rows' offsets, and how tall they are.
struct Column {
    scroll: f32,
    rows: Vec<(f32, Hit)>,
    content: f32,
}

// The category shown (0 while a search shows every module's matches), the module chosen, this frame's columns, what the
// pointer is on and was on with when that changed and how lit each is, and when the menu opened.
struct View {
    page: usize,
    chosen: Option<usize>,
    listed: Listed,
    list: Column,
    pane: Column,
    hover: Option<(Hit, Instant)>,
    left: Option<(Hit, Instant)>,
    lit: [u32; 2],
    opened: Option<Instant>,
}

static VIEW: Mutex<View> = Mutex::new(View {
    page: 1,
    chosen: None,
    listed: Listed { page: usize::MAX, query: String::new(), count: 0, hidden: Vec::new(), ids: Vec::new() },
    list: Column { scroll: 0.0, rows: Vec::new(), content: 0.0 },
    pane: Column { scroll: 0.0, rows: Vec::new(), content: 0.0 },
    hover: None,
    left: None,
    lit: [0; 2],
    opened: None,
});

fn view<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut View) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut VIEW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// ClickGUI's Style, as sync_flags last read it.
static ON: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub(super) fn set_on(on: bool) {
    ON.store(on, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub(super) fn on() -> bool {
    ON.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

// How wide the panel is for ClickGUI's Panel width: 400 at its least, 540 by default, 680 at its most.
const WIDTH_BASE: f32 = 190.0;
const WIDTH_PER_PANEL: f32 = 3.5;
const HEIGHT: f32 = 420.0;
const SIDE: f32 = 116.0;
// Above and below the columns, so a lit row stays clear of the panel's corners.
const PAD: f32 = 8.0;
const LIST_MIN: f32 = 150.0;
const LIST_MAX: f32 = 270.0;
const SEARCH_H: f32 = 18.0;
const TAB_H: f32 = 20.0;
const TAB_GAP: f32 = 2.0;
const TABS_Y: f32 = 34.0;
const TOGGLE_W: f32 = 14.0;
const TOGGLE_H: f32 = 8.0;
// To the right of a row's toggle.
const TOGGLE_PAD: f32 = 7.0;

const SURFACE: u32 = 0xFF12_1214;
const HAIRLINE: u32 = 0xFF26_262B;
const CONTROL: u32 = 0xFF1C_1C20;
// A lit row or category at its brightest.
const LIT: u32 = 0x10;
const FADE: f32 = 0.08;
const TIP_AFTER: f32 = 0.5;
// The menu coming in.
const OPEN_TIME: f32 = 0.12;
const OPEN_RISE: f32 = 6.0;

fn frame(s: &State) -> [f32; 4] {
    let menu = dash_menu(s);
    frame_in(menu.view_w, menu.view_h)
}

fn frame_in(view_w: f32, view_h: f32) -> [f32; 4] {
    let wanted = WIDTH_BASE + wanted_panel_w() * WIDTH_PER_PANEL;
    let (w, h) = ((view_w - 16.0).clamp(0.0, wanted).floor(), (view_h - 16.0).clamp(0.0, HEIGHT).floor());
    [((view_w - w) / 2.0).floor(), ((view_h - h) / 2.0).floor(), w, h]
}

// The list and the settings beside it.
fn columns(s: &State) -> ([f32; 4], [f32; 4]) {
    let [x, y, w, h] = frame(s);
    let (top, room, rest) = (y + PAD, (h - 2.0 * PAD).max(0.0), (w - SIDE).max(0.0));
    let list = (rest * 0.42).clamp(LIST_MIN, LIST_MAX).min(rest).floor();
    ([x + SIDE, top, list, room], [x + SIDE + list, top, rest - list, room])
}

fn module_h() -> f32 {
    row_hh() + 4.0
}

fn height(s: &State, hit: Hit) -> f32 {
    match hit {
        Hit::Module(_) => module_h(),
        _ => row_h(s, hit),
    }
}

// A category's place, for pages 1 and up.
fn tab_rect(s: &State, page: usize) -> [f32; 4] {
    let [x, y, ..] = frame(s);
    [x + 8.0, y + TABS_Y + (page - 1) as f32 * (TAB_H + TAB_GAP), SIDE - 16.0, TAB_H]
}

// Where a module's name and bound key go in its row: clear of its toggle.
pub(super) fn module_text([x, y, w, h]: [f32; 4]) -> [f32; 4] {
    [x, y + 2.0, w - TOGGLE_W - 4.0, h - 4.0]
}

// Once a frame, before anything reads the columns; a column that got shorter comes back to its end.
pub(super) fn prepare(s: &State) {
    if !on() {
        return;
    }
    let menu = dash_menu(s);
    let room = columns(s).0[3];
    view(|v| {
        let page = if menu.search.is_empty() { v.page } else { 0 };
        let hidden = super::sunset_extra_modules::hidden(&s.modules);
        if v.listed.page != page || v.listed.query != menu.search || v.listed.count != s.modules.len() || v.listed.hidden != hidden {
            let query = norm(menu.search);
            v.listed.ids.clear();
            v.listed.ids.extend(s.modules.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(i, m)| {
                let shown = (page == 0 || m.category == CATEGORIES[page - 1])
                    && !hidden.contains(&m.name)
                    && (norm(m.name).contains(&query) || norm(aliases(m.name)).contains(&query));
                shown.then_some(i)
            }));
            v.listed.page = page;
            v.listed.query.clear();
            v.listed.query.push_str(menu.search);
            v.listed.count = s.modules.len();
            v.listed.hidden = hidden;
        }
        // The first module listed, until another is chosen.
        if !v.chosen.is_some_and(|i| v.listed.ids.contains(&i)) {
            v.chosen = v.listed.ids.first().copied();
            v.pane.scroll = 0.0;
            smooth::jump(smooth::PANE);
        }
        let View { listed, list, pane, chosen, .. } = v;
        list.rows.clear();
        let mut y = 0.0;
        for &i in &listed.ids {
            list.rows.push((y, Hit::Module(i)));
            y += module_h();
        }
        list.content = y;
        pane.rows.clear();
        let mut y = 0.0;
        if let Some(i) = *chosen {
            let m = &s.modules[i];
            pane.rows.push((y, Hit::Bind(i)));
            y += row_hh();
            for j in (0..m.settings.len()).filter(|&j| m.setting_visible(j)) {
                let hit = Hit::Setting(i, j);
                pane.rows.push((y, hit));
                y += row_h(s, hit);
            }
        }
        pane.content = y;
        list.scroll = snap_scroll(&list.rows, list.content, room, list.scroll, 0);
        pane.scroll = snap_scroll(&pane.rows, pane.content, room, pane.scroll, 0);
    });
}

pub(super) fn list_scroll() -> f32 {
    view(|v| v.list.scroll)
}

pub(super) fn pane_scroll() -> f32 {
    view(|v| v.pane.scroll)
}

// The top and bottom of both columns, in this style.
pub(super) fn list_y(s: &State) -> Option<[f32; 2]> {
    on().then(|| {
        let [_, y, _, room] = columns(s).0;
        [y, y + room]
    })
}

// The rows from the one the column's top is in, up to its bottom.
fn visible(rows: &[(f32, Hit)], scroll: f32, room: f32) -> std::ops::Range<usize> {
    let first = rows.partition_point(|(off, _)| *off <= scroll).saturating_sub(1);
    first..first + rows[first..].partition_point(|(off, _)| *off < scroll + room)
}

fn column_rows(s: &State, column: &Column, [x, y, w, room]: [f32; 4], scroll: f32, out: &mut Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)>) {
    out.extend(column.rows[visible(&column.rows, scroll, room)].iter().map(|&(off, hit)| ([x, y + off - scroll, w, height(s, hit)], hit)));
}

// The rows in view, and where. One part way in view is drawn cut.
pub(super) fn rows(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    let (list, pane) = columns(s);
    let (list_at, pane_at) = view(|v| (v.list.scroll, v.pane.scroll));
    let (list_at, pane_at) = (smooth::shown(smooth::DASHBOARD, list_at), smooth::shown(smooth::PANE, pane_at));
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    view(|v| {
        column_rows(s, &v.list, list, list_at, &mut out);
        column_rows(s, &v.pane, pane, pane_at, &mut out);
    });
    out
}

// What the pointer can hit around the rows.
pub(super) fn hits(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    if !on() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut out = vec![(frame(s), Hit::Dash(Part::Frame))];
    out.extend((1..=CATEGORIES.len()).map(|p| (tab_rect(s, p), Hit::Dash(Part::Page(p)))));
    out
}

pub(super) fn press(s: &mut State, part: Part, right: bool) {
    if let (Part::Page(page), false) = (part, right) {
        view(|v| {
            v.page = page;
            v.list.scroll = 0.0;
        });
        smooth::jump(smooth::DASHBOARD);
        dash_search_clear(s);
    }
}

// A module's settings go in the pane.
pub(super) fn choose(i: usize) {
    view(|v| {
        if v.chosen != Some(i) {
            v.chosen = Some(i);
            v.pane.scroll = 0.0;
            smooth::jump(smooth::PANE);
        }
    });
}

pub(super) fn wheel(s: &State, steps: f32, at: (f32, f32)) {
    let (list, pane) = columns(s);
    let by = -steps * 2.0;
    let by = if by > 0.0 { by.ceil() } else { by.floor() } as i32;
    let over_pane = super::sunset::inside(pane, at);
    view(|v| {
        let column = if over_pane { &mut v.pane } else { &mut v.list };
        column.scroll = snap_scroll(&column.rows, column.content, list[3], column.scroll, by);
    });
}

// The menu has just opened.
pub(super) fn opened() {
    view(|v| v.opened = Some(Instant::now()));
}

// How far the menu has come in, while it is coming in: its opacity and how far below its place it still is.
pub(super) fn open_motion() -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    if !on() || !smooth::enabled() {
        return None;
    }
    view(|v| {
        let t = v.opened?.elapsed().as_secs_f32() / OPEN_TIME;
        if t >= 1.0 {
            v.opened = None;
            return None;
        }
        let eased = 1.0 - (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t);
        Some((eased, (1.0 - eased) * OPEN_RISE))
    })
}

// How lit a row or category is: the one under the pointer fades in, the one it left fades out.
pub(super) fn glow(hit: Hit) -> u32 {
    view(|v| {
        if v.hover.is_some_and(|(h, _)| h == hit) {
            v.lit[0]
        } else if v.left.is_some_and(|(h, _)| h == hit) {
            v.lit[1]
        } else {
            0
        }
    })
}

fn follow_hover(hover: Option<Hit>) {
    let animate = smooth::enabled();
    view(|v| {
        if v.hover.map(|(h, _)| h) != hover {
            v.left = v.hover.map(|(h, _)| (h, Instant::now()));
            v.hover = hover.map(|h| (h, Instant::now()));
        }
        let k = |since: Instant| if animate { (since.elapsed().as_secs_f32() / FADE).min(1.0) } else { 1.0 };
        v.lit[0] = v.hover.map_or(0, |(_, since)| (LIT as f32 * k(since)) as u32);
        v.lit[1] = v.left.map_or(0, |(_, since)| (LIT as f32 * (1.0 - k(since))) as u32);
    });
}

// Whether a module's description shows under the pointer: in the panels always, here after a moment on it.
pub(super) fn wants_tip(i: usize) -> bool {
    !on() || view(|v| v.hover.is_some_and(|(h, since)| h == Hit::Module(i) && since.elapsed().as_secs_f32() >= TIP_AFTER))
}

// A panel's corner as a quarter of a squircle (x^4 + y^4 = 1), from its side round to its top.
const CURVE: usize = 14;

fn curve() -> &'static [[f32; 2]; CURVE + 1] {
    static TABLE: OnceLock<[[f32; 2]; CURVE + 1]> = OnceLock::new();
    TABLE.get_or_init(|| {
        std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            let a = i as f32 / CURVE as f32 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
            [a.cos().max(0.0).sqrt(), a.sin().max(0.0).sqrt()]
        })
    })
}

// A squircle: its middle in plain fills, its corners in fans with a soft edge one pixel wide.
pub(super) fn squircle(game: &Game<'_>, batch: &mut HudBatch, [x, y, w, h]: [f32; 4], radius: f32, argb: u32, px: f32) {
    let r = radius.min(w / 2.0).min(h / 2.0);
    game.native_fill(batch, [x + r, y, w - 2.0 * r, h], argb);
    game.native_fill(batch, [x, y + r, r, h - 2.0 * r], argb);
    game.native_fill(batch, [x + w - r, y + r, r, h - 2.0 * r], argb);
    let [a, red, g, b] = argb.to_be_bytes();
    let colour = horizon_client::hud::rgba(red, g, b, a);
    let (inner, outer) = ((r - px * 0.5).max(0.0), r + px * 0.5);
    let points = curve();
    for ([cx, cy], [sx, sy]) in [
        ([x + r, y + r], [-1.0, -1.0]),
        ([x + w - r, y + r], [1.0, -1.0]),
        ([x + w - r, y + h - r], [1.0, 1.0]),
        ([x + r, y + h - r], [-1.0, 1.0]),
    ] {
        let at = |p: [f32; 2], d: f32| [cx + sx * p[0] * d, cy + sy * p[1] * d];
        for pair in points.windows(2) {
            let (p0, p1) = (at(pair[0], inner), at(pair[1], inner));
            batch.fill_quad(&game.gui.atlas, [[cx, cy], p0, p1, p1], colour);
            let start = batch.vertices.len();
            batch.fill_quad(&game.gui.atlas, [p0, at(pair[0], outer), at(pair[1], outer), p1], colour);
            // fill_quad's two triangles use corners 0,1,2,0,2,3.
            for (vertex, corner) in batch.vertices[start..].iter_mut().zip([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]) {
                if corner == 1 || corner == 2 {
                    vertex.color &= 0x00FF_FFFF;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Everything under the rows: the panel, its dividers, the search box, the categories, and each listed module's mark for
// being chosen and its toggle.
pub(super) fn back(s: &State, game: &Game<'_>, hover: Option<Hit>, px: f32, out: &mut Vec<Shape>) {
    follow_hover(hover);
    let solid = 0xFF00_0000 | accent();
    let radius = panel_radius();
    let f = frame(s);
    let (list, pane) = columns(s);
    let menu = dash_menu(s);
    let page = if menu.search.is_empty() { view(|v| v.page) } else { 0 };

    out.push(Shape::Squircle([f[0] - px, f[1] - px, f[2] + 2.0 * px, f[3] + 2.0 * px], radius + px, HAIRLINE));
    out.push(Shape::Squircle(f, radius, SURFACE));
    out.push(Shape::Fill([list[0], f[1], px, f[3]], HAIRLINE));
    out.push(Shape::Fill([pane[0], f[1], px, f[3]], HAIRLINE));

    // The search box: typing anywhere goes to it.
    let r = [f[0] + 8.0, f[1] + 8.0, SIDE - 16.0, SEARCH_H];
    let selected = menu.select_all && !menu.search.is_empty();
    out.push(Shape::Round(r, radius, if selected { 0xFF30_60B0 } else { CONTROL }));
    let text = if menu.search.is_empty() { "Search".to_owned() } else { format!("{}_", menu.search) };
    let colour = if menu.search.is_empty() { 0xD4D4D8 } else { 0xFFFFFF };
    out.push(Shape::Text(fit_to(game, &text, r[2] - 16.0), [r[0] + 8.0, r[1] + text_y(r[3])], colour));

    // The categories: the one shown a capsule in the accent colour.
    for p in 1..=CATEGORIES.len() {
        let r = tab_rect(s, p);
        if p == page {
            out.push(Shape::Round(r, TAB_H / 2.0, solid));
        } else {
            let lit = glow(Hit::Dash(Part::Page(p)));
            if lit > 0 {
                out.push(Shape::Round(r, TAB_H / 2.0, lit << 24 | 0x00FF_FFFF));
            }
        }
        let colour = if p == page { 0xFFFFFF } else { 0xD4D4D8 };
        out.push(Shape::Head(CATEGORIES[p - 1].label().to_owned(), [r[0] + 10.0, r[1] + text_y(r[3])], colour));
    }

    // The list's rows: the chosen one lit, and each module's toggle.
    let scroll = smooth::shown(smooth::DASHBOARD, list_scroll());
    let (content, pane_content) = view(|v| {
        let shown = visible(&v.list.rows, scroll, list[3]);
        out.push(Shape::ClipStart);
        for &(off, hit) in &v.list.rows[shown] {
            let Hit::Module(i) = hit else {
                continue;
            };
            let y = list[1] + off - scroll;
            if v.chosen == Some(i) {
                out.push(Shape::Fill([list[0], y, list[2], module_h()], 0x16FF_FFFF));
            }
            let on = s.modules[i].on;
            let (tx, ty) = (list[0] + list[2] - TOGGLE_PAD - TOGGLE_W, y + (module_h() - TOGGLE_H) / 2.0);
            out.push(Shape::Round([tx, ty, TOGGLE_W, TOGGLE_H], TOGGLE_H / 2.0, if on { solid } else { 0xFF2E_2E33 }));
            let knob = TOGGLE_H - 2.0;
            out.push(Shape::Round([if on { tx + TOGGLE_W - knob - 1.0 } else { tx + 1.0 }, ty + 1.0, knob, knob], knob / 2.0, SURFACE));
        }
        out.push(Shape::ClipEnd([list[0], list[1], list[0] + list[2], list[1] + list[3]]));
        (v.list.content, v.pane.content)
    });

    // The scroll markers: how much of a column shows, and where.
    let pane_at = smooth::shown(smooth::PANE, pane_scroll());
    for (c, content, at) in [(list, content, scroll), (pane, pane_content, pane_at)] {
        let room = c[3];
        if content > room && room > 0.0 {
            let thumb = (room * room / content).max(10.0);
            let t = (at / (content - room)).min(1.0);
            out.push(Shape::Round([c[0] + c[2] - 3.0, c[1] + (room - thumb) * t, 2.0, thumb], 1.0, 0x50FF_FFFF));
        }
    }
}


```

`mixins/sunset/debug.rs`:

```rs
// Debug Report (Client): `.debug [chat lines]`, the module's row or its bind copies a plain-text report to the
// clipboard (the game's own) and saves it as <mod data>/debug/<date-time>.md: versions and server, the player, the
// input sent, the modules on with their changed settings, the anticheat alerts read from chat (counted per check),
// the server's position corrections and the disconnects, the last packets sent tick by tick, and the chat. Markdown
// in short labelled sections, for pasting into an AI or a bug report. It reads; it changes nothing, and it holds no
// secrets (no session token, no account UUID; chat commands and messages sent are named, not quoted).

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Category, Module};
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::{self, Serverbound as S};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::time::SystemTime;

pub(super) const NAME: &str = "Debug Report";
// tools/pack.py writes the commit it packs here; a build straight from the source folder says so.
const COMMIT: &str = "unpacked";
const HORIZON_PIN: &str = "ba6344a";

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new(NAME, Category::Client, "Copies a debug report to the clipboard.")
            .num("Chat lines", 100.0, 0.0, 500.0, 10.0)
            .num("Packet ticks", 40.0, 5.0, 200.0, 5.0)
            .num("Max size (k chars)", 20.0, 5.0, 100.0, 5.0),
    ]
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the hooks note

struct Correction {
    at: SystemTime,
    tick: u64,
    from: Option<[f64; 3]>,
    to: [f64; 3],
}

static CORRECTIONS: Mutex<VecDeque<Correction>> = Mutex::new(VecDeque::new());
static CORRECTED: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
// GUI Move's last change to a tick's PlayerInput: the wire tick, the game's flags and the ones sent.
static GUI_MOVE: Mutex<Option<(u64, u8, u8)>> = Mutex::new(None);

// A server position packet (a setback, or a teleport): where the player was and where it puts them.
pub(super) fn correction(game: &Game<'_>, p: &play::PlayerPosition) {
    use play::relative as rel;
    let from = game.player.as_ref().map(|pl| [pl.position.x, pl.position.y, pl.position.z]);
    let to = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
        let bit = [rel::X, rel::Y, rel::Z][i];
        if p.relatives & bit != 0 { from.map_or(0.0, |f| f[i]) + p.position[i] } else { p.position[i] }
    });
    CORRECTED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mut list = CORRECTIONS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if list.len() == 30 {
        list.pop_front();
    }
    list.push_back(Correction { at: SystemTime::now(), tick: horizon_protocol::connection::sunset_wire::ticks(), from, to });
}

pub(super) fn gui_move_input(game_flags: u8, sent: u8) {
    *GUI_MOVE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) =
        Some((horizon_protocol::connection::sunset_wire::ticks(), game_flags, sent));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- copying

pub(super) fn copy(game: &mut Game<'_>, chat_lines: Option<usize>) {
    use horizon_client::clipboard::Clipboard;
    let mods = super::sunset::snapshot();
    let m = mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == NAME);
    let setting = |name: &str, default: f64| m.map_or(default, |m| m.n(name));
    let limits = Limits {
        chat: chat_lines.unwrap_or(setting("Chat lines", 100.0) as usize).min(500),
        ticks: setting("Packet ticks", 40.0) as u64,
        size: (setting("Max size (k chars)", 20.0) * 1000.0) as usize,
    };
    let report = report(game, &limits);
    game.clipboard.set(&report);
    let dir = game.native_data_dir(super::sunset::ID).join("debug");
    let saved = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).and_then(|()| {
        let base = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S").to_string();
        let path = (1..)
            .map(|n| dir.join(if n == 1 { format!("{base}.md") } else { format!("{base}_{n}.md") }))
            .find(|p| !p.exists())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| dir.join(format!("{base}.md")));
        std::fs::write(&path, &report).map(|()| path)
    });
    let chars = report.chars().count();
    let line = match saved {
        Ok(path) => format!("Debug report copied to the clipboard ({chars} characters) and saved to {}", path.display()),
        Err(e) => format!("Debug report copied to the clipboard ({chars} characters); saving it failed: {e}"),
    };
    super::sunset::say(game, &line);
}

struct Limits {
    chat: usize,
    ticks: u64,
    size: usize,
}

fn report(game: &Game<'_>, limits: &Limits) -> String {
    let (ticks, sent) = horizon_protocol::connection::sunset_wire::recent();
    let chat = horizon_client::chat::sunset_chat_log::lines();
    let mut out = String::new();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "# Sunset debug report");
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "Times are local ({}). \"Tick\" = client ticks ended (ClientTickEnd packets sent) since the game started; now {ticks}.",
        chrono::Local::now().format("UTC%:z")
    );
    header(&mut out, game);
    player(&mut out, game);
    input(&mut out, game);
    modules(&mut out);
    anticheat(&mut out, &chat);
    // The packet log gets up to two fifths of the room, the chat what is left.
    let packets = packet_log(&sent, ticks, limits.ticks, limits.size * 2 / 5);
    out.push_str(&packets);
    let room = limits.size.saturating_sub(out.len());
    chat_log(&mut out, &chat, limits.chat, room);
    out
}

fn clock(at: SystemTime) -> String {
    chrono::DateTime::<chrono::Local>::from(at).format("%H:%M:%S").to_string()
}

fn v3(v: [f64; 3]) -> String {
    format!("{:.3} {:.3} {:.3}", v[0], v[1], v[2])
}

fn yes(b: bool) -> &'static str {
    if b { "yes" } else { "no" }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- sections

fn header(out: &mut String, game: &Game<'_>) {
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Versions and server");
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Sunset: {} (commit {COMMIT}), made for Horizon {HORIZON_PIN}", super::sunset::VERSION);
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- Horizon: {} (commit {})",
        horizon_client::crash::version(),
        option_env!("HORIZON_COMMIT").unwrap_or("not stamped")
    );
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- OS: {} {}", std::env::consts::OS, std::env::consts::ARCH);
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Time: {}", chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %:z"));
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Protocol: Minecraft {} ({})", horizon_protocol::GAME_VERSION, horizon_protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION);
    match &game.remote {
        Some(r) => {
            let place = if game.integrated.is_some() { " (single player, the integrated server)" } else { "" };
            let _ = writeln!(out, "- Server: {}{place}", r.session.address);
            let _ = writeln!(out, "- Brand: {}", if r.brand.is_empty() { "(none sent)" } else { r.brand.as_str() });
            let _ = writeln!(out, "- Player: {}", r.session.name);
        }
        None => {
            let _ = writeln!(out, "- Server: not connected");
        }
    }
    let ping = super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::latency(game);
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Ping: {}", ping.map_or("unknown".to_owned(), |ms| format!("{ms} ms (player list)")));
    let tps = horizon_client::net::sunset_packets::tps();
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- TPS estimate: {}",
        tps.map_or("unknown (needs 3 s of the server's clock)".to_owned(), |(t, s)| format!("{t:.2} (the server's clock over the last {s:.0} s)"))
    );
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Dimension: {}", game.dim.id());
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Game mode: {:?}", game.mode);
}

fn item(stack: Option<&horizon_client::items::ItemStack>) -> String {
    stack.map_or("empty".to_owned(), |s| format!("{} x{}", s.item, s.count))
}

fn screen_name(game: &Game<'_>) -> &'static str {
    use super::Screen as Sc;
    match game.screen {
        Sc::Playing => "none (playing)",
        Sc::GameModeSwitcher => "game mode switcher",
        Sc::Paused => "pause menu",
        Sc::Options => "options",
        Sc::Chat => "chat",
        Sc::Creative => "creative inventory",
        Sc::Inventory => "inventory or container",
        Sc::Dead => "death screen",
        Sc::Stats => "statistics",
        Sc::Advancements => "advancements",
        Sc::WorldOptions => "world options",
        Sc::Friends => "friends",
        Sc::CommandBlock => "command block",
        Sc::ServerLinks => "server links",
        Sc::ConfirmLink => "confirm link",
        Sc::DialogWarning => "dialog warning",
        Sc::Win => "end credits",
    }
}

fn player(out: &mut String, game: &Game<'_>) {
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Player");
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- No player (not in a world).");
        return;
    };
    let pos = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Position: {} (block {} {} {})", v3(pos), pos[0].floor(), pos[1].floor(), pos[2].floor());
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Rotation: yaw {:.2} pitch {:.2}", game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Velocity: {} blocks/tick", v3([p.velocity.x, p.velocity.y, p.velocity.z]));
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- On ground: {}; horizontal collision: {}; fall distance: {:.2}",
        yes(p.ground.on_ground),
        yes(p.collision.horizontal),
        p.fall_distance
    );
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- Sprinting: {}; sneak key: {}; crouching: {}; swimming: {}; elytra: {}; flying: {}",
        yes(p.sprinting),
        yes(p.shift_key_down),
        yes(p.local_crouching),
        yes(p.swimming),
        yes(p.fall_flying),
        yes(p.flying)
    );
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- Health: {:.1}; absorption: {:.1}; food: {} (saturation {:.1})",
        p.health.health(),
        p.health.absorption(),
        p.health.food.food,
        p.health.food.saturation
    );
    let effects: Vec<String> = game
        .potions
        .effects
        .list
        .iter()
        .map(|e| {
            let time = if e.duration < 0 { "infinite".to_owned() } else { format!("{}s", e.duration / 20) };
            format!("{} {} ({time})", e.id, e.amplifier + 1)
        })
        .collect();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Effects: {}", if effects.is_empty() { "none".to_owned() } else { effects.join(", ") });
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Held (hotbar slot {}): {}", game.selected + 1, item(game.inventory.get(game.selected).and_then(Option::as_ref)));
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Offhand: {}", item(game.offhand.as_ref()));
    let armour: Vec<String> = ["head", "chest", "legs", "feet"]
        .iter()
        .zip(&game.armor)
        .map(|(part, s)| format!("{part} {}", item(s.as_ref())))
        .collect();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Armour: {}", armour.join(", "));
    let gui = if super::sunset::gui_open() { " (Sunset's menu open)" } else { "" };
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Screen: {}{gui}", screen_name(game));
}

fn input_flags(flags: u8) -> String {
    let names = ["forward", "back", "left", "right", "jump", "shift", "sprint"];
    let on: Vec<&str> = names.iter().enumerate().filter(|(i, _)| flags & (1 << i) != 0).map(|(_, n)| *n).collect();
    format!("0x{flags:02x} ({})", if on.is_empty() { "none".to_owned() } else { on.join(" ") })
}

fn move_flags(flags: u8) -> String {
    format!(" ground {} wall {}", flags & 1, (flags >> 1) & 1)
}

fn input(out: &mut String, game: &Game<'_>) {
    use horizon_protocol::connection::sunset_wire;
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Input");
    let decoded = |s: Option<sunset_wire::Sent>| s.and_then(|s| S::decode(s.id, &s.payload).ok().map(|p| (s.tick, p)));
    let last_input = match decoded(sunset_wire::last_input()) {
        Some((t, S::PlayerInput(i))) => format!("{} at tick {t}", input_flags(i.flags)),
        _ => "none this game (the game sends one only when the keys change)".to_owned(),
    };
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Last PlayerInput sent: {last_input}");
    let held = |k: winit::keyboard::KeyCode| game.keys.contains(&k) || game.physical_keys.contains(&k);
    use winit::keyboard::KeyCode as K;
    let keys: Vec<&str> = [(K::KeyW, "W"), (K::KeyA, "A"), (K::KeyS, "S"), (K::KeyD, "D"), (K::Space, "Space"), (K::ShiftLeft, "Shift"), (K::ControlLeft, "Ctrl")]
        .iter()
        .filter(|(k, _)| held(*k))
        .map(|(_, n)| *n)
        .collect();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Move keys held now: {}", if keys.is_empty() { "none".to_owned() } else { keys.join(" ") });
    let mods = super::sunset::snapshot();
    let on = |name: &str| mods.iter().any(|m| m.name == name && m.on);
    let gui_move = match *GUI_MOVE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) {
        Some((t, from, to)) => format!("last changed a PlayerInput at tick {t}: game's {} sent as {}", input_flags(from), input_flags(to)),
        None => "never changed a PlayerInput this session".to_owned(),
    };
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- GUI Move: {}; {gui_move}", if on("GUI Move") { "on" } else { "off" });
    let lost: Vec<String> = super::sunset_snap_tap::last().iter().map(|(l, w)| format!("{l:?} (lost to {w:?})")).collect();
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "- Snap Tap: {}; last tick it took out: {}",
        if on("Snap Tap") { "on" } else { "off" },
        if lost.is_empty() { "nothing".to_owned() } else { lost.join(", ") }
    );
    let last_move = decoded(sunset_wire::last_move()).map(|(t, p)| format!("{} at tick {t}", packet_line(&p)));
    let _ = writeln!(out, "- Last move packet: {}", last_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("none this game"));
}

fn modules(out: &mut String) {
    let (profile, list) = super::sunset::debug_modules();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Modules ({} on; profile: {profile})", list.len());
    let _ = writeln!(out, "Settings listed only where they differ from the default.");
    for (name, key, changed) in list {
        let bind = key.map(|k| format!(" [bind {k}]")).unwrap_or_default();
        let settings: Vec<String> = changed.iter().map(|(s, v, d)| format!("{s} = {v} (default {d})")).collect();
        let rest = if settings.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!(": {}", settings.join("; ")) };
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- {name}{bind}{rest}");
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- anticheat alerts

struct Alert {
    ac: String,
    player: String,
    check: String,
    vl: Option<String>,
    detail: String,
}

// Which anticheat a prefix names ("Grim »", "[Intave]", "[NC+]", Horizon's "[Anticheat]"...).
fn ac_name(prefix: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let p = prefix.to_ascii_lowercase();
    let known = [
        ("grim", "Grim"),
        ("intave", "Intave"),
        ("spartan", "Spartan"),
        ("nc+", "NCP"),
        ("ncp", "NCP"),
        ("nocheat", "NCP"),
        ("vulcan", "Vulcan"),
        ("matrix", "Matrix"),
        ("anticheat", "Horizon"),
    ];
    if let Some((_, name)) = known.iter().find(|(k, _)| p.contains(k)) {
        return Some((*name).to_owned());
    }
    let word: String = prefix.chars().filter(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == '+' || *c == ' ').collect();
    let word = word.trim();
    (!word.is_empty()).then(|| word.to_owned())
}

// "<prefix> <player>": the prefix and the player (the last word).
fn split_player(head: &str) -> (&str, &str) {
    let head = head.trim_end();
    head.rsplit_once(' ').map_or(("", head), |(p, n)| (p.trim(), n))
}

fn number(s: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let s = s.trim();
    s.parse::<f64>().is_ok().then(|| s.to_owned())
}

// An alert line, in the formats of the anticheats on Sunset's test rig: Grim's "<prefix> <player> failed <Check>
// (x<vl>) <verbose>", Horizon's "[Anticheat] <player> failed <check> (VL <vl>): <detail>", NCP's "[NC+] <player>
// failed <Check>: <detail> (VL<n>)", Intave's "[Intave] <player>/ <message> <details> (+<added> -> <vl>)" and
// Spartan's "[Spartan] <player> >> <detection>[<level>] (<info>)". Another "<prefix> <player> failed <check> ..."
// counts only when its prefix names an anticheat.
fn alert(text: &str) -> Option<Alert> {
    let text = text.trim();
    if let Some((head, tail)) = text.split_once(" failed ") {
        let (prefix, player) = split_player(head);
        let found = |check: &str, vl: Option<String>, detail: &str, ac: String| {
            let check = check.trim();
            (!check.is_empty() && !check.contains(' ') && !player.is_empty()).then(|| Alert {
                ac,
                player: player.to_owned(),
                check: check.to_owned(),
                vl,
                detail: detail.trim().to_owned(),
            })
        };
        // Grim: (x<vl>).
        if let Some((check, rest)) = tail.split_once(" (x")
            && let Some((vl, detail)) = rest.split_once(')')
            && let Some(vl) = number(vl)
        {
            return found(check, Some(vl), detail, ac_name(prefix).unwrap_or_else(|| "Grim".to_owned()));
        }
        // Horizon: (VL <vl>): <detail>.
        if let Some((check, rest)) = tail.split_once(" (VL ")
            && let Some((vl, detail)) = rest.split_once(')')
            && let Some(vl) = number(vl)
        {
            return found(check, Some(vl), detail.trim_start_matches(':'), ac_name(prefix).unwrap_or_else(|| "Horizon".to_owned()));
        }
        let ac = ac_name(prefix)?;
        // NCP and the rest: <Check>: <detail>, a VL at the end or none.
        let (check, detail) = tail.split_once(':').unwrap_or_else(|| tail.split_once(' ').unwrap_or((tail, "")));
        let vl = detail
            .rsplit_once("VL")
            .and_then(|(_, v)| number(v.trim_matches(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit() && c != '.')));
        return found(check, vl, detail, ac);
    }
    // Intave: <player>/<trust> <message> (+<added> -> <vl>).
    if let Some((head, tail)) = text.rsplit_once(" (+")
        && let Some((_, vl)) = tail.split_once("->")
        && let Some(vl) = number(vl.trim_end_matches(')'))
        && let Some(slash) = head.find("/ ").or_else(|| head.find('/'))
    {
        let (prefix, player) = split_player(&head[..slash]);
        let message = head[slash + 1..].trim();
        let (check, detail) = message.split_once(" (").map_or((message, ""), |(c, d)| (c, d.trim_end_matches(')')));
        return (!player.is_empty() && !check.is_empty()).then(|| Alert {
            ac: ac_name(prefix).unwrap_or_else(|| "Intave".to_owned()),
            player: player.to_owned(),
            check: check.trim().to_owned(),
            vl: Some(vl),
            detail: detail.to_owned(),
        });
    }
    // Spartan: <player> >> <detection>[<level>] (<info>).
    if let Some((head, tail)) = text.split_once(" >> ")
        && let Some((check, rest)) = tail.split_once('[')
        && let Some((level, info)) = rest.split_once(']')
    {
        let (prefix, player) = split_player(head);
        let ac = ac_name(prefix)?;
        return (!player.is_empty() && !check.trim().is_empty()).then(|| Alert {
            ac,
            player: player.to_owned(),
            check: check.trim().to_owned(),
            vl: number(level),
            detail: info.trim().trim_start_matches('(').trim_end_matches(')').to_owned(),
        });
    }
    None
}

struct Count {
    ac: String,
    player: String,
    check: String,
    count: usize,
    vl: Option<String>,
    detail: String,
    first: SystemTime,
    last: SystemTime,
}

fn counts(chat: &[horizon_client::chat::sunset_chat_log::Line]) -> Vec<Count> {
    let mut out: Vec<Count> = Vec::new();
    for line in chat.iter().filter(|l| l.source == horizon_client::chat::ChatSource::Server) {
        let Some(a) = alert(&line.text) else {
            continue;
        };
        match out.iter_mut().find(|c| c.ac == a.ac && c.player == a.player && c.check == a.check) {
            Some(c) => {
                c.count += 1;
                c.last = line.at;
                if a.vl.is_some() {
                    c.vl = a.vl;
                }
                c.detail = a.detail;
            }
            None => out.push(Count {
                ac: a.ac,
                player: a.player,
                check: a.check,
                count: 1,
                vl: a.vl,
                detail: a.detail,
                first: line.at,
                last: line.at,
            }),
        }
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| b.count.cmp(&a.count).then(a.check.cmp(&b.check)));
    out
}

fn cell(s: &str) -> String {
    let s: String = s.chars().take(80).collect();
    s.replace('|', "/")
}

fn anticheat(out: &mut String, chat: &[horizon_client::chat::sunset_chat_log::Line]) {
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Anticheat flags");
    let found = counts(chat);
    let _ = writeln!(
        out,
        "Alert lines read from all {} chat lines kept (Grim, Intave, Spartan, NCP and Horizon formats; other \"<name> failed <check>\" lines under their prefix).",
        chat.len()
    );
    if found.is_empty() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- No alert lines in chat.");
    } else {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "| Anticheat | Player | Check | Count | Last VL | Last detail | First | Last |");
        let _ = writeln!(out, "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|");
        for c in found.iter().take(40) {
            let _ = writeln!(
                out,
                "| {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
                cell(&c.ac),
                cell(&c.player),
                cell(&c.check),
                c.count,
                c.vl.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
                cell(&c.detail),
                clock(c.first),
                clock(c.last)
            );
        }
        if found.len() > 40 {
            let _ = writeln!(out, "({} more checks left out)", found.len() - 40);
        }
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n### Server position packets (setbacks and teleports)");
    let list = CORRECTIONS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if list.is_empty() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- None this game.");
    } else {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "{} this game; the newest {} here, newest first.", CORRECTED.load(Ordering::Relaxed), list.len().min(20));
        let _ = writeln!(out, "| Time | Tick | From | To | Moved |");
        let _ = writeln!(out, "|---|---|---|---|---|");
        for c in list.iter().rev().take(20) {
            let (from, moved) = match c.from {
                Some(f) => (v3(f), format!("{:.3}", (0..3).map(|i| (c.to[i] - f[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt())),
                None => ("(no player yet)".to_owned(), "-".to_owned()),
            };
            let _ = writeln!(out, "| {} | {} | {from} | {} | {moved} |", clock(c.at), c.tick, v3(c.to));
        }
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n### Disconnects and kicks");
    let ends = horizon_client::net::sunset_packets::ends();
    if ends.is_empty() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- None this game.");
    }
    for (at, reason, from_server) in ends.iter().rev().take(10) {
        let by = if *from_server { "server's reason" } else { "connection" };
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- {} ({by}): {}", clock(*at), reason.replace('\n', " "));
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- packets and chat

fn action_name(action: i32) -> String {
    match action {
        0 => "start dig".into(),
        1 => "dig (new face)".into(),
        2 => "abort dig".into(),
        3 => "stop dig".into(),
        4 => "drop stack".into(),
        5 => "drop item".into(),
        6 => "release use".into(),
        7 => "swap hands".into(),
        8 => "stab".into(),
        n => format!("action {n}"),
    }
}

fn command_name(action: i32) -> String {
    match action {
        0 => "leave bed".into(),
        1 => "start sprint".into(),
        2 => "stop sprint".into(),
        3 => "start riding jump".into(),
        4 => "stop riding jump".into(),
        5 => "open vehicle inventory".into(),
        6 => "start elytra".into(),
        n => format!("action {n}"),
    }
}

fn packet_line(p: &S) -> String {
    match p {
        S::MovePlayerPos(m) => format!("MovePos {}{}", v3([m.x, m.y, m.z]), move_flags(m.flags)),
        S::MovePlayerPosRot(m) => format!("MovePosRot {} yaw {:.2} pitch {:.2}{}", v3([m.x, m.y, m.z]), m.yaw, m.pitch, move_flags(m.flags)),
        S::MovePlayerRot(m) => format!("MoveRot yaw {:.2} pitch {:.2}{}", m.yaw, m.pitch, move_flags(m.flags)),
        S::MovePlayerStatus(m) => format!("MoveStatus{}", move_flags(m.flags)),
        S::PlayerInput(i) => format!("PlayerInput {}", input_flags(i.flags)),
        S::PlayerCommand(c) => format!("PlayerCommand {}", command_name(c.action)),
        S::PlayerAction(a) => format!("PlayerAction {} at {:?} face {} seq {}", action_name(a.action), a.pos, a.direction, a.sequence),
        S::Attack(a) => format!("Attack entity {}", a.id),
        S::Interact(i) => format!("Interact entity {} hand {}{}", i.id, i.hand, if i.secondary { " sneaking" } else { "" }),
        S::UseItem(u) => format!("UseItem hand {} seq {} yaw {:.2} pitch {:.2}", u.hand, u.sequence, u.yaw, u.pitch),
        S::UseItemOn(u) => format!("UseItemOn {:?} face {} hand {} seq {}", u.pos, u.face, u.hand, u.sequence),
        S::SetCarriedItem(c) => format!("SetCarriedItem slot {}", c.slot),
        S::ContainerClick(c) => format!("ContainerClick container {} slot {} button {} mode {}", c.container, c.slot, c.button, c.input),
        S::ContainerClose(c) => format!("ContainerClose {}", c.container),
        S::AcceptTeleportation(t) => format!("AcceptTeleportation id {} at {}", t.id, v3([t.x, t.y, t.z])),
        S::PickItemFromBlock(b) => format!("PickItemFromBlock {:?}", b.pos),
        S::ClientTickEnd(_) => "ClientTickEnd".into(),
        // The rest by name only: chat, commands, payloads and keys stay out of the report.
        other => {
            let name = format!("{other:?}");
            name.split(['(', ' ', '{']).next().unwrap_or("?").to_owned()
        }
    }
}

// One line a packet, its tick first; a tick's packets all went before its ClientTickEnd, which is left out. The same
// packet again in a tick is counted on its line, and a run of ticks with nothing else sent is one line.
fn packet_log(sent: &[horizon_protocol::connection::sunset_wire::Sent], now: u64, ticks: u64, room: usize) -> String {
    let from = now.saturating_sub(ticks);
    let mut lines: Vec<(u64, String, usize)> = Vec::new();
    for s in sent.iter().filter(|s| s.tick >= from && s.id != horizon_protocol::ids::play::serverbound::CLIENT_TICK_END) {
        let text = match S::decode(s.id, &s.payload) {
            Ok(p) => packet_line(&p),
            Err(_) => format!("packet id {} ({} bytes, not read)", s.id, s.len),
        };
        match lines.last_mut() {
            Some((tick, last, n)) if *tick == s.tick && *last == text => *n += 1,
            _ => lines.push((s.tick, text, 1)),
        }
    }
    let mut shown: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut next = from;
    for (tick, text, n) in &lines {
        if *tick > next {
            shown.push(quiet(next, *tick - 1));
        }
        next = tick + 1;
        shown.push(if *n > 1 { format!("{tick} {text} (x{n})") } else { format!("{tick} {text}") });
    }
    if now > next {
        shown.push(quiet(next, now - 1));
    }
    // The newest that fit.
    let mut used = 0;
    let kept = shown.iter().rev().take_while(|l| {
        used += l.len() + 1;
        used <= room
    }).count();
    let mut out = String::new();
    let _ = writeln!(out, "\n## Packets sent (ticks {from} to {now}, oldest first)");
    let _ = writeln!(out, "Tick number first; each tick's packets went before its ClientTickEnd (left out).");
    if kept < shown.len() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "({} older lines left out for size)", shown.len() - kept);
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "```");
    for l in &shown[shown.len() - kept..] {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "{l}");
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "```");
    out
}

fn quiet(from: u64, to: u64) -> String {
    if from == to { format!("{from} (nothing sent)") } else { format!("{from}-{to} (nothing sent)") }
}

fn chat_log(out: &mut String, chat: &[horizon_client::chat::sunset_chat_log::Line], want: usize, room: usize) {
    use horizon_client::chat::ChatSource;
    let lines: Vec<String> = chat
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .take(want)
        .map(|l| {
            let source = match l.source {
                ChatSource::Player => "player",
                ChatSource::Server => "server",
                ChatSource::Client => "client",
            };
            format!("[{}] [{source}] {}", clock(l.at), l.text)
        })
        .collect();
    let title = "\n## Chat (newest last, [time] [source])\n";
    let mut used = title.len() + 16;
    let kept = lines.iter().take_while(|l| {
        used += l.len() + 1;
        used <= room
    }).count();
    out.push_str(&title);
    if kept < lines.len() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "(the {} oldest of the {} lines asked for left out for size)", lines.len() - kept, lines.len());
    }
    if lines.is_empty() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "- No chat lines.");
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "```");
    for l in lines[..kept].iter().rev() {
        let _ = writeln!(out, "{l}");
    }
    let _ = writeln!(out, "```");
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::alert;

    #[test]
    fn alert_formats() {
        let grim = alert("Grim » pointofpressure failed Simulation (x102.0) .420000").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((grim.ac.as_str(), grim.player.as_str(), grim.check.as_str(), grim.vl.as_deref()), ("Grim", "pointofpressure", "Simulation", Some("102.0")));
        assert_eq!(grim.detail, ".420000");
        let horizon = alert("[Anticheat] Tester failed prediction (VL 456.7): moved up to 0.118 blocks off, sent back").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((horizon.ac.as_str(), horizon.check.as_str(), horizon.vl.as_deref()), ("Horizon", "prediction", Some("456.7")));
        let ncp = alert("[NC+] Tester failed Commands: issued too many commands too quickly (VL12)").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((ncp.ac.as_str(), ncp.check.as_str(), ncp.vl.as_deref()), ("NCP", "Commands", Some("12")));
        let intave = alert("[Intave] Tester/ moved incorrectly (Δ0.132919 / 🔍1) (+10.00 -> 10.00)").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((intave.ac.as_str(), intave.player.as_str(), intave.check.as_str(), intave.vl.as_deref()), ("Intave", "Tester", "moved incorrectly", Some("10.00")));
        let spartan = alert("[Spartan] Tester >> gravity-simulation[3] (y: .30)").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((spartan.ac.as_str(), spartan.check.as_str(), spartan.vl.as_deref()), ("Spartan", "gravity-simulation", Some("3")));
        assert!(alert("<r94_> sgudpi").is_none());
        assert!(alert("Steve failed to escape the Wither").is_none());
    }
}

// Debug Report's chat log: every line that comes into the chat (the server's, players' and the client's own), as
// plain text without its colour codes, with the time it came. Kept even when the Chat option hides it, and past the
// chat's own 100.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::SystemTime;

const KEEP: usize = 500;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Line {
    pub at: SystemTime,
    pub source: crate::chat::ChatSource,
    pub text: String,
}

static LOG: Mutex<VecDeque<Line>> = Mutex::new(VecDeque::new());

pub fn added(content: &crate::text::Text, source: crate::chat::ChatSource) {
    let text: String = content.strip_legacy().plain().chars().map(|c| if c.is_control() { ' ' } else { c }).collect();
    let mut log = LOG.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if log.len() == KEEP {
        log.pop_front();
    }
    log.push_back(Line { at: SystemTime::now(), source, text });
}

// The lines kept, oldest first.
pub fn lines() -> Vec<Line> {
    LOG.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).iter().cloned().collect()
}

`mixins/sunset/debug_wire.rs`:

```rs
// Debug Report's packet log: the client's own packets as they go on the wire (after Sunset changed, held or added
// them, with the game's ClientTickEnd between ticks), each tagged with the number of client ticks ended before it; the
// last PlayerInput and the last move packet kept apart too, however long ago they went.
// The single player server's threads (horizon-lan-..., horizon-local-...) write here too and are skipped. Only the
// start of a long packet is kept; the report decodes what it can.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

const KEEP: usize = 2048;
const BODY: usize = 256;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Sent {
    pub tick: u64,
    pub id: i32,
    // The packet after its id (cut at BODY bytes).
    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
    pub len: usize,
}

static TICKS: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
static LOG: Mutex<VecDeque<Sent>> = Mutex::new(VecDeque::new());
static LAST_INPUT: Mutex<Option<Sent>> = Mutex::new(None);
static LAST_MOVE: Mutex<Option<Sent>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn id(body: &[u8]) -> Option<(i32, usize)> {
    let mut value = 0i32;
    for (i, b) in body.iter().take(5).enumerate() {
        value |= i32::from(b & 0x7F) << (7 * i);
        if b & 0x80 == 0 {
            return Some((value, i + 1));
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn sent(body: &[u8]) {
    if std::thread::current().name().is_some_and(|n| n.starts_with("horizon-lan") || n.starts_with("horizon-local")) {
        return;
    }
    let Some((id, start)) = id(body) else {
        return;
    };
    use crate::ids::play::serverbound as ids;
    let payload = body[start..].get(..BODY).unwrap_or(&body[start..]).to_vec();
    let sent = Sent { tick: TICKS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), id, payload, len: body.len() - start };
    let last = match id {
        ids::PLAYER_INPUT => Some(&LAST_INPUT),
        ids::MOVE_PLAYER_POS | ids::MOVE_PLAYER_POS_ROT | ids::MOVE_PLAYER_ROT | ids::MOVE_PLAYER_STATUS_ONLY => Some(&LAST_MOVE),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(last) = last {
        *last.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(sent.clone());
    }
    let mut log = LOG.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if log.len() == KEEP {
        log.pop_front();
    }
    log.push_back(sent);
    if id == ids::CLIENT_TICK_END {
        TICKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

// The last PlayerInput and the last move packet sent.
pub fn last_input() -> Option<Sent> {
    LAST_INPUT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone()
}

pub fn last_move() -> Option<Sent> {
    LAST_MOVE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone()
}

// The client ticks ended so far, and the packets kept, oldest first.
pub fn recent() -> (u64, Vec<Sent>) {
    let log = LOG.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    (TICKS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), log.iter().cloned().collect())
}

// The client ticks ended so far.
pub fn ticks() -> u64 {
    TICKS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

```

`mixins/sunset/duel.rs`:

```rs
// Ported from Sayer's Duelkit (MIT, github.com/PointOfPressure/duelkit): Wind Jump, Hold to Eat and Pearl Catch
// (Loadouts are in loadouts.rs).
use super::sunset::{Category, Module, hold, with};
use super::sunset_util as util;
use super::{Game, Screen};
use horizon_client::projectiles::ProjectileKind;
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::{self, Serverbound as S};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use winit::event::MouseButton;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Wind Jump", Category::Movement, "Jumps with wind charges.").num("Min pitch", 60.0, 0.0, 90.0, 5.0),
        Module::new("Hold to Eat", Category::Player, "Eats from a held hotbar key.")
            .bool("Golden apples", true)
            .bool("Any food", false),
        Module::new("Pearl Catch", Category::Movement, "Catches pearls with wind charges.")
            .num("Min look up", 45.0, 0.0, 90.0, 5.0)
            .bool("Auto", true)
            .num("Max delay", 10.0, 1.0, 20.0, 1.0)
            .num("Delay", 2.0, 1.0, 20.0, 1.0)
            .bool("At feet", false),
    ]
}

// Duelkit's numbers: a pearl leaves at 1.5 blocks a tick and slows by 0.99 with 0.03 gravity; a wind charge flies
// straight at 1.5 with neither; its blast (radius 1.2) pushes with 1.22.
const THROW: f64 = 1.5;
const RADIUS: f64 = 1.2;
const KICK: f64 = 1.22;

fn add(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]]
}

fn scale(a: [f64; 3], k: f64) -> [f64; 3] {
    [a[0] * k, a[1] * k, a[2] * k]
}

fn pearl_step(pos: [f64; 3], vel: [f64; 3]) -> ([f64; 3], [f64; 3]) {
    let pos = add(pos, vel);
    (pos, add(scale(vel, 0.99), [0.0, -0.03, 0.0]))
}

// The earliest tick a wind charge thrown now from `from` (inheriting `inherit` a tick) meets the pearl: the direction
// to throw it and how high the kicked pearl goes.
fn intercept(from: [f64; 3], inherit: [f64; 3], pearl: [f64; 3], speed: [f64; 3]) -> Option<([f64; 3], f64)> {
    let (mut pos, mut vel) = (pearl, speed);
    for k in 1..=40 {
        (pos, vel) = pearl_step(pos, vel);
        let need = add(add(pos, scale(from, -1.0)), scale(inherit, -f64::from(k)));
        let len = need.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
        if len <= THROW * f64::from(k) && len > 0.0 {
            let dir = scale(need, 1.0 / len);
            let kicked = add(vel, scale(dir, KICK * (1.0 - 0.2 / (2.0 * RADIUS))));
            let (mut y, mut vy) = (pos[1], kicked[1]);
            while vy > 0.0 {
                y += vy;
                vy = vy * 0.99 - 0.03;
            }
            return Some((dir, y));
        }
    }
    None
}

// Your eyes, a pearl's start and speed thrown with your look and movement, and the movement a charge inherits.
fn throw_start(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<([f64; 3], [f64; 3], [f64; 3], bool)> {
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let look = super::view_vector(game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let ground = p.ground.on_ground;
    let move_ = [p.velocity.x, if ground { 0.0 } else { p.velocity.y }, p.velocity.z];
    Some((eye, add(scale(look, THROW), move_), move_, ground))
}

// Auto: the delay (ticks) whose catch sends the pearl highest, simulated for both throws; None if none catches it.
fn best_delay(game: &Game<'_>, max: u32) -> Option<u32> {
    let (eye, pearl_speed, move_, ground) = throw_start(game)?;
    let (mut me, mut mv) = (eye, move_);
    let (mut pp, mut pv) = (add(eye, [0.0, -0.1, 0.0]), pearl_speed);
    let mut best: Option<(u32, f64)> = None;
    for d in 1..=max {
        if !ground {
            me = add(me, mv);
            mv = [mv[0] * 0.91, (mv[1] - 0.08) * 0.98, mv[2] * 0.91];
        }
        (pp, pv) = pearl_step(pp, pv);
        let inherit = if ground { move_ } else { mv };
        if let Some((_, apex)) = intercept(add(me, [0.0, -0.1, 0.0]), inherit, pp, pv)
            && best.is_none_or(|b| apex > b.1)
        {
            best = Some((d, apex));
        }
    }
    best.map(|b| b.0)
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Duel {
    // Wind Jump: the tick a wind charge went down from the ground and whether it has jumped for it, till its blast.
    thrown: Option<(u64, bool)>,
    // Wind Jump: the ticks from a throw to its blast, the last three on this connection.
    blast_after: Option<(usize, Vec<u64>)>,
    // Hold to Eat: the slot eaten from, its key, and the slot to go back to.
    eating: Option<(usize, String, usize)>,
    // Pearl Catch: the tick of the catch (as Duelkit counts it), the pearl as thrown (start, speed, tick), the throw
    // waiting for the look the server has (charge slot, yaw, pitch, retried), and the slot to come back (slot, charge
    // slot) at the start of the tick after a hotbar charge went.
    catch_at: Option<u64>,
    pearl: Option<([f64; 3], [f64; 3], u64)>,
    catch_ready: Option<(usize, f32, f32, bool)>,
    catch_back: Option<(usize, usize)>,
}

static DUEL: Mutex<Option<Duel>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn duel<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Duel) -> R) -> R {
    f(DUEL.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Duel::default))
}

fn module(name: &str) -> Option<Module> {
    with(|s| s.module(name).filter(|m| m.on).cloned())
}

// The use hook: a wind charge thrown from the ground looking down far enough (Wind Jump waits for its blast).
pub(super) fn used(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize) {
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on(super::sunset::ID) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(stack) = game.stack_in(slot) else {
        return;
    };
    let cooling = game.res.items().get(&stack.item).is_some_and(|i| {
        game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown(&horizon_client::cooldowns::group(stack, i.use_cooldown.as_ref()))
    });
    if let Some(m) = module("Pearl Catch")
        && stack.item.ends_with(":ender_pearl")
        && !cooling
        && -f64::from(game.pitch) >= m.n("Min look up")
    {
        let delay = if m.b("Auto") { best_delay(game, m.n("Max delay") as u32) } else { Some(m.n("Delay") as u32) };
        let pearl = throw_start(game).map(|(eye, speed, _, _)| (add(eye, [0.0, -0.1, 0.0]), speed, game.ticks));
        duel(|d| {
            d.catch_at = delay.map(|t| game.ticks + u64::from(t));
            d.pearl = pearl;
        });
    }
    if stack.item.ends_with(":wind_charge")
        && !cooling
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.ground.on_ground && !p.flying)
        && game.riding.is_none()
        && module("Wind Jump").is_some_and(|m| f64::from(game.pitch) >= m.n("Min pitch"))
    {
        duel(|d| d.thrown = Some((game.ticks, false)));
    }
}

// The connection a learned blast delay holds for.
fn connection(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| std::sync::Arc::as_ptr(&r.session.counters) as usize)
}

// Before the tick's move: Wind Jump jumps, a real jump the server sees in the tick's PlayerInput, on the tick before
// its charge's blast, so the blast pushes you in the air and adds to the rise (a jump keeps the faster of its own speed
// and the push, so a late one is never less than the blast alone; an early one is, as you are higher when it comes).
// The tick is the shortest of the last three blasts' delays on this connection (one that came late does not make the
// next jump late), or before one is known, the tick the charge is a step from the ground. Not standing, no jump; 20
// ticks on, it waits no more.
pub(super) fn pre_input(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let Some((thrown, jumped)) = duel(|d| d.thrown) else {
        return;
    };
    if module("Wind Jump").is_none() || game.ticks > thrown + 20 {
        duel(|d| d.thrown = None);
        return;
    }
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref().filter(|p| !jumped && p.ground.on_ground && !p.flying && game.riding.is_none()) else {
        return;
    };
    let feet = p.position;
    let here = connection(game);
    let learned = duel(|d| d.blast_after.as_ref().filter(|(at, _)| Some(*at) == here).and_then(|(_, after)| after.iter().min().copied()));
    let due = match learned {
        Some(after) => game.ticks + 1 >= thrown + after,
        None => game.creatures.projectiles.iter().any(|c| {
            c.kind == ProjectileKind::WindCharge
                && (c.position.x - feet.x).hypot(c.position.z - feet.z) < 1.5
                && c.position.y + c.velocity.y <= feet.y + 0.1
        }),
    };
    if due {
        duel(|d| d.thrown = Some((thrown, true)));
        super::sunset_melee::press_jump(game);
    }
}

// The explosion hook: the blast of a charge Wind Jump waits for pushed you up; the ticks it took are kept.
pub(super) fn blast(game: &Game<'_>, push: Option<[f64; 3]>) {
    if push.is_none_or(|p| p[1] <= 0.0) {
        return;
    }
    let at = connection(game);
    duel(|d| {
        if let (Some((thrown, _)), Some(at)) = (d.thrown.take(), at) {
            let mut after = d.blast_after.take().filter(|(was, _)| *was == at).map_or_else(Vec::new, |(_, after)| after);
            if after.len() == 3 {
                after.remove(0);
            }
            after.push(game.ticks.saturating_sub(thrown));
            d.blast_after = Some((at, after));
        }
    });
}

fn edible(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, slot: usize) -> bool {
    game.inventory[slot].as_ref().is_some_and(|s| {
        if s.item.ends_with(":golden_apple") || s.item.ends_with(":enchanted_golden_apple") {
            m.b("Golden apples")
        } else {
            m.b("Any food") && game.res.items().get(&s.item).is_some_and(|i| i.food.is_some())
        }
    })
}

// The key hook: Hold to Eat: the hotbar key of food pressed starts eating it (unless the Loadouts panel has the keys).
pub(super) fn key(game: &mut Game<'_>, key: &str, pressed: bool) {
    super::sunset_loadouts::key(game, key, pressed);
    if super::sunset_loadouts::listing() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(m) = module("Hold to Eat") else {
        return;
    };
    if !pressed || game.screen != Screen::Playing || duel(|d| d.eating.is_some()) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(slot) = (0..9).find(|i| game.settings.keys.get(&format!("key.hotbar.{}", i + 1)) == key) else {
        return;
    };
    if edible(game, &m, slot) {
        let back = game.selected;
        duel(|d| d.eating = Some((slot, key.to_owned(), back)));
    }
}

// A wind charge Pearl Catch can throw from `slot`: there, and off cooldown.
fn charge_ready(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize) -> bool {
    game.stack_in(slot).is_some_and(|s| {
        s.item.ends_with(":wind_charge")
            && !game.res.items().get(&s.item).is_some_and(|i| {
                game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown(&horizon_client::cooldowns::group(s, i.use_cooldown.as_ref()))
            })
    })
}

// Pearl Catch's aim, as the server takes the throw a tick from now (its look goes out first): straight down (At feet),
// at your pearl (Auto: Duelkit's intercept from where you will be, the pearl as thrown flown that far, else the one
// you see a tick on), or along your look.
fn catch_aim(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> (f32, f32) {
    let own = (game.yaw, game.pitch);
    if m.b("At feet") {
        return (game.yaw, 90.0);
    }
    let Some((eye, _, move_, _)) = throw_start(game).filter(|_| m.b("Auto")) else {
        return own;
    };
    let pearl = match duel(|d| d.pearl) {
        Some((mut pos, mut vel, thrown)) => {
            for _ in 0..(game.ticks + 1).saturating_sub(thrown) {
                (pos, vel) = pearl_step(pos, vel);
            }
            Some((pos, vel))
        }
        None => game
            .creatures
            .projectiles
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| p.kind == ProjectileKind::EnderPearl && util::dist(eye, [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z]) < 48.0)
            .max_by_key(|p| p.id)
            .map(|p| pearl_step([p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z], [p.velocity.x, p.velocity.y, p.velocity.z])),
    };
    match pearl.and_then(|(pos, vel)| intercept(add(add(eye, move_), [0.0, -0.1, 0.0]), move_, pos, vel)) {
        Some((dir, _)) => ((-dir[0]).atan2(dir[2]).to_degrees() as f32, (-dir[1].asin().to_degrees()) as f32),
        None => own,
    }
}

// The start of a tick after a hotbar charge went, before any hit or use in it: the slot from before comes back. Whether
// the slot changed.
pub(super) fn catch_back(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some((back, charge)) = duel(|d| d.catch_back.take()) else {
        return false;
    };
    if game.selected != charge || back >= 9 {
        return false;
    }
    hold(game, back);
    true
}

// Pearl Catch's wind charge, at the start of the tick once the server has its look (Grim: nothing of it after the
// tick's move packet, and the use packet's look is the move packet's): the charge's hotbar slot (the offhand needs
// none), the use packet with that look, the look kept for this tick's move packet (BadPacketsJ), and nothing else; a
// hotbar slot comes back at the start of the next tick (catch_back), never after the use in this one (PacketOrderE).
// A tick that already has a hit or a slot change waits one more, the look kept.
pub(super) fn catch_throw(game: &mut Game<'_>, busy: bool) {
    let Some((slot, yaw, pitch, retried)) = duel(|d| d.catch_ready.take()) else {
        return;
    };
    let alive = game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.health.health() > 0.0);
    if module("Pearl Catch").is_none() || game.screen != Screen::Playing || !alive || !charge_ready(game, slot) {
        return;
    }
    // Another module's look waits: this tick's move packet would carry that one.
    if super::sunset::turn_pending() {
        return;
    }
    if busy {
        if !retried {
            super::sunset::turn("Pearl Catch", yaw, pitch);
            duel(|d| d.catch_ready = Some((slot, yaw, pitch, true)));
        }
        return;
    }
    if slot != util::OFFHAND && game.selected != slot {
        let back = game.selected;
        hold(game, slot);
        duel(|d| d.catch_back = Some((back, slot)));
    }
    super::sunset::turn("Pearl Catch", yaw, pitch);
    let sequence = util::sequence(game);
    let wire = super::sunset::wire_yaw(game, yaw);
    game.send(S::UseItem(play::UseItem { hand: i32::from(slot == util::OFFHAND), sequence, yaw: wire, pitch: pitch.clamp(-90.0, 90.0) }));
    game.swing_arm();
    // Your own use waits: the charge's slot is in hand until the next tick.
    game.use_delay = game.use_delay.max(2);
    game.clicks.right_click_delay = game.clicks.right_click_delay.max(2);
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    // Pearl Catch: a tick before Duelkit's catch tick, the look goes out with the next move packet and the throw
    // follows at the start of the tick after it (catch_throw): to the server the same moment as Duelkit's throw after
    // the catch tick's move packet, in the order Grim wants. Another module's look in the way: up to two ticks more.
    if let Some(at) = duel(|d| d.catch_at)
        && game.ticks + 1 >= at
    {
        let slot = std::iter::once(util::OFFHAND).chain(0..9).find(|&s| charge_ready(game, s));
        match (module("Pearl Catch").filter(|_| game.screen == Screen::Playing), slot) {
            (Some(m), Some(slot)) => {
                let (yaw, pitch) = catch_aim(game, &m);
                let asked = super::sunset::try_turn_then("Pearl Catch", yaw, pitch, move |_| {
                    duel(|d| d.catch_ready = Some((slot, yaw, pitch, false)));
                });
                if asked || game.ticks + 1 > at + 2 {
                    duel(|d| d.catch_at = None);
                }
            }
            _ => duel(|d| d.catch_at = None),
        }
    }
    let Some((slot, key, back)) = duel(|d| d.eating.clone()) else {
        return;
    };
    let held = game.physical_keys.iter().any(|k| horizon_client::keybinds::key_name(*k) == Some(key.as_str()));
    let go_on = module("Hold to Eat").is_some_and(|m| edible(game, &m, slot));
    if held && go_on && game.screen == Screen::Playing {
        hold(game, slot);
        if game.using.is_none() {
            let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
        }
        return;
    }
    // Let go (or ran out): stop eating, and the slot from before comes back.
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
    hold(game, back);
    duel(|d| d.eating = None);
}

`mixins/sunset/durability_patch.rs`:

```rs
// An item's damage as the server's component patch gives it.
use super::sunset_faceplace_policy::ArmorCondition;
use horizon_protocol::{buf::Reader, item::component};
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Prototype {
    pub maximum: Option<u32>,
    pub damage_present: bool,
    pub unbreakable: bool,
}
pub fn resolve(base: Prototype, decoded_damage: u32, patch: Option<&[u8]>) -> Option<ArmorCondition> {
    let mut maximum = base.maximum;
    let mut damage = decoded_damage;
    let mut damage_present = base.damage_present;
    let mut unbreakable = base.unbreakable;
    if let Some(bytes) = patch {
        if bytes.len() > 8192 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut input = Reader::new(bytes);
        let added = input.count(64).ok()?;
        let removed = input.count(64).ok()?;
        if added + removed > 64 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut seen = [-1; 64];
        let mut used = 0;
        for _ in 0..added {
            let id = input.varint().ok()?;
            if id < 0 || seen[..used].contains(&id) {
                return None;
            }
            seen[used] = id;
            used += 1;
            let count = input.count(input.remaining()).ok()?;
            let payload = input.bytes(count).ok()?;
            let mut value = Reader::new(payload);
            match id {
                component::MAX_DAMAGE => {
                    maximum = Some(u32::try_from(value.varint().ok()?).ok()?);
                }
                component::DAMAGE => {
                    damage = u32::try_from(value.varint().ok()?).ok()?;
                    damage_present = true;
                }
                component::UNBREAKABLE => {
                    unbreakable = true;
                }
                _ => continue,
            }
            if value.remaining() != 0 {
                return None;
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..removed {
            let id = input.varint().ok()?;
            if id < 0 || seen[..used].contains(&id) {
                return None;
            }
            seen[used] = id;
            used += 1;
            match id {
                component::MAX_DAMAGE => maximum = None,
                component::DAMAGE => damage_present = false,
                component::UNBREAKABLE => unbreakable = false,
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if input.remaining() != 0 {
            return None;
        }
    }
    Some(ArmorCondition {
        damageable: damage_present && !unbreakable && maximum.is_some_and(|v| v > 0),
        maximum: maximum.unwrap_or(0),
        lost: damage,
    })
}

`mixins/sunset/explosive_aura.rs`:

```rs
// Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura, run together: one acts at a time (the better hit first), and the box each would use
// next is drawn.
use super::sunset::{self, Module};
use super::{Game, Screen};
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
struct View {
    session: Arc<Mutex<Option<Arc<horizon_protocol::connection::Counters>>>>,
    dim: super::Dim,
    pos: [f64; 3],
    from: [f64; 3],
    moved: Instant,
    shown: Instant,
    damage: f64,
    own: f64,
    tick: u64,
}
static VIEWS: Mutex<[Option<View>; 2]> = Mutex::new([None, None]);
static CRYSTAL_ON: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub(super) fn show(game: &Game<'_>, anchor: bool, pos: [i32; 3], rating: super::sunset_explosive_choice::Rating) {
    let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let now = Instant::now();
    let pos = pos.map(f64::from);
    let mut guard = VIEWS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let previous = guard[usize::from(anchor)].as_ref().filter(|v| {
        v.dim == game.dim
            && Arc::ptr_eq(&v.session, &remote.session.counters)
            && v.shown.elapsed() < Duration::from_millis(500)
    });
    let (from, moved) =
        previous.map_or((pos, now), |v| if v.pos == pos { (v.from, v.moved) } else { (slide(v, now), now) });
    guard[usize::from(anchor)] = Some(View {
        session: remote.session.counters.clone(),
        dim: game.dim,
        pos,
        from,
        moved,
        shown: now,
        damage: rating.full_damage,
        own: rating.self_damage,
        tick: game.ticks,
    });
}
fn slide(view: &View, now: Instant) -> [f64; 3] {
    let fraction = (now.duration_since(view.moved).as_secs_f64() / 0.12).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let progress = 1.0 - (1.0 - fraction).powi(3);
    std::array::from_fn(|i| view.from[i] + (view.pos[i] - view.from[i]) * progress)
}
pub(super) fn clear_view(anchor: bool) {
    VIEWS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())[usize::from(anchor)] = None;
}
pub(super) fn draw(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    camera: &sunset::Camera,
    modules: &[Module],
    out: &mut impl sunset::Canvas,
    _width: f32,
) {
    let now = Instant::now();
    let views = VIEWS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).each_ref().map(|v| {
        v.as_ref()
            .filter(|v| {
                v.dim == game.dim
                    && game.ticks >= v.tick
                    && now.duration_since(v.shown) < Duration::from_millis(500)
                    && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, &v.session))
            })
            .map(|v| {
                (
                    slide(v, now),
                    v.damage,
                    v.own,
                    ((0.5 - now.duration_since(v.shown).as_secs_f64()) / 0.35).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                )
            })
    });
    for (index, name) in ["Crystal Aura", "Anchor Aura"].iter().enumerate() {
        let Some(module) = modules.iter().find(|m| m.name == *name && m.on && m.b("Aura") && m.b("Render")) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some((lo, damage, own, alpha)) = views[index] else {
            continue;
        };
        let color = module.t("Render color");
        let color = color
            .strip_prefix('#')
            .or_else(|| color.strip_prefix("0x"))
            .and_then(|s| u32::from_str_radix(s, 16).ok())
            .or_else(|| color.parse::<i32>().ok().map(|n| n as u32))
            .map(|n| if n <= 0x00ff_ffff { n | 0xff00_0000 } else { n })
            .unwrap_or(0xffff_ffff);
        let color = (((f64::from(color >> 24) * alpha).round() as u32) << 24) | (color & 0xffffff);
        super::sunset_visual::draw_box(
            camera,
            out,
            &super::sunset_visual::Look::BOXED,
            lo,
            lo.map(|v| v + 1.0),
            color,
            1.5,
        );
        let top = [lo[0] + 0.5, lo[1] + 1.25, lo[2] + 0.5];
        if let Some([x, y]) = camera.project(top) {
            let label = format!("{damage:.1}  self {own:.1}");
            let width = game.native_text_width(&label);
            out.text(&label, [x - width * 0.5, y], color & 0xffffff);
        }
    }
}

pub(super) use super::sunset_explosive_choice::Rating;
use super::sunset_explosive_choice::prefer_first;

pub(super) fn can_act(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.native_window()
        && game.native_on(sunset::ID)
        && game.native_playing()
        && game.screen == Screen::Playing
        && game.remote.is_some()
        && !sunset::gui_open()
        && !game.spectator()
        && game.selected < 9
        && game.using.is_none()
        && game.mining.is_none()
        && super::remote::sunset_remote::breaking(game).is_none()
        && !super::sunset_player::gap_eating()
        && !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::use_conflicts(game)
        && super::sunset_util::inventory_idle(game)
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.health.health().is_finite() && p.health.health() > 0.0)
        && sunset::CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0
        && super::sunset_combat_control::owner().is_none_or(|o| o == "Crystal Aura" || o == "Anchor Aura")
        && !sunset::with(|s| ["Blink", "Nuker", "Scaffold"].iter().any(|name| s.is_on(name)))
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, modules: &[Module], ticks: u64) {
    super::sunset_prediction::tick(game);
    // Each module's Aura section (its Macro section is combat_macros.rs's).
    let crystal = modules.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Crystal Aura" && m.on && m.b("Aura"));
    let anchor = modules.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Anchor Aura" && m.on && m.b("Aura"));
    if CRYSTAL_ON.swap(crystal.is_some(), Ordering::Relaxed) && crystal.is_none() {
        super::sunset_crystal_aura::disabled(game);
    }
    if crystal.is_none() && anchor.is_none() {
        super::sunset_crystal_aura::cleanup_shared(game);
    }
    if anchor.is_none() {
        super::sunset_anchor_aura::disabled(game);
    }
    if crystal.is_none() && anchor.is_none() {
        return;
    }
    if !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::refresh(game) || !can_act(game) {
        if crystal.is_some() {
            super::sunset_crystal_aura::paused(game);
        }
        if anchor.is_some() {
            super::sunset_anchor_aura::paused(game);
        }
        return;
    }
    if crystal.is_some()
        && !super::sunset_crystal_aura::owns_selection(game)
        && !super::sunset_explosive_tactics::may_take_hand(game)
    {
        super::sunset_crystal_aura::idle(game);
        super::sunset_anchor_aura::idle(game);
        return;
    }
    // Prepare each at most once, then claim only the chosen action. A pending
    // server acknowledgement is not a new inventory/rotation owner.
    let c = crystal.and_then(|m| super::sunset_crystal_aura::prepare(game, Some(m), ticks)).filter(|r| r.valid());
    super::sunset_anchor_aura::rival(if crystal.is_some() { super::sunset_crystal_aura::opening_value() } else { 0.0 });
    let a = anchor.and_then(|m| super::sunset_anchor_aura::prepare(game, m, ticks)).filter(|r| r.valid());
    let crystal_first = match (c, a) {
        (Some(c), Some(a)) => prefer_first(c, a, ticks % 2 == 0),
        (Some(_), None) => true,
        _ => false,
    };
    if c.is_none() && a.is_none() {
        let c = super::sunset_crystal_aura::lookahead();
        let a = super::sunset_anchor_aura::lookahead();
        let first = match (c, a) {
            (Some(c), Some(a)) => prefer_first(c, a, true),
            (Some(_), None) => true,
            _ => false,
        };
        if first {
            if let Some(m) = crystal {
                super::sunset_crystal_aura::advance_look(game, m);
            }
        } else if let Some(m) = anchor {
            super::sunset_anchor_aura::advance_look(game, m);
        }
        return;
    }
    if crystal_first {
        if let Some(m) = crystal {
            super::sunset_crystal_aura::execute(game, m, ticks);
        }
    } else if a.is_some() {
        if let Some(m) = anchor {
            super::sunset_anchor_aura::execute(game, m, ticks);
        }
    }
}
