```rs
// Which explosive action goes first, Crystal Aura's or Anchor Aura's, from what each would deal and cost.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Kind {
    CrystalHit,
    AnchorHit,
    Charge,
    CrystalPlace,
    ObsidianPlace,
    AnchorPlace,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Rating {
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub target_damage: f64,
    pub target_health: f64,
    pub self_damage: f64,
    pub held_totem: bool,
    pub ready_in: u16,
    pub look_credit: f64,
    pub full_damage: f64,
}

impl Rating {
    pub(super) fn new(
        kind: Kind,
        target_damage: f64,
        target_health: f64,
        self_damage: f64,
        held_totem: bool,
        ready_in: u16,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            kind,
            target_damage,
            target_health,
            self_damage,
            held_totem,
            ready_in,
            look_credit: 0.0,
            full_damage: target_damage,
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn planning_value(self) -> f64 {
        self.value() + self.look_credit
    }

    pub(super) fn valid(self) -> bool {
        [self.target_damage, self.target_health, self.self_damage].iter().all(|n| n.is_finite() && *n >= 0.0)
            && self.target_health > 0.0
    }
    pub(super) fn lethal(self) -> bool {
        self.target_damage >= self.target_health
    }
    pub(super) fn value(self) -> f64 {
        self.target_damage.min(self.target_health) - 0.5 * self.self_damage
            + if !self.lethal() {
                0.0
            } else if self.held_totem {
                500.0
            } else {
                1000.0
            }
    }
}

// Preserve scan order for exact ties; ready-in is a tie break within one kind.
// This accepts a bounded caller slice; no world scan or packet side effects.
pub(super) fn select(candidates: &[Rating]) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut best: [Option<usize>; 6] = [None; 6];
    let slot = |k| match k {
        Kind::CrystalHit => 0,
        Kind::AnchorHit => 1,
        Kind::Charge => 2,
        Kind::CrystalPlace => 3,
        Kind::ObsidianPlace => 4,
        Kind::AnchorPlace => 5,
    };
    for (i, c) in candidates.iter().copied().enumerate() {
        if !c.valid() {
            continue;
        }
        let at = slot(c.kind);
        if best[at].is_none_or(|old| {
            c.value() > candidates[old].value()
                || c.value() == candidates[old].value() && c.ready_in < candidates[old].ready_in
        }) {
            best[at] = Some(i);
        }
    }
    match (best[0], best[1]) {
        (Some(crystal), Some(anchor)) => {
            let (c, a) = (candidates[crystal], candidates[anchor]);
            Some(if a.value() > c.value() + 1.0 || a.lethal() && !c.lethal() { anchor } else { crystal })
        }
        (Some(i), None) | (None, Some(i)) => Some(i),
        (None, None) => best[2..].iter().copied().flatten().next(),
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(super) struct Stage {
    pub immediate_crystal: bool,
    pub opening_crystal: bool,
    pub crystal_receipt_pending: bool,
    pub existing_anchor_now: bool,
    pub existing_anchor_opening: bool,
}
impl Stage {
    pub(super) fn new_crystal(self) -> bool {
        !(self.immediate_crystal || self.opening_crystal || self.crystal_receipt_pending)
    }
    pub(super) fn new_anchor(self) -> bool {
        !(self.existing_anchor_now || self.existing_anchor_opening)
    }
}

pub(super) fn opening_horizon(action_steps: u32, opens_in: u32) -> u32 {
    action_steps.max(opens_in)
}

// A block can be placeable but its future crystal can be outside attack reach.
// Check the entity shape, not its center or the clicked block top.
pub(super) fn future_crystal_breakable(eye: [f64; 3], base: [i32; 3], entity_range: f64) -> bool {
    if !eye.iter().all(|n| n.is_finite()) || !entity_range.is_finite() || entity_range <= 0.1 {
        return false;
    }
    let min = [f64::from(base[0]) - 0.5, f64::from(base[1]) + 1.0, f64::from(base[2]) - 0.5];
    let max = [min[0] + 2.0, min[1] + 2.0, min[2] + 2.0];
    let squared = (0..3)
        .map(|i| {
            let n = eye[i].clamp(min[i], max[i]) - eye[i];
            n * n
        })
        .sum::<f64>();
    squared <= (entity_range - 0.1).powi(2)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn c(kind: Kind, target_damage: f64) -> Rating {
        Rating {
            kind,
            target_damage,
            target_health: 20.0,
            self_damage: 0.0,
            held_totem: false,
            ready_in: 0,
            look_credit: 0.0,
            full_damage: target_damage,
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn setup_advances_existing_cycle_before_new_cycle() {
        assert_eq!(select(&[c(Kind::AnchorPlace, 19.0), c(Kind::CrystalPlace, 15.0), c(Kind::Charge, 6.0)]), Some(2));
    }
    #[test]
    fn crystal_wins_small_anchor_improvement_and_equal_margin() {
        assert_eq!(select(&[c(Kind::CrystalHit, 8.0), c(Kind::AnchorHit, 9.0)]), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(select(&[c(Kind::CrystalHit, 8.0), c(Kind::AnchorHit, 9.01)]), Some(1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn apparent_lethal_anchor_beats_nonlethal_crystal() {
        let mut anchor = c(Kind::AnchorHit, 3.0);
        anchor.target_health = 3.0;
        assert_eq!(select(&[c(Kind::CrystalHit, 19.0), anchor]), Some(1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn observed_totem_pop_and_kill_have_different_priority() {
        let kill = c(Kind::CrystalHit, 20.0);
        let mut pop = kill;
        pop.held_totem = true;
        assert_eq!(select(&[pop, kill]), Some(1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn readiness_breaks_only_equal_within_kind() {
        let mut a = c(Kind::CrystalPlace, 8.0);
        a.ready_in = 3;
        let mut b = a;
        b.ready_in = 1;
        assert_eq!(select(&[a, b, c(Kind::AnchorPlace, 19.0)]), Some(1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn rejects_nonfinite_and_negative_scores_inputs() {
        assert_eq!(select(&[c(Kind::CrystalHit, f64::NAN), c(Kind::AnchorHit, -1.0)]), None);
    }
    #[test]
    fn pending_or_opening_crystal_blocks_another_placement() {
        assert!(Stage::default().new_crystal());
        assert!(!Stage { opening_crystal: true, ..Stage::default() }.new_crystal());
        assert!(!Stage { crystal_receipt_pending: true, ..Stage::default() }.new_crystal());
    }
    #[test]
    fn waiting_existing_anchor_blocks_fresh_anchor() {
        assert!(!Stage { existing_anchor_opening: true, ..Stage::default() }.new_anchor());
        assert!(Stage::default().new_anchor());
        assert_eq!(opening_horizon(2, 8), 8);
    }
    #[test]
    fn placement_reach_alone_does_not_make_crystal_breakable() {
        assert!(!future_crystal_breakable([0.0, 2.0, 0.5], [4, 0, 0], 3.0));
        assert!(future_crystal_breakable([0.0, 2.0, 0.5], [3, 0, 0], 3.0));
    }
    #[test]
    fn box_boundary_is_used_rather_than_crystal_center() {
        assert!(future_crystal_breakable([0.0, 2.0, 0.5], [3, 0, 0], 3.0));
        assert!(!future_crystal_breakable([f64::INFINITY, 2.0, 0.5], [3, 0, 0], 3.0));
    }
}

pub(super) fn prefer_first(first: Rating, second: Rating, _tie_first: bool) -> bool {
    select(&[first, second]) == Some(0)
```

```rs
// What an explosion would do to you or a target, from Horizon's own collision shapes and damage rules: never
// changes the world, equipment or anything else.
use super::Game;
use super::sunset_explosive_policy::{Budget, in_range, raw_damage, samples};
use super::sunset_util::Target;
use horizon_client::collisions::SceneCollisions;
use horizon_core::{
    geometry::{Vec3, VoxelShape},
    position::BlockPos,
};
use horizon_world::{
    collision_context::{CollisionContext, CollisionEntity, CollisionItem},
    combat_rules::ArmorWorld,
    damage_reduction::{self, Bypass, DamageReductionWorld},
    damage_source::{DamageSource, Scaling},
    entity_obstruction::EntityIdentity,
    food::Difficulty,
    registry::BlockStateId,
    world_ray::{RayBlockMode, RayFluidMode, RayWorld, clip_world},
};
use std::io;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Blast {
    pub center: [f64; 3],
    pub power: f32,
    // Ignore exactly one destroyed block without changing the damage source.
    pub ignored_block: Option<[i32; 3]>,
    virtual_block: Option<([i32; 3], BlockStateId)>,
    kind: BlastKind,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
enum BlastKind {
    Explosion,
    BadRespawnPoint,
}
impl Blast {
    pub(super) fn explosion(center: [f64; 3], power: f32) -> Self {
        Self { center, power, ignored_block: None, virtual_block: None, kind: BlastKind::Explosion }
    }
    pub(super) fn anchor(block: [i32; 3]) -> Self {
        Self {
            center: block.map(|v| f64::from(v) + 0.5),
            power: 5.0,
            ignored_block: Some(block),
            virtual_block: None,
            kind: BlastKind::BadRespawnPoint,
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn with_block(mut self, pos: [i32; 3], state: BlockStateId) -> Self {
        self.virtual_block = Some((pos, state));
        self
    }
    fn source(self) -> &'static str {
        match self.kind {
            BlastKind::Explosion => "minecraft:explosion",
            BlastKind::BadRespawnPoint => "minecraft:bad_respawn_point",
        }
    }
}

// The damage an explosion does you, with your armour, toughness, resistance, protection and the difficulty as observed.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Prediction {
    pub estimate: f64,
}

// Engine collider shape dispatch, including contextual blocks, rather than
// treating every occupied block as a full cube. Missing chunks/errors abort the
// entire prediction; they must never become false evidence of protective cover.
struct Rays<'a, 'r> {
    scene: SceneCollisions<'a, 'r>,
    context: CollisionContext<'static>,
    ignored: Option<[i32; 3]>,
    virtual_block: Option<([i32; 3], BlockStateId)>,
}
impl RayWorld for Rays<'_, '_> {
    type Error = io::Error;
    type Block = BlockStateId;
    type Fluid = ();
    fn block_state(&mut self, p: BlockPos) -> io::Result<BlockStateId> {
        if !self.scene.world.loaded(p.x, p.z) {
            return Err(io::Error::other("unloaded explosive ray"));
        }
        if let Some((pos, state)) = self.virtual_block
            && pos == [p.x, p.y, p.z]
        {
            return Ok(state);
        }
        Ok(self.scene.world.block(p.x, p.y, p.z))
    }
    fn fluid_state(&mut self, _: BlockPos) -> io::Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn block_shape(&mut self, state: BlockStateId, p: BlockPos, _: RayBlockMode) -> io::Result<VoxelShape> {
        if self.ignored == Some([p.x, p.y, p.z]) {
            return Ok(VoxelShape::empty());
        }
        let binding = self.scene.binding;
        binding
            .collision_shape_with_context(&mut self.scene, state, p, &self.context)
            .map_err(|e| io::Error::other(format!("{e:?}")))
    }
    fn interaction_shape(&mut self, _: BlockStateId, _: BlockPos) -> io::Result<VoxelShape> {
        Ok(VoxelShape::empty())
    }
    fn fluid_is_source(&mut self, _: ()) -> io::Result<bool> {
        Ok(false)
    }
    fn fluid_is_empty(&mut self, _: ()) -> io::Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }
    fn fluid_is_water(&mut self, _: ()) -> io::Result<bool> {
        Ok(false)
    }
    fn fluid_shape(&mut self, _: (), _: BlockPos) -> io::Result<VoxelShape> {
        Ok(VoxelShape::empty())
    }
}

fn rays<'a, 'r>(game: &'a Game<'r>, y: f64, ignored: Option<[i32; 3]>) -> Rays<'a, 'r> {
    Rays {
        scene: SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: None },
        context: CollisionContext::for_entity(
            CollisionEntity {
                identity: EntityIdentity(0),
                y,
                descending: false,
                main_hand: Some(CollisionItem::EMPTY),
            },
            false,
        ),
        ignored,
        virtual_block: None,
    }
}

fn clear(rays: &mut Rays<'_, '_>, from: [f64; 3], to: [f64; 3]) -> Option<bool> {
    if !in_range(from, to, 64.0) || !from.iter().chain(to.iter()).all(|v| v.abs() <= 30_000_000.0) {
        return None;
    }
    clip_world(
        rays,
        Vec3::new(from[0], from[1], from[2]),
        Vec3::new(to[0], to[1], to[2]),
        RayBlockMode::Collider,
        RayFluidMode::None,
        4096,
    )
    .ok()
    .map(|hit| hit.miss)
}

pub(super) fn clear_line(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    from: [f64; 3],
    to: [f64; 3],
    ignored: Option<[i32; 3]>,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> bool {
    if !budget.line() {
        return false;
    }
    clear(&mut rays(game, from[1], ignored), from, to) == Some(true)
}

fn raw(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    feet: [f64; 3],
    min: [f64; 3],
    max: [f64; 3],
    blast: Blast,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<f32> {
    if !blast.center.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() <= 30_000_000.0) || !feet.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
        return None;
    }
    let distance = (0..3).map(|i| (feet[i] - blast.center[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    let unoccluded = raw_damage(distance, blast.power, 1.0)?;
    if unoccluded == 0.0 {
        return budget.prediction(0).then_some(0.0);
    }
    let points = samples(min, max)?;
    if !budget.prediction(points.len()) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut ray = rays(game, min[1], blast.ignored_block);
    ray.virtual_block = blast.virtual_block;
    let mut seen = 0;
    for point in &points {
        if clear(&mut ray, *point, blast.center)? {
            seen += 1;
        }
    }
    raw_damage(distance, blast.power, seen as f32 / points.len() as f32)
}

// The source catalog decides difficulty and bypass tags; do not assume that
// all explosion-like sources scale the same way on a customized server.
fn source<'a>(game: &'a Game<'_>, blast: Blast) -> Option<DamageSource<'a, ()>> {
    let catalog = &game.motion.health.damage;
    catalog.source(catalog.id(blast.source())?, None, None, None)
}

fn difficulty(damage: f32, difficulty: Difficulty, scaling: Scaling) -> f32 {
    // Crystals/anchors have no living non-player causing entity.
    if scaling != Scaling::Always {
        return damage;
    }
    match difficulty {
        Difficulty::Peaceful => 0.0,
        Difficulty::Easy => (damage / 2.0 + 1.0).min(damage),
        Difficulty::Normal => damage,
        Difficulty::Hard => damage * 3.0 / 2.0,
    }
}

fn difficulty_id(id: u8) -> Difficulty {
    match id {
        0 => Difficulty::Peaceful,
        1 => Difficulty::Easy,
        3 => Difficulty::Hard,
        _ => Difficulty::Normal,
    }
}

fn observed_difficulty(game: &Game<'_>) -> Difficulty {
    // Remote ChangeDifficulty updates the UI snapshot, not World.health_rules. Horizon's own server never sends it
    // when /difficulty changes, so a Peaceful seen at join can be stale; read as such it made every player's damage 0
    // and Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura did nothing at all. Peaceful counts as Normal: where the world really is
    // peaceful no player takes explosion damage, so that costs a few crystals there, and your own damage is never
    // counted short.
    if game.remote.is_some() {
        match difficulty_id(game.ui.difficulty) {
            Difficulty::Peaceful => Difficulty::Normal,
            seen => seen,
        }
    } else {
        game.world.health_rules.difficulty
    }
}

// The armour worn is all known: no unknown item, stack, component or enchantment that changes how it wears.
fn equipment_known(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.armor.iter().flatten().all(|stack| {
        game.items().get(&stack.item).is_some()
            && stack.count == 1
            && stack.extra.as_ref().is_none_or(|extra| extra.other.is_empty())
            && stack.wire_patch().is_none_or(|patch| known_equipment_patch(&patch))
            && stack.extra.as_ref().is_none_or(|extra| {
                extra.enchantments.iter().all(|(id, _)| {
                    let Some(enchantment) = game.stations().enchantments.get(id) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    let Some(effects) = enchantment.effects.get("minecraft:item_damage") else {
                        return true;
                    };
                    effects.as_array().is_some_and(|list| {
                        list.iter().all(|effect| effect["effect"]["type"].as_str() == Some("minecraft:remove_binomial"))
                    })
                })
            })
    })
}

fn known_equipment_patch(patch: &[u8]) -> bool {
    use horizon_protocol::{buf::Reader, item::component as c};
    let mut reader = Reader::new(patch);
    let Ok(added) = reader.count(64) else {
        return false;
    };
    // Removed component ids can change prototype durability/equipment rules.
    if reader.count(64).ok() != Some(0) {
        return false;
    }
    for _ in 0..added {
        let Ok(kind) = reader.varint() else {
            return false;
        };
        if !matches!(kind, c::DAMAGE | c::ENCHANTMENTS | c::CUSTOM_NAME | c::REPAIR_COST | c::TRIM | c::DYED_COLOR) {
            return false;
        }
        let Ok(length) = reader.count(reader.remaining()) else {
            return false;
        };
        if reader.bytes(length).is_err() {
            return false;
        }
    }
    reader.remaining() == 0
}

struct Defenses<'a> {
    source: DamageSource<'a, ()>,
    armor: f64,
    toughness: f64,
    resistance: Option<i32>,
    protection: f32,
}
impl ArmorWorld for Defenses<'_> {
    type Error = std::convert::Infallible;
    type Weapon = ();
    type ServerLevel = ();
    fn weapon(&mut self) -> Result<Option<()>, Self::Error> {
        Ok(None)
    }
    fn server_level(&mut self) -> Result<Option<()>, Self::Error> {
        Ok(Some(()))
    }
    fn modify_armor_effectiveness(&mut self, _: (), _: (), value: f32) -> Result<f32, Self::Error> {
        Ok(value)
    }
}
impl DamageReductionWorld for Defenses<'_> {
    fn bypasses(&mut self, kind: Bypass) -> Result<bool, Self::Error> {
        Ok(self.source.bypasses(kind))
    }
    fn hurt_armor(&mut self, _: f32) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn armor_value(&mut self) -> Result<i32, Self::Error> {
        Ok(damage_reduction::armor_from_attribute(self.armor))
    }
    fn toughness_attribute(&mut self) -> Result<f64, Self::Error> {
        Ok(self.toughness)
    }
    fn has_resistance(&mut self) -> Result<bool, Self::Error> {
        Ok(self.resistance.is_some())
    }
    fn resistance_amplifier(&mut self) -> Result<i32, Self::Error> {
        Ok(self.resistance.unwrap_or(0))
    }
    fn victim_is_server_player(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }
    fn award_resisted(&mut self, _: i32) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn attacker_is_server_player(&mut self) -> Result<bool, Self::Error> {
        Ok(false)
    }
    fn award_dealt_resisted(&mut self, _: i32) -> Result<(), Self::Error> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn damage_protection(&mut self, _: ()) -> Result<f32, Self::Error> {
        Ok(self.protection)
    }
}

fn reduced(mut defenses: Defenses<'_>, damage: f32) -> Option<f64> {
    if ![defenses.armor, defenses.toughness, f64::from(defenses.protection)].iter().all(|x| x.is_finite() && *x >= 0.0)
        || defenses.resistance.is_some_and(|n| !(0..=255).contains(&n))
    {
        return None;
    }
    let armored = damage_reduction::after_armor(&mut defenses, damage).ok()?;
    let result = damage_reduction::after_magic(&mut defenses, armored).ok()?;
    (result.is_finite() && result >= 0.0).then_some(f64::from(result))
}

pub(super) fn local_damage(game: &mut Game<'_>, blast: Blast, budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<Prediction> {
    local_damage_at(game, blast, [0.0; 3], budget)
}
pub(super) fn local_damage_at(
    game: &mut Game<'_>,
    blast: Blast,
    offset: [f64; 3],
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<Prediction> {
    if !offset.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
        return None;
    }
    let p = game.player.as_mut()?;
    let armor = p.attribute("minecraft:armor").ok()?;
    let toughness = p.attribute("minecraft:armor_toughness").ok()?;
    let resistance = p.status.resistance;
    let protection = p.status.protection(blast.source());
    let feet = [p.position.x + offset[0], p.position.y + offset[1], p.position.z + offset[2]];
    let bounds = p.bounds().move_by(Vec3::new(offset[0], offset[1], offset[2]));
    let (min, max) = (bounds.min_position(), bounds.max_position());
    let damage = raw(game, feet, [min.x, min.y, min.z], [max.x, max.y, max.z], blast, budget)?;
    let source = source(game, blast)?;
    let scaling = source.definition().scaling;
    let observed = observed_difficulty(game);
    let estimate =
        reduced(Defenses { source, armor, toughness, resistance, protection }, difficulty(damage, observed, scaling))?;
    Some(Prediction { estimate })
}

// Offensive target pipeline: difficulty -> native shield -> hurt window ->
// native armor/magic. Self and friend bounds continue to use the full blast.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(super) struct TargetHurtRaw {
    victim: u32,
    blast: Blast,
    raw: f32,
}
impl TargetHurtRaw {
    pub(super) fn raw_before_armor(self) -> f32 {
        self.raw
    }
}

fn target_blocked(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Target, blast: Blast, scaled: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    use horizon_world::blocking_rules::{DamageReduction, TypeMatchWorld};
    let Some((stack, elapsed)) = super::sunset_prediction::blocking_hand(target.id, game.ticks)? else {
        return Some(0.0);
    };
    let Some(component) = game.blocks_attacks(&stack) else {
        return Some(0.0);
    };
    // Native protocol cannot decode a customized blocks_attacks patch. Never
    // manufacture custom component facts from an ordinary shield prototype.
    if stack.extra.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| !e.other.is_empty()) {
        return None;
    }
    if elapsed < (component.delay_seconds * 20.0).round().max(0.0) as u64 {
        return Some(0.0);
    }
    let damage_type = blast.source();
    let tags = &game.stations().enchantments.damage_tags;
    let matches = |spec: &str| match spec.strip_prefix('#') {
        Some(tag) => tags.get(tag).is_some_and(|set| set.contains(damage_type)),
        None => spec == damage_type,
    };
    if component.bypassed_by.as_deref().is_some_and(matches) {
        return Some(0.0);
    }
    let mob = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target.id)?;
    let yaw = f64::from(mob.head_yaw).to_radians();
    let delta = [blast.center[0] - target.pos[0], blast.center[2] - target.pos[2]];
    let length = delta[0].hypot(delta[1]);
    let cosine = if length < 1e-4 { 0.0 } else { (-yaw.sin() * delta[0] + yaw.cos() * delta[1]) / length };
    let angle = cosine.clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos();
    struct Known;
    impl TypeMatchWorld for Known {
        type Error = ();
        type Set = bool;
        fn source_in_set(&mut self, value: bool) -> Result<bool, ()> {
            Ok(value)
        }
    }
    let mut blocked = 0.0;
    for reduction in &component.reductions {
        let native = DamageReduction {
            horizontal_angle: reduction.horizontal_angle,
            types: reduction.types.as_ref().map(|set| set.iter().any(|spec| matches(spec))),
            base: reduction.base,
            factor: reduction.factor,
        };
        blocked += native.resolve(&mut Known, scaled, angle).ok()?;
    }
    (blocked.is_finite() && blocked >= 0.0).then_some(blocked.min(scaled))
}
pub(super) fn target_hurt_raw_at(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    target: &Target,
    blast: Blast,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<TargetHurtRaw> {
    game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target.id && !m.removed && m.alive())?;
    let raw = raw(game, target.pos, target.lo, target.hi, blast, budget)?;
    let source = source(game, blast)?;
    let scaled =
        if target.player { difficulty(raw, observed_difficulty(game), source.definition().scaling) } else { raw };
    let blocked = if target.player { target_blocked(game, target, blast, scaled)? } else { 0.0 };
    let raw = scaled - blocked;
    (raw.is_finite() && raw >= 0.0).then_some(TargetHurtRaw { victim: target.id, blast, raw })
}
pub(super) fn reduce_target_hurt_raw(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Target, sample: TargetHurtRaw, raw: f32) -> Option<f64> {
    if sample.victim != target.id || !raw.is_finite() || raw < 0.0 || raw > sample.raw {
        return None;
    }
    let mob = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target.id && !m.removed && m.alive())?;
    let (armor, toughness) = mob.worn_armor();
    let resistance = mob.extra.effects.iter().find(|e| e.0 == "resistance" && e.1 != 0).map(|e| e.2);
    let protection = horizon_client::mobs::gear::protection(mob, horizon_client::mobs::DamageKind::Explosion);
    reduced(
        Defenses {
            source: source(game, sample.blast)?,
            armor: f64::from(mob.kind.armor + armor),
            toughness: f64::from(mob.kind.armor_toughness + toughness),
            resistance,
            protection,
        },
        raw,
    )
}

// A caller that distinguishes open from covered must also distinguish unknown.
// Reuse the existing strict loaded-chunk collider query and shared ray budget.
pub(super) fn known_line(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    from: [f64; 3],
    to: [f64; 3],
    ignored: Option<[i32; 3]>,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<bool> {
    if !budget.line() {
        return None;
    }
    clear(&mut rays(game, from[1], ignored), from, to)
}

// Ordinary observed local estimate for explicitly requested manual actions.
// Unknown equipment components cannot silently borrow prototype defenses.
pub(super) fn observed_local_damage(game: &mut Game<'_>, blast: Blast, budget: &mut Budget) -> Option<f64> {
    if !equipment_known(game) {
        return None;
    }
    local_damage(game, blast, budget).map(|p| p.estimate).filter(|damage| damage.is_finite() && *damage >= 0.0)
}
```

```rs
// Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura's shared limits: the work a tick may do, the reach checks, an explosion's raw damage.

pub(super) fn in_range(from: [f64; 3], to: [f64; 3], range: f64) -> bool {
    if !range.is_finite() || range < 0.0 || !from.iter().chain(to.iter()).all(|x| x.is_finite()) {
        return false;
    }
    let squared = (0..3).map(|i| (from[i] - to[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>();
    squared.is_finite() && squared <= range * range
}

// Same sample locations as the pinned engine's ServerExplosion exposure grid.
// Refuse giant/invalid boxes rather than allocating or casting unbounded rays.
pub(super) fn samples(min: [f64; 3], max: [f64; 3]) -> Option<Vec<[f64; 3]>> {
    if !(0..3).all(|i| {
        min[i].is_finite()
            && max[i].is_finite()
            && min[i].abs() <= 30_000_000.0
            && max[i].abs() <= 30_000_000.0
            && max[i] >= min[i]
            && max[i] - min[i] <= 16.0
    }) {
        return None;
    }
    let step: [f64; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|i| 1.0 / ((max[i] - min[i]) * 2.0 + 1.0));
    let offset =
        [(1.0 - (1.0 / step[0]).floor() * step[0]) / 2.0, 0.0, (1.0 - (1.0 / step[2]).floor() * step[2]) / 2.0];
    let mut result = Vec::with_capacity(64);
    let mut x = 0.0;
    while x <= 1.0 {
        let mut y = 0.0;
        while y <= 1.0 {
            let mut z = 0.0;
            while z <= 1.0 {
                if result.len() >= 256 {
                    return None;
                }
                result.push([
                    min[0] + (max[0] - min[0]) * x + offset[0],
                    min[1] + (max[1] - min[1]) * y,
                    min[2] + (max[2] - min[2]) * z + offset[2],
                ]);
                z += step[2];
            }
            y += step[1];
        }
        x += step[0];
    }
    Some(result)
}

pub(super) fn raw_damage(distance: f64, power: f32, exposure: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    if !distance.is_finite()
        || distance < 0.0
        || !power.is_finite()
        || power <= 0.0
        || power > 8.0
        || !exposure.is_finite()
        || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&exposure)
    {
        return None;
    }
    let diameter = f64::from(power * 2.0);
    let normalized = distance / diameter;
    if normalized > 1.0 {
        return Some(0.0);
    }
    let impact = (1.0 - normalized) * f64::from(exposure);
    // The pinned engine converts to f32, without integer rounding.
    Some(((impact * impact + impact) / 2.0 * 7.0 * diameter + 1.0) as f32)
}

// A prediction reserves all exposure rays before any are cast. Both limits are
// absolute even if malformed dimensions/settings arrive from a server/config.
// Create once per aura tick and reuse for all candidates AND all friend checks.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Budget {
    limit: usize,
    pub predictions: usize,
    pub rays: usize,
    pub rejected: usize,
}

impl Budget {
    pub(super) fn new(max_predictions: usize) -> Self {
        Self { limit: max_predictions.min(64), predictions: 0, rays: 0, rejected: 0 }
    }

    pub(super) fn prediction(&mut self, rays: usize) -> bool {
        if self.predictions >= self.limit || rays > 256 || self.rays.saturating_add(rays) > 4096 {
            self.rejected = self.rejected.saturating_add(1);
            return false;
        }
        self.predictions += 1;
        self.rays += rays;
        true
    }

    pub(super) fn line(&mut self) -> bool {
        if self.rays >= 4096 {
            self.rejected = self.rejected.saturating_add(1);
            return false;
        }
        self.rays += 1;
        true
    }
}
```

```rs
// What Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura share each tick: the reach attributes, the players to hit and spare, the look.
use super::sunset_util::Target;
use super::{Dim, Game};
use super::{sunset_prediction as prediction, sunset_util as util};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
type Connection = Arc<Mutex<Option<Arc<horizon_protocol::connection::Counters>>>>;
struct Context {
    session: Connection,
    dim: Dim,
    id: i32,
    tick: u64,
    block: f64,
    entity: f64,
    focus: Option<u32>,
}
static CONTEXT: Mutex<Option<Context>> = Mutex::new(None);
fn same(game: &Game<'_>, c: &Context) -> bool {
    game.dim == c.dim
        && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == c.id && Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, &c.session))
}
pub(super) fn refresh(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let (session, id) = (remote.session.counters.clone(), remote.entity_id);
    let Some(player) = game.player.as_mut() else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some((block, entity)) = player
        .attribute("minecraft:block_interaction_range")
        .ok()
        .zip(player.attribute("minecraft:entity_interaction_range").ok())
    else {
        return false;
    };
    if ![block, entity].iter().all(|n| n.is_finite() && *n > 0.1 && *n <= 64.0) {
        return false;
    }
    let mut guard = CONTEXT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let focus = guard.as_ref().filter(|c| same(game, c)).and_then(|c| c.focus);
    *guard = Some(Context { session, dim: game.dim, id, tick: game.ticks, block, entity, focus });
    true
}
fn range(game: &Game<'_>, entity: bool) -> f64 {
    CONTEXT
        .lock()
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|c| same(game, c) && c.tick == game.ticks)
        .map_or(0.0, |c| if entity { c.entity } else { c.block })
}
// Exact current interaction attributes for manual cursor picking. Autonomous
// planners retain their own small placement/rotation margins below.
pub(super) fn interaction_ranges(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
    let guard = CONTEXT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let c = guard.as_ref().filter(|c| same(game, c) && c.tick == game.ticks)?;
    Some((c.block, c.entity))
}
pub(super) fn block_range(game: &Game<'_>) -> f64 {
    (range(game, false) - 0.1).max(0.0)
}
pub(super) fn anchor_range(game: &Game<'_>) -> f64 {
    (range(game, false) - 0.01).max(0.0)
}
pub(super) fn entity_range(game: &Game<'_>) -> f64 {
    (range(game, true) - 0.1).max(0.0)
}
pub(super) fn target_score(distance: f64, focused: bool, weak: bool) -> f64 {
    distance - if focused { 2.0 } else { 0.0 } - if weak { 2.0 } else { 0.0 }
}
pub(super) fn players(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<(Vec<Target>, Vec<Target>)> {
    if game.mobs.len() > 512 {
        return None;
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let feet = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    let own = game.remote.as_ref()?.entity_id as u32;
    let names = super::sunset::with(|s| s.friends.clone());
    let focus =
        CONTEXT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_ref().filter(|c| same(game, c)).and_then(|c| c.focus);
    let (mut targets, mut friends) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
    for mob in &game.mobs {
        if mob.kind.id != "minecraft:player" || mob.removed || !mob.alive() || mob.id == own {
            continue;
        }
        let t = util::mob_target(mob);
        if !t.pos.iter().chain(t.lo.iter()).chain(t.hi.iter()).all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
            return None;
        }
        let friend =
            game.remote_player_name(mob.id).is_some_and(|name| names.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)));
        if friend {
            friends.push(t);
        } else if util::dist(feet, t.pos) < 10.0 && util::player_enemy(game, mob) {
            targets.push(t);
        }
    }
    let score = |t: &Target| {
        target_score(
            util::dist(feet, t.pos),
            focus == Some(t.id),
            prediction::effective_health(game, t).unwrap_or(f64::from(t.health)) <= 10.0,
        )
    };
    targets.sort_by(|a, b| score(a).total_cmp(&score(b)));
    targets.truncate(3);
    if let Some(c) = CONTEXT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_mut().filter(|c| same(game, c)) {
        c.focus = targets.first().map(|t| t.id);
    }
    Some((targets, friends))
}
pub(super) fn breakable(game: &Game<'_>, base: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    game.eye_position().is_some_and(|eye| {
        super::sunset_explosive_choice::future_crystal_breakable(eye, base, entity_range(game) + 0.1)
    })
}
pub(super) fn endangered(damage: f64, health: f64, creative: bool) -> bool {
    !damage.is_finite()
        || !health.is_finite()
        || damage < 0.0
        || health <= 0.0
        || !creative && damage * 1.15 + 2.0 >= health
}
pub(super) fn friend_health(game: &Game<'_>, t: &Target) -> f64 {
    prediction::effective_health(game, t).unwrap_or(f64::from(t.health))
}
pub(super) fn fixed_look(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.riding.is_some()
        || game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.fall_flying || p.auto_spin_attack_ticks > 0 || p.swimming)
        || super::sunset_render::camera_takes_mouse()
}
pub(super) fn next_look(game: &Game<'_>, desired: (f32, f32), speed: f64) -> (f32, f32) {
    if fixed_look(game) {
        return (game.yaw, game.pitch);
    }
    let base = super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game).unwrap_or((game.yaw, game.pitch));
    let quantum = horizon_client::mouse::degrees_per_count(game.look_options());
    let random = {
        use horizon_core::random::{LegacyRandom, RandomSource};
        static RANDOM: Mutex<Option<LegacyRandom>> = Mutex::new(None);
        let mut random = RANDOM.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        random.get_or_insert_with(|| LegacyRandom::new(game.ticks as i64)).next_double()
    };
    super::sunset_aura_policy::rotation_step([base.0, base.1], [desired.0, desired.1], quantum, speed, random)
        .map_or((game.yaw, game.pitch), |[yaw, pitch]| (yaw, pitch))
}
pub(super) fn same_camera(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game).is_some_and(|(yaw, pitch)| {
        ((yaw - game.yaw + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0).abs() <= 2.0 && (pitch - game.pitch).abs() <= 2.0
    })
}
pub(super) fn aim_eye(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    if fixed_look(game) {
        return Some(eye);
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    // Standing on the ground the game still adds gravity to the velocity, but the eyes don't go down: aiming from
    // there flattened the look at a crystal spot near your feet until it fell short or ran past reach.
    let fall = if p.ground.on_ground { p.velocity.y.max(0.0) } else { p.velocity.y };
    let velocity = [p.velocity.x, fall, p.velocity.z];
    velocity.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()).then(|| std::array::from_fn(|i| eye[i] + velocity[i]))
}
// The auras take the hotbar from whatever you hold (a pickaxe, food, blocks: walking up to someone, you rarely hold
// a sword) and give it back after, except a golden apple you keep ready to eat. While you use the item (right click,
// eating, mining) they wait.
pub(super) fn may_take_hand(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    !game
        .inventory
        .get(game.selected)
        .and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
        .is_some_and(|s| matches!(util::short(&s.item), "golden_apple" | "enchanted_golden_apple"))
}
pub(super) fn use_conflicts(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    if !game.right {
        return false;
    }
    fn name(s: Option<&horizon_client::items::ItemStack>) -> Option<&str> {
        s.map(|s| util::short(&s.item))
    }
    let main = game.inventory.get(game.selected).and_then(|s| s.as_ref());
    if matches!(name(main), Some("respawn_anchor" | "glowstone")) {
        return true;
    }
    // Right click held with a block, food or anything else of your own in hand: you are using it.
    if !matches!(name(main), Some("end_crystal" | "obsidian")) && !combat_item(game, main) {
        return true;
    }
    let off = game.offhand.as_ref();
    !matches!(name(off), Some("end_crystal" | "obsidian")) && !combat_item(game, off)
}
pub(super) fn combat_item(game: &Game<'_>, stack: Option<&horizon_client::items::ItemStack>) -> bool {
    stack.is_none_or(|s| {
        s.count == 0
            || matches!(util::short(&s.item), "mace" | "totem_of_undying")
            || ["minecraft:swords", "minecraft:axes"]
                .iter()
                .any(|tag| game.items().item_tags.get(*tag).is_some_and(|items| items.contains(&*s.item)))
    })
}
pub(super) fn friend_damage(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    target: &Target,
    blast: super::sunset_explosive_damage::Blast,
    budget: &mut super::sunset_explosive_policy::Budget,
) -> Option<f64> {
    use super::sunset_explosive_damage as damage;
    let sample = damage::target_hurt_raw_at(game, target, blast, budget)?;
    damage::reduce_target_hurt_raw(game, target, sample, sample.raw_before_armor())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/extras.rs`:

```rs
// Client: the things that are not cheats (Unlock All Recipes, in World, works in recipes.rs). Client Sort, like
// ClientSort as Sayer uses it: three small buttons down the right of each part of an inventory screen (sort_buttons.rs),
// Sort, Fill Stacks and Restock. Sort goes in creative order, by count with Shift, by name with Ctrl and by id with Alt; Horizon's
// sort key does the same, on the hotbar only while the pointer is on it. The clicks go out a few a tick, an operation
// at least two ticks after the one before.

use super::sunset::{Category, Module};
use super::Game;
use horizon_client::items::ItemStack;
use horizon_client::menu::Input;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use winit::keyboard::KeyCode;

// A key past any real one.
const LAST: usize = 1 << 40;
const CLICKS_PER_TICK: usize = 4;
const GAP_TICKS: u32 = 2;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Unlock All Recipes", Category::World,
            "Shows every recipe as unlocked."),
        Module::new("Profiles", Category::Client, "Saved settings to load."),
        Module::new("Client Sort", Category::Client,
            "Sorts inventories in your order."),
    ]
}

// Client Sort is on (read by the buttons' hooks each frame).
static ON: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub(super) fn on() -> bool {
    ON.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

// The operations still to do, each its clicks (slot id, quick move or not), and the ticks to wait before the next.
struct Queue {
    ops: VecDeque<VecDeque<(usize, bool)>>,
    wait: u32,
}

static QUEUE: Mutex<Queue> = Mutex::new(Queue { ops: VecDeque::new(), wait: 0 });

fn queue<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Queue) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut QUEUE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// Horizon's sort of `slots` (its sort key; the buttons are Client Sort's own), done Client Sort's way. True when it
// took it.
pub(super) fn sort(game: &mut Game<'_>, slots: &[usize]) -> bool {
    if !on() || !game.native_on(super::sunset::ID) {
        return false;
    }
    let hotbar: Vec<usize> = (0..9).collect();
    let slots = if game.inventory_target().0.is_some_and(|s| s < 9) { &hotbar } else { slots };
    operate(game, 0, slots);
    true
}

// One of the buttons' operations on the part `slots`: 0 sort, 1 fill stacks, 2 restock. Queued after any still going.
pub(super) fn operate(game: &mut Game<'_>, op: usize, slots: &[usize]) {
    if game.carried.is_some() {
        return;
    }
    // Slots Loadouts locks take no part.
    let slots: Vec<usize> = slots.iter().copied().filter(|&s| !super::sunset_loadouts::locked(s)).collect();
    let slots = &slots[..];
    let clicks: VecDeque<(usize, bool)> = match op {
        0 => sort_clicks(game, slots).into_iter().map(|s| (s, false)).collect(),
        1 => fill_clicks(game, slots).into(),
        _ => restock_clicks(game, slots).into(),
    };
    queue(|q| q.ops.push_back(clicks));
}

// What faces this part: a container's slots face your inventory, your inventory faces the container (or, with none,
// the hotbar).
fn other_side(game: &Game<'_>, slots: &[usize]) -> Vec<usize> {
    if slots.first().is_some_and(|&s| s >= 300) {
        return (0..36).filter(|&s| !super::sunset_loadouts::locked(s)).collect();
    }
    let container: Vec<usize> = game.slots().into_iter().filter(|s| (300..500).contains(s)).collect();
    if container.is_empty() { (0..9).collect() } else { container }
}

// Left clicks that sort `slots`: creative order, Shift by count, Ctrl by name, Alt by id.
fn sort_clicks(game: &mut Game<'_>, slots: &[usize]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let alt = game.physical_keys.contains(&KeyCode::AltLeft) || game.physical_keys.contains(&KeyCode::AltRight);
    let (ctrl, shift) = (game.has_control_down(), game.has_shift_down());
    let views: Vec<Option<ItemStack>> = slots.iter().map(|&s| game.slot_view(s)).collect();
    let totals = |item: &str| views.iter().flatten().filter(|s| &*s.item == item).map(|s| s.count as usize).sum::<usize>();
    let registry = &game.res.items().registry_order;
    let rank = |s: &ItemStack| -> horizon_client::inv_sort::Rank {
        let name = s.custom_name().unwrap_or_else(|| game.pack.names.display_item(&s.item));
        let creative = game.creative_screen.order_of(s).unwrap_or(LAST);
        if alt {
            (registry.iter().position(|r| *r == s.item).unwrap_or(LAST), name)
        } else if ctrl {
            (0, name.to_lowercase())
        } else if shift {
            (LAST - totals(&s.item).min(LAST), format!("{creative:012}"))
        } else {
            (creative, name)
        }
    };
    let max = |s: &ItemStack| game.max_stack(s);
    horizon_client::inv_sort::plan(&views, &rank, &max).into_iter().map(|i| slots[i]).collect()
}

// Fill Stacks: each stack here short of full takes the same item from the other side (pick it up, click the stack
// here, put back what is left), as the counts will be after each move.
fn fill_clicks(game: &mut Game<'_>, slots: &[usize]) -> Vec<(usize, bool)> {
    let side = other_side(game, slots);
    let mut here: Vec<(usize, Option<ItemStack>)> = slots.iter().map(|&s| (s, game.slot_view(s))).collect();
    let mut there: Vec<(usize, Option<ItemStack>)> = side.iter().map(|&s| (s, game.slot_view(s))).collect();
    let mut clicks = Vec::new();
    for (to, stack) in &mut here {
        let Some(stack) = stack else {
            continue;
        };
        let max = game.max_stack(stack);
        for (from, source) in &mut there {
            if stack.count >= max {
                break;
            }
            let Some(src) = source.as_mut().filter(|v| v.same_item_same_components(stack)) else {
                continue;
            };
            let moved = src.count.min(max - stack.count);
            stack.count += moved;
            src.count -= moved;
            clicks.extend([(*from, false), (*to, false)]);
            if src.count > 0 {
                clicks.push((*from, false));
            } else {
                *source = None;
            }
        }
    }
    clicks
}

// Restock: each stack here whose item the other side already has is quick-moved across.
fn restock_clicks(game: &mut Game<'_>, slots: &[usize]) -> Vec<(usize, bool)> {
    let side = other_side(game, slots);
    let there: Vec<ItemStack> = side.iter().filter_map(|&s| game.slot_view(s)).collect();
    slots
        .iter()
        .filter(|&&s| game.slot_view(s).is_some_and(|v| there.iter().any(|t| t.same_item_same_components(&v))))
        .map(|&s| (s, true))
        .collect()
}

// Each tick: Horizon's sort (its key) on while Client Sort is, and the next clicks of an operation; none once the
// screen they were for has closed.
pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, mods: &[Module]) {
    super::recipe_book::sunset_recipes::sync(game, mods.iter().any(|m| m.name == "Unlock All Recipes" && m.on));
    let on = mods.iter().any(|m| m.name == "Client Sort" && m.on);
    ON.store(on, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if on {
        game.settings.extras.sort = true;
    }
    if game.screen != super::Screen::Inventory {
        queue(|q| q.ops.clear());
        return;
    }
    let now: Vec<(usize, bool)> = queue(|q| {
        if q.wait > 0 {
            q.wait -= 1;
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let Some(op) = q.ops.front_mut() else {
            return Vec::new();
        };
        let now = op.drain(..CLICKS_PER_TICK.min(op.len())).collect();
        if op.is_empty() {
            q.ops.pop_front();
            q.wait = GAP_TICKS;
        }
        now
    });
    for (slot, quick) in now {
        game.tweak_click(slot, 0, if quick { Input::QuickMove } else { Input::Pickup });
    }
}
```

```rs
// The facts Face Place needs about a target: health, the blocks round its feet, its armour's wear.
use super::{
    sunset_durability_patch::{self as durability_patch, Prototype},
    sunset_faceplace_policy::ArmorCondition,
};
use horizon_client::{blocks::BlockFacts, items::ItemStack, world::World};
use horizon_core::{geometry::Vec3, position::BlockPos};
pub fn horizontal_resistance(world: &World, facts: &BlockFacts, feet: Vec3) -> [Option<f32>; 4] {
    if !feet.is_finite() || feet.components().iter().any(|v| v.abs() > 30_000_000.0) {
        return [None; 4];
    }
    let pos = BlockPos::containing(feet);
    [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]].map(|[x, z]| {
        let p = pos.offset(x, 0, z);
        if !world.loaded(p.x, p.z) {
            return None;
        }
        let resistance = facts.get(world.block(p.x, p.y, p.z)).explosion_resistance;
        resistance.is_finite().then_some(resistance)
    })
}
pub fn armor(stack: &ItemStack, prototype: Prototype) -> Option<ArmorCondition> {
    if stack.count == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let patch = stack.wire_patch();
    // A changed locally decoded stack can lose its exact wire patch. Saved
    // unmodelled components must not silently fall back to ordinary prototypes.
    if patch.is_none() && stack.extra.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| !e.other.is_empty()) {
        return None;
    }
    durability_patch::resolve(prototype, stack.damage, patch.as_deref())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/faceplace_policy.rs`:

```rs
// Face Place: a lower damage floor when the target is low on health, in a hole, or its armour is nearly broken.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ArmorCondition {
    /// Already resolved native components: unbreakable is false here.
    pub damageable: bool,
    pub maximum: u32,
    pub lost: u32,
}
impl ArmorCondition {
    pub fn low(self) -> bool {
        self.damageable
            && self.maximum > 0
            && u64::from(self.maximum.saturating_sub(self.lost)) * 10 <= u64::from(self.maximum)
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct FaceFacts {
    /// Actual health plus absorption; None means the observer cannot establish it.
    pub effective_health: Option<f64>,
    /// Four horizontal neighbors at the target's CURRENT feet cell.
    pub neighbor_resistance: [Option<f32>; 4],
    pub armor: [Option<ArmorCondition>; 4],
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Reason {
    Normal,
    Forced,
    LowHealth,
    Hole,
    LowArmor,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Threshold {
    pub minimum: f64,
    pub reason: Reason,
}
fn health(facts: &FaceFacts) -> Option<f64> {
    facts.effective_health.filter(|v| v.is_finite() && *v > 0.0)
}
pub fn crystal(configured: f64, enabled: bool, forced: bool, breaking: bool, facts: &FaceFacts) -> Option<Threshold> {
    if !configured.is_finite() || configured < 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    let reason = if forced {
        Reason::Forced
    } else if !enabled {
        Reason::Normal
    } else if health(facts).is_some_and(|hp| hp <= 10.0) {
        Reason::LowHealth
    } else if facts.neighbor_resistance.iter().all(|r| r.is_some_and(|v| v.is_finite() && v >= 600.0)) {
        Reason::Hole
    } else if facts.armor.iter().flatten().any(|a| a.low()) {
        Reason::LowArmor
    } else {
        Reason::Normal
    };
    let minimum = if reason == Reason::Normal { configured } else { configured.min(2.0) };
    Some(Threshold { minimum: minimum * if breaking { 0.6 } else { 1.0 }, reason })
}
pub fn anchor(configured: f64, effective_health: Option<f64>) -> Option<f64> {
    if !configured.is_finite() || configured < 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(effective_health.filter(|v| v.is_finite() && *v > 0.0).map_or(configured, |hp| configured.min(hp)))
}
/// Call only AFTER raw hurt-window adjustment and native defense reduction.
/// Unknown absorption never establishes estimated lethality.
pub fn sufficient(incremental_estimate: f64, threshold: f64, effective_health: Option<f64>) -> bool {
    incremental_estimate.is_finite()
        && incremental_estimate >= 0.0
        && threshold.is_finite()
        && threshold >= 0.0
        && (incremental_estimate >= threshold
            || effective_health.is_some_and(|hp| hp.is_finite() && hp > 0.0 && incremental_estimate >= hp))
}
```

```rs
// No Render's fog switches, read by the fog type hook.
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;

pub static NO_WATER: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub static NO_LAVA: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
thread_local! {
    pub static BUSY: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
}
pub fn busy() -> bool {
    BUSY.with(Cell::get)
}
pub fn set_busy(v: bool) {
    BUSY.with(|b| b.set(v));
}
```

`mixins/sunset/fog_hook.rs`:

```rs
// No Render: water, lava and powder snow fog turned into plain air.
fn sunset_fog_hook(world: &World, facts: &BlockFacts, camera: [f64; 3], forward: [f64; 3]) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<FogType> {
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    let (water, lava) = (sunset_fog::NO_WATER.load(Relaxed), sunset_fog::NO_LAVA.load(Relaxed));
    if !(water || lava) || sunset_fog::busy() {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    sunset_fog::set_busy(true);
    let found = fog_type(world, facts, camera, forward);
    sunset_fog::set_busy(false);
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(match found {
        FogType::Water if water => FogType::Atmospheric,
        FogType::Lava | FogType::PowderSnow if lava => FogType::Atmospheric,
        other => other,
    })
}
```

`mixins/sunset/font_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Sunset's own fonts, so its menu and HUD don't use Minecraft's bitmap one. Horizon reads TrueType fonts from
// the resources, so each file and its definition are written there before the fonts load.
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU8, Ordering};

use super::sunset_fontdata::FONTS;

// The HUD's Font choice: 0 is the game's own font, 1 and up the fonts of sunset_fontdata::FONTS in order.
pub static STYLE: AtomicU8 = AtomicU8::new(1);
// Set while a header is drawn: it takes the font's bolder weight.
pub static BOLD: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub static READY: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// The GUI scale the glyphs were last drawn for (f32 bits).
static SCALE: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0);

// The STYLE for a name HUD > Font offers: Minecraft's own is 0, a font its place in the list, and anything else (a
// choice from an older version) the first.
pub fn style(label: &str) -> u8 {
    match super::sunset_fontdata::LABELS.iter().position(|l| *l == label) {
        Some(i) if i < FONTS.len() => i as u8 + 1,
        Some(_) => 0,
        None => 1,
    }
}

fn put(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if std::fs::read(path).is_ok_and(|have| have == bytes) {
        return true;
    }
    std::fs::write(path, bytes).is_ok()
}

// Called as the game's fonts load: puts the fonts where they look.
pub fn install(root: &Path) {
    let dir = root.join("assets").join("sunset").join("font");
    let mut ok = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).is_ok();
    for (name, regular, bold, size) in FONTS {
        for (stem, data) in [(name.to_owned(), regular), (format!("{name}-bold"), bold)] {
            let definition = format!(
                r#"{{"providers":[{{"type":"ttf","file":"sunset:{stem}.ttf","size":{size:.1},"oversample":4.0,"shift":[0.0,0.0]}}]}}"#
            );
            ok = ok && put(&dir.join(format!("{stem}.json")), definition.as_bytes()) && put(&dir.join(format!("{stem}.ttf")), data);
        }
    }
    READY.store(ok, Ordering::Relaxed);
    // The fonts are new: tune them again at the next draw.
    SCALE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

// Draws the glyphs at the screen's own pixel size: one oversampled pixel for each screen pixel, so each glyph
// lands on whole screen pixels and the text is sharp at any GUI scale instead of being scaled from a fixed bitmap.
// The height is nudged so the capitals are a whole number of pixels tall, and their top and bottom edges are
// crisp. Called as text is drawn.
pub fn sync(font: &super::Font, gui_scale: f32) {
    use ab_glyph::Font as _;
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    if f32::from_bits(SCALE.load(Relaxed)) == gui_scale {
        return;
    }
    SCALE.store(gui_scale.to_bits(), Relaxed);
    {
        let mut cache = font.cache.borrow_mut();
        for (id, set) in cache.sets.iter_mut() {
            let Some(size) = id
                .strip_prefix("sunset:")
                .and_then(|n| FONTS.iter().find(|f| f.0 == n.strip_suffix("-bold").unwrap_or(n)))
                .map(|f| f.3)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            for provider in set.providers.iter_mut() {
                if let super::Provider::TrueType(_, tt) = provider {
                    let units = tt.font.units_per_em().unwrap_or(1000.0);
                    let k = tt.font.height_unscaled() / units;
                    // The capitals' height as a share of the em: the H at an em of 1000 pixels.
                    let cap = tt
                        .font
                        .outline_glyph(tt.font.glyph_id('H').with_scale(ab_glyph::PxScale::from(1000.0 * k)))
                        .map_or(0.7, |o| o.px_bounds().height() / 1000.0);
                    let em = (size * gui_scale).round().max(1.0);
                    let tall = (cap * em).round().max(1.0) / cap;
                    tt.oversample = gui_scale;
                    tt.scale = ab_glyph::PxScale { x: em * k, y: tall * k };
                    tt.shift = (0.0, 0.0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    font.reset_cache();
}

pub fn enabled() -> bool {
    STYLE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) != 0 && READY.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

// A line of text in the chosen font.
pub fn text(s: &str) -> crate::text::Text {
    let name = FONTS.get(usize::from(STYLE.load(Ordering::Relaxed)).wrapping_sub(1)).map_or(FONTS[0].0, |f| f.0);
    let bold = if BOLD.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { "-bold" } else { "" };
    crate::text::Text::styled(
        s,
        crate::text::Style {
            font: Some(format!("sunset:{name}{bold}")),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
}
```

```rs
// As the fonts load, Sunset's goes into the resources.
fn sunset_font_hook(root: &Path) {
    sunset_font::install(root);
}
```

`mixins/sunset/goto.rs`:

```rs
// .goto x y z (from Rust's PR #24): walks there on Horizon's own A* path and walking task, the one horizon-ctl's goto
// runs, so it lives next to them in agent.rs. Movement keys, a screen, the menu, Panic or turning Sunset off stop it.
use super::{Game, Goto, MOVE_KEYS, TaskKind};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::mpsc::{Receiver, TryRecvError, channel};

const TASK: &str = "sunset.goto";
const RANGE: f64 = 128.0;

// The running walk's answer channel and the dimension it started in.
static WALK: Mutex<Option<(Receiver<String>, &'static str)>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn owns(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.agent.task.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.name == TASK)
}

pub(crate) fn cancel(game: &mut Game<'_>, why: &str) -> bool {
    if !owns(game) {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(task) = game.agent.task.take() {
        let _ = task.reply.send(serde_json::json!({ "error": why }).to_string());
    }
    // The walk holds movement keys only: the mouse buttons stay as you hold them.
    for key in MOVE_KEYS {
        game.keys.remove(&key);
    }
    true
}

fn parse(args: &[&str]) -> Result<Option<[i32; 3]>, &'static str> {
    if let [word] = args
        && word.eq_ignore_ascii_case("stop")
    {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let usage = "Use .goto <x> <y> <z> (whole block coordinates) or .goto stop.";
    let [x, y, z] = args else {
        return Err(usage);
    };
    let at = [x, y, z].map(|w| w.parse::<i32>());
    let [Ok(x), Ok(y), Ok(z)] = at else {
        return Err(usage);
    };
    if x.abs() > 29_999_983 || z.abs() > 29_999_983 || !(-64..=319).contains(&y) {
        return Err("That is outside the world.");
    }
    Ok(Some([x, y, z]))
}

pub(crate) fn command(game: &mut Game<'_>, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
    let Some(at) = parse(args)? else {
        let stopped = cancel(game, "navigation stopped");
        return Ok(if stopped { "Stopped walking." } else { "Not walking anywhere." }.into());
    };
    game.playing().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if game.agent.task.is_some() || game.agent.glide.is_some() {
        return Err("Something else is moving you; stop it first.".into());
    }
    if game.keys.iter().any(|k| MOVE_KEYS.contains(k)) {
        return Err("Let go of the movement keys first.".into());
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref().ok_or("No player.")?;
    if p.flying || !p.ground.on_ground {
        return Err("Stand on the ground first.".into());
    }
    let from = [p.position.x.floor() as i32, p.position.y.round() as i32, p.position.z.floor() as i32];
    let target = [f64::from(at[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(at[1]), f64::from(at[2]) + 0.5];
    let far = (target[0] - p.position.x).hypot(target[2] - p.position.z).hypot(target[1] - p.position.y);
    if far > RANGE {
        return Err(format!("That is {far:.0} blocks away; .goto walks up to {RANGE:.0}."));
    }
    let path = game.find_path(from, target, 0.6).ok_or("No walking path there through loaded terrain.")?;
    let nodes = path.len();
    let goto = Goto {
        target,
        near: 0.6,
        sprint: false,
        path,
        next: 1,
        progress_tick: game.ticks,
        replans: 0,
        jump_until: 0,
        warning: None,
    };
    let (tx, rx) = channel();
    game.start_task(TASK, TaskKind::Goto(Box::new(goto)), &tx, 60.0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    *WALK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some((rx, game.dim.id()));
    Ok(format!("Walking to {} {} {} ({nodes} steps). .goto stop stops.", at[0], at[1], at[2]))
}

// Each frame, before Horizon steps the task: stop it when it should, and say how it ended.
pub(crate) fn frame(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let mut walk = WALK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Some((rx, dim)) = walk.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    if *dim != game.dim.id() || !game.native_on("sunset") || crate::game::sunset::gui_open() || game.playing().is_err() {
        cancel(game, "stopped: a screen opened or Sunset was turned off");
    }
    let reply = match rx.try_recv() {
        Ok(reply) => Some(reply),
        Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => None,
        Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => return,
    };
    *walk = None;
    drop(walk);
    let Some(v) = reply.and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&s).ok()) else {
        return;
    };
    let text = if v["arrived"].as_bool() == Some(true) {
        "Arrived."
    } else {
        v["error"].as_str().unwrap_or("Stopped walking.")
    };
    crate::game::sunset::say(game, text);
}

// A movement key you press stops the walk; the game then takes the key as usual, so your movement wins at once.
pub(crate) fn key(game: &mut Game<'_>, key: &str) {
    let moves = ["key.forward", "key.back", "key.left", "key.right", "key.jump", "key.sneak", "key.sprint"];
    if moves.iter().any(|m| game.settings.keys.get(m) == key) {
        cancel(game, "stopped: you moved");
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/hand_item.rs`:

```rs
// Hand View: an item held in first person, moved, turned and sized, and lit at full brightness with No hand shadow.
fn sunset_hand_item(this: &Game<'_>, state: &ItemRenderState, pose: glam::Mat4, light: u32, out: &mut Vec<Vertex>) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<()> {
    use horizon_client::first_person::sunset_hand_view as view;
    let left = match state.display {
        DisplayContext::FirstPersonLeftHand => true,
        DisplayContext::FirstPersonRightHand => false,
        _ => return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(()),
    };
    let posed = view::posed(left, pose);
    let lit = view::hand_light(light);
    if posed == pose && lit == light {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    this.submit_item_lit(state, posed, lit, diffuse_lights(this.dim == Dim::Nether), out);
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/hand_view_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Hand View's switches, read where the first-person hands are posed and set by the game: a transform for each arm
// (right, left) put after the game's own pose, whether the hands keep still when the view turns, whether they are
// lit at full brightness, and the totem pop's size, place on the screen and extra ticks.
use std::sync::RwLock;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};

pub static NO_SWAY: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub static NO_SHADOW: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub static VIEW: RwLock<Option<[glam::Mat4; 2]>> = RwLock::new(None);
pub static TOTEM: RwLock<Option<TotemPop>> = RwLock::new(None);
pub static TOTEM_EXTRA_TICKS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

// Block light 15 and sky light 15, packed as the hands' vertices take it.
pub const FULL_LIGHT: u32 = 0xF0F0;

// The totem pop's size, and where it flies on the screen (fractions of half the screen, right and up).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug)]
pub struct TotemPop {
    pub scale: f32,
    pub x: f32,
    pub y: f32,
}

// The hand pass's field of view is 70 degrees: half the screen's height, one block out, is tan(35).
const HALF_SCREEN: f32 = 0.700_207_5;

impl TotemPop {
    // The game's pose of the item this frame, sized about its middle and moved by the same share of the screen at
    // any distance (the move grows with how far out the item is).
    pub fn apply(self, pose: glam::Mat4, aspect: f32) -> glam::Mat4 {
        let depth = -pose.w_axis.z;
        let shift = glam::Vec3::new(self.x * HALF_SCREEN * aspect * depth, self.y * HALF_SCREEN * depth, 0.0);
        glam::Mat4::from_translation(shift) * pose * glam::Mat4::from_scale(glam::Vec3::splat(self.scale))
    }
}

pub fn totem_pose(pose: glam::Mat4, aspect: f32) -> glam::Mat4 {
    match TOTEM.read() {
        Ok(t) => t.map_or(pose, |t| t.apply(pose, aspect)),
        Err(_) => pose,
    }
}

// The light the hands are drawn with: the eye block's, or full with No hand shadow.
pub fn hand_light(light: u32) -> u32 {
    if NO_SHADOW.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { FULL_LIGHT } else { light }
}

// A pose with the arm's own transform after it.
pub fn posed(left: bool, pose: glam::Mat4) -> glam::Mat4 {
    match VIEW.read() {
        Ok(view) => view.map_or(pose, |v| pose * v[usize::from(left)]),
        Err(_) => pose,
    }
}

thread_local! {
    // An arm is being drawn again in its new pose.
    static POSING: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
}
pub fn posing() -> bool {
    POSING.with(std::cell::Cell::get)
}
pub fn set_posing(v: bool) {
    POSING.with(|p| p.set(v));
}

```

`mixins/sunset/hands.rs`:

```rs
// RF Click (R and F as the mouse buttons) and Kill Aura's and Trigger Bot's Shield (a shield kept up, lowered for each
// of your hits).
use super::sunset::{Category, Module, gui_open, with};
use super::sunset_util as util;
use super::{Game, Screen};
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::{self, Serverbound as S};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use winit::event::{ElementState, MouseButton, WindowEvent};
use winit::keyboard::PhysicalKey;

const RF: &str = "RF Click";

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new(RF, Category::Player, "R and F act as mouse buttons.")
            .text("Left key", "R")
            .text("Right key", "F"),
    ]
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Hands {
    // RF Click: the key names for the left and right button (None: off), whether you are typing as of the last frame,
    // and which of the two is down as a button.
    keys: [Option<String>; 2],
    typing: bool,
    down: [bool; 2],
    // Shield: it holds use, and the tick it last lowered the shield for a hit.
    raised: bool,
    lowered: Option<u64>,
}

static HANDS: Mutex<Option<Hands>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn hands<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Hands) -> R) -> R {
    f(HANDS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Hands::default))
}

fn module(name: &str) -> Option<Module> {
    with(|s| s.module(name).filter(|m| m.on).cloned())
}

// A text box or anything else that takes keys has them.
fn typing(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    matches!(game.screen, Screen::Chat | Screen::CommandBlock | Screen::Options | Screen::WorldOptions)
        || game.sign_edit.is_some()
        || game.book.is_some()
        || game.title.is_some()
        || (game.screen == Screen::Creative && game.creative_screen.tab().search)
        || game.recipe_search_focused()
        || game.mod_browser_typing()
        || game.station_typing()
        || game.dialog_open()
        || gui_open()
}

// Every frame: RF Click's keys and whether you are typing.
pub(super) fn frame(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let keys = match module(RF).filter(|_| game.native_on(super::sunset::ID)) {
        Some(m) => [super::sunset::key_from_text(m.t("Left key")), super::sunset::key_from_text(m.t("Right key"))],
        None => [None, None],
    };
    let typing = typing(game);
    hands(|h| {
        h.keys = keys;
        h.typing = typing;
    });
}

// Focus lost: the window sends no releases for what was down, and the game lets go of its buttons by itself.
pub(super) fn rf_focus_lost() {
    hands(|h| h.down = [false; 2]);
}

// The window's key events, before anything sees them: RF Click's keys become mouse button presses and releases (a key
// repeat becomes nothing). A key let go is always the button let go, even if typing started meanwhile.
pub(super) fn rf_event(event: &mut WindowEvent) {
    let WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { device_id, event: key, .. } = event else {
        return;
    };
    let PhysicalKey::Code(code) = key.physical_key else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(name) = horizon_client::keybinds::key_name(code) else {
        return;
    };
    let (state, repeat, device_id) = (key.state, key.repeat, *device_id);
    let button = hands(|h| {
        let i = h.keys.iter().position(|k| k.as_deref() == Some(name)).or_else(|| {
            // Turned off while held: its release still lets go.
            (state == ElementState::Released).then(|| h.down.iter().position(|&d| d)).flatten()
        })?;
        match state {
            ElementState::Pressed if h.down[i] => Some(i),
            ElementState::Pressed if h.typing || repeat => None,
            ElementState::Pressed => {
                h.down[i] = true;
                Some(i)
            }
            ElementState::Released if h.down[i] => {
                h.down[i] = false;
                Some(i)
            }
            ElementState::Released => None,
        }
    });
    let Some(i) = button else {
        return;
    };
    *event = if repeat {
        WindowEvent::HoveredFileCancelled
    } else {
        WindowEvent::MouseInput { device_id, state, button: if i == 0 { MouseButton::Left } else { MouseButton::Right } }
    };
}

// Shield has the shield up (Kill Aura and Trigger Bot hit through it: it comes down for the hit).
pub(super) fn shielding(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    hands(|h| h.raised) && game.using.is_some_and(|(slot, _)| slot == util::OFFHAND)
}

fn offhand_shield(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.offhand.as_ref().and_then(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item)).is_some_and(|i| i.blocks_attacks.is_some())
}

fn wanted(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> bool {
    let held = game.held().map(|s| util::short(&s.item));
    let weapon = held.is_some_and(|h| h.ends_with("_sword") || h.ends_with("_axe") || h == "mace");
    // Anything else in hand with a use of its own (food, blocks, bows) would be used instead.
    let free = held.is_none() || weapon;
    let own = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.entity_id as u32);
    let near = || {
        let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
            return false;
        };
        game.mobs.iter().any(|mob| {
            mob.alive()
                && !mob.removed
                && Some(mob.id) != own
                && (mob.kind.id == "minecraft:player" || mob.hostile() || mob.kind.category == "monster")
                && util::dist(eye, [mob.position.x, mob.position.y + 1.0, mob.position.z]) <= m.n("Shield range")
        })
    };
    game.native_playing()
        && game.screen == Screen::Playing
        && !gui_open()
        && offhand_shield(game)
        && free
        && (weapon || !m.b("Shield only with a weapon"))
        && (!m.b("Shield only near a target") || near())
}

// Before the tick's hits (Kill Aura's and Trigger Bot's queued ones, your click): the shield comes down, so the hit
// goes in the same tick.
pub(super) fn before_hits(game: &mut Game<'_>, hits: bool) {
    if !shielding(game) || !(hits || game.attack_clicks > 0) {
        return;
    }
    game.send(S::PlayerAction(play::PlayerAction { action: 6, pos: [0; 3], direction: 0, sequence: 0 }));
    game.using = None;
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
    hands(|h| {
        h.raised = false;
        h.lowered = Some(game.ticks);
    });
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    // Kill Aura's Shield, else Trigger Bot's: the first of them on with it.
    let m = ["Kill Aura", "Trigger Bot"]
        .into_iter()
        .find_map(|name| module(name).filter(|m| m.b("Shield")))
        .filter(|_| game.native_on(super::sunset::ID));
    let want = m.as_ref().is_some_and(|m| wanted(game, m));
    let raised = hands(|h| h.raised);
    if !want {
        if raised {
            hands(|h| h.raised = false);
            if !game.physical_buttons.contains(&MouseButton::Right) {
                let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    let delay = m.as_ref().map_or(0, |m| m.n("Shield re-raise delay") as u64);
    let rested = hands(|h| h.lowered.is_none_or(|t| game.ticks >= t.saturating_add(delay)));
    if !raised && rested && game.using.is_none() && !super::sunset::strike_waiting() {
        let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
        hands(|h| h.raised = true);
    }
}
```

```rs
// F1 leaves the HUD shown while the menu is open: the menu is drawn with the HUD, and hidden it would still take the
```
