`mixins/sunset/loadouts.rs`:

```rs
// Loadouts, ported from Sayer's Duelkit (MIT, github.com/PointOfPressure/duelkit) and grown into inventory profiles:
// a loadout keeps the hotbar and the off hand, with Armour what you wear, with Full layout the main inventory too,
// and the Locked slots of the time. Equipping puts every saved item back where it was; Locked slots are left alone by
// every Sunset module that moves items; Refill broken tools puts the same tool from the inventory in the hotbar slot
// whose tool just broke. Loadouts are shared as files through the exports and imports folders, as profiles are.
use super::sunset::{Canvas, Category, Module, Shape, say, with};
use super::sunset_util as util;
use super::{Game, Screen};
use horizon_client::items::ItemStack;
use horizon_client::menu::Input;
use std::sync::Mutex;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Loadouts", Category::Player, "Hold K for your saved inventory layouts.")
            .text("Menu key", "K")
            .bool("Armour", true)
            .bool("Full layout", false)
            .text("Locked slots", "")
            .bool("Refill broken tools", true),
    ]
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Panel {
    // The Menu key is held; a loadout's number key selected its slot, to undo (that slot, the one before).
    listing: bool,
    undo: Option<(usize, usize)>,
    // Refill broken tools: each hotbar slot's tool last tick, and whether it was a use from breaking.
    tools: [Option<(String, bool)>; 9],
}

static PANEL: Mutex<Option<Panel>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn panel<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Panel) -> R) -> R {
    f(PANEL.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Panel::default))
}

fn module() -> Option<Module> {
    with(|s| s.module("Loadouts").filter(|m| m.on).cloned())
}

// The panel is open (Hold to Eat leaves the number keys to it then).
pub(super) fn listing() -> bool {
    panel(|p| p.listing)
}

// "1 2 10" (or with commas): inventory slots by number, the hotbar 1 to 9 and the main inventory 10 to 36.
fn slot_numbers(text: &str) -> [bool; 36] {
    let mut out = [false; 36];
    for n in text.split(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit()).filter_map(|n| n.parse::<usize>().ok()) {
        if (1..=36).contains(&n) {
            out[n - 1] = true;
        }
    }
    out
}

// The inventory slots (0-8 hotbar, 9-35 main) no Sunset module moves items into or out of, while Loadouts is on.
pub(super) fn locked_slots() -> [bool; 36] {
    with(|s| s.module("Loadouts").filter(|m| m.on).map(|m| slot_numbers(m.t("Locked slots")))).unwrap_or([false; 36])
}

pub(super) fn locked(slot: usize) -> bool {
    slot < 36 && locked_slots()[slot]
}

// Each loadout a line "name|hotbar|offhand|armour|main|locked": nine hotbar slots, then four armour slots (head to
// feet) and the 27 of the main inventory (both empty when not kept), comma separated, each "-" (left alone) or an
// item id with its custom name after a "~" when it had one (names %-escaped); then the locked slot numbers. Duelkit's
// lines have the first three fields only. Kept in loadouts.txt in the mod's data folder.
struct Slot {
    item: String,
    name: Option<String>,
}

struct Loadout {
    name: String,
    hotbar: Vec<Option<Slot>>,
    offhand: Option<Slot>,
    armour: Vec<Option<Slot>>,
    main: Vec<Option<Slot>>,
    // None in Duelkit's lines: equipping one leaves the locked slots as they are.
    locked: Option<String>,
}

fn escape(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace('%', "%25").replace('|', "%7C").replace(',', "%2C").replace('~', "%7E").replace('\n', " ")
}

fn unescape(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace("%7E", "~").replace("%2C", ",").replace("%7C", "|").replace("%25", "%")
}

fn parse(line: &str) -> Option<Loadout> {
    let mut parts = line.split('|');
    let name = unescape(parts.next()?);
    let slot = |s: &str| {
        (s != "-" && !s.is_empty()).then(|| match s.split_once('~') {
            Some((item, name)) => Slot { item: item.to_owned(), name: Some(unescape(name)) },
            None => Slot { item: s.to_owned(), name: None },
        })
    };
    let slots = |s: Option<&str>| s.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map_or_else(Vec::new, |s| s.split(',').map(slot).collect());
    let hotbar = slots(parts.next());
    let offhand = slot(parts.next()?);
    let armour = slots(parts.next());
    let main = slots(parts.next());
    let locked = parts.next().map(str::to_owned);
    Some(Loadout { name, hotbar, offhand, armour, main, locked })
}

// A loadout of what you have now, named: the hotbar and the off hand, and what Armour and Full layout keep.
fn capture(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, name: &str) -> String {
    let slot = |s: Option<&ItemStack>| match s {
        None => "-".to_owned(),
        Some(s) => match s.custom_name() {
            Some(n) => format!("{}~{}", s.item, escape(&n)),
            None => s.item.to_string(),
        },
    };
    let row = |slots: &mut dyn Iterator<Item = Option<&ItemStack>>| slots.map(slot).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    let hotbar = row(&mut (0..9).map(|i| game.inventory[i].as_ref()));
    let armour = if m.b("Armour") { row(&mut game.armor.iter().map(Option::as_ref)) } else { String::new() };
    let main = if m.b("Full layout") { row(&mut (9..36).map(|i| game.inventory[i].as_ref())) } else { String::new() };
    let locked = slot_numbers(m.t("Locked slots"));
    let locked = (0..36).filter(|&i| locked[i]).map(|i| (i + 1).to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
    format!("{}|{hotbar}|{}|{armour}|{main}|{locked}", escape(name), slot(game.offhand.as_ref()))
}

fn loadouts() -> Vec<Loadout> {
    with(|s| s.loadouts.iter().filter_map(|l| parse(l)).collect())
}

fn file(game: &Game<'_>) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    game.native_data_dir(super::sunset::ID).join("loadouts.txt")
}

// Read once with the config: the file's loadouts, or (the first time) the ones the config kept, written to it.
pub(super) fn load(game: &Game<'_>) {
    match std::fs::read_to_string(file(game)) {
        Ok(text) => with(|s| s.loadouts = text.lines().filter(|l| parse(l).is_some()).map(str::to_owned).collect()),
        Err(_) if with(|s| !s.loadouts.is_empty()) => store(game),
        Err(_) => {}
    }
}

// The loadouts written to their file (never through a link).
fn store(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let path = file(game);
    if std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_symlink()) {
        return;
    }
    let text: String = with(|s| s.loadouts.iter().map(|l| format!("{l}\n")).collect());
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir);
    }
    let _ = std::fs::write(&path, text);
}

fn find_loadout(list: &[Loadout], what: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    what.parse::<usize>()
        .ok()
        .filter(|n| (1..=list.len()).contains(n))
        .map(|n| n - 1)
        .or_else(|| list.iter().position(|l| l.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(what)))
}

// 0: not it; 1: the same item; 2: the same item and name (or a slot saved without a name).
fn score(want: &Slot, have: Option<&ItemStack>) -> u8 {
    match have {
        Some(h) if *h.item == *want.item => {
            if want.name.is_none() || h.custom_name().as_deref() == want.name.as_deref() { 2 } else { 1 }
        }
        _ => 0,
    }
}

// What the loadout wants in inventory slot `k` (0-8 hotbar, 9-35 main), if anything.
fn wanted(l: &Loadout, k: usize) -> Option<&Slot> {
    if k < 9 { l.hotbar.get(k) } else { l.main.get(k - 9) }.and_then(Option::as_ref)
}

// Puts each saved item in its slot from the inventory slot that matches it best (the name too, before just the item),
// slots that already hold theirs staying: the hotbar and the off hand with the clicks of a number key pressed over it
// in the inventory, as Duelkit's; armour and the main inventory picked up, put down and the stack it met put back.
// Then the loadout's locked slots are the ones locked (a Duelkit loadout leaves them).
fn equip(game: &mut Game<'_>, l: &Loadout) {
    if !util::inventory_idle(game) {
        return;
    }
    let mut done = [false; 36];
    let best = |game: &Game<'_>, want: &Slot, done: &[bool; 36]| {
        (0..36)
            .filter(|&k| !done[k])
            .filter(|&k| !wanted(l, k).is_some_and(|w| score(w, game.inventory[k].as_ref()) == 2))
            .map(|k| (score(want, game.inventory[k].as_ref()), k))
            .filter(|&(s, _)| s > 0)
            .max_by_key(|&(s, k)| (s, std::cmp::Reverse(k)))
            .map(|(_, k)| k)
    };
    let place = |game: &mut Game<'_>, i: usize, done: &mut [bool; 36]| {
        if let Some(want) = wanted(l, i)
            && score(want, game.inventory[i].as_ref()) < 2
            && let Some(from) = best(game, want, done)
        {
            if i < 9 {
                game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), i as i32, Input::Swap)]);
            } else {
                game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), 0, Input::Pickup), (Some(i), 0, Input::Pickup), (Some(from), 0, Input::Pickup)]);
            }
        }
        done[i] = wanted(l, i).is_some();
    };
    for i in 0..9 {
        place(game, i, &mut done);
    }
    // The off hand and the armour before the main inventory takes its pick.
    if let Some(want) = &l.offhand
        && score(want, game.offhand.as_ref()) < 2
        && let Some(from) = best(game, want, &done)
    {
        game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), 40, Input::Swap)]);
    }
    for (a, want) in l.armour.iter().enumerate().take(4) {
        if let Some(want) = want
            && score(want, game.armor[a].as_ref()) < 2
            && let Some(from) = best(game, want, &done)
        {
            game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), 0, Input::Pickup), (Some(500 + a), 0, Input::Pickup), (Some(from), 0, Input::Pickup)]);
        }
    }
    for i in 9..36 {
        place(game, i, &mut done);
    }
    if let Some(locked) = &l.locked {
        super::sunset::set_setting(game, "loadouts.lockedslots", locked);
    }
}

fn equip_row(game: &mut Game<'_>, row: usize) {
    let list = loadouts();
    if let Some(l) = list.get(row) {
        equip(game, l);
        game.titles.set_overlay(format!("Equipped {}", l.name).into(), false);
    }
}

// Refill broken tools: a hotbar slot whose tool was a use from breaking last tick and is empty now gets the same tool
// from the inventory (the least worn), swapped in as a number key over it would.
pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if let Some((from, back)) = panel(|p| p.undo.take())
        && game.selected == from
    {
        super::sunset::hold(game, back);
    }
    let Some(m) = module().filter(|m| m.b("Refill broken tools")) else {
        panel(|p| p.tools = Default::default());
        return;
    };
    let now: [Option<(String, bool)>; 9] = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
        let s = game.inventory[i].as_ref()?;
        let max = game.res.items().get(&s.item).map_or(0, |i| i.max_damage);
        (max > 0).then(|| (s.item.to_string(), max.saturating_sub(s.damage) <= 2))
    });
    let was = panel(|p| std::mem::replace(&mut p.tools, now.clone()));
    if !util::inventory_idle(game) {
        return;
    }
    let locked = slot_numbers(m.t("Locked slots"));
    for (i, (before, after)) in was.iter().zip(&now).enumerate() {
        let (Some((item, true)), None) = (before, after) else {
            continue;
        };
        let spare = (9..36)
            .filter(|&k| !locked[k])
            .filter_map(|k| game.inventory[k].as_ref().filter(|s| *s.item == **item).map(|s| (s.damage, k)))
            .min();
        if let Some((_, k)) = spare
            && !locked[i]
        {
            game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(k), i as i32, Input::Swap)]);
            panel(|p| p.tools[i] = None);
        }
    }
}

// The panel's measures, as Duelkit's: rows 40 apart, each a name over a hotbar strip 182 by 22 with the off hand's
// slot to its left.
const ROW: f32 = 40.0;
const BAR_W: f32 = 182.0;

fn top(h: f32, count: usize) -> f32 {
    (h / 2.0 - count as f32 * ROW / 2.0 - 10.0).max(20.0)
}

fn bar_x(w: f32) -> f32 {
    w / 2.0 - BAR_W / 2.0 + 12.0
}

fn row_at(w: f32, h: f32, count: usize, (mx, my): (f32, f32)) -> Option<usize> {
    let (top, x) = (top(h, count), bar_x(w));
    (0..count).find(|&i| {
        let y = top + i as f32 * ROW;
        mx >= x - 26.0 && mx <= x + BAR_W && my >= y && my <= y + ROW - 4.0
    })
}

// The Save current button, under the rows.
fn save_button(w: f32, h: f32, count: usize) -> [f32; 4] {
    [w / 2.0 - 40.0, top(h, count) + count as f32 * ROW + 2.0, 80.0, 14.0]
}

fn inside(r: [f32; 4], (x, y): (f32, f32)) -> bool {
    x >= r[0] && x < r[0] + r[2] && y >= r[1] && y < r[1] + r[3]
}

// The screen's size in the HUD's pixels, as the panel was last drawn.
static VIEW: Mutex<(f32, f32)> = Mutex::new((0.0, 0.0));

fn view() -> (f32, f32) {
    *VIEW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

// Loadouts' keys: the Menu key held opens the panel (the pointer free); let go over a row, it equips that one. A
// hotbar number key equips that loadout instead.
pub(super) fn key(game: &mut Game<'_>, key: &str, pressed: bool) {
    let Some(m) = module() else {
        panel(|p| p.listing = false);
        return;
    };
    if super::sunset::key_from_text(m.t("Menu key")).as_deref() == Some(key) {
        let was = listing();
        let now = pressed && game.screen == Screen::Playing && !super::sunset::gui_open();
        if now == was {
            return;
        }
        panel(|p| p.listing = now);
        if now {
            game.keys.clear();
            game.capture(false);
            return;
        }
        let (w, h) = view();
        if let Some(row) = row_at(w, h, loadouts().len(), game.cursor) {
            equip_row(game, row);
        }
        if game.screen == Screen::Playing {
            game.capture(true);
        }
        return;
    }
    if !pressed || !listing() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(n) = (0..9).find(|i| game.settings.keys.get(&format!("key.hotbar.{}", i + 1)) == key) else {
        return;
    };
    if n < loadouts().len() {
        let back = game.selected;
        panel(|p| p.undo = Some((n, back)));
        equip_row(game, n);
    }
}

// A mouse press while the panel is open: a row clicked equips it, right-clicked deletes it; Save current keeps what
// you have as "Loadout N". Every press stops here while it is open.
pub(super) fn press(game: &mut Game<'_>, right: bool) -> bool {
    let Some(m) = module().filter(|_| listing()) else {
        return false;
    };
    let (w, h) = view();
    let count = loadouts().len();
    if !right && inside(save_button(w, h, count), game.cursor) {
        let line = capture(game, &m, &format!("Loadout {}", count + 1));
        with(|s| s.loadouts.push(line));
        store(game);
    } else if let Some(row) = row_at(w, h, count, game.cursor) {
        if right {
            with(|s| {
                s.loadouts.remove(row);
            });
            store(game);
        } else {
            equip_row(game, row);
        }
    }
    true
}

// The panel while the Menu key is held: a title, each loadout's number and name (and what more it keeps) over a hotbar
// of its items with the off hand's to the left (the row under the pointer lit), Save current, and how to use it.
pub(super) fn draw(game: &Game<'_>, w: f32, h: f32, out: &mut Vec<Shape>) {
    if !listing() || module().is_none() {
        return;
    }
    *VIEW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = (w, h);
    let list = loadouts();
    let (top, x) = (top(h, list.len()), bar_x(w));
    let centred = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, text: &str, y: f32, colour: u32| {
        out.text(text, [(w - game.native_text_width(text)) / 2.0, y], colour);
    };
    centred(out, if list.is_empty() { "No loadouts yet" } else { "Loadouts" }, top - 14.0, 0xFFFFFF);
    let hover = row_at(w, h, list.len(), game.cursor);
    // A vanilla-like slot: dark edge, grey face.
    let slot = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, x: f32, y: f32| {
        out.fill([x, y, 22.0, 22.0], 0xFF1E_1E1E);
        out.fill([x + 1.0, y + 1.0, 20.0, 20.0], 0xFF8B_8B8B);
        out.fill([x + 2.0, y + 2.0, 18.0, 18.0], 0xFF37_3737);
    };
    for (i, l) in list.iter().enumerate() {
        let y = top + i as f32 * ROW;
        if hover == Some(i) {
            out.fill([x - 28.0, y - 2.0, BAR_W + 30.0, ROW - 2.0], 0x40FF_FFFF);
        }
        let name = if i < 9 { format!("{}  {}", i + 1, l.name) } else { l.name.clone() };
        out.text(&name, [x, y], if hover == Some(i) { 0xFFFF55 } else { 0xE0E0E0 });
        let more: Vec<&str> = [("armour", !l.armour.is_empty()), ("inventory", !l.main.is_empty()), ("locked slots", l.locked.as_ref().is_some_and(|l| !l.is_empty()))]
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(what, kept)| kept.then_some(what))
            .collect();
        if !more.is_empty() {
            let text = more.join(" \u{b7} ");
            out.text(&text, [x + BAR_W - game.native_text_width(&text), y], 0xA0A0A0);
        }
        out.fill([x, y + 10.0, BAR_W, 22.0], 0xFF1E_1E1E);
        for k in 0..9 {
            slot(out, x + k as f32 * 20.0, y + 10.0);
        }
        for (k, item) in l.hotbar.iter().take(9).enumerate() {
            if let Some(item) = item {
                out.push(Shape::Item(item.item.as_str().into(), [x + 3.0 + k as f32 * 20.0, y + 13.0], 16.0));
            }
        }
        slot(out, x - 26.0, y + 10.0);
        if let Some(item) = &l.offhand {
            out.push(Shape::Item(item.item.as_str().into(), [x - 23.0, y + 13.0], 16.0));
        }
    }
    let b = save_button(w, h, list.len());
    out.push(Shape::Round(b, 3.0, if inside(b, game.cursor) { 0xC050_5050 } else { 0xC030_3030 }));
    centred(out, "Save current", b[1] + 3.0, 0xFFFFFF);
    centred(out, "Release K over one to equip  \u{b7}  right-click deletes", h - 46.0, 0xA0A0A0);
}

// .loadout save [name] | delete <n|name> | list | export <n|name> | import <file> | <n|name>
pub(super) fn command(game: &mut Game<'_>, args: &[&str]) {
    let list = loadouts();
    let m = with(|s| s.module("Loadouts").cloned());
    match (args.get(1).map(|a| a.to_ascii_lowercase()).as_deref(), args.get(2..).map(|a| a.join(" "))) {
        (Some("save" | "add"), name) => {
            let Some(m) = m else {
                return;
            };
            let name = name.filter(|n| !n.is_empty()).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("Loadout {}", list.len() + 1));
            let line = capture(game, &m, &name);
            keep(game, &name, line);
            say(game, &format!("Saved loadout {name}"));
        }
        (Some("delete" | "del" | "remove" | "rm"), Some(what)) => match find_loadout(&list, &what) {
            Some(i) => {
                let name = list[i].name.clone();
                with(|s| s.loadouts.retain(|l| parse(l).is_none_or(|l| l.name != name)));
                store(game);
                say(game, &format!("Deleted loadout {name}"));
            }
            None => say(game, &format!("No loadout {what}")),
        },
        (Some("export"), Some(what)) => match find_loadout(&list, &what) {
            Some(i) => {
                let line = with(|s| s.loadouts.iter().find(|l| parse(l).is_some_and(|l| l.name == list[i].name)).cloned());
                let done = super::sunset_profiles::name(&list[i].name).and_then(|file| {
                    let store = super::sunset_profiles::Store::new(game.native_data_dir(super::sunset::ID))?;
                    store.share(&format!("{file}.loadout"), &format!("{}\n", line.unwrap_or_default()))
                });
                match done {
                    Ok(path) => say(game, &format!("Loadout {} is in {}", list[i].name, path.display())),
                    Err(e) => say(game, &format!("Loadout: {e}.")),
                }
            }
            None => say(game, &format!("No loadout {what}")),
        },
        (Some("import"), Some(what)) => {
            let read = super::sunset_profiles::name(&what).and_then(|file| {
                let store = super::sunset_profiles::Store::new(game.native_data_dir(super::sunset::ID))?;
                store.shared(&format!("{file}.loadout"))
            });
            match read.map(|text| text.lines().find(|l| parse(l).is_some()).map(str::to_owned)) {
                Ok(Some(line)) => {
                    let name = parse(&line).map(|l| l.name).unwrap_or_default();
                    keep(game, &name, line);
                    say(game, &format!("Imported loadout {name}"));
                }
                Ok(None) => say(game, &format!("Loadout: {what} holds no loadout.")),
                Err(e) => say(game, &format!("Loadout: {e}.")),
            }
        }
        (Some("list") | None, _) => {
            if list.is_empty() {
                say(game, "No loadouts yet. Use .loadout save <name>");
            }
            for (i, l) in list.iter().enumerate() {
                say(game, &format!("{}: {}", i + 1, l.name));
            }
        }
        (Some(_), _) => {
            let what = args[1..].join(" ");
            match find_loadout(&list, &what) {
                Some(i) => equip_row(game, i),
                None => say(game, &format!("No loadout {what}")),
            }
        }
    }
}

// A loadout kept under its name, in place of one of the same name.
fn keep(game: &Game<'_>, name: &str, line: String) {
    with(|s| {
        s.loadouts.retain(|l| parse(l).is_none_or(|l| !l.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name)));
        s.loadouts.push(line);
    });
    store(game);
}
```

`mixins/sunset/loot_guard.rs`:

```rs
// Protect Loot: no explosion near where a player just died, so their drops aren't blown up.
use super::remote::sunset_loot_remote::{self, Death};
use super::sunset_explosive_damage::Blast;
use super::sunset_loot_policy::{Dimension, Guard, LOOT_BOX, Reason};
use super::{Game, sunset};
use horizon_protocol::{connection::Counters, packets::play::Clientbound as C};
use std::{
    sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock},
    time::Instant,
};
type Session = Arc<Mutex<Option<Arc<Counters>>>>;
struct State {
    session: Option<Session>,
    dimension: Option<Dimension>,
    guard: Guard,
    last: Reason,
    blocked: u64,
}
static STATE: Mutex<State> =
    Mutex::new(State { session: None, dimension: None, guard: Guard::new(), last: Reason::Clear, blocked: 0 });
static START: OnceLock<Instant> = OnceLock::new();
fn now() -> u64 {
    START.get_or_init(Instant::now).elapsed().as_millis().min(u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64
}
fn state<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut State) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}
fn same_session(game: &Game<'_>, s: &State) -> bool {
    game.remote.as_ref().zip(s.session.as_ref()).is_some_and(|(r, old)| Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, old))
}
fn scene(game: &Game<'_>, name: &str, login: bool) {
    let dimension = Dimension::of(name);
    state(|s| {
        if login || !same_session(game, s) || s.dimension != dimension {
            s.guard.clear();
            s.last = Reason::Clear;
        }
        s.session = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.session.counters.clone());
        s.dimension = dimension;
    });
}
pub(super) fn packet(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &C) {
    if !game.native_window() {
        return;
    }
    match packet {
        C::Login(p) => scene(game, &p.spawn.dimension, true),
        // Same-connection, same-dimension respawn deliberately retains death
        // zones. A changed local entity id is not a different world.
        C::Respawn(p) => scene(game, &p.spawn.dimension, false),
        C::Disconnect(_) => state(|s| {
            s.session = None;
            s.dimension = None;
            s.guard.clear();
            s.last = Reason::Clear;
        }),
        C::EntityEvent(p) if p.event == 3 && game.native_on(sunset::ID) => {
            // Event3 also belongs to egg/snowball particles. The native identity
            // bridge must recognize an actual current player before recording.
            let death = sunset_loot_remote::player_death(game, p.id);
            if matches!(death, Death::Other) {
                return;
            }
            state(|s| {
                if !same_session(game, s) || s.dimension.is_none() {
                    return;
                }
                match death {
                    Death::Player(Some(at)) => s.guard.record(now(), p.id, at),
                    Death::Player(None) => s.guard.unknown_death(now()),
                    Death::Other => {}
                }
            });
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}
pub(super) fn allows(game: &Game<'_>, blast: Blast, protect: bool) -> bool {
    if !protect {
        return true;
    }
    let feet = game.player.as_ref().map(|p| [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z]);
    // Loot more than 32 blocks off may not be loaded yet: that spot is kept.
    let loot = |at: [f64; 3]| {
        feet.is_none_or(|f| (0..3).map(|i| (f[i] - at[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>() > 32.0 * 32.0)
            || game.dropped.iter().any(|item| {
                let p = [item.position.x, item.position.y, item.position.z];
                (0..3).all(|i| (p[i] - at[i]).abs() <= LOOT_BOX[i])
            })
    };
    state(|s| {
        s.guard.release_empty(now(), loot);
        s.last = if !same_session(game, s) || s.dimension.is_none() {
            Reason::UnknownScene
        } else {
            s.guard.check(now(), blast.center, blast.power)
        };
        let allowed = s.last == Reason::Clear;
        if !allowed {
            s.blocked = s.blocked.saturating_add(1);
        }
        allowed
    })
}
```

`mixins/sunset/loot_policy.rs`:

```rs
// Protect Loot's list of recent deaths: up to 16, each kept 30 seconds.
pub const CAPACITY: usize = 16;
pub const TTL_MS: u64 = 30_000;
pub const DROP_MARGIN: f64 = 2.0;
// Anubis's: a death spot with no dropped item left round it (8 blocks across, 4 up or down) is let go this long
// after the death, so one kill doesn't hold every crystal back for the whole TTL.
pub const EMPTY_GRACE_MS: u64 = 3_000;
pub const LOOT_BOX: [f64; 3] = [8.0, 4.0, 8.0];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Reason {
    Clear,
    NearDeath,
    Overflow,
    InvalidBlast,
    ClockRewind,
    UnknownScene,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Spot {
    entity: i32,
    at: [f64; 3],
    since: u64,
    until: u64,
}
pub struct Guard {
    spots: [Option<Spot>; CAPACITY],
    overflow_until: u64,
    last_ms: u64,
}
impl Guard {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        Self { spots: [None; CAPACITY], overflow_until: 0, last_ms: 0 }
    }
    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        *self = Self::new();
    }
    fn expired(until: u64, now: u64) -> bool {
        until != u64::MAX && until <= now
    }
    fn prune(&mut self, now: u64) {
        for spot in &mut self.spots {
            if spot.is_some_and(|s| Self::expired(s.until, now)) {
                *spot = None;
            }
        }
        if Self::expired(self.overflow_until, now) {
            self.overflow_until = 0;
        }
    }
    pub fn unknown_death(&mut self, now: u64) {
        self.last_ms = self.last_ms.max(now);
        self.overflow_until = self.overflow_until.max(self.last_ms.saturating_add(TTL_MS));
    }
    pub fn record(&mut self, now: u64, entity: i32, at: [f64; 3]) {
        if now < self.last_ms || !valid(at) {
            self.unknown_death(now);
            return;
        }
        self.last_ms = now;
        self.prune(now);
        let until = now.saturating_add(TTL_MS);
        // Duplicate death notifications for the same known place need one cell.
        if let Some(old) = self.spots.iter_mut().flatten().find(|s| s.entity == entity && s.at == at) {
            old.until = old.until.max(until);
            return;
        }
        if let Some(cell) = self.spots.iter_mut().find(|s| s.is_none()) {
            *cell = Some(Spot { entity, at, since: now, until });
        } else {
            // Dropping an unexpired location would silently unprotect it.
            self.overflow_until = self.overflow_until.max(until);
        }
    }
    // `loot(at)`: a dropped item is (or may be: out of sight) round the death spot `at`.
    pub fn release_empty(&mut self, now: u64, loot: impl Fn([f64; 3]) -> bool) {
        for spot in &mut self.spots {
            if spot.is_some_and(|s| now.saturating_sub(s.since) > EMPTY_GRACE_MS && !loot(s.at)) {
                *spot = None;
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn check(&mut self, now: u64, center: [f64; 3], power: f32) -> Reason {
        if !valid(center) || !power.is_finite() || power <= 0.0 || power > 16.0 {
            return Reason::InvalidBlast;
        }
        if now < self.last_ms {
            return Reason::ClockRewind;
        }
        self.last_ms = now;
        self.prune(now);
        if self.overflow_until != 0 {
            return Reason::Overflow;
        }
        let reach = f64::from(power) * 2.0 + DROP_MARGIN;
        if self
            .spots
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .any(|spot| (0..3).map(|i| (center[i] - spot.at[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>() <= reach * reach)
        {
            Reason::NearDeath
        } else {
            Reason::Clear
        }
    }
}
fn valid(at: [f64; 3]) -> bool {
    at.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() <= 30_000_000.0)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Dimension {
    bytes: [u8; 256],
    len: usize,
}
impl Dimension {
    pub fn of(name: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 256 {
            return None;
        }
        let mut bytes = [0; 256];
        bytes[..name.len()].copy_from_slice(name.as_bytes());
        Some(Self { bytes, len: name.len() })
    }
}
```

```rs
// Whether an entity event 3 is a player dying, and where.
pub(crate) enum Death {
    Other,
    Player(Option<[f64; 3]>),
}
pub(crate) fn player_death(game: &crate::game::Game<'_>, id: i32) -> Death {
    let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        return Death::Other;
    };
    if remote.entity_id == id {
        return Death::Player(game.player.as_ref().map(|p| [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z]));
    }
    if !remote.level_players.contains_key(&id) {
        return Death::Other;
    }
    match remote.entities.get(&id) {
        Some(entity) if entity.kind == "minecraft:player" => Death::Player(Some(entity.position)),
        Some(_) => Death::Other,
        None => Death::Player(None),
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/mace_native.rs`:

```rs
// Whether Mace may hold a smash for one more tick (Rust's PR #16): a tick from now, with your body and the target
// moved on as they move now, the look (yaw, pitch) the server has still meets the target within reach, nothing blocks
// the way, and the next step is clear. None: the facts are not there, which counts as no.
use super::Game;
use horizon_client::collisions::SceneCollisions;
use horizon_core::geometry::Vec3;

pub(super) fn continuation(game: &mut Game<'_>, target: u32, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> Option<bool> {
    if !yaw.is_finite() || !pitch.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let reach = game.player.as_mut()?.attribute("minecraft:entity_interaction_range").ok()? - 0.35;
    if !reach.is_finite() || reach <= 0.0 || reach > 64.0 {
        return None;
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let velocity = p.velocity;
    let current = game.eye_position()?;
    let from = Vec3::new(current[0], current[1], current[2]).add_vector(velocity);
    let look = super::view_vector(yaw, pitch);
    let next_bounds = p.bounds().move_by(velocity);
    let mob = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target && m.alive() && !m.removed)?;
    let next_target = mob.bounds().move_by(mob.position.subtract(mob.previous));
    let (lo, hi) = (next_bounds.min_position(), next_bounds.max_position());
    let (tlo, thi) = (next_target.min_position(), next_target.max_position());
    if [from.x, from.y, from.z, look[0], look[1], look[2], lo.x, lo.y, lo.z, hi.x, hi.y, hi.z, tlo.x, tlo.y, tlo.z, thi.x, thi.y, thi.z]
        .iter()
        .any(|n| !n.is_finite())
    {
        return None;
    }
    let clear_step = SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: None }.unobstructed(next_bounds).ok()?;
    if !clear_step {
        return Some(false);
    }
    if next_target.contains(from) {
        return Some(true);
    }
    let to = from.add_vector(Vec3::new(look[0], look[1], look[2]).scale(reach));
    let Some(contact) = next_target.clip(from, to) else {
        return Some(false);
    };
    let wall = super::spear::sunset_combat_collision::clip(game, from, contact);
    Some(wall.is_none_or(|point| from.distance_squared(point) >= from.distance_squared(contact) - 0.001))
}
```

`mixins/sunset/mace_policy.rs`:

```rs
// Mace's plan for a fall (Rust's PR #16): break a raised shield with an axe first, hold the smash for a better
// moment, smash, or nothing. It decides only; melee.rs does the hit.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Timing {
    Direct,
    Delayed,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Intent {
    Idle,
    BreakShield { slot: usize },
    Hold,
    Smash,
}

// What the plan sees this tick.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Frame {
    pub tick: u64,
    pub target: u32,
    pub grounded: bool,
    pub descending: bool,
    pub native_smash: bool,
    pub fall: f64,
    pub min_fall: f64,
    pub target_allowed: bool,
    pub mace_available: bool,
    pub shield_blocks: bool,
    pub axe: Option<usize>,
    pub auto_swap: bool,
    pub swap_back: bool,
    // The target is still in reach along the look a tick from now, with nothing in the way of the next step.
    pub can_continue: bool,
    pub timing: Timing,
    pub charge: f64,
    pub charge_next: f64,
    pub target_immune: bool,
    pub sprinting: bool,
}

// The fall the server counts after a smash, and the axe hit sent at a shield (not a confirmed break) for a second. A
// smash resets the server's fall (vanilla's mace does), and the client is never told: from then the fall is what you
// drop below the smash's height, or below the top of a rise after it (a Wind Burst bounce), so the next smash of a
// chain waits for Min fall again, and nothing takes a mace for a fall the server no longer has.
#[derive(Default, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Smash {
    top: Option<f64>,
    shield_attempt: Option<(u32, u64)>,
}

impl Smash {
    // Each tick: the ground ends the count, a rise moves its top up.
    pub(super) fn observe(&mut self, grounded: bool, y: f64) {
        if grounded || !y.is_finite() {
            self.top = None;
        } else if let Some(top) = &mut self.top {
            *top = top.max(y);
        }
    }
    // A smash went out at height `y`.
    pub(super) fn smashed(&mut self, y: f64) {
        if y.is_finite() {
            self.top = Some(y);
        }
    }
    // The fall the server has: the game's own `native`, or no more than what you dropped since the last smash.
    pub(super) fn fall(&self, native: f64, y: f64) -> f64 {
        let native = if native.is_finite() { native.max(0.0) } else { 0.0 };
        match self.top {
            Some(top) if y.is_finite() => (top - y).clamp(0.0, native),
            Some(_) => 0.0,
            None => native,
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn shield_attempted(&self, id: u32, tick: u64) -> bool {
        self.shield_attempt.is_some_and(|(target, until)| target == id && tick < until)
    }
    pub(super) fn plan(&mut self, f: Frame) -> Intent {
        self.shield_attempt = self.shield_attempt.filter(|(_, until)| f.tick < *until);
        if f.grounded
            || !f.descending
            || !f.native_smash
            || !f.target_allowed
            || !f.mace_available
            || !f.fall.is_finite()
            || !f.min_fall.is_finite()
            || f.min_fall < 1.5
            || f.fall < f.min_fall
            || !f.charge.is_finite()
            || !f.charge_next.is_finite()
        {
            return Intent::Idle;
        }
        let shield_recent = self.shield_attempt.is_some_and(|(id, _)| id == f.target);
        if f.shield_blocks && !shield_recent {
            return if f.can_continue && (f.auto_swap || f.swap_back) {
                f.axe.filter(|slot| *slot < 9).map_or(Intent::Idle, |slot| Intent::BreakShield { slot })
            } else {
                Intent::Idle
            };
        }
        // Hold only while this target stays in reach along the next tick's look.
        let hold = f.timing == Timing::Delayed
            || (f.charge <= 0.9 && f.charge_next > 0.9)
            || f.target_immune
            || f.sprinting;
        if f.can_continue && hold { Intent::Hold } else { Intent::Smash }
    }
    // After the axe hit at a shield went out. (A smash counts from its own packet: see `smashed`.)
    pub(super) fn accepted(&mut self, intent: Intent, target: u32, tick: u64) {
        if let Intent::BreakShield { .. } = intent {
            self.shield_attempt = Some((target, tick.saturating_add(20)));
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
// The order of the combat macros' steps, each moved on only by what the server shows.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Kind {
    Crystal,
    Anchor,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Step {
    Base,
    CrystalPlace,
    CrystalBreak,
    AnchorPlace,
    Guard,
    Charge,
    Detonate,
    Done,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) struct Sequence {
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub step: Step,
    pub remaining: u8,
    pub refilled: bool,
}
impl Sequence {
    pub(super) fn new(kind: Kind, first: Step, double: bool) -> Self {
        Self { kind, step: first, remaining: if kind == Kind::Anchor && double { 2 } else { 1 }, refilled: false }
    }
    pub(super) fn acknowledged(&mut self, sent: Step) -> bool {
        if self.step != sent || sent == Step::Done {
            return false;
        }
        self.step = match sent {
            Step::Base => Step::CrystalPlace,
            Step::CrystalPlace => Step::CrystalBreak,
            Step::CrystalBreak => Step::Done,
            Step::AnchorPlace if self.refilled => Step::Charge,
            Step::AnchorPlace => Step::Guard,
            Step::Guard => Step::Charge,
            Step::Charge => Step::Detonate,
            Step::Detonate if self.remaining > 1 => {
                self.remaining -= 1;
                self.refilled = true;
                Step::AnchorPlace
            }
            Step::Detonate | Step::Done => Step::Done,
        };
        true
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) enum Wait {
    Pending,
    Acknowledged,
    Expired,
}
pub(super) fn wait(sent: u64, now: u64, observed: bool, timeout: u64) -> Wait {
    if now < sent {
        Wait::Expired
    } else if observed {
        Wait::Acknowledged
    } else if now - sent >= timeout {
        Wait::Expired
    } else {
        Wait::Pending
    }
}
pub(super) fn restore(previous: usize, owned: usize, current: usize, requested: bool) -> Option<usize> {
    (requested && previous < 9 && owned < 9 && current == owned && previous != owned).then_some(previous)
}
pub(super) fn human_gap(sample: u64) -> u64 {
    match sample % 100 {
        0..=69 => 2,
        70..=94 => 3,
        _ => 4,
    }
}
pub(super) fn action_due(last: Option<u64>, now: u64, delay: f64, gap: u64) -> bool {
    if !delay.is_finite() || !(0.0..=10.0).contains(&delay) {
        return false;
    }
    last.is_none_or(|at| now >= at && now - at > delay as u64 && now - at >= gap)
}
pub(super) fn double_eligible(
    requested: bool,
    face: i32,
    anchor_y: i32,
    feet_floor: i32,
    replacement: bool,
    glowstone: bool,
) -> bool {
    requested && face == 1 && anchor_y >= feet_floor && replacement && glowstone
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Retries {
    entries: Vec<(u32, u8, u64)>,
}
impl Retries {
    pub(super) const fn new() -> Self {
        Self { entries: Vec::new() }
    }
    pub(super) fn allows(&self, id: u32, tick: u64) -> bool {
        id != 0
            && self
                .entries
                .iter()
                .find(|(cid, _, _)| *cid == id)
                .map_or(self.entries.len() < 256, |(_, _, until)| tick >= *until)
    }
    pub(super) fn sent(&mut self, id: u32, tick: u64) {
        if !self.allows(id, tick) {
            return;
        }
        let index = match self.entries.iter().position(|(cid, _, _)| *cid == id) {
            Some(index) => index,
            None => {
                self.entries.push((id, 0, 0));
                self.entries.len() - 1
            }
        };
        let (_, count, until) = &mut self.entries[index];
        *count += 1;
        if *count >= 3 {
            *count = 0;
            *until = tick.saturating_add(100);
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn retain(&mut self, mut exists: impl FnMut(u32) -> bool) {
        self.entries.retain(|(id, _, _)| exists(*id));
    }
    pub(super) fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.entries.clear();
    }
}
pub(super) fn face(face: [i32; 3]) -> Option<i32> {
    match face {
        [0, -1, 0] => Some(0),
        [0, 1, 0] => Some(1),
        [0, 0, -1] => Some(2),
        [0, 0, 1] => Some(3),
        [-1, 0, 0] => Some(4),
        [1, 0, 0] => Some(5),
        _ => None,
    }
}
pub(super) fn outside(hit: [f64; 3], face: i32) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let d = match face {
        0 => [0., -1., 0.],
        1 => [0., 1., 0.],
        2 => [0., 0., -1.],
        3 => [0., 0., 1.],
        4 => [-1., 0., 0.],
        5 => [1., 0., 0.],
        _ => return None,
    };
    hit.iter().all(|n| n.is_finite()).then(|| std::array::from_fn(|i| hit[i] + d[i] * 1.0e-5))
}
pub(super) fn ray(eye: [f64; 3], direction: [f64; 3], lo: [f64; 3], hi: [f64; 3], range: f64) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    if !eye
        .iter()
        .chain(direction.iter())
        .chain(lo.iter())
        .chain(hi.iter())
        .chain([range].iter())
        .all(|n| n.is_finite())
        || range < 0.
        || (0..3).any(|i| lo[i] > hi[i])
    {
        return None;
    }
    let norm = direction.iter().map(|n| n * n).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    if norm < 1.0e-12 {
        return None;
    }
    let d = direction.map(|n| n / norm);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (0f64, range);
    for i in 0..3 {
        if d[i].abs() < 1.0e-12 {
            if eye[i] < lo[i] || eye[i] > hi[i] {
                return None;
            }
        } else {
            let p = (lo[i] - eye[i]) / d[i];
            let q = (hi[i] - eye[i]) / d[i];
            a = a.max(p.min(q));
            b = b.min(p.max(q));
            if a > b {
                return None;
            }
        }
    }
    Some(std::array::from_fn(|i| eye[i] + d[i] * a))
}

// An explicit-hand operation can still require borrowing another main slot.
// Facts are copied from the native catalog/stack before this bounded decision.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) struct UseRoute {
    pub select: Option<usize>,
    pub offhand: bool,
}
pub(super) fn placement_route(
    current: usize,
    preferred: usize,
    hotbar: [bool; 9],
    through: [bool; 9],
    offhand: bool,
) -> Option<UseRoute> {
    if current >= 9 {
        return None;
    }
    if hotbar[current] {
        return Some(UseRoute { select: None, offhand: false });
    }
    if offhand && through[current] {
        return Some(UseRoute { select: None, offhand: true });
    }
    if let Some(slot) = hotbar.iter().position(|present| *present) {
        return Some(UseRoute { select: Some(slot), offhand: false });
    }
    if !offhand {
        return None;
    }
    let selected = if preferred < 9 && through[preferred] {
        Some(preferred)
    } else {
        through.iter().position(|allowed| *allowed)
    }?;
    Some(UseRoute { select: (selected != current).then_some(selected), offhand: true })
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(super) struct ClickFacts {
    pub empty: bool,
    pub known: bool,
    pub consuming: bool,
    pub blocking: bool,
    pub kinetic: bool,
    pub equip_swap: bool,
    pub sword: bool,
    pub axe: bool,
    pub mace: bool,
    pub totem: bool,
}
pub(super) fn click_through(f: ClickFacts, crystal_base: bool) -> bool {
    if f.empty {
        return true;
    }
    f.known
        && !f.consuming
        && !f.blocking
        && !f.kinetic
        && !f.equip_swap
        && (f.sword || f.mace || f.totem || (f.axe && crystal_base))
}
pub(super) fn anchor_supplied(charged: bool, glowstone: bool, detonator: bool) -> bool {
    detonator && (charged || glowstone)
}

// Counts are bounded by the native exposure sampler. Unknown geometry never
// enters either count; callers must abort its guard decision instead.
pub(super) fn guard_already_covered(total: usize, open: usize) -> bool {
    total > 0 && total <= 256 && open <= total && open * 100 < total * 15
}
pub(super) fn guard_shade_needed(open: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    (open > 0 && open <= 256).then(|| (open * 15).div_ceil(100))
}
```
