```rs
            .num("Longest delay", 4.0, 1.0, 20.0, 1.0),
        Module::new(TAP, Category::Combat, "Resets sprint between hits.")
            .pick("Mode", &["W Tap", "S Tap"])
            .num("Hold", 1.0, 1.0, 8.0, 1.0)
            .num("Longest hold", 1.0, 1.0, 8.0, 1.0)
            .num("Reaction (ticks)", 0.0, 0.0, 5.0, 1.0)
            .num("Chance (%)", 100.0, 0.0, 100.0, 5.0),
        Module::new(JUMP, Category::Combat, "Jumps to take less knockback.")
            .num("Chance (%)", 100.0, 0.0, 100.0, 5.0),
        Module::new(FRIEND, Category::Combat, "Stops hits on friends.")
            .bool("Notifications", true),
    ]
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct InputSave {
    before: [bool; INPUT_KEYS.len()],
    physical: [bool; INPUT_KEYS.len()],
    changed: [bool; INPUT_KEYS.len()],
}

// Relaunch: the tick the next may start, and Air steer's target until a tick.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Relaunch {
    next: u64,
    steer: Option<(u32, u64)>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    // The tick a hit or use went out, and in which world: one action a tick.
    action_tick: Option<u64>,
    action_scene: Option<(Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>, super::Dim, i32)>,
    lease: Option<SlotLease>,
    lease_end: Option<control::Finish>,
    queued: Option<&'static str>,
    queued_since: Option<Instant>,
    lunge: policy::Request,
    // W Tap and Sprint's Keep sprint: forward let go from `tap_from` until `tap_until` (S held too with `tap_back`).
    tap_from: u64,
    tap_until: u64,
    tap_back: bool,
    jump_pending: bool,
    input: Option<InputSave>,
    last_attack: Option<u64>,
    shield_ready: u64,
    mace: mace_policy::Smash,
    broken_shield: Option<(u32, u64)>,
    friend_hint_at: Option<Instant>,
    friend_hint: Option<u32>,
    jump_owner: Option<&'static str>,
    // Smash assist holds a smash: sprinting stops at the start of the next tick, by its key, before the move packet.
    unsprint: bool,
    relaunch: Relaunch,
    // A hit whose look the server has: it goes at the start of the next tick, before that tick's move packet, as the
    // game's own attack does.
    due: Option<Box<dyn for<'a, 'b> FnOnce(&'a mut Game<'b>) + Send>>,
}

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn state<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut State) -> R) -> R {
    let mut s = STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(s.get_or_insert_with(State::default))
}

fn module(name: &str) -> Option<Module> {
    with(|s| s.module(name).filter(|m| m.on).cloned())
}

// Auto Weapon, on with the section `owner` names on; any other owner's module of that name.
fn section(owner: &str) -> Option<Module> {
    match owner {
        BEST | SHIELD | MACE | SPEAR => module(WEAPON).filter(|m| m.b(owner)),
        _ => module(owner),
    }
}

fn alive(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.native_window()
        && game.native_on(super::sunset::ID)
        && game.remote.is_some()
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.health.health().is_finite() && p.health.health() > 0.0)
        && !game.spectator()
        && game.selected < 9
}

fn allowed(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    alive(game)
        && game.native_playing()
        && game.screen == Screen::Playing
        && !gui_open()
        && (super::sunset_hands::shielding(game) || (game.using.is_none() && !game.right))
        && game.mining.is_none()
        && util::inventory_idle(game)
        && !with(|s| s.is_on("Blink"))
        && game.mobs.len() <= policy::POPULATION_LIMIT
}

pub(super) fn note_action(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let Some(r) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    state(|s| {
        s.action_tick = Some(game.ticks);
        s.action_scene = Some((r.session.counters.clone() as Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>, game.dim, r.entity_id));
    });
}

fn acted(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    state(|s| {
        s.action_tick == Some(game.ticks)
            && s.action_scene.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| {
                old.1 == game.dim
                    && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| {
                        r.entity_id == old.2 && Arc::as_ptr(&old.0) as *const () == Arc::as_ptr(&r.session.counters) as *const ()
                    })
            })
    })
}

// The fall a mace hit would smash with, as the server counts it: the game's own, or what you dropped since your last
// smash (see mace_policy's Smash). 0 while gliding.
fn smash_fall(game: &Game<'_>) -> f64 {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return 0.0;
    };
    if p.fall_flying {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let (native, y) = (p.fall_distance, p.position.y);
    state(|s| s.mace.fall(native, y))
}

// The attack cooldown (0 to 1) a hit with the item in hotbar `slot` would have, `partial` ticks on.
pub(super) fn slot_strength(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize, partial: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    if slot >= 9 || !partial.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let modifier = match game.inventory.get(slot)? {
        Some(stack) => {
            let info = game.res.items().get(&stack.item)?;
            if !policy::usable(stack.count, stack.damage, info.max_damage) {
                return None;
            }
            f64::from(info.attack_speed)
        }
        None => 0.0,
    };
    let modifiers =
        game.potions.effects.modifiers().into_iter().filter(|m| m.0 == "minecraft:attack_speed").map(|m| m.2);
    let speed = policy::attack_speed(modifier, modifiers)?;
    (speed > 0.0).then(|| game.hand_strength.scale(partial, speed))
}

// A spear's stab: the game's PlayerAction 8, the swing and the sound.
fn stab(game: &mut Game<'_>, kinetic: Kinetic) {
    game.send(S::PlayerAction(play::PlayerAction { action: 8, pos: [0; 3], direction: 0, sequence: 0 }));
    game.hand_strength.reset_attack();
    game.swing_hand(horizon_client::first_person::Hand::Main, kinetic.attack_animation());
    game.play_at_feet(kinetic.attack_sound);
}

fn available_item<'a>(game: &'a Game<'_>, slot: usize) -> Option<&'a ItemStack> {
    let stack = game.inventory.get(slot)?.as_ref()?;
    let info = game.res.items().get(&stack.item)?;
    policy::usable(stack.count, stack.damage, info.max_damage).then_some(stack)
}

fn known_friend(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.id == id && m.kind.id == "minecraft:player")
        && game.remote_player_name(id).is_some_and(|name| with(|s| s.friends.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))))
}

fn enemy(game: &Game<'_>, mob: &Mob, mobs: bool) -> bool {
    if mob.kind.id == "minecraft:player" {
        return util::player_enemy(game, mob);
    }
    mobs && mob.alive()
        && !mob.removed
        && mob.health.is_finite()
        && mob.kind.id != "minecraft:armor_stand"
        && game.riding != Some(mob.id)
}

pub(super) fn reset_friend_feedback() {
    state(|s| {
        s.friend_hint = None;
        s.friend_hint_at = None;
    });
}

// Friend Guard's action bar line, at most every 1.5 s. The packet checks only read the game, so the line waits for
// the next tick.
fn queue_friend_hint(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    if !module(FRIEND).is_some_and(|m| m.b("Notifications")) || game.remote_player_name(id).is_none() {
        return;
    }
    let now = Instant::now();
    state(|s| {
        if s.friend_hint_at.is_none_or(|at| now.saturating_duration_since(at) >= Duration::from_millis(1500)) {
            s.friend_hint_at = Some(now);
            s.friend_hint = Some(id);
        }
    });
}

fn flush_friend_hint(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if !module(FRIEND).is_some_and(|m| m.b("Notifications")) || !alive(game) {
        reset_friend_feedback();
        return;
    }
    let Some(id) = state(|s| s.friend_hint.take()) else {
        return;
    };
    if !known_friend(game, id) {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(name) = game.remote_player_name(id) {
        let message = horizon_client::text::Text::literal(format!("Held back your hit on {name}"));
        game.titles.set_overlay(message, false);
    }
}

// Friend Guard: true stops a hit on `id` (every Attack packet comes through here, your clicks too).
pub(super) fn guard_attack(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    let blocked = module(FRIEND).is_some() && alive(game) && known_friend(game, id);
    if blocked {
        queue_friend_hint(game, id);
    }
    blocked
}

// What a spear stab along (yaw, pitch) would pass through: indices into game.mobs.
fn spear_hits_at(game: &Game<'_>, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    if game.mobs.len() > policy::POPULATION_LIMIT || !yaw.is_finite() || !pitch.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    if !eye.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
        return None;
    }
    if game.mobs.iter().any(|m| {
        let b = m.bounds();
        let (a, z) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        policy::box_distance(eye, [a.x, a.y, a.z], [z.x, z.y, z.z]).is_none()
    }) {
        return None;
    }
    let look = super::view_vector(yaw, pitch);
    let boxes: Vec<_> = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, m)| m.alive() && !m.removed && game.riding != Some(m.id))
        .map(|(i, m)| (i, m.bounds()))
        .collect();
    let reach = if game.creative {
        (REACH.min_creative, REACH.max_creative, REACH.hitbox_margin)
    } else {
        (REACH.min, REACH.max, REACH.hitbox_margin)
    };
    Some(
        hits_in_reach(
            &boxes,
            Vec3::new(eye[0], eye[1], eye[2]),
            Vec3::new(look[0], look[1], look[2]),
            game.known_player_movement(),
            reach,
            |from, to| super::spear::sunset_combat_collision::clip(game, from, to),
        )
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(i, _)| i)
        .collect(),
    )
}

// Friend Guard for a spear: a stab passes through several, so a friend behind the first counts too. True stops it.
pub(super) fn block_stab(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    guard_stab_at(game, game.yaw, game.pitch)
}

pub(super) fn guard_stab_at(game: &Game<'_>, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> bool {
    if module(FRIEND).is_none() || !alive(game) {
        return false;
    }
    let hits = spear_hits_at(game, yaw, pitch);
    let friend = hits.as_ref().and_then(|hits| hits.iter().map(|&i| game.mobs[i].id).find(|&id| known_friend(game, id)));
    if let Some(id) = friend {
        queue_friend_hint(game, id);
    }
    hits.is_none() || friend.is_some()
}

// A held spear charge that would run through a friend is let go (the game's release-use packet).
fn stop_guarded_use(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let spear = game.using.and_then(|(slot, _)| game.stack_in(slot)).is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some());
    if spear && block_stab(game) {
        game.send(S::PlayerAction(play::PlayerAction { action: 6, pos: [0; 3], direction: 0, sequence: 0 }));
        game.using = None;
    }
}

// A raised shield `id` holds up toward you: its blocks_attacks component, raised long enough (its delay, less your
// ping) and facing you within its angle.
pub(super) fn observed_shield(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    let Some(mob) = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id && m.alive() && !m.removed) else {
        return false;
    };
    if !mob.extra.blocking || mob.extra.using_item <= 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let used = if mob.extra.using_off_hand { mob.extra.off_hand.as_ref() } else { mob.extra.main_hand.as_ref() };
    let Some(component) = used.and_then(|item| game.res.items().get(item)).and_then(|i| i.blocks_attacks.as_ref()) else {
        return false;
    };
    let lead = super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::latency(game).map_or(0.0, |ms| (f64::from(ms) / 50.0).round().clamp(0.0, 4.0)) as f32;
    if (mob.extra.using_item as f32) + lead < (component.delay_seconds * 20.0).round() {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    component.reductions.iter().any(|r| {
        (r.factor > 0.0 || r.base > 0.0)
            && policy::facing_attack(
                [mob.position.x, mob.position.y, mob.position.z],
                mob.head_yaw,
                [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z],
                r.horizontal_angle,
            )
    })
}

// A shield in either of `id`'s hands, raised or not.
fn holds_shield(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id).is_some_and(|mob| {
        [mob.extra.main_hand.as_ref(), mob.extra.off_hand.as_ref()]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .any(|item| game.res.items().get(item).is_some_and(|i| i.blocks_attacks.is_some()))
    })
}

// A shield Axe on shields takes the axe to: raised at you, or with Shield held only held.
fn shield_counts(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    observed_shield(game, id) || (section(SHIELD).is_some_and(|m| m.b("Shield held")) && holds_shield(game, id))
}

// The hardest-hitting hotbar item that disables shields (an axe).
fn best_axe(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    (0..9)
        .filter_map(|slot| {
            let info = game.res.items().get(&available_item(game, slot)?.item)?;
            (info.disable_blocking_seconds > 0.0).then_some((slot, info.attack_damage))
        })
        .max_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
        .map(|(slot, _)| slot)
}

// The target's armour as the server would weigh it against a mace smash (Breach lowers it).
struct ArmorEstimate<'a, 'r> {
    game: &'a Game<'r>,
    stack: &'a ItemStack,
    victim: &'a str,
    random: LegacyRandom,
}

impl ArmorWorld for ArmorEstimate<'_, '_> {
    type Error = std::convert::Infallible;
    type Weapon = ();
    type ServerLevel = ();
    fn weapon(&mut self) -> Result<Option<()>, Self::Error> {
        Ok(Some(()))
    }
    fn server_level(&mut self) -> Result<Option<()>, Self::Error> {
        Ok(Some(()))
    }
    fn modify_armor_effectiveness(&mut self, _: (), _: (), value: f32) -> Result<f32, Self::Error> {
        let ctx = EffectContext {
            this: Some(self.victim),
            attacker: Some("minecraft:player"),
            direct_attacker: Some("minecraft:player"),
            is_direct: true,
            damage_type: Some("minecraft:mace_smash"),
            items: Some(self.game.res.items()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        Ok(self.game.res.items().enchantments.modify_value(
            Some(self.stack),
            "minecraft:armor_effectiveness",
            &ctx,
            &mut self.random,
            value,
        ))
    }
}

// The damage a hit with `stack` would do to `target` after armour, a smash's fall bonus included. Its own random
// stream: weighing the hotbar changes nothing in the game.
fn estimate_weapon(game: &Game<'_>, stack: &ItemStack, target: &Mob) -> Option<f32> {
    let info = game.res.items().get(&stack.item)?;
    let fall = smash_fall(game);
    let smashing = &*stack.item == "minecraft:mace" && fall > 1.5;
    let ctx = EffectContext {
        this: Some(&target.kind.id),
        attacker: Some("minecraft:player"),
        direct_attacker: Some("minecraft:player"),
        is_direct: true,
        damage_type: Some(if smashing { "minecraft:mace_smash" } else { "minecraft:player_attack" }),
        items: Some(game.res.items()),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let enchantments = &game.res.items().enchantments;
    let mut random = LegacyRandom::new(0);
    let mut damage = enchantments.modify_value(
        Some(stack),
        "minecraft:damage",
        &ctx,
        &mut random,
        1.0 + info.attack_damage + game.effect_attack_bonus(),
    );
    if smashing {
        let per = enchantments.modify_value(Some(stack), "minecraft:smash_damage_per_fallen_block", &ctx, &mut random, 0.0);
        damage += (policy::smash_bonus(fall)? + f64::from(per) * fall) as f32;
    }
    let (armor, tough) = target.worn_armor();
    let mut estimate = ArmorEstimate { game, stack, victim: &target.kind.id, random };
    let damage =
        combat_rules::after_armor(&mut estimate, damage, target.kind.armor + armor, target.kind.armor_toughness + tough).ok()?;
    (damage.is_finite() && damage >= 0.0).then_some(damage)
}

// The mace that does most to `target` (Wind Burst first with Pick on it); outside a smash only one with Breach.
fn best_mace(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Mob, m: &Module) -> Option<usize> {
    let smash = smash_fall(game) > 1.5;
    let wind = smash && m.p("Mace pick") == "Wind Burst";
    (0..9)
        .filter_map(|slot| {
            let stack = available_item(game, slot)?;
            if &*stack.item != "minecraft:mace" || (!smash && stack.enchantment_level("minecraft:breach") == 0) {
                return None;
            }
            Some((slot, wind && stack.enchantment_level("minecraft:wind_burst") > 0, estimate_weapon(game, stack, target)?))
        })
        .max_by(|a, b| a.1.cmp(&b.1).then_with(|| a.2.total_cmp(&b.2)))
        .map(|(slot, _, _)| slot)
}

// A slot to hit `id` with, and whether to go back after.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct WeaponPlan {
    pub slot: usize,
    pub owner: &'static str,
    pub restore: bool,
    // Ticks more before the slot goes back (Back after A delay).
    pub delay: u64,
}

// What the hand holds, as Duelkit's Holding lists name it.
fn held_kind(game: &Game<'_>) -> &'static str {
    let Some(stack) = game.held() else {
        return "empty";
    };
    let tagged = |tag: &str| game.res.items().item_tags.get(tag).is_some_and(|items| items.contains(&*stack.item));
    match &*stack.item {
        "minecraft:mace" => "mace",
        "minecraft:trident" => "trident",
        "minecraft:totem_of_undying" => "totem",
        name if Kinetic::of(name).is_some() => "spear",
        _ if tagged("minecraft:swords") => "sword",
        _ if tagged("minecraft:axes") => "axe",
        _ => "other",
    }
}

// The swap modules start only from what their Holding lists; Totem hit adds a totem in hand.
fn holding(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> bool {
    let kind = held_kind(game);
    util::listed(m.t("Holding"), kind) || (kind == "totem" && m.b("Totem hit"))
}

// A roll from 0 to 9999 for the chance settings, different each tick and for each `salt`.
fn roll(game: &Game<'_>, salt: u64) -> u64 {
    let mut x = game.ticks.wrapping_add(salt.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)) | 1;
    x ^= x << 13;
    x ^= x >> 7;
    x ^= x << 17;
    x % 10_000
}

fn chance(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, salt: u64) -> bool {
    (roll(game, salt) as f64) < m.n("Chance (%)") * 100.0
}

// A tick count from `lo` to `hi` (either way round), picked by the tick.
fn between(game: &Game<'_>, lo: f64, hi: f64, salt: u64) -> u64 {
    let (lo, hi) = (lo.min(hi).max(0.0) as u64, lo.max(hi).max(0.0) as u64);
    lo + roll(game, salt) % (hi - lo + 1)
}

// Duelkit's After a delay: the swapped weapon stays in hand a few ticks, from Shortest to Longest delay (picked by the
// tick it starts, so it varies), before the slot goes back; 0 with Same tick.
pub(super) fn back_delay(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> u64 {
    if m.p("Back after") != "A delay" {
        return 0;
    }
    let lo = m.n("Shortest delay") as u64;
    let hi = (m.n("Longest delay") as u64).max(lo);
    lo + game.ticks.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9) % (hi - lo + 1)
}

// The weapon Auto Weapon wants for a hit on `id`, while what Holding lists is held: an axe at a raised shield (Axe on
// shields), a mace for a smash or for Breach doing 15% more (Mace), else the best weapon (Best weapon). It only
// chooses: whoever hits switches and goes back.
fn preferred_weapon(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> Option<WeaponPlan> {
    if !allowed(game) {
        return None;
    }
    let m = module(WEAPON).filter(|m| holding(game, m))?;
    let target = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id && m.alive() && !m.removed)?;
    let plan = |slot, owner| WeaponPlan { slot, owner, restore: m.b("Swap back"), delay: back_delay(game, &m) };
    let shield_up = shield_counts(game, id) && !broken_shield(game, id);
    if m.b(SHIELD)
        && target.kind.id == "minecraft:player"
        && shield_up
        && !game.held().and_then(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item)).is_some_and(|i| i.disable_blocking_seconds > 0.0)
    {
        return best_axe(game).map(|slot| plan(slot, SHIELD));
    }
    let smash = smash_fall(game) > 1.5;
    if m.b(MACE)
        && m.b("Mace swap")
        && !shield_up
        && (smash || m.b("Breach swap"))
        && let Some(slot) = best_mace(game, target, &m)
    {
        // Breach swap (Prism's BreachSwap): only once the mace itself would hit with Min charge. The cooldown fills
        // at the held item's pace, and a mace's is far slower than a sword's, so a hit at sword pace is a weak one. A
        // smash needs no charge: its fall bonus comes after the charge's scaling.
        let charged = slot_strength(game, slot, 0.5).is_some_and(|c| f64::from(c) >= m.n("Min charge"));
        let old = game.held().and_then(|s| estimate_weapon(game, s, target)).unwrap_or(1.0);
        if smash
            || (charged && available_item(game, slot).and_then(|s| estimate_weapon(game, s, target)).is_some_and(|new| new >= old * 1.15))
        {
            return Some(plan(slot, MACE));
        }
    }
    if m.b(BEST) {
        return super::sunset::best_weapon(game, m.b("Prefer axes")).filter(|&slot| slot != game.selected).map(|slot| plan(slot, BEST));
    }
    None
}

// `owner` turned off: its look waiting and its borrowed slot go.
pub(super) fn cancel_owner(game: &mut Game<'_>, owner: &str) {
    state(|s| {
        if s.jump_owner == Some(owner) {
            s.jump_owner = None;
        }
    });
    super::sunset::cancel_turns(owner);
    if state(|s| s.lease.is_some_and(|lease| lease.owner == owner)) {
        release_lease(game, true);
    }
}

fn take_slot(game: &mut Game<'_>, plan: WeaponPlan, hold_ticks: u64, queued_end: Option<control::Finish>) -> bool {
    if state(|s| s.lease.is_some() && !s.lease_end.as_ref().is_some_and(|end| end.current())) {
        state(|s| {
            s.lease = None;
            s.lease_end = None;
        });
    }
    let old = state(|s| s.lease);
    if old.is_some_and(|l| l.owner != plan.owner) || available_item(game, plan.slot).is_none() || !control::claim(plan.owner) {
        return false;
    }
    let end = if old.is_none() { queued_end.or_else(|| Some(control::finish(plan.owner))) } else { None };
    let previous = old.map_or(game.selected, |l| l.previous);
    hold(game, plan.slot);
    state(|s| {
        if let Some(end) = end {
            s.lease_end = Some(end);
        }
        s.lease = Some(SlotLease {
            owner: plan.owner,
            previous,
            selected: plan.slot,
            until: game.ticks.saturating_add(hold_ticks + plan.delay),
            return_enabled: plan.restore,
        })
    });
    true
}

// Your own click on `id`: false stops it (a friend); Auto Weapon switches the weapon for it.
fn before_attack(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    if guard_attack(game, id) {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(plan) = preferred_weapon(game, id) {
        take_slot(game, plan, 2, None);
    }
    true
}

fn release_lease(game: &mut Game<'_>, force: bool) {
    let Some(lease) = state(|s| s.lease) else {
        return;
    };
    let owned = state(|s| s.lease_end.as_ref().is_some_and(|end| end.current()));
    if force || lease.expired(game.selected, game.ticks, owned) {
        if let Some(slot) = lease.restore(game.selected, if force { u64::MAX } else { game.ticks }, owned) {
            hold(game, slot);
        }
        state(|s| {
            s.lease = None;
            s.lease_end = None;
        });
    } else {
        control::claim(lease.owner);
    }
}

// Sunset off, a new world or life: the borrowed slot goes back, keys come back, the rest is dropped.
pub(super) fn cancel(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    post_input(game);
    release_lease(game, true);
    for owner in [BEST, SHIELD, MACE, SPEAR] {
        super::sunset::cancel_turns(owner);
    }
    state(|s| {
        let (action_tick, action_scene) = (s.action_tick, s.action_scene.take());
        *s = State { action_tick, action_scene, ..State::default() };
    });
}

// Key Throw's wind charge jump presses the jump key for the next tick, while `owner` is on.
pub(super) fn request_jump(owner: &'static str) {
    state(|s| s.jump_owner = Some(owner));
}

// An Attack packet went out: a mace smash resets the fall, an Axe on shields hit counts for a second, W Tap starts.
fn note_attack(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    note_action(game);
    super::sunset_swap_keys::hit(game);
    if game.held().is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace")
        && smash_fall(game) > 1.5
        && let Some(y) = game.player.as_ref().map(|p| p.position.y)
    {
        state(|s| s.mace.smashed(y));
    }
    if observed_shield(game, id)
        && game.held().and_then(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item)).is_some_and(|i| i.disable_blocking_seconds > 0.0)
    {
        state(|s| s.broken_shield = Some((id, game.ticks.saturating_add(20))));
    }
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let living = game.mobs.iter().any(|t| t.id == id && t.alive() && !t.removed);
    let tap = module(TAP);
    if let Some(m) = &tap
        && policy::should_tap(
            p.sprinting,
            game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyW),
            slot_strength(game, game.selected, 0.5).unwrap_or(0.0),
            living,
        )
    {
        start_tap(game, m);
    } else if tap.is_none() {
        keep_sprint(game, id);
    }
}

// W Tap after a hit: by Chance, Reaction ticks later, forward let go for Hold to Longest hold ticks.
fn start_tap(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if state(|s| s.last_attack == Some(game.ticks)) {
        return;
    }
    state(|s| s.last_attack = Some(game.ticks));
    if !chance(game, m, 1) {
        return;
    }
    let from = game.ticks.saturating_add(m.n("Reaction (ticks)").clamp(0.0, 5.0) as u64);
    let hold = between(game, m.n("Hold"), m.n("Longest hold"), 2).clamp(1, 8);
    state(|s| (s.tap_from, s.tap_until, s.tap_back) = (from, from + hold, m.p("Mode") == "S Tap"));
}

// Sprint's Keep sprint, without W Tap: after a sprinting hit on a player with forward held, forward is let go for the
// restore delay's ticks and pressed again, so the server sees the sprint start again (0 ticks: never).
fn keep_sprint(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    let Some(m) = module("Sprint").filter(|m| m.b("Keep sprint")) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let player = game.mobs.iter().any(|t| t.id == id && t.alive() && !t.removed && t.kind.id == "minecraft:player");
    if !player
        || !p.sprinting
        || !game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyW)
        || game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ShiftLeft)
        || p.collision.horizontal
        || game.using.is_some()
        || p.health.food.food <= 6
        || state(|s| s.last_attack == Some(game.ticks) || game.ticks < s.tap_until)
    {
        return;
    }
    let ticks = between(game, m.n("Shortest restore delay"), m.n("Longest restore delay"), 3);
    state(|s| {
        s.last_attack = Some(game.ticks);
        if ticks > 0 {
            (s.tap_from, s.tap_until, s.tap_back) = (game.ticks, game.ticks + ticks, false);
        }
    });
}

// A spear stab went out along (yaw, pitch): W Tap starts if it went through someone.
fn note_stab_at(game: &Game<'_>, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
    note_action(game);
    if let Some(m) = module(TAP)
        && super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_sprinting(game)
        && game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyW)
        && spear_hits_at(game, yaw, pitch).is_some_and(|hits| !hits.is_empty())
    {
        start_tap(game, &m);
    }
}

// What went on the wire: hits and uses count as the tick's action.
pub(super) fn forwarded(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) {
    match packet {
        S::UseItem(_) | S::UseItemOn(_) => note_action(game),
        S::Attack(p) if p.id >= 0 => note_attack(game, p.id as u32),
        S::PlayerAction(p) if p.action == 8 => match super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game) {
            Some((yaw, pitch)) => note_stab_at(game, yaw, pitch),
            None => note_action(game),
        },
        _ => {}
    }
}

// Friend Guard on what is about to go out: false drops it (a hit on a friend, a stab or spear use through one).
pub(super) fn allowed_out(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) -> bool {
    let look = super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game).unwrap_or((game.yaw, game.pitch));
    match packet {
        S::Attack(p) => p.id < 0 || !guard_attack(game, p.id as u32),
        S::PlayerAction(p) if p.action == 8 => !guard_stab_at(game, look.0, look.1),
        S::UseItem(p) => {
            let slot = if p.hand == 1 { util::OFFHAND } else { game.selected };
            !game.stack_in(slot).is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some() && guard_stab_at(game, p.yaw, p.pitch))
        }
        _ => true,
    }
}

// The server's knockback on you (a velocity packet): Jump Reset jumps next tick.
pub(super) fn note_velocity(game: &Game<'_>, entity: i32, velocity: [f64; 3]) {
    if module(JUMP).is_some_and(|m| chance(game, &m, 4))
        && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == entity)
        && policy::jump_knockback(velocity)
    {
        state(|s| s.jump_pending = true);
    }
}

// Before the tick's movement: W Tap lets go of forward (S Tap presses back), Jump Reset and a requested jump press
// jump. post_input puts the keys back.
pub(super) fn pre_input(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    post_input(game);
    if !alive(game) || !game.native_playing() || gui_open() {
        state(|s| {
            s.tap_until = 0;
            s.jump_pending = false;
            s.jump_owner = None;
            s.unsprint = false;
            s.relaunch.steer = None;
        });
        return;
    }
    let unsprint = state(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.unsprint)) && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.sprinting);
    let steer = steer_keys(game);
    let tap = state(|s| (s.tap_from..s.tap_until).contains(&game.ticks).then_some(s.tap_back));
    let asked = state(|s| s.jump_owner.take()).is_some_and(|owner| section(owner).is_some() && control::available(owner));
    let knocked = state(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.jump_pending))
        && module(JUMP).is_some()
        && game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyW)
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.sprinting);
    let jump = (knocked || asked)
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| {
            p.ground.on_ground && !p.flying && !p.fall_flying && !p.fluids.was_touching_water && !p.is_in_lava()
        })
        && super::remote::sunset_prediction_remote::local_motion(game).is_some_and(|motion| !motion.floating)
        && game.using.is_none()
        && game.riding.is_none();
    if tap.is_none() && !jump && !unsprint && steer.is_none() {
        return;
    }
    let before = INPUT_KEYS.map(|key| game.keys.contains(&key));
    let physical = INPUT_KEYS.map(|key| game.physical_keys.contains(&key));
    if let Some(keys) = steer {
        for key in [KeyCode::KeyW, KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyD] {
            if keys.contains(&key) {
                game.keys.insert(key);
            } else {
                game.keys.remove(&key);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(back) = tap {
        game.keys.remove(&KeyCode::KeyW);
        game.keys.remove(&KeyCode::ControlLeft);
        if back {
            game.keys.insert(KeyCode::KeyS);
        }
    }
    // The game's own tick then tells the server, before the move packet, as letting go of sprint does.
    if unsprint {
        game.keys.remove(&KeyCode::ControlLeft);
        if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
            let _ = p.set_sprinting(false);
        }
    }
    if jump {
        game.keys.insert(KeyCode::Space);
    }
    let changed = std::array::from_fn(|i| before[i] != game.keys.contains(&INPUT_KEYS[i]));
    state(|s| s.input = Some(InputSave { before, physical, changed }));
}

// Wind Jump: jump held for this tick (after pre_input, before the tick's move and PlayerInput); post_input lets it
// go.
pub(super) fn press_jump(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    const SPACE: usize = 3;
    if game.keys.contains(&INPUT_KEYS[SPACE]) {
        return;
    }
    let before = INPUT_KEYS.map(|key| game.keys.contains(&key));
    let physical = INPUT_KEYS.map(|key| game.physical_keys.contains(&key));
    state(|s| s.input.get_or_insert(InputSave { before, physical, changed: [false; INPUT_KEYS.len()] }).changed[SPACE] = true);
    game.keys.insert(INPUT_KEYS[SPACE]);
}

// The keys pre_input changed go back to what you hold.
pub(super) fn post_input(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let Some(saved) = state(|s| s.input.take()) else {
        return;
    };
    for (i, key) in INPUT_KEYS.iter().enumerate().filter(|(i, _)| saved.changed[*i]) {
        if game.physical_keys.contains(key) || (saved.before[i] && !saved.physical[i]) {
            game.keys.insert(*key);
        } else {
            game.keys.remove(key);
        }
    }
}

// Auto Weapon's Spear Lunge key, pressed: a lunge waits up to 10 ticks for its moment.
pub(super) fn key(game: &Game<'_>, key: &str, pressed: bool) {
    if !pressed || !game.native_playing() || gui_open() || !alive(game) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(m) = section(SPEAR) else {
        return;
    };
    if super::sunset::key_from_text(m.t("Lunge key")).is_some_and(|wanted| super::sunset::key_from_text(key) == Some(wanted)) {
        state(|s| s.lunge.start(game.ticks, 10));
    }
}

// The hotbar spear for a lunge (the most Lunge, the one in hand if level) or a jab (the least).
fn best_spear(game: &Game<'_>, lunge: bool) -> Option<usize> {
    (0..9)
        .filter_map(|slot| {
            let stack = available_item(game, slot)?;
            Kinetic::of(&stack.item)?;
            let level = stack.enchantment_level("minecraft:lunge");
            (!lunge || level > 0).then_some((slot, level))
        })
        .max_by(|a, b| {
            if lunge {
                a.1.cmp(&b.1).then_with(|| (a.0 == game.selected).cmp(&(b.0 == game.selected)))
            } else {
                b.1.cmp(&a.1)
            }
            .then_with(|| b.0.cmp(&a.0))
        })
        .map(|v| v.0)
}

// Reach poke: your click reaches nobody, but a spear's stab along your look would reach an enemy past ordinary
// reach (and no friend): the spear to jab with.
fn poke_slot(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Option<usize> {
    if !m.b("Reach poke") || game.held().is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some()) || game.mob_hit().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let hits = spear_hits_at(game, game.yaw, game.pitch)?;
    let look = super::view_vector(game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let start = Vec3::new(eye[0], eye[1], eye[2]);
    let end = start.add_vector(Vec3::new(look[0], look[1], look[2]).scale(4.4));
    let ordinary = game.player.as_mut()?.attribute("minecraft:entity_interaction_range").ok()?;
    if hits.iter().any(|&i| known_friend(game, game.mobs[i].id)) {
        return None;
    }
    let past = hits.iter().any(|&i| {
        enemy(game, &game.mobs[i], true)
            && game.mobs[i]
                .bounds()
                .inflate(Vec3::new(0.125, 0.125, 0.125))
                .clip(start, end)
                .is_some_and(|at| start.distance_squared(at).sqrt() > ordinary)
    });
    if !past {
        return None;
    }
    best_spear(game, false).filter(|&slot| jab_ready(game, slot))
}

// The attack hook, before your click: Some(false) takes the click (a friend, a reach poke). None: the game's own.
pub(super) fn before_click(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> Option<bool> {
    if !allowed(game) {
        return None;
    }
    if game.held().is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some()) {
        return block_stab(game).then_some(false);
    }
    if let Some((index, distance)) = game.mob_hit() {
        let id = game.mobs[index].id;
        let held = game.selected;
        if game.before_block(distance) && !before_attack(game, id) {
            return Some(false);
        }
        // One slot change before a hit at most: none more for Spear reach after Auto Weapon's.
        if game.selected == held {
            spear_pass(game, id);
        }
        return None;
    }
    let m = section(SPEAR)?;
    let slot = poke_slot(game, &m)?;
    queue_action(game, SPEAR, m, Automatic::Jab { slot, lunge: false }).then_some(false)
}

fn jab_ready(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize) -> bool {
    available_item(game, slot).is_some()
        && slot_strength(game, slot, 0.0).is_some_and(|s| s >= 1.0)
        && game.clicks.miss_time <= 0
        && game.mining.is_none()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Automatic {
    Shield(u32),
    Smash(u32),
    SmashShield(u32),
    Jab { slot: usize, lunge: bool },
    // Mace's Relaunch: the wind charge (a hotbar slot or the offhand) and the target it is for.
    Relaunch { charge: usize, target: u32 },
}

// A hit of queue_action's waits for the start of the next tick.
pub(super) fn due_waiting() -> bool {
    state(|s| s.due.is_some())
}

// The start of a tick, before its move packet (a slot change after it flags Grim's Post), after lease_back: the hit
// queue_action has ready goes.
pub(super) fn due(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if let Some(hit) = state(|s| s.due.take()) {
        hit(game);
    }
}

// A hit of the melee modules' own: once the server has your look, at the start of the next tick, checked again (the
// same world, slot, item and settings, under 200 ms), the slot switched for one hit and the hit sent.
fn queue_action(game: &mut Game<'_>, owner: &'static str, m: Module, action: Automatic) -> bool {
    if state(|s| s.lease.is_some() || s.queued.is_some()) || !control::claim(owner) {
        return false;
    }
    let done = control::finish(owner);
    let Some(connection) = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.session.counters.clone()) else {
        return false;
    };
    let original = game.selected;
    let original_item = game.held().cloned();
    let dimension = game.dim;
    let queued = Instant::now();
    // Relaunch throws straight down.
    let (yaw, pitch) = (game.yaw, if matches!(action, Automatic::Relaunch { .. }) { 90.0 } else { game.pitch });
    state(|s| {
        s.queued = Some(owner);
        s.queued_since = Some(queued);
    });
    let accepted = try_turn_then(owner, yaw, pitch, move |_| state(|s| s.due = Some(Box::new(move |game: &mut Game<'_>| {
        let done = done;
        if state(|s| s.queued_since) == Some(queued) {
            state(|s| s.queued = None);
        }
        let valid = done.current()
            && allowed(game)
            && queued.elapsed() <= Duration::from_millis(200)
            && game.dim == dimension
            && game.selected == original
            && game.held() == original_item.as_ref()
            && !acted(game)
            && super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::sprint_synced(game)
            && game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| Arc::ptr_eq(&connection, &r.session.counters))
            && section(owner).is_some_and(|now| now == m);
        if !valid {
            return;
        }
        if let Automatic::Relaunch { charge, target } = action {
            throw_relaunch(game, &m, charge, target, yaw, done);
            return;
        }
        let under = |game: &Game<'_>, id: u32| game.mob_hit().is_some_and(|(i, d)| game.mobs[i].id == id && game.before_block(d));
        let slot = match action {
            Automatic::Shield(id) => {
                if !under(game, id) || !shield_counts(game, id) || guard_attack(game, id) {
                    None
                } else {
                    best_axe(game)
                }
            }
            Automatic::SmashShield(id) => match smash_intent(game, &m, id) {
                mace_policy::Intent::BreakShield { slot } => Some(slot),
                _ => None,
            },
            Automatic::Smash(id) => {
                if !under(game, id) || smash_intent(game, &m, id) != mace_policy::Intent::Smash || guard_attack(game, id) {
                    None
                } else if m.b("Mace swap") {
                    game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id).and_then(|target| best_mace(game, target, &m))
                } else {
                    available_item(game, game.selected).filter(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace").map(|_| game.selected)
                }
            }
            Automatic::Jab { slot, lunge } => {
                let valid = available_item(game, slot)
                    .is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some() && (!lunge || s.enchantment_level("minecraft:lunge") > 0))
                    && jab_ready(game, slot)
                    && !block_stab(game)
                    && (lunge || poke_slot(game, &m) == Some(slot));
                valid.then_some(slot)
            }
            Automatic::Relaunch { .. } => None,
        };
        let Some(slot) = slot else {
            return;
        };
        let restore = m.b("Swap back");
        let hold_ticks = if matches!(action, Automatic::Shield(_)) { 2 } else { 1 };
        let delay = back_delay(game, &m);
        if !take_slot(game, WeaponPlan { slot, owner, restore, delay }, hold_ticks, Some(done)) {
            return;
        }
        match action {
            Automatic::Shield(id) | Automatic::Smash(id) | Automatic::SmashShield(id) => {
                game.send(S::Attack(play::Attack { id: id as i32 }));
                game.swing_arm();
                game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
                game.reset_attack_strength();
                state(|s| match action {
                    Automatic::Shield(_) => s.shield_ready = game.ticks.saturating_add(10),
                    Automatic::Smash(_) => s.mace.accepted(mace_policy::Intent::Smash, id, game.ticks),
                    _ => s.mace.accepted(mace_policy::Intent::BreakShield { slot }, id, game.ticks),
                });
            }
            Automatic::Jab { slot, .. } => {
                if let Some(kinetic) = available_item(game, slot).and_then(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item)) {
                    stab(game, kinetic);
                }
                state(|s| s.lunge.clear());
            }
            Automatic::Relaunch { .. } => {}
        }
        claim_tick(game);
    }))));
    if !accepted && state(|s| s.queued_since) == Some(queued) {
        state(|s| s.queued = None);
    }
    accepted
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    flush_friend_hint(game);
    stop_guarded_use(game);
    let (grounded, y) = game.player.as_ref().map_or((true, 0.0), |p| (p.ground.on_ground, p.position.y));
    state(|s| s.mace.observe(grounded, y));
    if !alive(game) {
        release_lease(game, true);
        state(|s| {
            s.lunge.clear();
            s.jump_pending = false;
            s.tap_until = 0;
        });
        return;
    }
    // The borrowed slot goes back at the start of a tick (lease_back), never here, after the tick's move packet.
    if let Some(lease) = state(|s| s.lease) {
        control::claim(lease.owner);
    }
    if let Some(owner) = state(|s| s.queued) {
        if !allowed(game)
            || section(owner).is_none()
            || state(|s| s.queued_since.is_none_or(|t| t.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(200)))
        {
            super::sunset::cancel_turns(owner);
            state(|s| s.queued = None);
        }
        return;
    }
    if !allowed(game) || acted(game) || game.attack_clicks > 0 || game.clicks.miss_time > 0 || state(|s| s.lease.is_some()) {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = section(SPEAR)
        && state(|s| s.lunge.active(game.ticks))
        && game.riding.is_none()
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| !p.fall_flying && !p.fluids.was_touching_water && (game.creative || p.health.food.food >= 7))
        && let Some(slot) = best_spear(game, true).filter(|&i| jab_ready(game, i))
        && !block_stab(game)
        && queue_action(game, SPEAR, m, Automatic::Jab { slot, lunge: true })
    {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = section(MACE)
        && let Some((charge, target)) = relaunch_plan(game, &m)
        && queue_action(game, MACE, m, Automatic::Relaunch { charge, target })
    {
        return;
    }
    let Some((index, distance)) = game.mob_hit() else {
        return;
    };
    if !game.before_block(distance) {
        return;
    }
    let id = game.mobs[index].id;
    if let Some(m) = section(SHIELD).filter(|m| m.p("Shield mode") == "Auto")
        && game.ticks >= state(|s| s.shield_ready)
        && enemy(game, &game.mobs[index], false)
        && shield_counts(game, id)
        && !broken_shield(game, id)
        && holding(game, &m)
        && best_axe(game).is_some()
        && queue_action(game, SHIELD, m, Automatic::Shield(id))
    {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = section(MACE).filter(|m| m.b("Smash assist")) {
        match smash_intent(game, &m, id) {
            mace_policy::Intent::BreakShield { .. } => {
                queue_action(game, MACE, m, Automatic::SmashShield(id));
            }
            mace_policy::Intent::Hold => {
                state(|s| s.unsprint = true);
                game.clicks.miss_time = game.clicks.miss_time.max(1);
            }
            mace_policy::Intent::Smash => {
                queue_action(game, MACE, m, Automatic::Smash(id));
            }
            mace_policy::Intent::Idle => {}
        }
    }
}

// A hit went out this tick: the game's own click and use wait.
fn claim_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    game.attack_clicks = 0;
    game.clicks.miss_time = game.clicks.miss_time.max(1);
    game.clicks.right_click_delay = game.clicks.right_click_delay.max(2);
    game.use_delay = game.use_delay.max(2);
}

fn broken_shield(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    state(|s| s.broken_shield.is_some_and(|(target, until)| target == id && game.ticks < until) || s.mace.shield_attempted(id, game.ticks))
}

// Falling far enough onto `id` for Mace's smash, with a mace in hand or to swap to.
fn smash_ready(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    let Some(m) = section(MACE) else {
        return false;
    };
    let fall = smash_fall(game);
    if fall <= 1.5 || fall < m.n("Min fall") {
        return false;
    }
    available_item(game, game.selected).is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace")
        || (m.b("Mace swap") && game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id).is_some_and(|target| best_mace(game, target, &m).is_some()))
}

fn can_hold_smash(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) -> bool {
    let (yaw, pitch) = super::sunset_combat_wire::sent_look(game).unwrap_or((game.yaw, game.pitch));
    super::sunset_mace_native::continuation(game, id, yaw, pitch).unwrap_or(false)
}

// A hit from Kill Aura or Trigger Bot on `id`, planned: the slot of Auto Weapon's axe at a raised shield, mace or
// best weapon for it, when it is not the one in hand, and the ticks after the hit it goes back (None: it stays). The
// caller holds it.
pub(super) fn strike_weapon(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> Option<(usize, Option<u64>)> {
    let plan = preferred_weapon(game, id)?;
    (plan.slot != game.selected).then_some((plan.slot, plan.restore.then_some(plan.delay)))
}

// Stun slam's mace hit, the tick after the axe's: still falling far enough, the mace still in `slot`, no friend, and
// `id` within reach.
pub(super) fn slam_ready(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32, slot: usize) -> bool {
    let Some(mace) = section(MACE) else {
        return false;
    };
    let fall = smash_fall(game);
    if !allowed(game) || fall <= 1.5 || fall < mace.n("Min fall") || guard_attack(game, id) {
        return false;
    }
    if !available_item(game, slot).is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace") {
        return false;
    }
    let reach = game.player.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.attribute("minecraft:entity_interaction_range").ok()).unwrap_or(3.0);
    let (Some(eye), Some(target)) = (game.eye_position(), game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id && t.alive() && !t.removed)) else {
        return false;
    };
    let b = target.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    policy::box_distance(eye, [lo.x, lo.y, lo.z], [hi.x, hi.y, hi.z]).is_some_and(|d| d <= reach)
}

// The start of a tick, before its hits: a borrowed slot whose time is up goes back. (Sent after the tick's move packet
// it is what Grim's Post check flags; after a hit in the same tick, its PacketOrderE.) True if the slot changed.
pub(super) fn lease_back(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    if !alive(game) {
        return false;
    }
    let before = game.selected;
    let disabled = state(|s| s.lease).is_some_and(|l| section(l.owner).is_none());
    release_lease(game, disabled || !game.native_playing() || gui_open());
    game.selected != before
}

fn smash_intent(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, id: u32) -> mace_policy::Intent {
    let Some(target) = game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id) else {
        return mace_policy::Intent::Idle;
    };
    let target_allowed = enemy(game, target, m.b("Smash mobs"));
    let target_immune = target.hurt_time > 0;
    // The charge is the mace's, the one swapped in if it is not in hand (Prism's): a held sword's would be too high.
    let held_mace = available_item(game, game.selected).is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace");
    let charge_slot = if held_mace || !m.b("Mace swap") { game.selected } else { best_mace(game, target, m).unwrap_or(game.selected) };
    let shield_blocks = observed_shield(game, id) && !broken_shield(game, id);
    let mace_available = smash_ready(game, id);
    let fall = smash_fall(game);
    let can_continue = can_hold_smash(game, id);
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return mace_policy::Intent::Idle;
    };
    let frame = mace_policy::Frame {
        tick: game.ticks,
        target: id,
        grounded: p.ground.on_ground,
        descending: p.velocity.y < 0.0,
        native_smash: fall > 1.5,
        fall,
        min_fall: m.n("Min fall"),
        target_allowed,
        mace_available,
        shield_blocks,
        axe: best_axe(game),
        auto_swap: m.b("Mace swap"),
        swap_back: m.b("Swap back"),
        can_continue,
        timing: if m.p("Smash timing") == "Delayed" { mace_policy::Timing::Delayed } else { mace_policy::Timing::Direct },
        charge: f64::from(slot_strength(game, charge_slot, 0.5).unwrap_or(0.0)),
        charge_next: f64::from(slot_strength(game, charge_slot, 1.5).unwrap_or(0.0)),
        target_immune,
        sprinting: p.sprinting,
    };
    state(|s| s.mace.plan(frame))
}

// Spear reach (Duelkit's): the hotbar spear the crosshair reaches as far as, while what Holding lists is held (a
// sword or axe). None: off.
pub(super) fn spear_reach_slot(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    section(SPEAR).filter(|m| m.p("Spear reach") != "Off" && holding(game, m))?;
    best_spear(game, false)
}

// Before a hit on `id` with a sword or axe: Spear reach selects the spear and the weapon again (both told to the
// server), as a manual reach swap does; When out of reach only past the reach you have without it. Never after
// another slot change for the same hit. The two slot changes in one tick are what Grim's Reach check falsely flags
// (Grim issues #2601 and #2517), so it is left off on Grim servers.
pub(super) fn spear_pass(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    let Some(spear) = spear_reach_slot(game) else {
        return;
    };
    let every = section(SPEAR).is_some_and(|m| m.p("Spear reach") == "Every hit");
    let (Some(eye), Some(target)) = (game.eye_position(), game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id)) else {
        return;
    };
    let b = target.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    let distance = policy::box_distance(eye, [lo.x, lo.y, lo.z], [hi.x, hi.y, hi.z]);
    let ordinary = game.player.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.attribute("minecraft:entity_interaction_range").ok()).unwrap_or(3.0);
    if every || distance.is_none_or(|d| d > ordinary) {
        let weapon = game.selected;
        hold(game, spear);
        hold(game, weapon);
    }
}

// Axe on shields' Stun slam, before Kill Aura's axe hit on `id`: falling far enough onto their raised shield, the
// mace to hit with at the start of the next tick (slam_ready).
pub(super) fn stun_slam(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> Option<usize> {
    section(SHIELD).filter(|m| m.b("Stun slam"))?;
    let mace = section(MACE)?;
    let axe = game.held().and_then(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item)).is_some_and(|i| i.disable_blocking_seconds > 0.0);
    let fall = smash_fall(game);
    if !axe || !observed_shield(game, id) || fall <= 1.5 || fall < mace.n("Min fall") {
        return None;
    }
    let target = game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id)?;
    best_mace(game, target, &mace)
}

// Key Throw's Hotbar keys on a Lunge spear (Duelkit's Quick use): a jab with it at the start of the next tick, before
// its move packet (the lunge is the jab's), and the slot you held back in the same tick.
pub(super) fn quick_lunge(game: &mut Game<'_>, slot: usize) -> bool {
    // No charge check: the game's key selected the spear, which restarted this client's charge, while the server's
    // is still the weapon's when the jab arrives.
    let fit = move |game: &Game<'_>| {
        allowed(game)
            && game.clicks.miss_time <= 0
            && game.mining.is_none()
            && !block_stab(game)
            && game.riding.is_none()
            && available_item(game, slot).is_some_and(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some() && s.enchantment_level("minecraft:lunge") > 0)
            && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| !p.fall_flying && !p.fluids.was_touching_water && (game.creative || p.health.food.food >= 7))
    };
    if !fit(game) || state(|s| s.due.is_some()) {
        return false;
    }
    let back = game.selected;
    state(|s| {
        s.due = Some(Box::new(move |game: &mut Game<'_>| {
            let Some(kinetic) = available_item(game, slot).and_then(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item)) else {
                return;
            };
            // The game's own hotbar key selected the spear meanwhile: that is undone first.
            if ![back, slot].contains(&game.selected) {
                return;
            }
            game.selected = back;
            if !fit(game) || acted(game) {
                return;
            }
            hold(game, slot);
            stab(game, kinetic);
            hold(game, back);
            claim_tick(game);
        }))
    });
    true
}

// A wind charge `stack` may be thrown: its cooldown is over.
fn off_cooldown(game: &Game<'_>, stack: &ItemStack) -> bool {
    game.res.items().get(&stack.item).is_some_and(|info| {
        !game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown(&horizon_client::cooldowns::group(stack, info.use_cooldown.as_ref()))
    })
}

// Mace's Relaunch (the idea of Prism's WindJump and Nora's MaceCombo, done with the game's own packets: no velocity
// written, no move packet of its own). It needs ground under you, an enemy within Relaunch range, a mace to come down
// with, room above you for the rise, and a wind charge off cooldown (the offhand's, or with Hotbar one from the
// hotbar). Returns the charge's slot and the target.
fn relaunch_plan(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Option<(usize, u32)> {
    let mode = m.p("Relaunch");
    if mode == "Off" || !allowed(game) || game.creative || game.riding.is_some() || game.ticks < state(|s| s.relaunch.next) {
        return None;
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    if !p.ground.on_ground || p.flying || p.fall_flying || p.fluids.was_touching_water || p.is_in_lava() {
        return None;
    }
    let mace = (0..9).any(|slot| {
        (slot == game.selected || m.b("Mace swap")) && available_item(game, slot).is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:mace")
    });
    if !mace {
        return None;
    }
    let charge = |stack: Option<&ItemStack>| {
        stack.is_some_and(|s| &*s.item == "minecraft:wind_charge" && s.count > 0 && off_cooldown(game, s))
    };
    let slot = if charge(game.offhand.as_ref()) {
        util::OFFHAND
    } else if mode == "Hotbar" {
        (0..9).find(|&i| charge(game.inventory.get(i).and_then(|s| s.as_ref())))?
    } else {
        return None;
    };
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let range = m.n("Relaunch range");
    let target = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| enemy(game, t, m.b("Smash mobs")) && !known_friend(game, t.id))
        .filter_map(|t| {
            let b = t.bounds();
            let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
            let d = policy::box_distance(eye, [lo.x, lo.y, lo.z], [hi.x, hi.y, hi.z])?;
            (d <= range).then_some((t.id, d))
        })
        .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))?
        .0;
    let mut scene = SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: None };
    let body = p.bounds();
    let room = (1..=3).all(|up| scene.unobstructed(body.move_by(Vec3::new(0.0, f64::from(up), 0.0))).unwrap_or(false));
    room.then_some((slot, target))
}

// Relaunch's throw, at the start of the tick after the server took your look straight down (as a player looks down,
// jumps and right clicks). The wind charge goes along that look: from the offhand, or a hotbar one selected for it and
// put back at the start of the next tick, never after the use in this tick (Grim's PacketOrderE). The jump key is held
// this tick. The look stays down for this tick's move packet, since a use packet's look must be the move's (Grim's
// BadPacketsJ). Air steer then takes you toward the target.
fn throw_relaunch(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, charge: usize, target: u32, yaw: f32, done: control::Finish) {
    // Another module's look waits: this tick's move packet would carry that one.
    if relaunch_plan(game, m) != Some((charge, target)) || super::sunset::turn_pending() {
        return;
    }
    if charge != util::OFFHAND && !take_slot(game, WeaponPlan { slot: charge, owner: MACE, restore: true, delay: 0 }, 1, Some(done)) {
        return;
    }
    // The yaw the move packet will carry, so the use packet's look is the move's exactly.
    let sent_yaw = super::sunset::wire_yaw(game, yaw);
    super::sunset::turn(MACE, yaw, 90.0);
    let sequence = util::sequence(game);
    game.send(S::UseItem(play::UseItem { hand: i32::from(charge == util::OFFHAND), sequence, yaw: sent_yaw, pitch: 90.0 }));
    request_jump(MACE);
    claim_tick(game);
    let now = game.ticks;
    state(|s| s.relaunch = Relaunch { next: now.saturating_add(20), steer: Some((target, now)) });
}

// Air steer (Prism's MovementHooks): for up to 40 ticks after a Relaunch, while you are in the air, the move keys
// toward the target's feet (none once you are over them). Any key you hold yourself wins, except W alone. None: no
// steering this tick.
fn steer_keys(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<Vec<KeyCode>> {
    let (id, start) = state(|s| s.relaunch.steer)?;
    let on = section(MACE).is_some_and(|m| m.p("Relaunch") != "Off" && m.b("Air steer"));
    let target = game.mobs.iter().find(|t| t.id == id && t.alive() && !t.removed);
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let over = game.ticks > start.saturating_add(40)
        || (p.ground.on_ground && game.ticks > start.saturating_add(3))
        || p.fall_flying
        || p.fluids.was_touching_water;
    let (Some(target), true, false) = (target, on, over) else {
        state(|s| s.relaunch.steer = None);
        return None;
    };
    if [KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyD].iter().any(|k| game.physical_keys.contains(k)) {
        return None;
    }
    let (dx, dz) = (target.position.x - p.position.x, target.position.z - p.position.z);
    if dx * dx + dz * dz < 0.35 * 0.35 {
        return Some(Vec::new());
    }
    // The move keys go by your own yaw, the one the game moves you with. Yaw grows turning right.
    let toward = (-dx).atan2(dz).to_degrees() as f32;
    let off = (toward - game.yaw + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0;
    let mut keys = Vec::new();
    if off.abs() < 67.5 {
        keys.push(KeyCode::KeyW);
    } else if off.abs() > 112.5 {
        keys.push(KeyCode::KeyS);
    }
    if (22.5..157.5).contains(&off) {
        keys.push(KeyCode::KeyD);
    } else if (-157.5..-22.5).contains(&off) {
        keys.push(KeyCode::KeyA);
    }
    Some(keys)
}

// Spear's Damage indicator: while you charge a spear, the hit it would do to the nearest player as things stand (the
// game's kinetic damage: a player's base attack damage plus the closing speed along your look, in blocks a second, times the
// spear's damage multiplier, rounded down), under the crosshair; LETHAL from 20.
const BASE_DAMAGE: f64 = 1.0;

pub(super) fn draw_spear(game: &Game<'_>, w: f32, h: f32, out: &mut impl Canvas) {
    if section(SPEAR).is_none_or(|m| !m.b("Damage indicator")) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(kinetic) = game.using.and_then(|(slot, _)| game.stack_in(slot)).and_then(|s| Kinetic::of(&s.item)) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians());
    let look = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let along = |v: [f64; 3]| (0..3).map(|i| look[i] * v[i] * 20.0).sum::<f64>();
    let theirs = util::player_target(game, 12.0, "Distance").map_or(0.0, |t| along([t.pos[0] - t.prev[0], t.pos[1] - t.prev[1], t.pos[2] - t.prev[2]]));
    let mine = along([p.velocity.x, p.velocity.y, p.velocity.z]);
    let damage = BASE_DAMAGE + ((mine - theirs).max(0.0) * f64::from(kinetic.damage_multiplier)).floor();
    let text = if damage >= 20.0 { "LETHAL".to_owned() } else { format!("Damage: {damage:.0} HP") };
    let (bw, bh) = (64.0_f32, 20.0_f32);
    let (x, y) = (w / 2.0 - bw / 2.0, h / 2.0 + 30.0);
    let share = (damage / 20.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) as f32;
    out.fill([x, y, bw, bh], 0x960E_0E0E);
    out.text(&text, [x + (bw - game.native_text_width(&text)) / 2.0, y + 3.0], 0xFFFFFF);
    out.fill([x + 7.0, y + bh - 7.0, bw - 14.0, 4.0], 0x5A00_0000);
    let red = ((1.0 - share) * 255.0) as u32;
    let green = (share * 255.0) as u32;
    out.fill([x + 7.0, y + bh - 7.0, (bw - 14.0) * share, 4.0], 0xDC00_0000 | red << 16 | green << 8);
}

```

`mixins/sunset/melee_policy.rs`:

```rs
// The melee modules' rules that need no world (Rust's PR #16): when a borrowed hotbar slot goes back, distances to a
// box, whether a shield faces an attacker, the mace's fall bonus, attack speed, W Tap and Jump Reset's triggers.

// More living things than this nearby and the melee modules sit out the tick.
pub(super) const POPULATION_LIMIT: usize = 512;

// A hotbar slot a melee module took for a hit, and the one it goes back to.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(super) struct SlotLease {
    pub owner: &'static str,
    pub previous: usize,
    pub selected: usize,
    pub until: u64,
    pub return_enabled: bool,
}

impl SlotLease {
    // The slot to go back to: never once you changed slot yourself.
    pub(super) fn restore(self, selected: usize, now: u64, still_owner: bool) -> Option<usize> {
        (still_owner && self.return_enabled && selected == self.selected && self.previous < 9 && now >= self.until)
            .then_some(self.previous)
    }
    pub(super) fn expired(self, selected: usize, now: u64, still_owner: bool) -> bool {
        !still_owner || selected != self.selected || now >= self.until
    }
}

// An item that is there and not broken.
pub(super) fn usable(count: u32, damage: u32, max_damage: u32) -> bool {
    count > 0 && (max_damage == 0 || damage < max_damage)
}

// From the eyes to the nearest point of a box.
pub(super) fn box_distance(eye: [f64; 3], lo: [f64; 3], hi: [f64; 3]) -> Option<f64> {
    if !eye.iter().chain(lo.iter()).chain(hi.iter()).all(|n| n.is_finite()) || (0..3).any(|i| lo[i] > hi[i]) {
        return None;
    }
    Some((0..3).map(|i| (eye[i] - eye[i].clamp(lo[i], hi[i])).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt())
}

// A raised shield facing the attacker within the shield's own angle (its blocks_attacks component).
pub(super) fn facing_attack(defender: [f64; 3], yaw: f32, attacker: [f64; 3], angle: f32) -> bool {
    if !defender.iter().chain(attacker.iter()).all(|n| n.is_finite()) || !yaw.is_finite() || !angle.is_finite() || angle < 0.0 {
        return false;
    }
    let dx = attacker[0] - defender[0];
    let dz = attacker[2] - defender[2];
    let length = dx.hypot(dz);
    if length < 1.0e-4 {
        return angle >= 90.0;
    }
    let y = f64::from(yaw).to_radians();
    let dot = (-y.sin() * dx + y.cos() * dz) / length;
    dot.clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos().to_degrees() <= f64::from(angle.min(180.0))
}

// The mace's smash bonus for a fall: 4 a block for the first 3, 2 for the next 5, 1 after.
pub(super) fn smash_bonus(fall: f64) -> Option<f64> {
    if !fall.is_finite() || fall < 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(fall.min(3.0) * 4.0 + (fall - 3.0).clamp(0.0, 5.0) * 2.0 + (fall - 8.0).max(0.0))
}

// W Tap: a charged hit while you sprint forward at something alive.
pub(super) fn should_tap(sprinting: bool, forward: bool, strength: f32, living_target: bool) -> bool {
    sprinting && forward && living_target && strength.is_finite() && strength > 0.9
}

// Jump Reset: knockback that throws you up and sideways.
pub(super) fn jump_knockback(velocity: [f64; 3]) -> bool {
    velocity.iter().all(|n| n.is_finite()) && velocity[1] > 0.0 && velocity[0].hypot(velocity[2]) >= 0.1
}

// The attack speed a hand item would give: 4 plus the item's modifier, times the effects' multipliers.
pub(super) fn attack_speed(item_modifier: f64, total_modifiers: impl IntoIterator<Item = f64>) -> Option<f64> {
    if !item_modifier.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut value = 4.0 + item_modifier;
    for modifier in total_modifiers {
        value *= 1.0 + modifier;
        if !value.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
    }
    Some(value.clamp(0.0, 1024.0))
}

// A key press kept for a few ticks (Auto Weapon's Lunge key).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub(super) struct Request {
    deadline: Option<u64>,
}

impl Request {
    pub(super) fn start(&mut self, now: u64, ticks: u64) {
        self.deadline = Some(now.saturating_add(ticks));
    }
    pub(super) fn active(&mut self, now: u64) -> bool {
        let active = self.deadline.is_some_and(|end| now <= end);
        if !active {
            self.clear();
        }
        active
    }
    pub(super) fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.deadline = None;
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/motion_flags.rs`:

```rs
// What Sunset asks of the player's own movement, set once a tick by the game and read by the hooks on the
// movement code (the window's thread only, never a server's): Safe Walk keeps to edges as sneaking does (Meteor's
// ClipAtLedgeEvent), Speed sets the move across the ground (Meteor's PlayerMoveEvent), Velocity scales how
// flowing liquids push (the flow each fluid block gives, across and up), Flight sets the air's pull, and GUI Move
// keeps a sprint going behind a screen.

use std::cell::Cell;

thread_local! {
    static SAFE_WALK: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    // Blocks a tick across the ground, x and z.
    static ACROSS: Cell<Option<[f64; 2]>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    static UP: Cell<Option<f64>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    static LIQUID: Cell<Option<[f64; 2]>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    // Flight's Velocity mode: the air's pull on your input (Player.getFlyingSpeed).
    static FLYING: Cell<Option<f32>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    // GUI Move: the move keys held behind a screen, which the game would not take.
    static SCREEN_KEYS: Cell<Option<crate::sprint::Keys>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    // GUI Move: the keys this tick's movement took behind a screen, for the tick's PlayerInput.
    static SCREEN_MOVED: Cell<Option<crate::sprint::Keys>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
    // No Slow's Skip: the item-use slowdown left out of this tick's move.
    static NO_SLOW_SKIP: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    // No Slow's GrimAC mode keeps Speed's movement override out of item-use ticks.
    static NO_SLOW_GRIM: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    // Knockback hits since the last movement, and the game tick of the last: each cuts the speed across to 0.6 and
    // stops the sprint.
    static ATTACK_SLOW: Cell<(u32, u64)> = const { Cell::new((0, 0)) };
}

pub fn set_no_slow_grim(on: bool) {
    NO_SLOW_GRIM.with(|c| c.set(on));
}

pub fn no_slow_grim() -> bool {
    NO_SLOW_GRIM.with(Cell::get)
}

pub fn set_no_slow_skip(on: bool) {
    NO_SLOW_SKIP.with(|c| c.set(on));
}

pub fn no_slow_skip() -> bool {
    NO_SLOW_SKIP.with(Cell::get)
}

pub fn add_attack_slow(tick: u64) {
    ATTACK_SLOW.with(|c| c.set((c.get().0.saturating_add(1), tick)));
}

// The start of a tick: hits from before the last tick's movement that no movement took (riding, dead) are gone.
pub fn expire_attack_slow(tick: u64) {
    ATTACK_SLOW.with(|c| {
        if c.get().1 < tick {
            c.set((0, 0));
        }
    });
}

// The knockback hits the next movement starts with (then none).
pub fn take_attack_slow() -> u32 {
    ATTACK_SLOW.with(|c| c.replace((0, 0)).0)
}

pub fn set_screen_keys(keys: Option<crate::sprint::Keys>) {
    SCREEN_KEYS.with(|c| c.set(keys));
    SCREEN_MOVED.with(|c| c.set(None));
}

// The keys a tick's movement takes behind a screen while GUI Move walks you: the ones held, when the game gave it none
// (a screen keeps them from it) and some are held. None: the keys as they are.
pub fn screen_keys(keys: crate::sprint::Keys) -> Option<crate::sprint::Keys> {
    let pressed = |k: crate::sprint::Keys| k.direction() != [0.0, 0.0] || k.jump || k.shift;
    let moved = SCREEN_KEYS.with(Cell::get).filter(|held| !pressed(keys) && pressed(*held));
    // Kept till the next tick: the move's call again with these keys passes through here too.
    if moved.is_some() {
        SCREEN_MOVED.with(|c| c.set(moved));
    }
    moved
}

// The PlayerInput flags a tick sends with the keys GUI Move moved with behind a screen added (the game's have none
// there, and the server predicts the move from them); None when that adds nothing.
pub fn screen_input(input: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    let k = SCREEN_MOVED.with(Cell::get)?;
    let with = input
        | u8::from(k.forward)
        | u8::from(k.backward) << 1
        | u8::from(k.left) << 2
        | u8::from(k.right) << 3
        | u8::from(k.jump) << 4
        | u8::from(k.shift) << 5
        | u8::from(k.sprint) << 6;
    (with != input).then_some(with)
}

pub fn set_flying_speed(speed: Option<f32>) {
    FLYING.with(|c| c.set(speed));
}

pub fn flying_speed(speed: f32) -> f32 {
    FLYING.with(Cell::get).unwrap_or(speed)
}

pub fn set_safe_walk(on: bool) {
    SAFE_WALK.with(|c| c.set(on));
}

pub fn set_across(across: Option<[f64; 2]>) {
    ACROSS.with(|c| c.set(across));
}

pub fn set_up(up: Option<f64>) {
    UP.with(|c| c.set(up));
}

pub fn set_liquid_flow(share: Option<[f64; 2]>) {
    LIQUID.with(|c| c.set(share));
}

pub fn liquid_flow(flow: horizon_core::geometry::Vec3) -> horizon_core::geometry::Vec3 {
    match LIQUID.with(Cell::get) {
        Some([h, v]) => horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(flow.x * h, flow.y * v, flow.z * h),
        None => flow,
    }
}

pub fn clip_at_ledge(sneaking: bool) -> bool {
    sneaking || SAFE_WALK.with(Cell::get)
}

pub fn self_move(movement: horizon_core::geometry::Vec3) -> horizon_core::geometry::Vec3 {
    let y = UP.with(Cell::get).unwrap_or(movement.y);
    match ACROSS.with(Cell::get) {
        Some([x, z]) => horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(x, y, z),
        None => horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(movement.x, y, movement.z),
    }
}
```
