`mixins/sunset/picker.rs`:

```rs
// The list picker: a list setting (blocks, items or entities, comma separated) chosen from the game's registries in
// the settings window instead of typed. The chosen ones come first, then every other one the search matches; a click
// adds or takes one away. Names show readable (Diamond Ore), the setting keeps ids (diamond_ore).

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::Shape;
use super::sunset_util::short;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum ListKind {
    Blocks,
    Items,
    Entities,
    Particles,
    Players,
}

// What a text setting lists, by its name (and module, for the white and black lists); None: free text.
pub(super) fn list_kind(module: &str, setting: &str) -> Option<ListKind> {
    match setting {
        "Blocks" | "Mine blocks" | "Use blocks" => Some(ListKind::Blocks),
        "Entities" | "Hit entities" | "Use entities" => Some(ListKind::Entities),
        "Particles" => Some(ListKind::Particles),
        "Friends" => Some(ListKind::Players),
        "Items" | "Item list" | "Selected weapon types" => Some(ListKind::Items),
        "Whitelist" | "Blacklist" if matches!(module, "Auto Eat" | "Auto Tool") => Some(ListKind::Items),
        "Whitelist" | "Blacklist" => Some(ListKind::Blocks),
        _ => None,
    }
}

// The open picker: every name it offers, sorted by readable name, and how far its list is scrolled; or, for a
// short list, the groups of names it ticks on and off together.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Picker {
    pub(super) kind: ListKind,
    pub(super) all: Arc<[Box<str>]>,
    pub(super) groups: Option<&'static [&'static [&'static str]]>,
    pub(super) scroll: f32,
}

// Xray's Simple list: the ores and valuables, each row the blocks it stands for (the first names the row).
pub(super) const VALUABLES: &[&[&str]] = &[
    &["diamond_ore", "deepslate_diamond_ore"],
    &["ancient_debris"],
    &["emerald_ore", "deepslate_emerald_ore"],
    &["gold_ore", "deepslate_gold_ore"],
    &["nether_gold_ore"],
    &["iron_ore", "deepslate_iron_ore"],
    &["copper_ore", "deepslate_copper_ore"],
    &["redstone_ore", "deepslate_redstone_ore"],
    &["lapis_ore", "deepslate_lapis_ore"],
    &["coal_ore", "deepslate_coal_ore"],
    &["nether_quartz_ore"],
    &["spawner", "trial_spawner"],
    &["chest", "trapped_chest", "barrel"],
    &["ender_chest"],
    &["obsidian", "crying_obsidian"],
    &["budding_amethyst", "amethyst_cluster"],
];

// The entity groups the entity lists take (see the aura's list matching).
const GROUPS: [&str; 4] = ["@all", "@player", "@hostile", "@passive"];

// The short list a picker of groups offers.
pub(super) fn short_list(groups: &'static [&'static [&'static str]]) -> Picker {
    Picker { kind: ListKind::Blocks, all: Arc::new([]), groups: Some(groups), scroll: 0.0 }
}

pub(super) fn open(game: &Game<'_>, kind: ListKind) -> Picker {
    let mut names: Vec<Box<str>> = match kind {
        ListKind::Blocks => game.res.facts().states.iter().map(|f| short(&f.name).into()).collect(),
        ListKind::Items => game.res.items().registry_order.iter().map(|n| short(n).into()).collect(),
        ListKind::Entities => std::iter::once("player")
            .chain(horizon_client::mobs::species::ALL.iter().map(|d| short(d.name)))
            .map(Into::into)
            .collect(),
        ListKind::Particles => horizon_client::particles::sunset_particles::names().into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
        ListKind::Players => online().into_iter().map(|(name, _)| name.into()).collect(),
    };
    names.retain(|n| !matches!(&**n, "air" | "cave_air" | "void_air"));
    names.sort();
    names.dedup();
    if kind != ListKind::Players {
        names.sort_by_cached_key(|n| readable(n));
    }
    if kind == ListKind::Entities {
        names.splice(0..0, GROUPS.iter().map(|g| (*g).into()));
    }
    Picker { kind, all: names.into(), groups: None, scroll: 0.0 }
}

const STEVE: &str = "entity/player/wide/steve";

// The players online and the skin each one's face is drawn from, as the menu last saw them (it looks while a
// player picker is open).
static ONLINE: std::sync::Mutex<Vec<(String, String)>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new());

fn online() -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    ONLINE.lock().map(|o| o.clone()).unwrap_or_default()
}

// The players in the server's list, their skins loaded for their faces (as the tab list does). The picker's names
// follow them.
pub(super) fn see_players(game: &mut Game<'_>, picker: &mut Option<Picker>) {
    let Some(p) = picker.as_mut().filter(|p| p.kind == ListKind::Players) else {
        return;
    };
    let players = game.remote_tab_players().map(|(list, _, _)| list).unwrap_or_default();
    let seen: Vec<(String, String)> = players.into_iter().map(|t| (t.name.clone(), game.face_skin(t.uuid, &t.skin))).collect();
    p.all = seen.iter().map(|(n, _)| n.as_str().into()).collect();
    if let Ok(mut o) = ONLINE.lock() {
        *o = seen;
    }
}

// A row's icon: a block or an item as the game draws it in its menus (a block with no item of its own as the item
// that places it: a wall torch as a torch, water as a bucket of it), a mob as its spawn egg, a player as a face.
pub(super) fn icon(game: &Game<'_>, picker: &Picker, name: &str, at: [f32; 2], size: f32) -> Option<Shape> {
    let items = game.res.items();
    let item = |id: &str| items.items.get_key_value(format!("minecraft:{id}").as_str()).map(|(k, _)| k.clone());
    let found = match picker.kind {
        _ if name.starts_with('@') => None,
        ListKind::Entities if name == "player" => {
            return Some(Shape::Face(STEVE.into(), at, size));
        }
        ListKind::Entities => item(&format!("{name}_spawn_egg")),
        ListKind::Items => item(name),
        ListKind::Particles => None,
        ListKind::Players => {
            let skin = online().into_iter().find(|(n, _)| n == name).map_or_else(|| STEVE.to_owned(), |(_, skin)| skin);
            return Some(Shape::Face(skin, at, size));
        }
        ListKind::Blocks => item(name)
            .or_else(|| item(&name.replace("_wall_", "_").replace("wall_", "")))
            .or_else(|| name.strip_prefix("potted_").and_then(item))
            .or_else(|| matches!(name, "water" | "lava" | "powder_snow").then(|| item(&format!("{name}_bucket"))).flatten()),
    };
    found.map(|id| Shape::Item(id, at, size))
}

// diamond_ore as Diamond Ore; a group as it is.
pub(super) fn readable(id: &str) -> String {
    if id.starts_with('@') {
        return id.to_owned();
    }
    short(id)
        .split('_')
        .filter(|w| !w.is_empty())
        .map(|w| {
            let mut c = w.chars();
            c.next().map_or(String::new(), |f| f.to_uppercase().chain(c).collect())
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
}

// The names in a list setting's text.
pub(super) fn chosen(text: &str) -> Vec<&str> {
    text.split(',').map(|n| short(n.trim())).filter(|n| !n.is_empty()).collect()
}

// The list with `name` added, or taken away if it was in.
pub(super) fn toggled(text: &str, name: &str) -> String {
    let mut list = chosen(text);
    match list.iter().position(|n| *n == name) {
        Some(i) => {
            list.remove(i);
        }
        None => list.push(name),
    }
    list.join(",")
}

// The list after a click on a row: the name, or its whole group, added or taken away.
pub(super) fn clicked(picker: &Picker, text: &str, name: &str) -> String {
    let Some(group) = picker.groups.and_then(|g| g.iter().find(|g| g[0] == name)) else {
        return toggled(text, name);
    };
    let mut list = chosen(text);
    if group.iter().all(|n| list.contains(n)) {
        list.retain(|n| !group.contains(n));
    } else {
        list.extend(group.iter().filter(|n| !chosen(text).contains(n)));
    }
    list.join(",")
}

// The rows the picker shows: the chosen ones (true), then the rest that the search finds in the id or the readable
// name; a list of groups keeps its order, a group chosen when all of it is.
pub(super) fn rows<'a>(picker: &'a Picker, text: &'a str, search: &'a str) -> Vec<(&'a str, bool)> {
    let have = chosen(text);
    let typed = search.trim();
    let lower = typed.to_lowercase();
    let found = |n: &str| lower.is_empty() || n.to_lowercase().contains(&lower) || readable(n).to_lowercase().contains(&lower);
    if let Some(groups) = picker.groups {
        return groups.iter().filter(|g| found(g[0])).map(|g| (g[0], g.iter().all(|n| have.contains(n)))).collect();
    }
    // A player's name typed in the search can be added when no row is that name.
    let other = |n: &str| !n.eq_ignore_ascii_case(typed);
    let named = picker.kind == ListKind::Players
        && !typed.is_empty()
        && !typed.contains(',')
        && have.iter().all(|n| other(n))
        && picker.all.iter().all(|n| other(n));
    have.iter()
        .map(|n| (*n, true))
        .chain(named.then_some((typed, false)))
        .chain(picker.all.iter().map(|n| &**n).filter(|n| !have.contains(n) && found(n)).map(|n| (n, false)))
        .collect()
}

pub(super) const ROW: f32 = 12.0;

// The picker's box, its list's area and its Done button.
pub(super) fn rect(w: f32, h: f32) -> [f32; 4] {
    let width = (w - 8.0).clamp(1.0, 300.0);
    let height = (h - 16.0).clamp(1.0, 280.0);
    [(w - width) / 2.0, ((h - height) / 2.0).max(0.0), width, height]
}

pub(super) fn list_area(r: [f32; 4]) -> [f32; 4] {
    [r[0] + 6.0, r[1] + 42.0, r[2] - 12.0, (r[3] - 64.0).max(0.0)]
}

pub(super) fn done_button(r: [f32; 4]) -> [f32; 4] {
    [r[0] + r[2] - 62.0, r[1] + r[3] - 19.0, 56.0, 15.0]
}

// How far the list can scroll.
pub(super) fn max_scroll(count: usize, r: [f32; 4]) -> f32 {
    (count as f32 * ROW - list_area(r)[3]).max(0.0)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn names_read_and_lists_toggle() {
        assert_eq!(readable("minecraft:diamond_ore"), "Diamond Ore");
        assert_eq!(readable("@hostile"), "@hostile");
        assert_eq!(toggled("obsidian, minecraft:anvil", "anvil"), "obsidian");
        assert_eq!(toggled("obsidian", "cobweb"), "obsidian,cobweb");
        assert_eq!(toggled("", "cobweb"), "cobweb");
    }

    #[test]
    fn chosen_first_then_what_the_search_finds() {
        let picker = Picker { kind: ListKind::Blocks, all: ["coal_ore", "diamond_ore", "dirt"].map(Into::into).into(), groups: None, scroll: 0.0 };
        assert_eq!(rows(&picker, "dirt", "ore"), [("dirt", true), ("coal_ore", false), ("diamond_ore", false)]);
        assert_eq!(rows(&picker, "", "Diamond O"), [("diamond_ore", false)]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_group_ticks_on_and_off_together() {
        let picker = short_list(&[&["coal_ore", "deepslate_coal_ore"], &["spawner"]]);
        assert_eq!(rows(&picker, "coal_ore,spawner", ""), [("coal_ore", false), ("spawner", true)]);
        assert_eq!(clicked(&picker, "coal_ore,spawner", "coal_ore"), "coal_ore,spawner,deepslate_coal_ore");
        assert_eq!(clicked(&picker, "coal_ore,deepslate_coal_ore,dirt", "coal_ore"), "dirt");
    }
}
```

```rs
#[derive(Default)]
struct Ps {
    fish_state: u8,
    cast_left: u32,
    catch_left: u32,
    gap_eating: bool,
    gap_prev: usize,
    spam_timer: u32,
    spam_index: usize,
    rng: u64,
    afk_jump: bool,
    afk_sneak: u32,
    afk_strafe: i32,
    afk_right: bool,
    afk_key: Option<KeyCode>,
    afk_yaw: Option<f32>,
    afk_message: i32,
    afk_index: usize,
    afk_wander: Wander,
    steal_wait: u32,
    steal_id: i32,
    steal_last: usize,
    steal_same: u32,
    steal_done: i32,
    clean_wait: u32,
    // Inventory Cleaner's Preset as last seen.
    clean_preset: String,
    // No Break Reset: the step the block's break took last tick, with the item held then.
    break_step: f32,
    // No Fall's Place: what it put down to land in, the item, the ticks since, the ticks you have stood still, and
    // whether the server's answer (the water there) has come.
    fall_placed: Option<([i32; 3], &'static str, u32, u32, bool)>,
    // Fast Place: the share of a block earned so far, in twentieths.
    place_credit: u32,
}

static PS: Mutex<Option<Ps>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn ps<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Ps) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = PS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(g.get_or_insert_with(Ps::default))
}

fn rand(n: usize) -> usize {
    ps(|p| {
        p.rng = p.rng.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407 + n as u64);
        ((p.rng >> 33) as usize) % n.max(1)
    })
}

// Reach's extra, read by the reach hook (f64 bits; None when off).
static REACH: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(u64::MAX);

pub(super) fn reach_extra() -> Option<f64> {
    let bits = REACH.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    (bits != u64::MAX).then(|| f64::from_bits(bits))
}

// How far the crosshair picks mobs (f64 bits; u64::MAX: the game's own), and Ghost Hand's Hits, read by the
// mob_hit and before_block hooks.
static ENTITY_REACH: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(u64::MAX);
static WALL_HITS: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool = std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);

// Hitboxes: how far the boxes of the mobs it picked this tick grow each way, and their ids (read by the mob_hit hook).
static HITBOXES: Mutex<(f64, Vec<u32>)> = Mutex::new((0.0, Vec::new()));
// Mine Through Mobs, at work this tick: the mobs it leaves to be hit as usual.
static NO_TRACE: Mutex<Option<String>> = Mutex::new(None);

// The mob under the crosshair with Reach's Entity reach or Auto Weapon's Spear reach, as the game's own pick finds it
// (the nearest box along the look), the boxes Hitboxes grows grown; none with Mine Through Mobs while a block is in
// reach (but for the mobs it lists). None: the game's own.
pub(super) fn mob_hit(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<Option<(usize, f64)>> {
    let bits = ENTITY_REACH.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    let (grow, grown) = HITBOXES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    let trace = NO_TRACE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    if bits == u64::MAX && grown.is_empty() && trace.is_none() {
        return None;
    }
    let hit = pick_mob(game, bits, grow, &grown);
    match (hit, trace) {
        (Some((i, _)), Some(kept)) if game.pick().is_some() && !listed(&kept, &game.mobs[i].kind.id) => Some(None),
        _ => Some(hit),
    }
}

fn pick_mob(game: &Game<'_>, bits: u64, grow: f64, grown: &[u32]) -> Option<(usize, f64)> {
    let ordinary = if game.creative { 5.0 } else { 3.0 };
    let reach = if bits == u64::MAX { ordinary } else { f64::from_bits(bits).max(ordinary) };
    let (eye, dir) = game.aim()?;
    let boxed = |m: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob| {
        let b = m.bounds();
        if grown.contains(&m.id) { b.inflate(horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(grow, grow, grow)) } else { b }
    };
    game.mobs
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, m)| m.alive() && Some(m.id) != game.riding)
        .filter_map(|(i, m)| Some((i, super::ray_box(eye, dir, reach, boxed(m))?)))
        .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
}

// Hitboxes (Meteor's), for the crosshair's pick: the mobs whose boxes grow by Expand, those the Entities list names
// (with @all, @player, @hostile, @passive), not friends with Ignore friends, and none unless what Weapons lists is
// in hand with Only on weapon.
fn hitboxes(game: &Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) -> (f64, Vec<u32>) {
    let Some(m) = m.filter(|m| m.n("Expand") > 0.0) else {
        return (0.0, Vec::new());
    };
    if m.b("Only on weapon") {
        let held = game.held().map_or("", |s| &*s.item);
        let tagged = |tag: &str| game.res.items().item_tags.get(tag).is_some_and(|items| items.contains(held));
        let kind = match short(held) {
            "mace" => "mace",
            "trident" => "trident",
            _ if horizon_client::spear::Kinetic::of(held).is_some() => "spear",
            _ => ["sword", "axe", "pickaxe", "shovel", "hoe"].into_iter().find(|k| tagged(&format!("minecraft:{k}s"))).unwrap_or(""),
        };
        if kind.is_empty() || !listed(m.t("Weapons"), kind) {
            return (0.0, Vec::new());
        }
    }
    let own = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.entity_id as u32);
    let (friends, names) = (super::sunset::with(|s| s.friends.clone()), game.remote_player_names());
    let ids = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|mob| Some(mob.id) != own)
        .filter(|mob| {
            let player = mob.kind.id == "minecraft:player";
            let hostile = super::sunset_aura::is_hostile(&mob.kind.id);
            m.t("Entities").split(',').map(str::trim).any(|tok| match tok {
                "@all" => true,
                "@player" => player,
                "@hostile" => hostile,
                "@passive" => !player && !hostile,
                _ => !tok.is_empty() && short(tok) == short(&mob.kind.id),
            }) && !(player && m.b("Ignore friends") && super::sunset::is_friend(&friends, &names, mob.id))
        })
        .map(|mob| mob.id)
        .collect();
    (m.n("Expand"), ids)
}

// Ghost Hand's Hits: the mob under the crosshair counts as before any block.
pub(super) fn hit_through_walls(game: &Game<'_>, distance: f64) -> bool {
    WALL_HITS.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) && game.mob_hit().is_some_and(|(_, d)| d == distance)
}

// What Ghost Hand opens or uses: containers, doors, trapdoors, gates, buttons, levers and work blocks.
fn usable(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    let name = short(&facts(game, p).name);
    name != "iron_door"
        && name != "iron_trapdoor"
        && ["chest", "barrel", "shulker_box", "hopper", "dispenser", "dropper", "furnace", "smoker", "brewing_stand", "crafting_table",
            "crafter", "anvil", "enchanting_table", "beacon", "smithing_table", "loom", "stonecutter", "cartography_table",
            "grindstone", "button", "lever", "door", "trapdoor", "fence_gate"]
            .iter()
            .any(|k| name == *k || name.ends_with(&format!("_{k}")))
}

// Ghost Hand (Meteor's): your right click is not on a usable block, so the first one along the look within reach is
// used instead, through whatever is in between (servers check the distance only).
fn ghost_hand(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if !super::sunset::with(|s| s.module("Ghost Hand").is_some_and(|m| m.on && m.b("Blocks"))) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    if game.pick().is_some_and(|h| usable(game, h.pos)) || game.mob_hit().is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let look = super::view_vector(game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let reach = game.reach();
    let mut last = None;
    for i in 1..(reach * 10.0) as i32 {
        let t = f64::from(i) / 10.0;
        let p = [0, 1, 2].map(|a| (eye[a] + look[a] * t).floor() as i32);
        if last == Some(p) {
            continue;
        }
        last = Some(p);
        if usable(game, p) {
            let sequence = sequence(game);
            game.send(S::UseItemOn(play::UseItemOn { hand: 0, pos: p, face: 1, cursor: [0.5, 1.0, 0.5], inside: true, world_border: false, sequence }));
            game.swing_arm();
            return;
        }
    }
}

// Right mouse button down while playing: Ghost Hand, Air Place.
pub(super) fn right_click(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    ghost_hand(game);
    let Some(m) = super::sunset::with(|s| s.module("Air Place").filter(|m| m.on).cloned()) else {
        return;
    };
    if !in_world(game) || game.pick().is_some() || game.entity_targeted() {
        return;
    }
    let held = game.held().is_some_and(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item).is_some_and(|i| i.block.is_some()));
    if !held {
        return;
    }
    let (Some(eye), yaw, pitch) = (game.eye_position(), f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians()) else {
        return;
    };
    let d = m.n("Range");
    let look = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let at = [
        (eye[0] + look[0] * d).floor() as i32,
        (eye[1] + look[1] * d).floor() as i32,
        (eye[2] + look[2] * d).floor() as i32,
    ];
    let slot = game.selected;
    place_block(game, at, slot, false, true);
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, mods: &[Module]) {
    let get = |n: &str| mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == n && m.on);
    REACH.store(
        get("Reach").map_or(u64::MAX, |m| m.n("Extra block reach").to_bits()),
        std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed,
    );
    let spear = super::sunset_melee::spear_reach_slot(game).map(|_| {
        let reach = horizon_client::spear::REACH;
        f64::from(if game.creative { reach.max_creative } else { reach.max })
    });
    let entity = match (get("Reach").map(|m| m.n("Entity reach")), spear) {
        (Some(a), Some(b)) => Some(a.max(b)),
        (a, b) => a.or(b),
    };
    ENTITY_REACH.store(entity.map_or(u64::MAX, f64::to_bits), std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    *HITBOXES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = hitboxes(game, get("Hitboxes"));
    // Mine Through Mobs (Meteor's): with a pickaxe in either hand (or anything, with Only with a pickaxe off).
    let pickaxe = [game.held(), game.offhand.as_ref()].into_iter().flatten().any(|s| s.item.ends_with("_pickaxe"));
    *NO_TRACE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) =
        get("Mine Through Mobs").filter(|m| pickaxe || !m.b("Only with a pickaxe")).map(|m| m.t("Entities").to_owned());
    WALL_HITS.store(get("Ghost Hand").is_some_and(|m| m.b("Hits")), std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    // These work on the inventory screen, which in_world leaves out.
    if game.remote.is_some() && game.player.is_some() {
        if let Some(m) = get("Chest Stealer") {
            auto_steal(game, m);
        }
        if let Some(m) = get("Inventory Cleaner") {
            inventory_cleaner(game, m);
        }
    }
    if !in_world(game) {
        ps(|p| p.place_credit = 0);
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Fish") {
        auto_fish(game, m);
    } else {
        ps(|p| p.fish_state = 0);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Gap") {
        auto_gap(game, m);
    } else if ps(|p| std::mem::take(&mut p.gap_eating)) {
        let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Fast Place") {
        fast_place(game, m);
    } else {
        ps(|p| p.place_credit = 0);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Fast Use") {
        fast_use(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Anti AFK") {
        anti_afk(game, m);
    } else {
        ps(|p| {
            p.afk_yaw = None;
            p.afk_message = 0;
            p.afk_wander = Wander::default();
        });
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Spam") {
        spam(game, m);
    } else {
        ps(|p| p.spam_timer = 0);
    }
    match get("No Fall") {
        Some(m) => no_fall(game, m),
        None => ps(|p| p.fall_placed = None),
    }
}

// Auto Gap is eating: Auto Eat waits.
pub(super) fn gap_eating() -> bool {
    ps(|p| p.gap_eating)
}

// ---- Auto Fish

fn rod_ok(game: &Game<'_>, slot: usize, anti_break: bool) -> Option<u32> {
    let s = game.inventory.get(slot)?.as_ref()?;
    if short(&s.item) != "fishing_rod" {
        return None;
    }
    let max = game.res.items().get(&s.item).map_or(0, |i| i.max_damage);
    if anti_break && max > 0 && s.damage + 1 >= max {
        return None;
    }
    let lvl = |e: &str| s.enchantment_level(e);
    Some(lvl("minecraft:luck_of_the_sea") + lvl("minecraft:lure") + lvl("minecraft:mending") + lvl("minecraft:unbreaking"))
}

fn use_rod(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> bool {
    let anti = m.b("Anti break");
    let selected = game.selected;
    let mut best: Option<(usize, u32)> = rod_ok(game, selected, anti).map(|s| (selected, s));
    for i in 0..9 {
        if i == selected {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(score) = rod_ok(game, i, anti) {
            if best.is_none_or(|(_, b)| score > b) {
                best = Some((i, score));
            }
        }
    }
    let Some((slot, _)) = best else {
        return false;
    };
    if slot != selected {
        if !m.b("Auto switch") {
            return false;
        }
        hold(game, slot);
    }
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
    ps(|p| p.cast_left = m.n("Cast delay (ticks)") as u32);
    true
}

fn auto_fish(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    match super::fishing::sunset_fishing::state(game) {
        None => {
            // Idle: cast again after the delay.
            ps(|p| p.fish_state = 0);
            if !m.b("Auto cast") {
                return;
            }
            if ps(|p| {
                if p.cast_left > 0 {
                    p.cast_left -= 1;
                    true
                } else {
                    false
                }
            }) {
                return;
            }
            if use_rod(game, m) {
                ps(|p| p.fish_state = 1);
            }
        }
        Some((bobbing, biting, hooked)) => {
            let state = ps(|p| p.fish_state);
            match state {
                0 => ps(|p| p.fish_state = 1),
                1 => {
                    if hooked {
                        if use_rod(game, m) {
                            ps(|p| p.fish_state = 0);
                        }
                    } else if bobbing && biting {
                        ps(|p| {
                            p.catch_left = m.n("Catch delay (ticks)") as u32;
                            p.fish_state = 2;
                        });
                    }
                }
                _ => {
                    let wait = ps(|p| {
                        if p.catch_left > 0 {
                            p.catch_left -= 1;
                            true
                        } else {
                            false
                        }
                    });
                    if hooked || !wait {
                        if use_rod(game, m) {
                            ps(|p| p.fish_state = 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ---- Auto Gap

fn gap_slot(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, need_egap: bool) -> Option<usize> {
    let plain = if need_egap { None } else { find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "golden_apple") };
    plain.or_else(|| if m.b("Allow egap") || need_egap { find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "enchanted_golden_apple") } else { None })
}

fn auto_gap(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let effects = &game.potions.effects;
    let missing = |name: &str| effects.amplifier(name).is_none();
    let mut need_egap = false;
    let mut should = m.b("Always");
    if !should && m.b("Potions regeneration") && missing("regeneration") {
        should = true;
    }
    if !should && m.b("Potions fire resistance") && missing("fire_resistance") {
        should = true;
        need_egap = true;
    }
    if !should && m.b("Potions absorption") && missing("absorption") {
        should = true;
        need_egap = true;
    }
    if !should && m.b("Health enabled") {
        let health = (p.health.health() + p.health.absorption()).round();
        should = f64::from(health) < m.n("Health threshold");
    }
    let eating = ps(|s| s.gap_eating);
    if eating {
        if should {
            match gap_slot(game, m, need_egap) {
                Some(slot) => {
                    hold(game, slot);
                    if game.using.is_none() {
                        let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
                    }
                }
                None => stop_eating(game),
            }
        } else {
            stop_eating(game);
        }
    } else if should {
        if let Some(slot) = gap_slot(game, m, need_egap) {
            let prev = game.selected;
            ps(|s| {
                s.gap_prev = prev;
                s.gap_eating = true;
            });
            hold(game, slot);
            let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
        }
    }
}

fn stop_eating(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, false);
    let prev = ps(|s| {
        s.gap_eating = false;
        s.gap_prev
    });
    hold(game, prev);
}

// ---- Fast Place

// Blocks a second at each speed. The game's own is one every 4 ticks (5 a second), and a tick places one at most (20).
const PLACE_RATES: [u32; 5] = [6, 8, 10, 14, 20];

fn holds_block(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    [game.held(), game.offhand.as_ref()]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .any(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item).is_some_and(|i| i.block.is_some()))
}

fn place_ready(credit: &mut u32, speed: usize) -> bool {
    let rate = PLACE_RATES[speed.clamp(1, PLACE_RATES.len()) - 1];
    *credit += rate;
    if *credit >= 20 {
        *credit -= 20;
        true
    } else {
        false
    }
}

// Runs after the game counts its delay down and before it reads it: each tick earns a share of a block, and the delay
// opens when a whole one is earned. So speeds between two whole delays average out to their exact rate.
fn fast_place(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if !game.right || game.using.is_some() || !holds_block(game) {
        ps(|p| p.place_credit = 0);
        return;
    }
    let speed = m.n("Speed") as usize;
    let ready = ps(|p| place_ready(&mut p.place_credit, speed));
    game.use_delay = if ready { 0 } else { game.use_delay.max(1) };
}

// ---- Fast Use

fn fast_use(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    // Blocks are Fast Place's while it is on, or its speed would not hold; throwables are Throwables' when it is on.
    if holds_block(game) && super::sunset::with(|s| s.is_on("Fast Place")) || super::sunset_combat_inventory::thrown_in_hand(game, m) {
        return;
    }
    let item = game.held().map(|s| short(&s.item).to_owned());
    let applies = m.p("Mode") == "All"
        || item.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| {
            passes(m, "Items", i)
                || m.b("Blocks") && game.res.items().get(&format!("minecraft:{i}")).is_some_and(|inf| inf.block.is_some())
        });
    if applies && game.use_delay > m.n("Cooldown (ticks)") as u32 {
        game.use_delay = m.n("Cooldown (ticks)") as u32;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod fast_place_tests {
    use super::place_ready;

    #[test]
    fn each_speed_places_its_configured_average_per_second() {
        let expected = [6, 8, 10, 14, 20];
        for (index, count) in expected.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let mut credit = 0;
            let placed = (0..20).filter(|_| place_ready(&mut credit, index + 1)).count();
            assert_eq!(placed, count);
            assert_eq!(credit, 0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn speed_is_clamped_to_the_supported_range() {
        let mut low = 0;
        let low_count = (0..20).filter(|_| place_ready(&mut low, 0)).count();
        let mut high = 0;
        let high_count = (0..20).filter(|_| place_ready(&mut high, 99)).count();
        assert_eq!(low_count, 6);
        assert_eq!(high_count, 20);
    }
}

// ---- Chest Stealer and Inventory Cleaner

// How many slots a server's container menu has, for the ones that are just a grid of items.
fn container_size(menu: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    let name = menu.strip_prefix("minecraft:").unwrap_or(menu);
    match name {
        "shulker_box" | "generic_9x3" => Some(27),
        "hopper" => Some(5),
        "generic_3x3" => Some(9),
        _ => name.strip_prefix("generic_9x")?.parse::<usize>().ok().map(|rows| rows * 9),
    }
}

fn auto_steal(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    use horizon_client::menu::Input::QuickMove;
    if game.screen != Screen::Inventory {
        // Closed: the next chest starts afresh.
        ps(|p| p.steal_done = i32::MIN);
        return;
    }
    // A chest of your own world, or the menu a server opened.
    let (id, size) = match game.container {
        Some(key) if matches!(game.container_kind(), Some(super::BlockEntity::Chest(_))) => {
            (key.0 ^ key.1.rotate_left(10) ^ key.2.rotate_left(20) | 1, game.container_size())
        }
        Some(_) => return,
        None => {
            let (id, menu) = game.remote_menu();
            match container_size(&menu) {
                Some(n) => (id, n),
                None => return,
            }
        }
    };
    if ps(|p| p.steal_done == id) || ps(|p| {
        p.steal_wait = p.steal_wait.saturating_sub(1);
        p.steal_wait > 0
    }) {
        return;
    }
    let items: Vec<usize> = (0..size).filter(|&i| game.slot_mut(300 + i).is_some()).collect();
    // Done when it is empty, or when taking stopped changing it (your inventory is full).
    let stuck = ps(|p| {
        p.steal_same = if p.steal_id == id && p.steal_last == items.len() { p.steal_same + 1 } else { 0 };
        (p.steal_id, p.steal_last) = (id, items.len());
        p.steal_same >= 6
    });
    if items.is_empty() || stuck {
        ps(|p| p.steal_done = id);
        return;
    }
    let ops: Vec<_> = items.iter().take(m.n("Items per tick") as usize).map(|&i| (Some(300 + i), 0, QuickMove)).collect();
    game.menu_ops(&ops);
    ps(|p| p.steal_wait = m.n("Delay (ticks)") as u32);
}

// Inventory Cleaner's presets: name, then the blocks, food, arrows and pearls kept, and the junk.
const PRESETS: [(&str, f64, f64, f64, f64, &str); 4] = [
    ("PvP", 128.0, 64.0, 64.0, 16.0, "dirt,gravel,sand,rotten_flesh,spider_eye,poisonous_potato,wheat_seeds,bone,string,feather,flint,stick,egg"),
    ("Building", 1728.0, 32.0, 0.0, 16.0, "rotten_flesh,spider_eye,poisonous_potato,wheat_seeds,bone,string,feather,flint,egg"),
    ("Mining", 64.0, 64.0, 0.0, 0.0, "dirt,gravel,cobblestone,cobbled_deepslate,netherrack,andesite,diorite,granite,tuff,rotten_flesh,spider_eye,poisonous_potato,wheat_seeds"),
    ("Survival", 256.0, 128.0, 128.0, 16.0, "rotten_flesh,spider_eye,poisonous_potato"),
];

// A tool, weapon or armour piece: its kind (the word after the material) and how good its material is.
fn gear(item: &str) -> Option<(&str, u32)> {
    const KINDS: [&str; 13] = ["sword", "axe", "pickaxe", "shovel", "hoe", "spear", "helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots", "bow", "crossbow", "mace"];
    let (material, kind) = item.rsplit_once('_').unwrap_or(("", item));
    if !KINDS.contains(&kind) || (material.is_empty() && !matches!(kind, "bow" | "crossbow" | "mace")) {
        return None;
    }
    let tier = match material {
        "netherite" => 7,
        "diamond" => 6,
        "iron" => 5,
        "copper" => 4,
        "stone" | "chainmail" | "turtle" => 3,
        "golden" => 2,
        _ => 1,
    };
    Some((kind, tier))
}

// The inventory slots (0-35) a preset drops: its junk; a tool, weapon or armour piece when a better one or the same
// one is kept (worn armour counts); building blocks, food, arrows and pearls past its limits.
fn junk_slots(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Vec<usize> {
    let item = |i: usize| game.inventory.get(i).and_then(|s| s.as_ref());
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    // What you wear is the best so far of its kind, and never dropped.
    const WORN: usize = usize::MAX;
    let mut best: Vec<(&str, u32, usize)> =
        game.armor.iter().flatten().filter_map(|s| gear(short(&s.item)).map(|(kind, tier)| (kind, tier, WORN))).collect();
    for i in 0..36 {
        let Some((kind, tier)) = item(i).and_then(|s| gear(short(&s.item))) else {
            continue;
        };
        match best.iter_mut().find(|b| b.0 == kind) {
            Some(b) if tier > b.1 => {
                if b.2 != WORN {
                    out.push(b.2);
                }
                *b = (kind, tier, i);
            }
            Some(_) => out.push(i),
            None => best.push((kind, tier, i)),
        }
    }
    let mut kept = [0.0; 4];
    for i in 0..36 {
        let Some(stack) = item(i) else {
            continue;
        };
        let name = short(&stack.item);
        if listed(m.t("Junk"), name) {
            out.push(i);
            continue;
        }
        let info = game.res.items().get(&stack.item);
        let class = if info.as_ref().and_then(|i| i.block).is_some_and(|b| game.res.facts().get(b).full_collision) {
            0
        } else if info.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| i.food.is_some()) {
            1
        } else if name.ends_with("arrow") {
            2
        } else if name == "ender_pearl" {
            3
        } else {
            continue;
        };
        let limit = m.n(["Blocks", "Food", "Arrows", "Pearls"][class]);
        if kept[class] + stack.count as f64 > limit {
            out.push(i);
        } else {
            kept[class] += stack.count as f64;
        }
    }
    out.sort_unstable();
    out.dedup();
    out
}

fn inventory_cleaner(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    // A preset just picked fills in its limits and junk (not on the first look, so a change you made stays).
    let preset = m.p("Preset");
    let before = ps(|p| std::mem::replace(&mut p.clean_preset, preset.to_owned()));
    if !before.is_empty() && before != preset
        && let Some(&(_, blocks, food, arrows, pearls, junk)) = PRESETS.iter().find(|p| p.0 == preset)
    {
        for (field, value) in [("blocks", blocks.to_string()), ("food", food.to_string()), ("arrows", arrows.to_string()),
            ("pearls", pearls.to_string()), ("junk", junk.to_owned())]
        {
            super::sunset::set_setting(game, &format!("inventorycleaner.{field}"), &value);
        }
        return;
    }

    use horizon_client::menu::Input::Throw;
    if game.screen != Screen::Inventory || game.remote_menu().1 != "inventory" {
        return;
    }
    if ps(|p| {
        p.clean_wait = p.clean_wait.saturating_sub(1);
        p.clean_wait > 0
    }) {
        return;
    }
    // Never from a slot Loadouts locks.
    let locked = super::sunset_loadouts::locked_slots();
    let junk = if preset == "Custom" {
        (0..36).find(|&i| !locked[i] && game.inventory.get(i).and_then(|s| s.as_ref()).is_some_and(|s| passes(m, "Items", short(&s.item))))
    } else {
        junk_slots(game, m).into_iter().find(|&i| !locked[i])
    };
    if let Some(i) = junk {
        game.menu_ops(&[(Some(i), 1, Throw)]);
        ps(|p| p.clean_wait = m.n("Delay (ticks)") as u32 + 1);
    }
}

// ---- Anti AFK (Meteor's AntiAFK)

// Wander, vape-rs's Anti-AFK (github.com/rdbtCVS/vape-rs, MIT): once none of your move keys has been held for a
// random Start delay, every few seconds at random (Frequency) a small visible turn at a random speed (at most Max yaw
// and Max pitch change) and a short walk, a tenth to a fifth of a second, toward a point within a block. Keep close
// walks back and turns back once it has drifted from where it started. Times in ticks.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Wander {
    idle_since: Option<u64>,
    delay: u64,
    next_walk: u64,
    next_turn: u64,
    walked_at: u64,
    turned_at: u64,
    // Where you were and how you looked when it began.
    origin: Option<([f64; 2], f32, f32)>,
    // The point it walks to, from when, for how long.
    walk: Option<([f64; 2], u64, u64)>,
    // The look it turns to and its speed, degrees a tick.
    turn: Option<(f32, f32, f32)>,
}

fn unit() -> f64 {
    rand(1_000_000) as f64 / 1e6
}

fn wrap180(a: f32) -> f32 {
    (a + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0
}

// The move keys from `at` toward `to` with this yaw (vape-rs's keys_towards).
fn keys_towards(at: [f64; 2], yaw: f32, to: [f64; 2]) -> Vec<KeyCode> {
    let (dx, dz) = (to[0] - at[0], to[1] - at[1]);
    if dx.hypot(dz) < 0.1 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let rad = f64::from(yaw).to_radians();
    let forward = -rad.sin() * dx + rad.cos() * dz;
    let left = rad.cos() * dx + rad.sin() * dz;
    let edge = 0.3 * dx.hypot(dz);
    [(forward > edge, KeyCode::KeyW), (forward < -edge, KeyCode::KeyS), (left > edge, KeyCode::KeyA), (left < -edge, KeyCode::KeyD)]
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(held, k)| held.then_some(k))
        .collect()
}

// One tick of Wander: the keys to hold, and the view turned a step.
fn wander(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Vec<KeyCode> {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let at = [p.position.x, p.position.z];
    let now = game.ticks;
    let yours = [KeyCode::KeyW, KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyD].iter().any(|k| game.physical_keys.contains(k));
    let mut w = ps(|p| std::mem::take(&mut p.afk_wander));
    if yours || w.idle_since.is_none() {
        let (lo, hi) = (m.n("Shortest start delay (s)"), m.n("Longest start delay (s)"));
        let delay = ((lo + unit() * (hi - lo).max(0.0)) * 20.0) as u64;
        w = Wander { idle_since: Some(now), delay, next_walk: delay, next_turn: delay, walked_at: now, turned_at: now, ..Wander::default() };
        ps(|p| p.afk_wander = w);
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut keys = Vec::new();
    if now.saturating_sub(w.idle_since.unwrap_or(now)) >= w.delay {
        // Up to a second plus the Frequency's interval between one and the next.
        let interval = 20 + (20.0 / m.n("Frequency").max(0.1)) as usize;
        let (yaw, pitch) = (game.yaw, game.pitch);
        if m.b("Turn") && in_world(game) && now.saturating_sub(w.turned_at) >= w.next_turn {
            w.origin.get_or_insert((at, yaw, pitch));
            w.next_turn = rand(interval) as u64;
            w.turned_at = now;
            let (most_yaw, most_pitch) = (m.n("Max yaw change"), m.n("Max pitch change"));
            let drifted = match (m.b("Keep close"), w.origin) {
                (true, Some((_, y, p))) => f64::from(wrap180(yaw - y).hypot(wrap180(pitch - p))) >= most_yaw.hypot(most_pitch),
                _ => false,
            };
            let mut dy = unit() * most_yaw;
            let mut dp = unit() * most_pitch;
            if unit() > 0.6 {
                dy = -dy;
            }
            if unit() > 0.5 {
                dp = -dp;
            }
            let to = match w.origin {
                Some((_, y, p)) if drifted => (y, p),
                _ => (yaw + dy as f32, (pitch + dp as f32).clamp(-90.0, 90.0)),
            };
            w.turn = Some((to.0, to.1, (unit() * 10.0).max(1.0) as f32));
        }
        if let Some((ty, tp, speed)) = w.turn {
            let (dy, dp) = (wrap180(ty - yaw), tp - pitch);
            game.yaw += dy.clamp(-speed, speed);
            game.pitch = (game.pitch + dp.clamp(-speed, speed)).clamp(-90.0, 90.0);
            if dy.abs() <= speed && dp.abs() <= speed {
                w.turn = None;
            }
        }
        match w.walk {
            None if now.saturating_sub(w.walked_at) >= w.next_walk => {
                w.origin.get_or_insert((at, yaw, pitch));
                w.next_walk = rand(interval) as u64;
                let mut to = [at[0] + unit() * 2.0 - 1.0, at[1] + unit() * 2.0 - 1.0];
                if let (true, Some((origin, _, _))) = (m.b("Keep close"), w.origin)
                    && (origin[0] - at[0]).hypot(origin[1] - at[1]) >= 0.75
                {
                    to = origin;
                }
                w.walk = Some((to, now, 2 + rand(3) as u64));
                w.walked_at = now;
            }
            Some((_, since, ticks)) if now.saturating_sub(since) >= ticks => w.walk = None,
            _ => {}
        }
        if let Some((to, _, _)) = w.walk {
            keys = keys_towards(at, game.yaw, to);
        }
    }
    ps(|p| p.afk_wander = w);
    keys
}

// The keys it holds this tick: Wander's walk; or, in Meteor mode, a jump now and then, sneaking, and strafing left
// and right.
pub(super) fn afk_keys(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Vec<KeyCode> {
    if m.p("Mode") == "Wander" {
        return wander(game, m);
    }
    let mut keys = Vec::new();
    if m.b("Jump") {
        // rand takes the same lock as ps: roll first, or the game freezes.
        let roll = rand(99) == 0;
        let jump = ps(|p| {
            p.afk_jump = !p.afk_jump && roll;
            p.afk_jump
        });
        if jump {
            keys.push(KeyCode::Space);
        }
    }
    if m.b("Sneak") {
        let sneak = ps(|p| {
            let held = p.afk_sneak < m.n("Sneak time") as u32;
            p.afk_sneak += 1;
            held
        });
        if sneak {
            keys.push(KeyCode::ShiftLeft);
        } else if rand(99) == 0 {
            ps(|p| p.afk_sneak = 0);
        }
    }
    if m.b("Strafe") {
        let key = ps(|p| {
            p.afk_strafe -= 1;
            if p.afk_strafe <= 0 {
                p.afk_key = Some(if p.afk_right { KeyCode::KeyD } else { KeyCode::KeyA });
                p.afk_right = !p.afk_right;
                p.afk_strafe = 20;
            }
            p.afk_key
        });
        keys.extend(key);
    }
    keys
}

fn anti_afk(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if !in_world(game) {
        return;
    }
    let meteor = m.p("Mode") == "Meteor";
    if meteor && m.b("Swing") && rand(99) == 0 {
        game.swing_arm();
        game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
    }
    if meteor && m.b("Spin") {
        let yaw = ps(|p| {
            let y = p.afk_yaw.unwrap_or(game.yaw) + m.n("Speed") as f32;
            p.afk_yaw = Some(y);
            y
        });
        if m.p("Spin mode") == "Client" {
            game.yaw = yaw;
        } else {
            super::sunset::turn("Anti AFK", yaw, m.n("Pitch") as f32);
        }
    }
    if m.b("Send messages") {
        let messages: Vec<&str> = m.t("Messages").split('|').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
        if messages.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let due = ps(|p| {
            p.afk_message -= 1;
            p.afk_message <= 0
        });
        if due {
            let i = if m.b("Random") {
                rand(messages.len())
            } else {
                ps(|p| {
                    p.afk_index = (p.afk_index + 1) % messages.len();
                    p.afk_index
                })
            };
            game.send_chat(messages[i]);
            ps(|p| p.afk_message = m.n("Delay (seconds)") as i32 * 20);
        }
    }
}

// ---- Spam

fn spam(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if game.remote.is_none() {
        toggle_off(game, "Spam");
        return;
    }
    if ps(|p| {
        if p.spam_timer > 0 {
            p.spam_timer -= 1;
            true
        } else {
            false
        }
    }) {
        return;
    }
    let messages: Vec<&str> = m.t("Messages").split('|').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
    if messages.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let i = if m.b("Randomise") {
        rand(messages.len())
    } else {
        ps(|p| {
            let i = p.spam_index % messages.len();
            p.spam_index = i + 1;
            i
        })
    };
    let mut text = messages[i].to_owned();
    if m.b("Bypass") {
        const LETTERS: &[u8] = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
        text.push(' ');
        for _ in 0..m.n("Bypass length") as usize {
            text.push(LETTERS[rand(LETTERS.len())] as char);
        }
    }
    text.truncate(256);
    game.send_chat(&text);
    ps(|p| p.spam_timer = m.n("Delay (ticks)") as u32);
}

// ---- No Fall (Meteor's NoFall): Air place and Place, and Clutch's place under Packet and No ground. Those two change
// the move packets (runtime.rs's outgoing). This runs after the tick, once its move packet has gone, where Meteor uses
// the item.

// Place's choices: the item, and whether it is a bucket (used, and picked back up) or a block (placed).
const FALL_ITEMS: [(&str, &str, bool); 5] = [
    ("Bucket", "water_bucket", true),
    ("Powder snow", "powder_snow_bucket", true),
    ("Hay bale", "hay_block", false),
    ("Cobweb", "cobweb", false),
    ("Slime block", "slime_block", false),
];

fn no_fall(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    if game.creative || p.flying || (m.b("Pause on mace") && game.held().is_some_and(|s| short(&s.item) == "mace")) {
        return;
    }
    match m.p("Mode") {
        "Air place" => fall_air_place(game, m),
        "Place" => fall_place(game, m),
        _ if m.b("Clutch") => fall_place(game, m),
        _ => {}
    }
}

// Air place: a block under you once the fall would hurt (Before damage) or kill (Before death).
fn fall_air_place(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let fallen = p.fall_distance;
    let health = f64::from(p.health.health() + p.health.absorption());
    let due = if m.p("Air place mode") == "Before damage" { fallen > 2.0 } else { fallen > health.max(2.0) };
    if !due {
        return;
    }
    let Some(slot) = (0..9).find(|&i| super::sunset::item_info(game, i).is_some_and(|info| info.block.is_some())) else {
        return;
    };
    if m.b("Anchor") {
        center_player(game);
    }
    if let Some(at) = block_pos(game) {
        place_block(game, [at[0], at[1] - 1, at[2]], slot, m.b("Rotate"), true);
    }
}

// Place: water (or what Placed item says) where the fall will land, a moment before it does; once you have stood
// still for two ticks, the water or powder snow goes back in the bucket.
fn fall_place(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let (vy, fallen, still) = (p.velocity.y, p.fall_distance, p.fall_distance == 0.0 && p.ground.on_ground);
    if let Some((at, item, timer, stood, seen)) = ps(|s| s.fall_placed) {
        let stood = if still { (stood + 1).min(2) } else { 0 };
        let there = facts(game, at);
        let present = if item == "water_bucket" { there.fluid_level == 8 && there.name.ends_with("water") } else { there.name.ends_with("powder_snow") };
        // Gone once it was there (it was picked up, or flowed away), or never there in a second.
        let mut done = (seen && !present) || timer > 20;
        if stood >= 2 && present {
            if let (Some(slot), Some(eye)) = (find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "bucket"), game.eye_position()) {
                let (yaw, pitch) = look_at(eye, center_of(at));
                use_held(game, slot, yaw, pitch);
            }
            done = true;
        }
        ps(|s| s.fall_placed = (!done).then_some((at, item, timer + 1, stood, seen || present)));
        return;
    }
    if vy >= 0.0 || (fallen <= 3.0 && vy > -0.6) || p.fluids.was_touching_water {
        return;
    }
    let chosen = m.p("Placed item");
    // Water boils away in the Nether: powder snow instead.
    let chosen = if chosen == "Bucket" && game.dim.id() == "minecraft:the_nether" { "Powder snow" } else { chosen };
    let Some(&(_, item, bucket)) = FALL_ITEMS.iter().find(|i| i.0 == chosen) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(slot) = find_hotbar(game, |n| n == item) else {
        return;
    };
    if m.b("Anchor") {
        center_player(game);
    }
    let (Some((ground, point)), Some(eye)) = (landing(game), game.eye_position()) else {
        return;
    };
    // The use reaches as far as a click does (4.5 blocks); further up, it waits for a later tick.
    if dist(eye, point) > 4.5 {
        return;
    }
    let above = [ground[0], ground[1] + 1, ground[2]];
    if bucket {
        let (yaw, pitch) = look_at(eye, point);
        use_held(game, slot, yaw, pitch);
        ps(|s| s.fall_placed = Some((above, item, 0, 0, false)));
    } else {
        place_block(game, above, slot, m.b("Rotate"), true);
    }
}

// Uses the item in a hotbar slot looking at (yaw, pitch), as a right click into the air does, then holds what you
// held before.
fn use_held(game: &mut Game<'_>, slot: usize, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
    let before = game.selected;
    hold(game, slot);
    let seq = sequence(game);
    game.send(S::UseItem(play::UseItem { hand: 0, sequence: seq, yaw, pitch }));
    game.swing_arm();
    hold(game, before);
}

// Where the fall lands within the next 8 ticks (Meteor's findLandingSurface, straight down): the block it lands on and
// the point on its top below you; nothing if it lands in water or later.
fn landing(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<([i32; 3], [f64; 3])> {
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let (x, z) = (p.position.x, p.position.z);
    let (bx, bz) = (x.floor() as i32, z.floor() as i32);
    let feet = p.position.y.floor() as i32;
    let below = (0..64).map(|d| feet - 1 - d).find(|&y| !is_air(game, [bx, y, bz]))?;
    let ground = [bx, below, bz];
    if facts(game, ground).fluid_level > 0 || !facts(game, ground).full_collision {
        return None;
    }
    let top = f64::from(below + 1);
    let (mut y, mut vy) = (p.position.y, p.velocity.y);
    for _ in 0..8 {
        y += vy;
        vy = (vy - 0.08) * 0.98;
        if y <= top {
            return Some((ground, [x, top, z]));
        }
    }
    None
}

// ---- Speed Mine (Meteor's SpeedMine), before the tick, where the game goes on breaking the block

pub(super) fn speed_mine(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) {
    use super::remote::sunset_remote as remote;
    // Haste mode's own Haste, taken off when it is no longer wanted.
    let haste = m.filter(|m| m.p("Mode") == "Haste").map(|m| m.n("Haste amplifier") as i32 - 1);
    let ours = game.potions.effects.get("haste").is_some_and(|e| !e.visible);
    match haste {
        Some(amplifier) if game.potions.effects.get("haste").is_none_or(|e| e.amplifier < amplifier) => {
            let mut effect = horizon_client::effects::EffectInstance::new("haste", -1, amplifier);
            effect.visible = false;
            game.potions.effects.add(effect);
        }
        None if ours => {
            game.potions.effects.list.retain(|e| e.id != "haste" || e.visible);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    let (Some(m), Some((pos, done))) = (m, remote::breaking(game)) else {
        return;
    };
    let name = &game.res.facts().get(game.world.block(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2])).name;
    if listed(m.t("Blocks"), name) != (m.p("Blocks filter") == "Whitelist") {
        return;
    }
    let step = game.destroy_progress(pos);
    match m.p("Mode") {
        // The server takes the stop once its count reaches 0.7 (counting the tick the break began in): be done then.
        "Damage" if (done > 0.0 && done + step >= 0.7) || (done == 0.0 && step > 0.5 && m.b("Instamine")) => {
            remote::set_breaking(game, 1.0);
        }
        // Modifier times the game's own step (the game adds one step itself).
        "Normal" if done > 0.0 => remote::set_breaking(game, done + step * (m.n("Modifier") as f32 - 1.0)),
        _ => {}
    }
}

// ---- No Break Reset, before the tick, where the game would see the new item and start the break again

pub(super) fn no_break_reset(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) {
    use super::remote::sunset_remote as remote;
    let (Some(m), Some((pos, _))) = (m, remote::breaking(game)) else {
        return;
    };
    let step = game.destroy_progress(pos);
    if remote::breaking_item_changed(game) && (!m.b("Only to better tools") || step >= ps(|p| p.break_step)) {
        remote::keep_breaking(game);
    }
    ps(|p| p.break_step = step);
}
```

`mixins/sunset/prediction.rs`:

```rs
// Where enemy players will be when a hit lands (their movement, stepped through Horizon's collisions), and which of
// them can be hurt yet: the server's hurt time after each hit, as observed.
use super::sunset_explosive_damage::{self as damage, Blast};
use super::sunset_explosive_policy::Budget;
use super::sunset_hurt_policy as hurt;
use super::sunset_lead_policy as lead;
use super::sunset_prediction_native::{NativeKernel, StrictChunks};
use super::sunset_util::{self as util, Target};
use super::{Dim, Game};
use horizon_client::collisions::{EntityCollisions, PowderSnowSubject, SceneCollisions};
use horizon_core::geometry::Vec3;
use horizon_protocol::{
    entity_data::Value,
    packets::play::{Clientbound as C, Serverbound as S},
};
use horizon_world::{
    collision_context::{CollisionContext, CollisionEntity, CollisionItem},
    entity_obstruction::EntityIdentity,
};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
type Session = Arc<Mutex<Option<Arc<horizon_protocol::connection::Counters>>>>;
struct Scene {
    session: Session,
    dim: Dim,
    id: i32,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Pending {
    source: hurt::ShotSource,
    victim: u32,
    raw: f32,
    tick: u64,
    lead: u32,
}
struct Hands {
    id: u32,
    stacks: [Option<horizon_client::items::ItemStack>; 2],
    using: Option<(usize, u64)>,
}
struct State {
    scene: Option<Scene>,
    generation: u64,
    tick: u64,
    steps: u32,
    tracks: lead::Tracks,
    cache: Vec<(u32, u32, Target)>,
    absorption: Vec<(u32, f32)>,
    clock: hurt::Clock,
    receipts: hurt::ReceiptTiming,
    pending: Vec<Pending>,
    hands: Vec<Hands>,
}
impl Default for State {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            scene: None,
            generation: 0,
            tick: 0,
            steps: 512,
            tracks: lead::Tracks::default(),
            cache: Vec::new(),
            absorption: Vec::new(),
            clock: hurt::Clock::new(),
            receipts: hurt::ReceiptTiming::new(),
            pending: Vec::new(),
            hands: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}
static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);
fn state<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut State) -> R) -> R {
    let mut guard = STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(guard.get_or_insert_with(State::default))
}
fn same(game: &Game<'_>, scene: &Scene) -> bool {
    scene.dim == game.dim
        && game
            .remote
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == scene.id && Arc::ptr_eq(&r.session.counters, &scene.session))
}
pub(super) fn reset() {
    state(|s| {
        let generation = s.generation.wrapping_add(1);
        *s = State { generation, ..State::default() };
    });
}
pub(super) fn tick(game: &Game<'_>) {
    state(|s| {
        let changed = s.scene.as_ref().is_none_or(|scene| !same(game, scene));
        if changed {
            let generation = s.generation.wrapping_add(1);
            *s = State {
                generation,
                scene: game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| Scene {
                    session: r.session.counters.clone(),
                    dim: game.dim,
                    id: r.entity_id,
                }),
                ..State::default()
            };
        }
        if changed || s.tick != game.ticks {
            s.tick = game.ticks;
            s.steps = 512;
            s.cache.clear();
            s.clock
                .tick(s.generation, game.ticks, |id| game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.id == id && m.alive() && !m.removed));
        }
        s.pending.retain(|p| p.tick == game.ticks);
    });
}
pub(super) fn reset_receipts() {
    state(|s| s.receipts.reset());
}
pub(super) fn rtt(game: &Game<'_>) -> u32 {
    state(|s| s.receipts.rtt_ticks(super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::latency(game).unwrap_or(0)))
}
pub(super) fn effective_health(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Target) -> Option<f64> {
    let extra = state(|s| {
        s.scene
            .as_ref()
            .filter(|scene| same(game, scene))
            .and_then(|_| s.absorption.iter().find(|p| p.0 == target.id).map(|p| p.1))
    })?;
    let hp = f64::from(target.health + extra);
    (hp.is_finite() && hp > 0.0).then_some(hp)
}
// Some(None) means no use was observed. None means an active hand's complete
// equipment has not arrived; that cannot establish a shield damage reduction.
pub(super) fn blocking_hand(id: u32, tick: u64) -> Option<Option<(horizon_client::items::ItemStack, u64)>> {
    state(|s| {
        let hand = s.hands.iter().find(|h| h.id == id)?;
        let Some((slot, since)) = hand.using else {
            return Some(None);
        };
        Some(Some((hand.stacks[slot].clone()?, tick.checked_sub(since)?)))
    })
}
fn vec(value: [f64; 3]) -> Vec3 {
    Vec3::new(value[0], value[1], value[2])
}
fn context<'a>(game: &'a Game<'_>, target: &Target) -> Option<CollisionContext<'a>> {
    let mob = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target.id && !m.removed)?;
    let held =
        mob.extra.main_hand.as_deref().map(|item| CollisionItem { item, count: 1 }).unwrap_or(CollisionItem::EMPTY);
    Some(CollisionContext::for_entity(
        CollisionEntity {
            identity: EntityIdentity(u64::from(target.id)),
            y: mob.position.y,
            descending: mob.extra.crouching,
            main_hand: Some(held),
        },
        false,
    ))
}
fn subject(game: &Game<'_>, id: u32) -> Option<PowderSnowSubject> {
    let mob = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id)?;
    Some(PowderSnowSubject {
        fall_distance: mob.fall_distance,
        leather_boots: mob.extra.feet.as_deref() == Some("minecraft:leather_boots"),
        ..Default::default()
    })
}
pub(super) fn target(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Target, ahead: u32) -> Option<Target> {
    if let Some(cached) = state(|s| s.cache.iter().find(|p| p.0 == target.id && p.1 == ahead).map(|p| p.2.clone())) {
        return Some(cached);
    }
    let observed = super::remote::sunset_prediction_remote::motion(game, target.id)?;
    let motion = state(|s| s.tracks.observe(target.id, game.ticks, observed.server, observed.update_interval).ok())?;
    let snapshot = lead::Snapshot {
        rendered_feet: observed.rendered,
        server_feet: observed.server,
        rendered_box: observed.bounds,
        motion,
        floating: observed.floating,
    };
    let blocks = SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: subject(game, target.id) };
    let mut world = StrictChunks(EntityCollisions::with_border(
        blocks,
        game.border.geometry(),
        [observed.rendered.x, observed.rendered.z],
    ));
    let mut kernel = NativeKernel {
        world: &mut world,
        identity: EntityIdentity(u64::from(target.id)),
        context: context(game, target)?,
        cell_budget_per_step: 512,
    };
    let projected = state(|s| lead::project(snapshot, ahead, &mut s.steps, &mut kernel).ok())?;
    let mut out = target.clone();
    out.pos = projected.feet.components();
    out.lo = projected.bounds.min_position().components();
    out.hi = projected.bounds.max_position().components();
    state(|s| {
        if s.cache.len() < 96 {
            s.cache.push((out.id, ahead, out.clone()));
        }
    });
    Some(out)
}
pub(super) fn local_offset(game: &Game<'_>, ahead: u32) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let local = super::remote::sunset_prediction_remote::local_motion(game)?;
    let player = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let held = game
        .inventory
        .get(game.selected)
        .and_then(Option::as_ref)
        .map(|s| CollisionItem { item: &s.item, count: s.count as i32 })
        .unwrap_or(CollisionItem::EMPTY);
    let blocks =
        SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: Some(player.powder_snow_subject()) };
    let mut world = StrictChunks(EntityCollisions::with_border(
        blocks,
        game.border.geometry(),
        [player.position.x, player.position.z],
    ));
    let mut kernel = NativeKernel {
        world: &mut world,
        identity: EntityIdentity(0),
        context: CollisionContext::for_entity(
            CollisionEntity {
                identity: EntityIdentity(0),
                y: player.position.y,
                descending: player.shift_key_down,
                main_hand: Some(held),
            },
            false,
        ),
        cell_budget_per_step: 512,
    };
    let snapshot = lead::Snapshot {
        rendered_feet: local.feet,
        server_feet: local.feet,
        rendered_box: local.bounds,
        motion: lead::Motion { velocity: local.previous.vector_to(local.feet), extra_ticks: 0 },
        floating: local.floating,
    };
    state(|s| lead::project(snapshot, ahead, &mut s.steps, &mut kernel).ok()).map(|p| p.offset.components())
}
pub(super) fn face_facts(game: &Game<'_>, target: &Target) -> super::sunset_faceplace_policy::FaceFacts {
    use super::{sunset_durability_patch::Prototype, sunset_faceplace_native as native};
    let armor = game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == target.id).map_or([None; 4], |mob| {
        std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            let stack = mob.extra.armor[i].as_ref()?;
            let info = game.items().get(&stack.item)?;
            let name = stack.item.strip_prefix("minecraft:")?;
            if !["helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"].iter().any(|suffix| name.ends_with(suffix))
                && name != "elytra"
            {
                return None;
            }
            native::armor(
                stack,
                Prototype {
                    maximum: (info.max_damage > 0).then_some(info.max_damage),
                    damage_present: true,
                    unbreakable: false,
                },
            )
        })
    });
    super::sunset_faceplace_policy::FaceFacts {
        effective_health: effective_health(game, target),
        armor,
        neighbor_resistance: native::horizontal_resistance(&game.world, game.res.facts(), vec(target.pos)),
    }
}
pub(super) fn estimate(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    victim: &Target,
    blast: Blast,
    ahead: u32,
    lead: u32,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<(f64, f32)> {
    let sample = damage::target_hurt_raw_at(game, victim, blast, budget)?;
    let assessed = state(|s| s.clock.assess(victim.id, sample.raw_before_armor(), ahead, lead));
    Some((damage::reduce_target_hurt_raw(game, victim, sample, assessed.raw_for_reduction)?, sample.raw_before_armor()))
}
// Both temporal assessments reuse one native exposure/shield/difficulty sample.
pub(super) fn estimate_pair(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    victim: &Target,
    blast: Blast,
    ahead: u32,
    opening: u32,
    lead: u32,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> Option<([f64; 3], f32)> {
    let sample = damage::target_hurt_raw_at(game, victim, blast, budget)?;
    let raw = sample.raw_before_armor();
    let assessments =
        state(|s| [s.clock.assess(victim.id, raw, ahead, lead), s.clock.assess(victim.id, raw, opening, lead)]);
    Some((
        [
            damage::reduce_target_hurt_raw(game, victim, sample, assessments[0].raw_for_reduction)?,
            damage::reduce_target_hurt_raw(game, victim, sample, assessments[1].raw_for_reduction)?,
            damage::reduce_target_hurt_raw(game, victim, sample, raw)?,
        ],
        raw,
    ))
}
pub(super) fn held_totem(id: u32) -> bool {
    state(|s| {
        s.hands.iter().find(|h| h.id == id).is_some_and(|h| {
            h.stacks.iter().flatten().any(|stack| stack.count > 0 && util::short(&stack.item) == "totem_of_undying")
        })
    })
}
pub(super) fn opens_in(victim: u32, lead: u32) -> u32 {
    state(|s| s.clock.opens_in(victim, lead))
}
pub(super) fn arm_blast(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    source: hurt::ShotSource,
    blast: Blast,
    targets: &[Target],
    selected: u32,
    horizon: u32,
    budget: &mut Budget,
) -> bool {
    let mut selected_ready = false;
    let mut samples = Vec::with_capacity(4);
    for victim in targets.iter().take(4) {
        let Some(projected) = target(game, victim, horizon) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some((_, raw)) = estimate(game, &projected, blast, 0, rtt(game), budget) else {
            continue;
        };
        samples.push((victim.id, raw));
        selected_ready |= victim.id == selected;
    }
    if !selected_ready {
        return false;
    }
    for (id, raw) in samples {
        arm(game, source, id, raw, rtt(game));
    }
    true
}
pub(super) fn arm(game: &Game<'_>, source: hurt::ShotSource, victim: u32, raw: f32, lead: u32) {
    state(|s| {
        if s.pending.len() < 8 {
            s.pending.push(Pending { source, victim, raw, tick: game.ticks, lead });
        }
    });
}
pub(super) fn forwarded(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) {
    state(|s| {
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < s.pending.len() {
            let pending = s.pending[i];
            let matches = match (pending.source, packet) {
                (hurt::ShotSource::Crystal(id), S::Attack(p)) => p.id == id as i32,
                (hurt::ShotSource::Anchor(center), S::UseItemOn(p)) => p.pos.map(|n| f64::from(n) + 0.5) == center,
                _ => false,
            };
            if matches && pending.tick == game.ticks {
                s.clock.sent(pending.victim, pending.raw, pending.source, pending.lead);
                s.pending.swap_remove(i);
            } else {
                i += 1;
            }
        }
        if let S::UseItemOn(p) = packet
            && matches!(&*util::facts(game, p.pos).name, "minecraft:obsidian" | "minecraft:bedrock")
            && game
                .stack_in(if p.hand == 1 { util::OFFHAND } else { game.selected })
                .is_some_and(|stack| &*stack.item == "minecraft:end_crystal")
        {
            s.receipts.placed(p.pos, game.ticks);
        }
    });
}
pub(super) fn packet(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &C) {
    if matches!(packet, C::Login(_) | C::Respawn(_) | C::Disconnect(_)) {
        reset();
        return;
    }
    tick(game);
    // Incoming packets are observed before native application. Drop all cached
    // copied actor facts so a deferred deed samples the updated native state.
    // Keep the shared collision budget: invalidation must not replenish it.
    state(|s| s.cache.clear());
    if let Some(notice) = super::remote::sunset_hurt_remote::damage_notice(game, packet, |id| {
        game.mobs.iter().find(|m| m.id == id).is_some_and(|m| util::player_enemy(game, m))
    }) && let Some(id) = game.remote.as_ref().and_then(|r| u32::try_from(r.entity_id).ok())
    {
        state(|s| s.clock.damaged(id, notice));
    }
    if let Some(ids) = super::remote::sunset_hurt_remote::removed_ids(packet) {
        state(|s| {
            s.clock.removed(&ids);
            for id in &ids {
                s.tracks.forget(*id);
            }
            s.absorption.retain(|p| !ids.contains(&p.0));
            s.cache.retain(|p| !ids.contains(&p.0));
            s.hands.retain(|p| !ids.contains(&p.id));
        });
    }
    if let Some((id, equipment)) = super::remote::sunset_prediction_remote::equipment(game, packet) {
        state(|s| {
            if let Some(hand) = s.hands.iter_mut().find(|h| h.id == id) {
                for (slot, stack) in equipment {
                    if hand.stacks[slot] != stack {
                        hand.stacks[slot] = stack;
                        if hand.using.is_some_and(|(active, _)| active == slot) {
                            hand.using = Some((slot, game.ticks));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
    if let Some(base) = super::remote::sunset_hurt_remote::spawned_base(game, packet) {
        state(|s| {
            s.receipts.spawned(base, game.ticks);
        });
    }
    match packet {
        C::AddEntity(p) if p.id >= 0 && super::remote::sunset_prediction_remote::is_player(game, p.kind) => {
            state(|s| {
                let id = p.id as u32;
                s.tracks.forget(id);
                s.absorption.retain(|p| p.0 != id);
                if s.absorption.len() < 512 {
                    s.absorption.push((id, 0.0));
                }
                s.hands.retain(|h| h.id != id);
                if s.hands.len() < 512 {
                    s.hands.push(Hands { id, stacks: [None, None], using: None });
                }
            })
        }
        C::SetEntityData(p) if p.id >= 0 => state(|s| {
            if let Some(extra) = s.absorption.iter_mut().find(|pair| pair.0 == p.id as u32) {
                for (index, _, value) in &p.values {
                    if let (17, Value::Float(amount)) = (index, value) {
                        extra.1 = if amount.is_finite() && *amount >= 0.0 { *amount } else { f32::NAN };
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(hand) = s.hands.iter_mut().find(|h| h.id == p.id as u32) {
                for (index, _, value) in &p.values {
                    if let (8, Value::Byte(flags)) = (index, value) {
                        let slot = usize::from(flags & 2 != 0);
                        if flags & 1 == 0 {
                            hand.using = None;
                        } else if !hand.using.is_some_and(|(active, _)| active == slot) {
                            hand.using = Some((slot, game.ticks));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }),
        _ => {}
    }
}
```

```rs
// The collision checks prediction.rs steps a player's movement through.
use super::sunset_lead_policy::{CollisionKernel, Error};
use horizon_core::{
    geometry::{Aabb, Vec3, VoxelShape},
    position::{BlockPos, ChunkPos},
};
use horizon_world::{
    block_collision_scan::{BlockCollisionWorld, CollisionBlock},
    collision_context::CollisionContext,
    entity_obstruction::EntityIdentity,
    world_movement::{EntityMovementWorld, MovementRequest, resolve_world_movement},
};
use std::io;

/// Native scans normally skip unavailable chunks. Forecasts must fail instead.
/// The wrapped SceneCollisions retains native contextual block shapes.
pub struct StrictChunks<W>(pub W);
impl<W: BlockCollisionWorld<Error = io::Error>> BlockCollisionWorld for StrictChunks<W> {
    type Error = io::Error;
    type Chunk = W::Chunk;
    fn collision_chunk(&mut self, p: ChunkPos) -> io::Result<Option<W::Chunk>> {
        self.0
            .collision_chunk(p)?
            .map(Some)
            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, "forecast collision chunk unavailable"))
    }
    fn collision_block(&mut self, c: W::Chunk, p: BlockPos) -> io::Result<CollisionBlock> {
        self.0.collision_block(c, p)
    }
    fn is_suffocating(&mut self, c: W::Chunk, b: CollisionBlock, p: BlockPos) -> io::Result<bool> {
        self.0.is_suffocating(c, b, p)
    }
    fn may_reach_out(&mut self, c: W::Chunk, y: i32) -> io::Result<bool> {
        self.0.may_reach_out(c, y)
    }
    fn context_shape(&mut self, b: CollisionBlock, p: BlockPos, c: &CollisionContext<'_>) -> io::Result<VoxelShape> {
        self.0.context_shape(b, p, c)
    }
}
impl<W: EntityMovementWorld<Error = io::Error>> EntityMovementWorld for StrictChunks<W> {
    type Error = io::Error;
    // Reference static forecast supplies no extra entity collision shapes.
    fn entity_collisions(&mut self, _: EntityIdentity, _: Aabb) -> io::Result<Vec<VoxelShape>> {
        Ok(Vec::new())
    }
    fn movement_border(&mut self, id: EntityIdentity, b: Aabb) -> io::Result<Option<VoxelShape>> {
        self.0.movement_border(id, b)
    }
}
pub struct NativeKernel<'a, W> {
    pub world: &'a mut StrictChunks<W>,
    pub identity: EntityIdentity,
    /// Capture from the real entity, including descending/mainhand. Do not substitute
    /// a placement context or change held-item facts to the planned attack hand.
    pub context: CollisionContext<'a>,
    pub cell_budget_per_step: usize,
}
impl<W> CollisionKernel for NativeKernel<'_, W>
where
    W: BlockCollisionWorld<Error = io::Error> + EntityMovementWorld<Error = io::Error>,
{
    fn clip(&mut self, bounds: Aabb, attempted: Vec3) -> Result<Vec3, Error> {
        resolve_world_movement(
            self.world,
            MovementRequest {
                entity: self.identity,
                context: self.context,
                bounds,
                movement: attempted,
                max_step: 0.0,
                on_ground: false,
                candidate_budget: self.cell_budget_per_step.min(1024),
            },
        )
        .map_err(|_| Error::Collision)
    }
}
```
