            mc_back: None,
            nuke: None,
            nuke_skip: Vec::new(),
            nuke_timer: 0,
            nuke_first: true,
            nuke_last: None,
            nuke_idle: 0,
            nuke_interacted: Vec::new(),
            nuke_box: None,
            nuke_broken: Vec::new(),
            armor_wait: 0,
            replenish_wait: 0,
            last_pos: Vec::new(),
            spots: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
    // The friends list, kept in ClickGUI's Friends setting too (where the menu's picker edits it).
    pub(super) fn set_friends(&mut self, list: Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(i) = self.find("ClickGUI")
            && let Some(set) = self.modules[i].settings.iter_mut().find(|s| s.name == "Friends")
        {
            set.value = Value::Text(list.join(","));
        }
        self.friends = list;
    }
    // A player in or out of the friends list; whether they are a friend now.
    pub(super) fn flip_friend(&mut self, name: &str) -> bool {
        let mut list = self.friends.clone();
        let was = list.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name));
        list.retain(|f| !f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name));
        if !was {
            list.push(name.to_owned());
        }
        self.set_friends(list);
        !was
    }
    // A module by its name, or by a name it had before (`.t autosteal` is Chest Stealer).
    pub(super) fn find(&self, name: &str) -> Option<usize> {
        let n = norm(name);
        let n = RENAMED.iter().find(|(from, _)| *from == n).map_or(n.as_str(), |(_, to)| to);
        self.modules.iter().position(|m| norm(m.name) == n)
    }
    fn save_text(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = self.module_text();
        out.push_str(&format!("profile-selection={}\n", self.selection.stored()));
        out.push_str(&format!("friends={}\n", self.friends.join(",")));
        for w in &self.waypoints {
            out.push_str(&format!("waypoint={}|{}|{}|{}|{}\n", w.name, w.pos[0], w.pos[1], w.pos[2], w.dim));
        }
        for (c, p) in CATEGORIES.iter().zip(&self.gui.panels) {
            out.push_str(&format!("panel.{}={},{},{}\n", norm(c.label()), p.x, p.y, p.collapsed));
        }
        out
    }
    fn module_text(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = String::new();
        for (i, m) in self.modules.iter().enumerate() {
            let id = norm(m.name);
            out.push_str(&format!("{id}.on={}\n", self.inputs.saved_on(i, m.on)));
            out.push_str(&format!("{id}.key={}\n", m.key.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")));
            for s in &m.settings {
                out.push_str(&format!("{id}.{}={}\n", norm(s.name), s.stored()));
            }
        }
        out
    }
    fn load_text(&mut self, text: &str) {
        self.waypoints.clear();
        self.loadouts.clear();
        self.selection = super::sunset_profiles::Selection::default();
        for line in merged_modules(text).lines() {
            let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once('=') else {
                continue;
            };
            let v = v.trim();
            if k == "profile-selection" {
                self.selection.restore(v);
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(cat) = k.strip_prefix("panel.") {
                // The Client panel was Extras before 0.9.
                let cat = if cat == "extras" { "client" } else { cat };
                let parts: Vec<&str> = v.split(',').collect();
                if let (Some(i), [x, y, c]) = (CATEGORIES.iter().position(|c| norm(c.label()) == cat), parts.as_slice())
                    && let (Ok(x), Ok(y)) = (x.parse(), y.parse())
                {
                    self.gui.panels[i] = Panel { x, y, collapsed: *c == "true", scroll: 0.0 };
                }
                continue;
            }
            if k == "loadout" {
                self.loadouts.push(v.to_owned());
                continue;
            }
            if k == "waypoint" {
                let f: Vec<&str> = v.split('|').collect();
                if let [name, x, y, z, dim] = f.as_slice()
                    && let (Ok(x), Ok(y), Ok(z)) = (x.parse(), y.parse(), z.parse())
                {
                    self.waypoints.push(Waypoint { name: (*name).to_owned(), pos: [x, y, z], dim: (*dim).to_owned() });
                }
                continue;
            }
            if k == "friends" {
                let list = v.split(',').map(str::trim).filter(|f| !f.is_empty()).map(str::to_owned).collect();
                self.set_friends(list);
                continue;
            }
            Self::set_field(&mut self.modules, k, v);
        }
        let snapshot = self.module_text();
        self.selection.refresh(&snapshot);
    }
    // One "module.field=value" line of a config or a profile, on `modules`.
    fn set_field(modules: &mut [Module], k: &str, v: &str) {
        let Some((id, field)) = k.split_once('.') else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(m) = modules.iter_mut().find(|m| norm(m.name) == id) else {
            return;
        };
        match field {
            "on" => m.on = v == "true",
            "key" => m.key = key_from_text(v),
            _ => {
                // Settings from the earlier local movement build used different names and percentage units.
                let migrated = match (id, field) {
                    ("speed", "speed") => Some(("vanillaspeed", v.to_owned())),
                    ("speed", "mode") if norm(v) == "ground" => Some(("mode", "Vanilla".to_owned())),
                    ("velocity", "horizontal") => v.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|n| n.is_finite())
                        .map(|n| ("knockbackhorizontal", (n / 100.0).to_string())),
                    ("velocity", "vertical") => v.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|n| n.is_finite())
                        .map(|n| ("knockbackvertical", (n / 100.0).to_string())),
                    ("velocity", "airhorizontal") => v.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|n| n.is_finite())
                        .map(|n| ("airknockbackhorizontal", (n / 100.0).to_string())),
                    ("velocity", "airvertical") => v.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|n| n.is_finite())
                        .map(|n| ("airknockbackvertical", (n / 100.0).to_string())),
                    ("scaffold", "rotation") => Some(("rotate", (norm(v) != "none").to_string())),
                    ("scaffold", "maxdistance") => Some(("maxplacementdistance", v.to_owned())),
                    // Kill Aura before its Attack timing, and when Switch delay was its only one.
                    ("killaura", "customdelay") => Some(("attacktiming", if v == "true" { "Custom delay" } else { "Vanilla cooldown" }.to_owned())),
                    ("killaura", "switchdelay") => Some(("weaponswitchdelay", v.to_owned())),
                    // Range was 64 by default before All (0): an unchanged one becomes All.
                    ("esp" | "tracers" | "nametags", "range") if v == "64" => Some(("range", "0".to_owned())),
                    // Offhand before vape-rs's Auto Totem: Refill Inventory opened the inventory for the totem; Off and
                    // Hotbar Swap moved it with no screen.
                    ("offhand", "refill") => Some(("silentopen", (v != "Inventory").to_string())),
                    // Base Finder's one list before its tiers: a list of your own becomes List 7.
                    ("basefinder", "blocks") if v != OLD_BASE_BLOCKS => Some(("list7", v.to_owned())),
                    ("basefinder", "threshold") => Some(("list7count", v.to_owned())),
                    _ => None,
                };
                // ...its Swap delay (ticks) is the Totem delay, and Item None (a totem only at Health or below) a totem
                // always: Health is gone, and Item comes before it in a saved config.
                if id == "offhand" && field == "swapdelay" && let Ok(ticks) = v.parse::<f64>() {
                    let ms = (ticks * 50.0).clamp(50.0, 200.0).to_string();
                    for target in ["shortesttotemdelayms", "longesttotemdelayms"] {
                        if let Some(s) = m.settings.iter_mut().find(|s| norm(s.name) == target) { s.parse(&ms); }
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if id == "offhand" && field == "health" && m.p("Item") == "None"
                    && let Some(s) = m.settings.iter_mut().find(|s| s.name == "Item")
                {
                    s.parse("Totem");
                }
                // Before Attack mode, more than one target meant hitting them all. A newer config's own Attack mode
                // comes after this line and has the last word.
                if id == "killaura" && field == "maxtargets" && v.parse::<f64>().is_ok_and(|n| n > 1.0)
                    && let Some(s) = m.settings.iter_mut().find(|s| norm(s.name) == "attackmode")
                {
                    s.parse("Multi");
                }
                if let Some((target, value)) = migrated {
                    if let Some(s) = m.settings.iter_mut().find(|s| norm(s.name) == target) { s.parse(&value); }
                    return;
                }
                // No Render's switches were called "Fog", "Water fog" and so on before 0.8.1.
                let legacy = format!("hide{field}");
                if let Some(s) = m.settings.iter_mut().find(|s| norm(s.name) == field || (id == "norender" && norm(s.name) == legacy)) {
                    s.parse(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // The modules' states, settings and keys: a profile.
    fn profile_text(&self) -> String {
        self.module_text().trim_end().to_owned()
    }
    // The profile in use is `name`, as the modules are now.
    fn select(&mut self, name: &str) {
        let snapshot = self.module_text();
        self.selection.choose(name, &snapshot);
    }
    // Migration for configs saved before selection metadata existed. Only a
    // unique, valid match may claim a name; a partial profile compares its fields.
    fn matches_profile(&self, body: &str) -> bool {
        !body.trim().is_empty() && merged_modules(body).lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).all(|line| {
            let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') else {
                return false;
            };
            let Some((id, field)) = key.split_once('.') else {
                return false;
            };
            let Some((i, module)) = self.modules.iter().enumerate().find(|(_, m)| norm(m.name) == id) else {
                return false;
            };
            match field {
                "on" => self.inputs.saved_on(i, module.on) == (value.trim() == "true"),
                "key" => module.key == key_from_text(value.trim()),
                _ => module.settings.iter().find(|s| norm(s.name) == field).is_some_and(|s| {
                    let mut parsed = s.clone();
                    parsed.parse(value.trim()) && parsed.stored() == s.stored()
                }),
            }
        })
    }
    fn load_profile(&mut self, text: &str) {
        for line in merged_modules(text).lines() {
            if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once('=') {
                Self::set_field(&mut self.modules, k, v.trim());
            }
        }
    }
    // A preset's lines as it is taken: every module it neither turns on nor leaves alone goes off first.
    fn preset_text(&self, preset: &super::sunset_presets::Preset) -> Result<String, String> {
        let body = self.check_profile(preset.text)?;
        let mut out = String::new();
        for m in self.modules.iter().filter(|m| m.on && !super::sunset_presets::untouched(m)) {
            out.push_str(&format!("{}.on=false\n", norm(m.name)));
        }
        out.push_str(body);
        Ok(out)
    }
    // What taking a preset does: the modules it turns on, those it turns off, and how many settings it changes.
    pub(super) fn preview(&self, preset: &super::sunset_presets::Preset) -> Result<Preview, String> {
        let text = self.preset_text(preset)?;
        let mut after = self.modules.clone();
        for line in merged_modules(&text).lines() {
            if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once('=') {
                Self::set_field(&mut after, k, v.trim());
            }
        }
        let mut preview = Preview::default();
        for (was, now) in self.modules.iter().zip(&after) {
            match (was.on, now.on) {
                (false, true) => preview.on.push(now.name),
                (true, false) => preview.off.push(now.name),
                _ => {}
            }
            preview.settings += was.settings.iter().zip(&now.settings).filter(|(a, b)| a.stored() != b.stored()).count();
        }
        Ok(preview)
    }
    // A profile file read whole before anything changes: its header, then lines this version knows, with values that
    // fit them. The lines, without the header.
    fn check_profile<'a>(&self, text: &'a str) -> Result<&'a str, String> {
        let body = text.strip_prefix(super::sunset_profiles::HEADER).and_then(|t| t.strip_prefix('\n')).ok_or("not a Sunset profile")?;
        for (n, line) in merged_modules(body).lines().enumerate().filter(|(_, l)| !l.trim().is_empty()) {
            let bad = |what: &str| format!("line {}: {what}", n + 2);
            let (k, v) = line.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| bad("no ="))?;
            let (id, field) = k.split_once('.').ok_or_else(|| bad("no module"))?;
            let m = self.modules.iter().find(|m| norm(m.name) == id).ok_or_else(|| bad(&format!("no module called {id}")))?;
            let fits = match field {
                "on" => matches!(v.trim(), "true" | "false"),
                "key" => !v.chars().any(char::is_control),
                _ => (id == "offhand" && OFFHAND_RETIRED.contains(&field))
                    || m.settings.iter().find(|s| norm(s.name) == field).is_some_and(|s| s.clone().parse(v)),
            };
            if !fits {
                return Err(bad(&format!("{k} can't be {}", v.chars().take(40).collect::<String>())));
            }
        }
        Ok(body)
    }
    pub(super) fn module(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&Module> {
        self.modules.iter().find(|m| m.name == name)
    }
    // The menus' modules: all but the extras Extra Modules leaves out.
    pub(super) fn listed(&self) -> impl Fn(&Module) -> bool + use<> {
        let hidden = super::sunset_extra_modules::hidden(&self.modules);
        move |m| !hidden.contains(&m.name)
    }
    pub(super) fn is_on(&self, name: &str) -> bool {
        self.module(name).is_some_and(|m| m.on)
    }
}

// What a preset turns on and off, and the number of settings it changes.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub(super) struct Preview {
    pub(super) on: Vec<&'static str>,
    pub(super) off: Vec<&'static str>,
    pub(super) settings: usize,
}

// Offhand's settings from before vape-rs's Auto Totem (0.9): set_field turns Health, Refill and Swap delay into the new
// ones, and the rest are gone.
const OFFHAND_RETIRED: [&str; 10] =
    ["health", "elytra", "fall", "explosion", "refill", "reactiondelay", "swapdelay", "closedelay", "switchbackdelay", "doublehand"];

// Settings that are gone: Client Sort's orders, lists and pace (0.9, it works as ClientSort does). Their lines go.
const DROPPED: [(&str, &str); 8] = [
    ("clientsort", "order"), ("clientsort", "shiftorder"), ("clientsort", "ctrlorder"), ("clientsort", "altorder"),
    ("clientsort", "hotbar"), ("clientsort", "startitems"), ("clientsort", "enditems"), ("clientsort", "clickspertick"),
];

// Offhand took in Auto Totem, Auto Inventory Totem and Hover Totem, Fast Use took in FastXP, Velocity took in
// Knockback Delay, Kill Aura and Trigger Bot took in Auto Shield and Auto Weapon took in Shield Breaker, Mace and
// Spear Swap (0.9): a config or profile from before has their
// lines turned into the new module's. FastXP's are Throwables; Fast Use is on if either was (only for throwables, with
// an empty list, when Fast Use itself was off).
// Offhand is on if any of its three was, with the first key bound; the old Offhand's Item when it was on, else a totem
// always (Auto Totem Strict) or only when needed (None), else the new default; Refill is Auto Inventory Totem's Mode.
// Modules renamed since go by their new names first, and a config from before Extra Modules lists the extras it uses.
fn merged_modules(text: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    let renamed = renamed_modules(text);
    let owned = match merge_lines(&renamed) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out) => Some(out),
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => None,
    };
    listed_extras(owned.map_or(renamed, std::borrow::Cow::Owned))
}

// Modules with new names (0.9): Auto Steal is Chest Stealer, No Mining Trace is Mine Through Mobs.
const RENAMED: [(&str, &str); 2] = [("autosteal", "cheststealer"), ("nominingtrace", "minethroughmobs")];

fn renamed_modules(text: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    let old = |l: &str| RENAMED.iter().find(|(from, _)| l.split_once('.').is_some_and(|(id, _)| id == *from));
    if !text.lines().any(|l| old(l).is_some()) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text);
    }
    let lines: Vec<String> = text
        .lines()
        .map(|l| match old(l) {
            Some((from, to)) => format!("{to}{}", &l[from.len()..]),
            None => l.to_owned(),
        })
        .collect();
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lines.join("\n"))
}

// A config or profile with no Extra Modules lines (from before it) has the extras it turns on or binds listed.
fn listed_extras(text: std::borrow::Cow<'_, str>) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    if text.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with("extramodules.")) {
        return text;
    }
    let used: Vec<String> = super::sunset_extra_modules::EXTRAS
        .iter()
        .map(|name| norm(name))
        .filter(|extra| {
            let last = |field: &str| {
                text.lines().rev().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(&format!("{extra}.{field}=")).map(str::trim))
            };
            last("on") == Some("true") || last("key").is_some_and(|k| k != "none")
        })
        .collect();
    if used.is_empty() {
        return text;
    }
    let mut out = text.into_owned();
    for extra in used {
        out.push_str(&format!("\nextramodules.{extra}=true"));
    }
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out)
}

fn merge_lines(text: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    let lines: Vec<(&str, &str, &str)> = text
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|l| {
            let (k, v) = l.split_once('=')?;
            let (id, field) = k.split_once('.')?;
            Some((id, field, v.trim()))
        })
        .collect();
    let get = |id: &str, field: &str| lines.iter().rev().find(|l| l.0 == id && l.1 == field).map(|l| l.2);
    let had = |id: &str| lines.iter().any(|l| l.0 == id);
    let on = |id: &str| get(id, "on") == Some("true");
    // The old Offhand had Min health where the new one has Health.
    let old_offhand = get("offhand", "minhealth").is_some();
    let gone = [
        "autototem", "autoinventorytotem", "hovertotem", "fastxp", "knockbackdelay", "autoshield", "shieldbreaker", "mace",
        "spearswap", "crystalmacro", "anchormacro", "antianvil", "selfanvil", "autoanvil", "anchor", "reversestep",
        // Potion Saver (gone in 0.9) only held the timer you see; the server's ran down all the same.
        "potionsaver",
    ];
    let dropped = lines.iter().any(|&(id, field, _)| DROPPED.contains(&(id, field)));
    if !old_offhand && !dropped && !gone.iter().any(|id| had(id)) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text);
    }
    let mut out: Vec<String> = text
        .lines()
        .filter(|l| {
            let key = l.split_once('=').map_or("", |(k, _)| k);
            let (id, field) = key.split_once('.').unwrap_or((key, ""));
            !gone.contains(&id) && !(old_offhand && id == "offhand") && !DROPPED.contains(&(id, field))
        })
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .collect();
    // Knockback Delay is Velocity's Knockback delay: on alone, Velocity comes on with its own pushes left alone.
    if had("knockbackdelay") && get("velocity", "knockbackdelay").is_none() {
        let delay = on("knockbackdelay");
        out.push(format!("velocity.knockbackdelay={delay}"));
        if delay && !on("velocity") {
            out.push("velocity.on=true".into());
            for field in ["knockback", "explosions", "liquids", "entitypush", "sinking"] {
                out.push(format!("velocity.{field}=false"));
            }
        }
        if get("velocity", "key").is_none_or(|k| k == "none")
            && let Some(key) = get("knockbackdelay", "key")
        {
            out.push(format!("velocity.key={key}"));
        }
        for (old, new) in [
            ("chance", "delaychance"), ("airdelayminms", "airdelayminms"), ("airdelaymaxms", "airdelaymaxms"),
            ("grounddelayminms", "grounddelayminms"), ("grounddelaymaxms", "grounddelaymaxms"),
            ("notinwater", "delaynotinwater"), ("onlynearenemies", "delayonlynearenemies"),
        ] {
            if let Some(value) = get("knockbackdelay", old) {
                out.push(format!("velocity.{new}={value}"));
            }
        }
    }
    // Auto Shield is Kill Aura's and Trigger Bot's Shield: on in both if it was on, with its settings.
    if had("autoshield") {
        for id in ["killaura", "triggerbot"].into_iter().filter(|id| get(id, "shield").is_none()) {
            out.push(format!("{id}.shield={}", on("autoshield")));
            for field in ["onlywithaweapon", "onlynearatarget", "range", "reraisedelay"] {
                if let Some(v) = get("autoshield", field) {
                    out.push(format!("{id}.shield{field}={v}"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Shield Breaker, Mace and Spear Swap are Auto Weapon's sections (Best weapon the old Auto Weapon): Auto Weapon on
    // if any of the four was, then with only their sections on, and the first key bound; the shared Holding and slot
    // back from the first of them that was on.
    if ["shieldbreaker", "mace", "spearswap"].iter().any(|id| had(id)) {
        let old = ["autoweapon", "shieldbreaker", "mace", "spearswap"];
        let weapon = get("autoweapon", "bestweapon").is_none() && on("autoweapon");
        out.push(format!("autoweapon.on={}", old.iter().any(|id| on(id))));
        if let Some(key) = old.iter().filter_map(|id| get(id, "key")).find(|k| *k != "none") {
            out.push(format!("autoweapon.key={key}"));
        }
        if old.iter().any(|id| on(id)) {
            for (id, section) in [("autoweapon", "bestweapon"), ("shieldbreaker", "axeonshields"), ("mace", "mace"), ("spearswap", "spear")] {
                out.push(format!("autoweapon.{section}={}", if id == "autoweapon" { weapon } else { on(id) }));
            }
        }
        for (id, old_field, field) in [
            ("shieldbreaker", "mode", "shieldmode"), ("shieldbreaker", "shieldheld", "shieldheld"), ("shieldbreaker", "stunslam", "stunslam"),
            ("mace", "autoswap", "maceswap"), ("mace", "pick", "macepick"), ("mace", "breachswap", "breachswap"),
            ("mace", "smashassist", "smashassist"), ("mace", "smashtiming", "smashtiming"), ("mace", "minfall", "minfall"),
            ("mace", "mobs", "smashmobs"), ("spearswap", "lungekey", "lungekey"), ("spearswap", "reachpoke", "reachpoke"),
            ("spearswap", "spearreach", "spearreach"),
        ] {
            if let Some(v) = get(id, old_field) {
                out.push(format!("autoweapon.{field}={v}"));
            }
        }
        if let Some(first) = ["shieldbreaker", "mace", "spearswap"].into_iter().find(|id| on(id)) {
            let back = if first == "mace" { "swapback" } else { "switchback" };
            for (old_field, field) in [("holding", "holding"), (back, "swapback"), ("backafter", "backafter"), ("shortestdelay", "shortestdelay"), ("longestdelay", "longestdelay")] {
                if let Some(v) = get(first, old_field) {
                    out.push(format!("autoweapon.{field}={v}"));
                }
            }
        } else if weapon {
            // Auto Weapon alone switched from anything and stayed.
            out.push("autoweapon.holding=sword,axe,spear,mace,trident,empty,other".into());
            out.push("autoweapon.swapback=false".into());
        }
    }
    if had("fastxp") {
        let (fast, xp) = (on("fastuse"), on("fastxp"));
        out.push(format!("fastuse.on={}", fast || xp));
        if let Some(key) = ["fastuse", "fastxp"].iter().filter_map(|id| get(id, "key")).find(|k| *k != "none") {
            out.push(format!("fastuse.key={key}"));
        }
        if xp && !fast {
            out.push("fastuse.mode=Some".into());
            out.push("fastuse.listmode=Whitelist".into());
            out.push("fastuse.items=".into());
            out.push("fastuse.blocks=false".into());
        }
        out.push(format!("fastuse.throwables={xp}"));
        // FastXP's Delay 0 threw every 2 ticks; Throw delay counts the ticks from one throw to the next.
        if let Some(delay) = get("fastxp", "delay").and_then(|d| d.parse::<f64>().ok()) {
            out.push(format!("fastuse.throwdelay={}", delay + 2.0));
        }
        for field in ["experiencebottles", "enderpearls", "windcharges", "snowballsandeggs", "splashpotions", "offhand"] {
            if let Some(v) = get("fastxp", field) {
                out.push(format!("fastuse.{field}={v}"));
            }
        }
    }
    // Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura took in Crystal Macro and Anchor Macro as their Macro sections, Step took in Reverse
    // Step, and Anvil took in Anti Anvil, Self Anvil and Auto Anvil as sections; Anchor (Movement) is gone, its lines
    // with it. `id` took in `parts` (each old module with its section; Crystal Aura is its own Aura): it is on if any
    // was, with only those sections on. With none on, the sections keep their defaults, unless the one key bound was
    // another module's: that module's section alone then. The first key bound goes over; each `shared` setting is the
    // first module's that was on (else the first with one), and `fields` (old module, old setting, new setting) are
    // copied.
    {
        let mut merge = |id: &str, parts: &[(&str, &str)], shared: &[&str], fields: &[(&str, &str, &str)]| {
            if !parts.iter().any(|(old, _)| *old != id && had(old)) {
                return;
            }
            let any_on = parts.iter().any(|(old, _)| on(old));
            out.push(format!("{id}.on={any_on}"));
            let keyed: Vec<&str> =
                parts.iter().map(|(old, _)| *old).filter(|old| get(old, "key").is_some_and(|k| k != "none")).collect();
            if let Some(key) = keyed.first().and_then(|old| get(old, "key")) {
                out.push(format!("{id}.key={key}"));
            }
            let sections: Option<Vec<&str>> = if any_on {
                Some(parts.iter().map(|(old, _)| *old).filter(|old| on(old)).collect())
            } else if let [only] = keyed.as_slice()
                && *only != id
            {
                Some(vec![*only])
            } else {
                None
            };
            if let Some(sections) = sections {
                for (old, section) in parts {
                    out.push(format!("{id}.{section}={}", sections.contains(old)));
                }
            }
            for field in shared {
                let from = parts.iter().map(|(old, _)| *old).find(|old| on(old) && get(old, field).is_some())
                    .or_else(|| parts.iter().map(|(old, _)| *old).find(|old| get(old, field).is_some()));
                if let Some(v) = from.and_then(|old| get(old, field)) {
                    out.push(format!("{id}.{field}={v}"));
                }
            }
            for (old, old_field, field) in fields {
                if let Some(v) = get(old, old_field) {
                    out.push(format!("{id}.{field}={v}"));
                }
            }
        };
        merge(
            "crystalaura",
            &[("crystalaura", "aura"), ("crystalmacro", "macro")],
            &["placedelay", "breakdelay", "maxselfdamage", "autoobsidian", "switchback", "humanpace", "protectloot"],
            &[("crystalmacro", "obsidiandelay", "obsidiandelay")],
        );
        merge(
            "anchoraura",
            &[("anchoraura", "aura"), ("anchormacro", "macro")],
            &["protectloot"],
            &[
                ("anchormacro", "mode", "mode"), ("anchormacro", "delay", "delay"), ("anchormacro", "safeanchor", "safeanchor"),
                ("anchormacro", "ifunguarded", "ifunguarded"), ("anchormacro", "switchback", "switchback"),
            ],
        );
        // Step took in Reverse Step as its Reverse step section (0.9).
        merge("step", &[("step", "stepup"), ("reversestep", "reversestep")], &[], &[("reversestep", "speed", "fallspeed")]);
        merge(
            "anvil",
            &[("antianvil", "antianvil"), ("selfanvil", "selfanvil"), ("autoanvil", "autoanvil")],
            &["rotate"],
            &[
                ("autoanvil", "targetrange", "targetrange"), ("autoanvil", "height", "height"), ("autoanvil", "delay", "delay"),
                ("autoanvil", "placeatfeet", "placeatfeet"), ("autoanvil", "multiplace", "multiplace"),
            ],
        );
    }
    if !old_offhand && !gone[..3].iter().any(|id| had(id)) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out.join("\n"));
    }
    let mut set = |field: &str, value: Option<&str>| {
        if let Some(v) = value {
            out.push(format!("offhand.{field}={v}"));
        }
    };
    let (offhand, totem, inv, hover) = (on("offhand"), on("autototem"), on("autoinventorytotem"), on("hovertotem"));
    set("on", Some(if offhand || totem || inv || hover { "true" } else { "false" }));
    set("key", ["offhand", "autototem", "autoinventorytotem", "hovertotem"].iter().filter_map(|id| get(id, "key")).find(|k| *k != "none"));
    let item = if offhand {
        get("offhand", "item")
    } else if totem && get("autototem", "mode") == Some("Strict") {
        Some("Totem")
    } else if totem || inv || hover {
        Some("None")
    } else {
        None
    };
    set("item", item);
    let (when, delay) = if offhand || !had("autototem") {
        ("offhand", get("offhand", "itemswitchdelay"))
    } else {
        ("autototem", get("autototem", "delayticks"))
    };
    set("health", get(when, if when == "offhand" { "minhealth" } else { "health" }));
    set("fall", get(when, if when == "offhand" { "falling" } else { "fall" }));
    set("elytra", get(when, "elytra"));
    set("explosion", get(when, "explosion"));
    set("delayticks", delay);
    for field in ["hotbar", "rightgapple", "swordgapple", "alwaysgaponsword", "alwayspotonsword", "swordpot"] {
        set(field, get("offhand", field));
    }
    set("refill", Some(if inv { get("autoinventorytotem", "mode").unwrap_or("Inventory") } else { "Off" }));
    let slots = if hover && !inv { "hovertotem" } else { "autoinventorytotem" };
    set("hotbarrefill", get(slots, "hotbarrefill"));
    set("hotbarslot", get(slots, "hotbarslot"));
    for field in ["reactiondelay", "swapdelay", "closedelay", "switchbackdelay", "doublehand"] {
        set(field, get("autoinventorytotem", field));
    }
    set("hover", Some(if hover { "true" } else { "false" }));
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out.join("\n"))
}

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);

// The packet hooks read these: they run inside the game's own sends, which
// may happen while a module holds the state.
// No Fall's move packets: 0 leaves them, 1 claims the ground while falling (Packet), 2 never does (No ground); and
// whether holding a mace pauses it.
static NO_FALL: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8::new(0);
static NO_FALL_MACE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(true);
static BLINK: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// Flight's position packets claim the ground, so nothing counts as a fall; Glide's too while you are not flying.
static FLIGHT_GROUND: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static GLIDE_GROUND: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// Flight's Packet anti kick: every move packet carries the position, and while FLY_DOWN the height sent sinks a
// little below the last one sent (FLY_LAST_Y, f64 bits).
static FLY_PACKET: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static FLY_DOWN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static FLY_LAST_Y: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(u64::MAX);
static ANTI_SPRINT: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static ANTI_GROUND: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static WELCOMED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// Panic hid Sunset: no HUD, menu, chat lines or keys, and only .panic is read from the chat
// (it brings Sunset back). Not saved: a restart brings it back too.
static HIDDEN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// The server takes one position packet per tick and disconnects a client that
// sends more ("Invalid move player packet received"). Criticals hops over three
// ticks instead: stages 1 to 3 turn the next position packets into the hop up
// (CRIT_HOP blocks, f64 bits), half way down and back down (all off the ground),
// stage 4 lets the hit follow. Vanilla servers take each packet as it comes, so
// two would do; Horizon's counts a tick's moves only after its packets, the hit
// included, so the hit needs a move down counted in an earlier tick. The hit
// goes at the start of the next tick, and that tick's move (CRIT_LAND) stays off
// the ground where the hop ended: Horizon's server judges a tick's hit with the
// ground its move says. Stage CRIT_FALL waits for you to fall (Jump, Mini jump,
// a hit in the air), and CRIT_JUMP presses jump for the next tick.
pub(super) static CRIT_STAGE: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8::new(0);
const CRIT_HIT: u8 = 4;
const CRIT_FALL: u8 = 5;
const CRIT_LAND: u8 = 6;
static CRIT_HOP: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0);
static CRIT_JUMP: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// A server takes no critical hit from a sprinting player, and Horizon's applies all the sprint commands of a tick
// before its hits: so a critical hit's sprint stop goes out when the hit is planned, ticks before it, and the sprint
// comes back the tick after it. CRIT_SPRINT_STOPPED: the server was told the sprint stopped; CRIT_SPRINT_DUE: the hit
// went, the sprint goes back on next tick.
static CRIT_SPRINT: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8::new(0);
const CRIT_SPRINT_STOPPED: u8 = 1;
const CRIT_SPRINT_DUE: u8 = 2;
// A move packet went out this tick (the game's or Sunset's): Sunset never sends a second.
static MOVED_THIS_TICK: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// Blink held at least one move packet.
static BLINK_HELD: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
// Scaffold's block placements count up from here (the game's own are small).

pub(super) fn with<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut State) -> R) -> R {
    let mut guard = STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(guard.get_or_insert_with(State::new))
}

// A module from a plugin: added once (by name), with its saved settings.
pub(super) fn register_module(m: Module) {
    with(|s| {
        if s.modules.iter().any(|x| x.name == m.name) {
            return;
        }
        s.modules.push(m);
        let raw = s.raw.clone();
        s.load_text(&raw);
        sync_flags(s);
    });
}

// The modules for one tick or frame. Comparing costs no allocation, so they are copied only when they changed.
pub(super) fn snapshot() -> Arc<Vec<Module>> {
    with(|s| {
        if *s.shared != s.modules {
            s.shared = Arc::new(s.modules.clone());
        }
        s.shared.clone()
    })
}

pub(super) fn sync_flags(s: &mut State) {
    if let Some(list) = s.module("ClickGUI").map(|m| super::sunset_picker::chosen(m.t("Friends")).into_iter().map(str::to_owned).collect()) {
        s.friends = list;
    }
    let g = s.module("ClickGUI");
    super::sunset_dashboard::set_on(g.is_some_and(|m| m.p("Style") == "Dashboard"));
    super::sunset_smooth::set_enabled(g.is_none_or(|m| m.p("Animations") != "Off"));
    LOOK[0].store(g.map_or(0xFFB020, |m| m.c("Accent color") & 0x00FF_FFFF), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[1].store(g.map_or(100.0, |m| m.n("Panel width") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[2].store(g.map_or(0.9, |m| m.n("Background opacity") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[3].store(g.map_or(20.0, |m| m.n("Background dim")) as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[5].store(g.map_or(6.0, |m| m.n("Text indent") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[6].store(g.map_or(1.0, |m| m.n("GUI scale") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[8].store(g.map_or(6.0, |m| m.n("Panel radius") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[9].store(g.map_or(4.0, |m| m.n("Control radius") as f32).to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    LOOK[10].store(u32::from(g.is_some_and(|m| m.p("Spacing") == "Compact")), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let no_fall = s.module("No Fall").filter(|m| m.on);
    NO_FALL.store(no_fall.map_or(0, |m| match m.p("Mode") {
        "Packet" => 1,
        "No ground" => 2,
        _ => 0,
    }), Ordering::Relaxed);
    NO_FALL_MACE.store(no_fall.is_some_and(|m| m.b("Pause on mace")), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let flight = s.module("Flight").filter(|m| m.on);
    FLIGHT_GROUND.store(flight.is_some(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    GLIDE_GROUND.store(s.is_on("Glide"), Ordering::Relaxed);
    FLY_PACKET.store(flight.is_some_and(|m| m.p("Anti kick mode") == "Packet"), Ordering::Relaxed);
    BLINK.store(s.is_on("Blink"), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let hunger = s.module("Anti Hunger").filter(|m| m.on);
    ANTI_SPRINT.store(hunger.is_some_and(|m| m.b("Sprint")), Ordering::Relaxed);
    ANTI_GROUND.store(hunger.is_some_and(|m| m.b("Ground")), Ordering::Relaxed);
}

// Sunset was Solstice before 0.8.1: with no settings of its own yet, it takes over the old mod's (the config, the profiles).
fn take_over_old_settings(game: &Game<'_>) {
    if game.native_setting(ID, "config").is_some() || game.native_setting("solstice", "config").is_none() {
        return;
    }
    for file in std::fs::read_dir(game.native_data_dir("solstice")).into_iter().flatten().flatten() {
        if let Some(key) = file.file_name().to_str()
            && let Some(value) = game.native_setting("solstice", key)
        {
            game.native_set_setting(ID, key, &value);
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn ensure_loaded(game: &Game<'_>) {
    if with(|s| s.loaded) {
        return;
    }
    take_over_old_settings(game);
    let text = game.native_setting(ID, "config").unwrap_or_default();
    with(|s| {
        s.raw = text.clone();
        s.load_text(&text);
        s.loaded = true;
        sync_flags(s);
    });
    // Loadouts live in their own file now (the config kept them before).
    super::sunset_loadouts::load(game);
    if !text.lines().any(|l| l.starts_with("profile-selection=")) {
        if let Ok(store) = super::sunset_profiles::Store::new(game.native_data_dir(ID))
            && let Ok(names) = store.list()
        {
            let matches: Vec<String> = names.into_iter().filter(|n| n != super::sunset_profiles::BACKUP).filter(|n| {
                store.read(n).is_ok_and(|text| with(|s| s.check_profile(&text).is_ok_and(|body| s.matches_profile(body))))
            }).collect();
            if let [name] = matches.as_slice() {
                with(|s| s.select(name));
            }
        }
        save(game);
    }
}

// A setting set from code (a preset filling in its values), as .set would, and saved.
pub(super) fn set_setting(game: &Game<'_>, key: &str, value: &str) {
    with(|s| State::set_field(&mut s.modules, key, value));
    save(game);
}

pub(super) fn save(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let text = with(|s| {
        release_changed_binds(s);
        sync_flags(s);
        let snapshot = s.module_text();
        s.selection.refresh(&snapshot);
        s.save_text()
    });
    game.native_set_setting(ID, "config", &text);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

pub(super) fn on_off(b: bool) -> &'static str {
    if b { "ON" } else { "OFF" }
}

pub(super) fn num(v: f64) -> String {
    let s = format!("{v:.2}");
    let s = s.trim_end_matches('0').trim_end_matches('.');
    if s == "-0" { "0".into() } else { s.into() }
}

pub(super) fn round_to(v: f64, step: f64) -> f64 {
    if step <= 0.0 {
        return v;
    }
    (v / step).round() * step
}

// Lowercase letters and digits only: how commands and the config name things.
pub(super) fn norm(s: &str) -> String {
    s.chars()
        .filter(char::is_ascii_alphanumeric)
        .map(|c| c.to_ascii_lowercase())
        .collect()
}

// A key or mouse button typed in a command (`r`, `rshift`, `f6`, `mouse4`, `key.keyboard.r`) as the game names it.
pub(super) fn key_from_text(t: &str) -> Option<String> {
    canonical(t)
}

pub(super) fn key_label(key: Option<&str>) -> String {
    match key {
        None => "None".into(),
        Some(k) => {
            if let Some(button) = k.strip_prefix("key.mouse.") {
                return format!("Mouse {}", match button {
                    "left" => "Left",
                    "right" => "Right",
                    "middle" => "Middle",
                    "4" => "Back",
                    "5" => "Forward",
                    other => other,
                });
            }
            let short = k.strip_prefix("key.keyboard.").or_else(|| k.strip_prefix("key.mouse.")).unwrap_or(k);
            let mut out = String::new();
            for (i, part) in short.split('.').enumerate() {
                if i > 0 {
                    out.push(' ');
                }
                let mut c = part.chars();
                if let Some(f) = c.next() {
                    out.extend(f.to_uppercase());
                    out.push_str(c.as_str());
                }
            }
            out
        }
    }
}

// ClickGUI's switch for a kind of chat line ("Toggle messages", "Module messages").
pub(super) fn chat_lines(kind: &str) -> bool {
    with(|s| s.module("ClickGUI").is_none_or(|m| m.b(kind)))
}

// A line in chat: Sunset's tag, then the message.
pub(super) fn say(game: &mut Game<'_>, msg: &str) {
    if HIDDEN.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let line = Text::literal("[Sunset] ")
        .with_color(accent())
        .append(Text::literal(msg).with_color(horizon_client::text::WHITE));
    let focused = game.screen == Screen::Chat;
    let atlas = &game.gui.atlas;
    game.ui.chat.add(
        atlas,
        line,
        None,
        horizon_client::chat::ChatSource::Client,
        game.ticks,
        focused,
    );
}

pub(super) fn own_id(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<u32> {
    game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.entity_id as u32)
}

// The move keys held now: forward minus back, left minus right.
pub(super) fn move_input(game: &Game<'_>) -> (f64, f64) {
    if !game.native_playing() {
        return (0.0, 0.0);
    }
    let held = |k: KeyCode| f64::from(u8::from(game.keys.contains(&k)));
    (
        held(KeyCode::KeyW) - held(KeyCode::KeyS),
        held(KeyCode::KeyA) - held(KeyCode::KeyD),
    )
}

// The direction the move keys point, flat, length 1 (or zero).
pub(super) fn move_direction(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<[f64; 2]> {
    let (f, s) = move_input(game);
    if f == 0.0 && s == 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    let yaw = f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians();
    // Yaw 0 faces south (+z); left of it is east (+x).
    let x = -yaw.sin() * f + yaw.cos() * s;
    let z = yaw.cos() * f + yaw.sin() * s;
    let len = (x * x + z * z).sqrt();
    Some([x / len, z / len])
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Kind {
    Player,
    Hostile,
    Passive,
}

pub(super) fn kind_of(mob: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob) -> Kind {
    if mob.kind.id == "minecraft:player" {
        Kind::Player
    } else if mob.hostile() || mob.kind.category == "monster" {
        Kind::Hostile
    } else {
        Kind::Passive
    }
}

// A mob of a kind switched on, or of a type in the module's Entities list.
pub(super) fn wanted(m: &Module, kind: Kind, id: &str) -> bool {
    let of_kind = match kind {
        Kind::Player => m.b("Players"),
        Kind::Hostile => m.b("Hostiles"),
        Kind::Passive => m.b("Passive"),
    };
    super::sunset_util::kind_wanted(of_kind, m.t("Entities"), m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist", id)
}

pub(super) fn is_friend(friends: &[String], names: &[(u32, String)], id: u32) -> bool {
    names
        .iter()
        .find(|(i, _)| *i == id)
        .is_some_and(|(_, n)| friends.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(n)))
}

pub(super) fn look_at(eye: [f64; 3], at: [f64; 3]) -> (f32, f32) {
    let (dx, dy, dz) = (at[0] - eye[0], at[1] - eye[1], at[2] - eye[2]);
    let yaw = (-dx).atan2(dz).to_degrees();
    let pitch = -dy.atan2((dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt()).to_degrees();
    (yaw as f32, pitch as f32)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the menu

pub(super) fn listed(mods: &mut Vec<super::native_hooks::NativeMod>) {
    mods.push(super::native_hooks::NativeMod {
        id: ID.into(),
        title: format!("{NAME} {VERSION}"),
        description: DESCRIPTION.into(),
        keys: vec![
            [MENU_KEY.into(), "Open Sunset menu".into(), MENU_DEFAULT.into()],
            [MENU2_KEY.into(), "Open Sunset menu (2nd key)".into(), MENU2_DEFAULT.into()],
        ],
    });
}

pub(super) fn mod_index(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<usize> {
    game.settings.mods.installed.iter().position(|m| m.id == ID)
}

pub(super) fn refresh(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if let Some(i) = mod_index(game) {
        game.native_settings_refresh(i);
    }
}

// Either of the two keys that open the click GUI.
pub(super) fn is_menu_key(game: &Game<'_>, key: &str) -> bool {
    key == game.native_mod_key(ID, MENU_KEY, MENU_DEFAULT) || key == game.native_mod_key(ID, MENU2_KEY, MENU2_DEFAULT)
}

pub(super) fn open_menu(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    release_binds();
    let Some(i) = mod_index(game) else {
        say(game, "Turn Sunset on in Options > Mods first.");
        return;
    };
    with(|s| {
        s.page = Page::Main;
        s.binding = None;
    });
    game.open_options_at(false, horizon_client::options_ui::Page::NativeMod(i));
    game.native_settings_refresh(i);
}

pub(super) fn buttons(game: &Game<'_>, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
    ensure_loaded(game);
    with(|s| match s.page {
        Page::Main => {
            let listed = s.listed();
            for c in CATEGORIES {
                let all: Vec<&Module> = s.modules.iter().filter(|m| m.category == c && listed(m)).collect();
                let on = all.iter().filter(|m| m.on).count();
                out.push(format!("{} ({on} of {} on)", c.label(), all.len()));
            }
            out.push(format!("Friends: {}", if s.friends.is_empty() { "none".into() } else { s.friends.join(", ") }));
            out.push("Type .help in chat for commands".into());
        }
        Page::Category(c) => {
            out.push("< Back".into());
            let listed = s.listed();
            for m in s.modules.iter().filter(|m| m.category == c && listed(m)) {
                out.push(format!("{}: {}", m.name, on_off(m.on)));
            }
        }
        Page::Module(i) => {
            let m = &s.modules[i];
            out.push(format!("< Back to {}", m.category.label()));
            out.push(format!("{}: {}", m.name, on_off(m.on)));
            if s.binding == Some(i) {
                out.push("Keybind: > press a key (Backspace: none) <".into());
            } else {
                out.push(format!("Keybind: {}", key_label(m.key.as_deref())));
            }
            for setting in &m.settings {
                out.push(setting.shown());
            }
            let mut about = m.about.to_owned();
            if m.settings.iter().any(|s| matches!(s.value, Value::Num { .. })) {
                about.push_str(" Shift-click lowers a number.");
            }
            out.push(about);
        }
    });
}

pub(super) fn click(game: &mut Game<'_>, button: usize) {
    ensure_loaded(game);
    let shift = game.modifiers.shift_key();
    let mut toggled = None;
    let changed = with(|s| match s.page {
        Page::Main => {
            if let Some(&c) = CATEGORIES.get(button) {
                s.page = Page::Category(c);
            }
            false
        }
        Page::Category(c) => {
            if button == 0 {
                s.page = Page::Main;
                return false;
            }
            let listed = s.listed();
            let idx: Vec<usize> = (0..s.modules.len()).filter(|&i| s.modules[i].category == c && listed(&s.modules[i])).collect();
            if let Some(&i) = idx.get(button - 1) {
                s.page = Page::Module(i);
            }
            false
        }
        Page::Module(i) => match button {
            0 => {
                s.binding = None;
                s.page = Page::Category(s.modules[i].category);
                false
            }
            1 => {
                toggled = Some(i);
                false
            }
            2 => {
                s.binding = if s.binding == Some(i) { None } else { Some(i) };
                false
            }
            b => match s.modules[i].settings.get_mut(b - 3) {
                Some(setting) => {
                    setting.click(shift);
                    true
                }
                None => false,
            },
        },
    });
    if let Some(i) = toggled {
        toggle(game, i, false);
    } else if changed {
        save(game);
    }
}

pub(super) fn toggle(game: &mut Game<'_>, i: usize, announce: bool) {
    let (name, on) = with(|s| {
        // Turned on or off by hand: a Hold bind no longer has it.
        s.inputs.take_where(|held| held.module == i);
        let m = &mut s.modules[i];
        m.on = !m.on;
        (m.name, m.on)
    });
    super::sunset_combat_macros::toggled(game, name, on);
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::toggled(game, name);
    super::sunset_packet_mine::toggled(game, name, on);
    if name == "Friend Guard" {
        super::sunset_melee::reset_friend_feedback();
    }
    if !on {
        match name {
            "Scaffold" => {
                with(|s| { s.scaffold_wait = 0; s.scaffold_recent.clear(); s.scaffold_stack = None; });
                restore_scaffold_rotation(game);
                legit_sneak(game, false);
                super::sunset_scaffold_bridge::stop(game);
            }
            "Speed" => {
                with(|s| { s.strafe = Strafe::default(); s.knockback_ticks = 0; });
                horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_across(None);
                horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_up(None);
            },
            "Velocity" => with(|s| { s.velocity = None; s.blast = [0.0; 3]; }),
            "Crystal Aura" => super::sunset_crystal_aura::disabled(game),
            "Cart" => super::sunset_cart::reset(game),
            "Kill Aura" => {
                let swap_back = with(|s| s.module("Kill Aura").is_some_and(|m| m.b("Swap back")));
                super::sunset_aura::disabled(game, swap_back);
            }
            "Anchor Aura" => super::sunset_anchor_aura::disabled(game),
            "No Slow" => {
                horizon_client::input::sunset_flags::NO_SLOW.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_no_slow_skip(false);
                horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_no_slow_grim(false);
            },
            "Server Scan" => super::sunset_server_scan::disabled(),
            _ => {},
        }
    }
    save(game);
    if announce && name != super::sunset_debug::NAME {
        say(game, &format!("{name} {}", if on { "on" } else { "off" }));
    }
}

fn take_scaffold_rotation(saved: &mut Option<(f32, f32)>) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    saved.take()
}

fn restore_scaffold_rotation(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if let Some((yaw, pitch)) = with(|s| take_scaffold_rotation(&mut s.scaffold_rotation)) {
        game.yaw = yaw;
        game.pitch = pitch;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys

// Modules Hold binds had on, back as they were (left off if something turned them off meanwhile).
fn restore_holds(s: &mut State, held: Vec<Held>) {
    if held.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    for h in held {
        if let Some(m) = s.modules.get_mut(h.module)
            && m.on
        {
            m.on = h.previous;
        }
    }
    sync_flags(s);
}

// Holds whose module went off, or whose bind or Bind mode changed, end.
fn release_changed_binds(s: &mut State) {
    let modules = &s.modules;
    let held = s.inputs.take_where(|h| {
        modules
            .get(h.module)
            .is_none_or(|m| !m.on || m.key.as_deref() != Some(h.key.as_str()) || m.p("Bind mode") != "Hold")
    });
    restore_holds(s, held);
}

// A screen, the menu or another window has the input: every hold ends.
fn release_binds() {
    with(|s| {
        let held = s.inputs.suspend();
        restore_holds(s, held);
    });
}

fn set_bind(s: &mut State, module: usize, key: Option<String>) {
    let held = s.inputs.take_where(|h| h.module == module);
    restore_holds(s, held);
    s.modules[module].key = key;
}

// Each tick, whatever the screen: keys let go of where no release came (from what is physically down), and no holds
// while the menu or a screen has the input (another window taking it is the window's Focused event, in bind_event).
fn sync_binds(game: &Game<'_>) {
    if !game.native_window() {
        return;
    }
    with(|s| {
        let held = s.inputs.missing(|name| {
            game.physical_keys.iter().any(|k| horizon_client::keybinds::key_name(*k) == Some(name))
                || game.physical_buttons.iter().any(|b| horizon_client::keybinds::mouse_name(*b) == name)
        });
        restore_holds(s, held);
        release_changed_binds(s);
        if !game.native_on(ID) || game.player.is_none() || !game.native_playing() || s.gui.open {
            let held = s.inputs.suspend();
            restore_holds(s, held);
        }
    });
}

// The window's presses and releases before any screen has them: a release a screen swallows still ends its hold, a
// key pressed in the menu or by the window coming back into focus is no bind press, and lost focus ends every hold.
pub(super) fn bind_event(event: &winit::event::WindowEvent) {
    use winit::event::{ElementState, WindowEvent};
    use winit::keyboard::{Key, NamedKey, PhysicalKey};
    if matches!(event, WindowEvent::Focused(false) | WindowEvent::CloseRequested | WindowEvent::Destroyed) {
        release_binds();
    }
    let (name, pressed, synthetic) = match event {
        WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, is_synthetic, .. } => {
            // Escape and Caps Lock by their meaning, as Horizon's keymap takes them.
            let code = match &event.logical_key {
                Key::Named(NamedKey::Escape) => KeyCode::Escape,
                Key::Named(NamedKey::CapsLock) => KeyCode::CapsLock,
                _ => match event.physical_key {
                    PhysicalKey::Code(code) => code,
                    PhysicalKey::Unidentified(_) => return,
                },
            };
            let Some(name) = horizon_client::keybinds::key_name(code) else {
                return;
            };
            (name.to_owned(), event.state == ElementState::Pressed, *is_synthetic)
        }
        WindowEvent::MouseInput { state, button, .. } => (horizon_client::keybinds::mouse_name(*button), *state == ElementState::Pressed, false),
        _ => return,
    };
    with(|s| {
        if !pressed {
            let held = s.inputs.release(&name);
            restore_holds(s, held);
            return;
        }
        if s.gui.open || synthetic {
            s.inputs.block(&name);
            let held = s.inputs.suspend();
            restore_holds(s, held);
        }
        if synthetic {
            s.inputs.synthetic(&name);
        }
    });
}

pub(super) fn key(game: &mut Game<'_>, key: &str, pressed: bool) {
    if !game.native_window() {
        return;
    }
    if pressed {
        super::agent::sunset_goto::key(game, key);
    }
    super::sunset_melee::key(game, key, pressed);
    super::sunset_swap_keys::key(game, key, pressed);
    super::sunset_combat::web_key(game, key, pressed);
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::key(game, key, pressed);
    super::sunset_duel::key(game, key, pressed);
    super::sunset_cart::key(game, key, pressed);
    if !pressed {
        with(|s| {
            let held = s.inputs.release(key);
            restore_holds(s, held);
        });
        return;
    }
    if !game.native_on(ID) || HIDDEN.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        release_binds();
        return;
    }
    if with(|s| s.inputs.is_synthetic(key)) {
        return;
    }
    ensure_loaded(game);
    if gui_open() {
        gui_key(game, key);
        return;
    }
    if let Some(i) = with(|s| s.binding) {
        let chosen = match key {
            "key.keyboard.escape" => {
                with(|s| s.binding = None);
                refresh(game);
                return;
            }
            "key.keyboard.backspace" | "key.keyboard.delete" => None,
            k => Some(k.to_owned()),
        };
        with(|s| {
            set_bind(s, i, chosen);
            s.binding = None;
        });
        save(game);
        refresh(game);
        return;
    }
    if !game.native_playing() || game.player.is_none() {
        with(|s| s.inputs.block(key));
        release_binds();
        return;
    }
    // The chat key opens a text screen: a bind on the same key is not pressed by it.
    if !is_menu_key(game, key) && (key == game.settings.keys.get("key.chat") || key == game.settings.keys.get("key.command")) {
        with(|s| s.inputs.block(key));
        release_binds();
        return;
    }
    // A fresh press only: not one a screen or the menu had when it went down.
    if !with(|s| s.inputs.press(key)) {
        return;
    }
    if is_menu_key(game, key) {
        open_gui(game);
        return;
    }
    if key == "key.mouse.middle" && with(|s| s.is_on("Middle Click Extra")) {
        middle_click(game);
    }
    if key == "key.mouse.right" {
        super::sunset_player::right_click(game);
    }
    let bound: Vec<usize> = with(|s| {
        (0..s.modules.len())
            .filter(|&i| s.modules[i].key.as_deref() == Some(key))
            .collect()
    });
    for i in bound {
        if with(|s| s.modules[i].p("Bind mode") == "Hold") {
            // On while the key is down, then as it was.
            with(|s| {
                let previous = s.modules[i].on;
                s.inputs.hold(i, key, previous);
                s.modules[i].on = true;
                sync_flags(s);
            });
        } else {
            toggle(game, i, chat_lines("Toggle messages"));
        }
    }
    // Air Jump: the jump key in mid-air jumps again.
    if key == "key.keyboard.space" && with(|s| s.is_on("Air Jump")) {
        if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut()
            && !p.ground.on_ground
            && !p.flying
        {
            p.velocity.y = 0.42;
            p.fall_distance = 0.0;
        }
        remember_velocity(game);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ticks

// Before the game ticks: keys this mod holds, abilities, step height.
pub(super) fn pre_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    sync_binds(game);
    // Single player's own server ticks a game of its own (no window) through here too: it must leave the player's
    // state alone, or it clears Velocity's baseline and Speed's push between the client's ticks.
    if !game.native_window() {
        return;
    }
    if game.player.is_none() {
        fall_died();
    }
    horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::expire_attack_slow(game.ticks);
    let packets = horizon_client::net::sunset_packets::take();
    if !game.native_on(ID) || game.player.is_none() {
        combat_cleanup(game);
        horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_across(None);
        horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_up(None);
        horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_safe_walk(false);
        horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_screen_keys(None);
        restore_scaffold_rotation(game);
        super::sunset_scaffold_bridge::stop(game);
        with(|s| { s.velocity = None; s.blast = [0.0; 3]; s.knockback_ticks = 0; s.scaffold_recent.clear(); });
        return;
    }
    if super::sunset_combat_control::begin_tick(game) {
        drop_strikes();
        super::sunset_melee::cancel(game);
    }
    combat_packets(game, &packets);
    ensure_loaded(game);
    super::sunset_parity::pre_tick(game);
    MOVED_THIS_TICK.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    crit_sprint_back(game);
    // Slots borrowed for earlier hits come back first, before this tick's move packet and any hit or use in it, one
    // slot change at most, and not while a hit or its weapon waits (send_strikes changes the slot itself).
    let (hits, selected) = (strike_waiting() || super::sunset_melee::due_waiting(), game.selected);
    if !hits && !super::sunset_melee::lease_back(game) && !super::sunset_duel::catch_back(game) {
        strike_weapon_back(game);
    }
    super::sunset_hands::before_hits(game, strike_due() || super::sunset_melee::due_waiting());
    send_strikes(game);
    send_slam(game);
    super::sunset_melee::due(game);
    // Pearl Catch's wind charge: in a tick with no hit and no slot change before it.
    super::sunset_duel::catch_throw(game, hits || game.selected != selected);
    // Cart's steps: in a tick with no hit and no slot change before them.
    super::sunset_cart::pre_tick(game, hits || game.selected != selected);
    // Shield, Key Throw's Crossbow key and Offhand's Double hand: likewise.
    super::sunset_swap_keys::pre_tick(game, hits || game.selected != selected);
    let mods = snapshot();
    super::sunset_render::pre_tick(game, &mods);
    super::sunset_player::speed_mine(game, mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Speed Mine" && m.on));
    super::sunset_player::no_break_reset(game, mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == "No Break Reset" && m.on));
    let on = |n: &str| mods.iter().any(|m| m.name == n && m.on);
    let get = |n: &str| mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == n);
    let playing = game.native_playing();
    // The click GUI holds no movement keys, as a screen would.
    if gui_open() {
        game.keys.clear();
    }
    let mut want = Vec::new();
    if on("Auto Walk") && playing {
        want.push(KeyCode::KeyW);
    }
    if on("Sprint") && playing {
        want.push(KeyCode::ControlLeft);
    }
    if on("Auto Jump") && playing && move_input(game) != (0.0, 0.0) {
        want.push(KeyCode::Space);
    }
    if on("Sneak") && playing {
        want.push(KeyCode::ShiftLeft);
    }
    // Criticals' Jump mode presses jump for this tick: the game's own jump.
    if CRIT_JUMP.swap(false, Ordering::Relaxed) && playing {
        want.push(KeyCode::Space);
    }
    // Parkour presses jump for this tick: the game's own jump (a sprint jump's push too).
    if let Some(m) = get("Parkour").filter(|m| m.on)
        && playing
        && parkour_jump(game, &m)
    {
        want.push(KeyCode::Space);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Anti AFK").filter(|m| m.on)
        && playing
    {
        want.extend(super::sunset_player::afk_keys(game, &m));
    }
    let scaffold_walk = get("Scaffold").is_some_and(|m| m.on && m.p("Mode") == "Normal" && m.b("Safe walk"));
    horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_safe_walk((on("Safe Walk") || scaffold_walk) && playing);
    // Snap Tap: of two opposite move keys held, the one pressed last (GUI Move's keys too).
    let snapped = super::sunset_snap_tap::pre_tick(game, get("Snap Tap").filter(|m| m.on));
    // GUI Move: behind a screen the game takes no move keys, so its movement is given the ones held and walks you as
    // it would without the screen (its own speeds, sprint, jumps, and the walk's look in first and third person).
    let held = |k: KeyCode| !snapped.contains(&k) && (game.keys.contains(&k) || game.physical_keys.contains(&k));
    // Flight flies you behind a screen by itself.
    let screen_keys = get("GUI Move").filter(|m| m.on && !on("Flight") && !gui_open() && gui_move_screen(game, m)).map(|m| horizon_client::sprint::Keys {
        forward: held(KeyCode::KeyW),
        backward: held(KeyCode::KeyS),
        left: held(KeyCode::KeyA),
        right: held(KeyCode::KeyD),
        jump: m.b("Jump") && held(KeyCode::Space),
        shift: m.b("Sneak") && held(KeyCode::ShiftLeft),
        sprint: m.b("Sprint") && (on("Sprint") || held(KeyCode::ControlLeft)),
        analog: None,
    });
    horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_screen_keys(screen_keys);
    let mut injected = Vec::new();
    for k in want {
        if game.keys.insert(k) {
            injected.push(k);
        }
    }
    // Scaffold's Legit and Godbridge sneak, turn and click before the game's tick moves you.
    let bridging = get("Scaffold")
        .filter(|m| m.on && m.p("Mode") != "Normal" && !scaffold_paused(m, on("Kill Aura"), on("Blink")))
        .filter(|_| playing && game.remote.is_some() && super::sunset_combat_control::available("Scaffold"));
    super::sunset_scaffold_bridge::pre_tick(game, bridging);
    // Offhand's Silent open holds your move keys and clicks while its totem moves.
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::pre_tick(game, get("Offhand").filter(|m| m.on && playing));
    velocity(game, get("Velocity").filter(|m| m.on));
    let across = get("Speed").filter(|m| m.on).and_then(|m| speed(game, &m));
    horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_across(across.map(|(xz, _)| xz));
    horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::set_up(across.and_then(|(_, y)| y));
    let flight = get("Flight").filter(|m| m.on);
    flight_pre(game, flight);
    let step = get("Step").filter(|m| m.on && m.b("Step up"));
    let high_jump = get("High Jump").filter(|m| m.on);
    let (was_flying, was_stepping, was_high_jumping) = with(|s| (s.flying, s.stepping, s.high_jumping));
    let (creative, spectator_mode) = (game.creative, game.spectator());
    let step_to = step.map_or(0.6, |st| step_height(game, st));
    if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
        if flight.is_none() && was_flying {
            p.flying = creative && p.flying || spectator_mode;
            p.may_fly = creative || spectator_mode;
            p.flying_speed = 0.05;
        }
        if step.is_some() {
            let _ = p.set_modifier("minecraft:step_height", "sunset:step", step_to - 0.6, "add_value", true);
        } else if was_stepping {
            let _ = p.set_modifier("minecraft:step_height", "sunset:step", 0.0, "add_value", false);
        }
        // High Jump: Meteor multiplies the jump's own speed, so the jump starts higher from its first tick.
        if let Some(h) = &high_jump {
            let _ = p.set_modifier("minecraft:jump_strength", "sunset:high_jump", h.n("Multiplier") - 1.0, "add_multiplied_total", true);
        } else if was_high_jumping {
            let _ = p.set_modifier("minecraft:jump_strength", "sunset:high_jump", 0.0, "add_multiplied_total", false);
        }
    }
    with(|s| {
        s.injected.extend(injected);
        s.flying = flight.is_some_and(|m| m.p("Mode") == "Abilities");
        s.stepping = step.is_some();
        s.high_jumping = high_jump.is_some();
    });
    super::sunset_melee::pre_input(game);
    super::sunset_duel::pre_input(game);
}

// How high Step lets you climb this tick: the setting, or vanilla's 0.6 when
// its conditions say no (Meteor's Step: active when, safe step).
fn step_height(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> f64 {
    let sneaking = game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ShiftLeft);
    let active = match m.p("Active when") {
        "Sneaking" => sneaking,
        "Not sneaking" => !sneaking,
        _ => true,
    };
    if !active {
        return 0.6;
    }
    if m.b("Safe step")
        && let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref()
    {
        let health = (p.health.health() + p.health.absorption()) as f64;
        let at = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
        let hurt = super::sunset_util::crystal_damage(game, at);
        // Safe means staying above the limit now and after the nearest crystal goes off.
        if health <= m.n("Step health") || health - hurt <= m.n("Step health") {
            return 0.6;
        }
    }
    m.n("Height")
}

// The screens GUI Move walks you in: the inventory and containers (not an anvil's rename box) and, with "All menus",
// the pause menu, the Options pages with no search box, Statistics, Advancements and the creative tabs but the search. Never
// a screen you type in. (A single-player game stops while the pause menu and the like are open: nothing moves there.)
fn gui_move_screen(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> bool {
    if game.screen == Screen::Inventory {
        return game.remote_menu().1 != "anvil";
    }
    if m.p("Screens") != "All menus" {
        return false;
    }
    match game.screen {
        Screen::Paused | Screen::Stats | Screen::Advancements => true,
        Screen::Options => {
            use horizon_client::options_ui::Page;
            let options = &game.ui.options;
            options.selected_key.is_none()
                && !matches!(options.page(), Page::Video | Page::Controls | Page::KeyBinds | Page::Language | Page::Packs)
        }
        Screen::Creative => game.creative_screen.tabs.get(game.creative_screen.selected).is_some_and(|t| !t.search),
        _ => false,
    }
}

// After the game ticks: let go of held keys, then each module's work.
// After the tick: first what waited for the look its move packet carried, then the modules, then (in a tick that
// sent no move packet) the one that carries the next look.
pub(super) fn post_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    super::sunset_snap_tap::post_tick(game);
    super::sunset_scaffold_bridge::post_tick(game);
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::post_tick(game);
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on(ID) {
        return;
    }
    super::sunset_sky::keep_shown(game);
    super::sunset_melee::post_input(game);
    turned(game);
    module_tick(game);
    end_turns(game);
}

fn module_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    ensure_loaded(game);
    let injected = with(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.injected));
    for k in injected {
        if !game.physical_keys.contains(&k) {
            game.keys.remove(&k);
        }
    }
    let mods = snapshot();
    let get = |n: &str| mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == n && m.on);
    // Once a session, in a world: how to get to the menu.
    if game.remote.is_some() && game.player.is_some() && !WELCOMED.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        say(game, &format!("{VERSION} is on. Press ` for the menu (or Right Shift), type .help for the commands."));
    }
    let ticks = with(|s| {
        s.ticks += 1;
        s.ticks
    });

    // Fullbright: the renderer's own fullbright, while on or while the
    // player's own extra is.
    let fullbright = get("Fullbright").is_some() || game.settings.extras.fullbright;
    if let Some(r) = game.renderer.as_mut() {
        r.fullbright = fullbright;
    }

    if game.player.is_none() {
        return;
    }
    // Debug Report: on for one tick (its button or bind), it copies the report.
    if get(super::sunset_debug::NAME).is_some() {
        if let Some(i) = with(|s| s.find(super::sunset_debug::NAME)) {
            toggle(game, i, false);
        }
        super::sunset_debug::copy(game, None);
    }

    let dead = game.screen == Screen::Dead;
    if let Some(m) = get("Death Location") {
        if dead && !with(|s| s.dead) {
            death_location(game, m);
        } else if !dead && m.b("Clear on reach") {
            reach_deaths(game);
        }
    }
    with(|s| s.dead = dead);
    if get("Auto Respawn").is_some() && game.screen == Screen::Dead {
        let wait = with(|s| {
            s.respawn_wait = s.respawn_wait.saturating_sub(1);
            let w = s.respawn_wait;
            if w == 0 {
                s.respawn_wait = 20;
            }
            w
        });
        if wait == 0 {
            let _ = game.respawn_player();
        }
        return;
    }
    if game.screen == Screen::Dead {
        return;
    }

    if get("Panic").is_some() {
        panic_off(game);
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Break Delay") {
        let wait = m.n("Cooldown (ticks)") as u32;
        game.destroy_delay = game.destroy_delay.min(wait);
        super::remote::sunset_remote::clear_destroy_delay(game, wait);
    }

    // GUI Move: the game ignores the keys while a menu is open, so what is held steers by hand. Flight,
    // Speed and the rest read the same keys, so they work with it open too.
    let screen_move = get("GUI Move").filter(|m| !gui_open() && gui_move_screen(game, m));
    let held = |k: KeyCode| game.keys.contains(&k) || game.physical_keys.contains(&k);
    let screen_keys = screen_move.as_ref().map(|m| {
        (
            f64::from(i8::from(held(KeyCode::KeyW)) - i8::from(held(KeyCode::KeyS))),
            f64::from(i8::from(held(KeyCode::KeyA)) - i8::from(held(KeyCode::KeyD))),
            m.b("Jump") && held(KeyCode::Space),
            m.b("Sneak") && held(KeyCode::ShiftLeft),
            m.b("Arrows"),
            [held(KeyCode::ArrowLeft), held(KeyCode::ArrowRight), held(KeyCode::ArrowUp), held(KeyCode::ArrowDown)],
        )
    });
    if let Some((.., true, arrows)) = screen_keys {
        let turn = |neg: bool, pos: bool| f32::from(i8::from(pos) - i8::from(neg));
        game.yaw += turn(arrows[0], arrows[1]) * 6.0;
        game.pitch = (game.pitch + turn(arrows[2], arrows[3]) * 4.0).clamp(-90.0, 90.0);
    }
    let (yaw, pitch) = (game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let flat = |f: f64, s: f64| {
        let a = f64::from(yaw).to_radians();
        let (x, z) = (-a.sin() * f + a.cos() * s, a.cos() * f + a.sin() * s);
        let len = (x * x + z * z).sqrt();
        (len > 0.0).then(|| [x / len, z / len])
    };
    let dir = move_direction(game).or_else(|| screen_keys.and_then(|(f, s, ..)| flat(f, s)));
    let jump = game.native_playing() && game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::Space) || screen_keys.is_some_and(|k| k.2);
    let sneak = game.native_playing() && game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ShiftLeft) || screen_keys.is_some_and(|k| k.3);
    let forward = move_input(game).0 > 0.0 || screen_keys.is_some_and(|k| k.0 > 0.0);
    let dim = game.dim.id();
    let flight_abilities = get("Flight").is_some_and(|f| f.p("Mode") == "Abilities");
    flight_post(game, get("Flight"), jump, sneak, screen_keys.and(dir));

    if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
        // Behind a screen, Flight's Abilities mode flies by hand at its speed, as creative flight does (about 11 blocks
        // a second at the default flying speed); and GUI Move's Sprint off stops a sprint.
        if let Some((.., sneaking, _, _)) = screen_keys {
            if flight_abilities && p.flying {
                let fly = f64::from(p.flying_speed) / 0.05 * 10.9 / 20.0;
                if let Some([x, z]) = dir {
                    (p.velocity.x, p.velocity.z) = (x * fly, z * fly);
                }
                p.velocity.y = if jump { fly * 0.6 } else if sneaking { -fly * 0.6 } else { 0.0 };
            }
            if p.sprinting && screen_move.as_ref().is_some_and(|m| !m.b("Sprint")) {
                let _ = p.set_sprinting(false);
            }
        }
        if get("No Jump Delay").is_some() {
            p.no_jump_delay = 0;
        }
        if let Some(g) = get("Glide")
            && !p.ground.on_ground
            && !p.flying
            && !p.fall_flying
        {
            p.velocity.y = p.velocity.y.max(-g.n("Fall speed") / 20.0);
            p.fall_distance = 0.0;
        }
        if let Some(sp) = get("Spider")
            && p.collision.horizontal
            && dir.is_some()
        {
            p.velocity.y = sp.n("Climb speed");
            p.fall_distance = 0.0;
        }
        if let Some(e) = get("Elytra Boost")
            && p.fall_flying
            && forward
        {
            let look = horizon_client::gizmos::view_vector(pitch, yaw);
            let a = e.n("Boost");
            p.velocity.x += look[0] * a;
            p.velocity.y += look[1] * a;
            p.velocity.z += look[2] * a;
            let v = &mut p.velocity;
            let len = (v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z).sqrt();
            let max = e.n("Max speed");
            if len > max {
                let k = max / len;
                (v.x, v.y, v.z) = (v.x * k, v.y * k, v.z * k);
            }
        }
        // Elytra Fly (Meteor's Vanilla mode): gliding, the keys set the move outright: Horizontal speed (blocks a tick)
        // the way they point, up or down at Vertical speed with jump or sneak, else a slow sink (Fall multiplier).
        // Auto take off opens the elytra as soon as a jump starts to fall; Stop in water lets water end the glide.
        if let Some(e) = get("Elytra Fly")
            && game.armor[1].as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.item.ends_with("elytra"))
            && !(e.b("Stop in water") && p.fluids.was_touching_water)
        {
            if e.b("Auto take off") && !p.fall_flying && !p.ground.on_ground && p.velocity.y < 0.0 && jump {
                p.fall_flying = true;
            }
            if p.fall_flying {
                let h = e.n("Horizontal speed");
                let [x, z] = dir.map_or([0.0, 0.0], |[x, z]| [x * h, z * h]);
                let y = if jump {
                    e.n("Vertical speed")
                } else if sneak {
                    -e.n("Vertical speed")
                } else {
                    -e.n("Fall multiplier")
                };
                p.velocity = horizon_core::geometry::Vec3::new(x, y, z);
            }
        }
        // Slippy: on the ground with no move key held, the last tick's slowing was the block's friction; it becomes
        // Friction's (a walk keeps its own pace: the game's push on a slippery block is smaller than this would make).
        if let Some(m) = get("Slippy").filter(|_| p.ground.on_ground && dir.is_none()) {
            let under = game.world.block(p.position.x.floor() as i32, (p.position.y - 0.5).floor() as i32, p.position.z.floor() as i32);
            let was = f64::from(game.res.facts().get(under).friction);
            if was > 0.0 {
                let k = m.n("Friction") / was;
                p.velocity.x *= k;
                p.velocity.z *= k;
            }
        }
        // Jesus (Meteor's Solid mode): on the top of water or lava you stand as on a block, at the liquid's top, unless
        // you sneak (Dip on sneak), are burning in lava's place (Dip if burning) or are already under it.
        if let Some(j) = get("Jesus") {
            let feet = [p.position.x.floor() as i32, (p.position.y - 0.05).floor() as i32, p.position.z.floor() as i32];
            let below = game.world.block(feet[0], feet[1], feet[2]);
            let f = game.res.facts().get(below);
            let name = super::sunset_util::short(&f.name);
            let liquid = (j.b("Water") && name == "water") || (j.b("Lava") && name == "lava");
            let top = f64::from(feet[1] + 1);
            let dip = (j.b("Dip on sneak") && sneak) || (j.b("Dip if burning") && p.fire_ticks > 0 && name == "water");
