        if game.remote.is_some() && impulse[0].hypot(impulse[2]).hypot(impulse[1]) > 0.08 {
            with(|s| s.knockback_ticks = s.module("Speed").filter(|m| m.on).map_or(0, |m| m.n("Knockback pause") as u32));
        }
    }
    let share = |on: &str, h: &str, v: &str| m.filter(|m| m.b(on)).map_or([1.0; 2], |m| [velocity_share(m, h), velocity_share(m, v)]);
    let liquids = m.filter(|m| m.b("Liquids")).map(|m| [velocity_share(m, "Liquids horizontal"), velocity_share(m, "Liquids vertical")]);
    motion::set_liquid_flow(liquids);
    let Some(m) = m else {
        return;
    };
    let pushed = if m.b("Entity push") { entity_push(game) } else { [0.0; 2] };
    let ground = game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.ground.on_ground);
    let knock = if m.b("Knockback") { knockback_shares(m, ground) } else { [1.0; 2] };
    let blasts = share("Explosions", "Explosions horizontal", "Explosions vertical");
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    let mut v = [p.velocity.x, p.velocity.y, p.velocity.z];
    if let Some(last) = last {
        for i in 0..3 {
            let (k, b) = if i == 1 { (knock[1], blasts[1]) } else { (knock[0], blasts[0]) };
            v[i] = last[i] + (v[i] - last[i] - blast[i]) * k + blast[i] * b;
        }
    }
    // The game adds the pushes later in the tick: take back what the push amount does not keep.
    let keep = velocity_share(m, "Entity push amount");
    v[0] -= pushed[0] * (1.0 - keep);
    v[2] -= pushed[1] * (1.0 - keep);
    (p.velocity.x, p.velocity.y, p.velocity.z) = (v[0], v[1], v[2]);
}

// The entities' push on the player this tick, x and z (the game's `LivingEntity.pushEntities` with
// `Entity.push(Entity)`): every living one but bats whose box overlaps yours, pushable by your team.
fn entity_push(game: &Game<'_>) -> [f64; 2] {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return [0.0; 2];
    };
    let (bounds, own) = (p.bounds(), own_id(game));
    let team = game.score.board.players_team(&game.options.player_name());
    let mut push = [0.0; 2];
    for m in &game.mobs {
        if Some(m.id) == own
            || !m.alive()
            || m.species() == horizon_client::mobs::Species::Bat
            || game.riding.is_some_and(|v| v == m.id || m.extra.mount == Some(v))
            || !m.bounds().intersects(bounds)
            || !horizon_client::scoreboard::pushable_by(game.mob_team(m.id), team, true)
        {
            continue;
        }
        let (mut xa, mut za) = (m.position.x - p.position.x, m.position.z - p.position.z);
        let dd = xa.abs().max(za.abs());
        if dd < f64::from(0.01_f32) {
            continue;
        }
        let dd = dd.sqrt();
        let pow = (1.0 / dd).min(1.0) * f64::from(0.05_f32);
        xa = xa / dd * pow;
        za = za / dd * pow;
        push[0] -= xa;
        push[1] -= za;
    }
    push
}

pub(super) fn cooldown_ready(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, wait: &mut u32) -> bool {
    if m.b("Wait for cooldown") {
        // The ticker the hand counts on a server (attack_ticks is the
        // local world's).
        game.hand_strength.scale(0.5, game.main_hand_attack_speed()) >= 1.0
    } else if *wait > 0 {
        *wait -= 1;
        false
    } else {
        true
    }
}

// How Criticals makes a hit critical, when it can: a hop of so many blocks over two ticks (Packet, the mace's
// smash), or a wait for the fall (Jump, Mini jump, a hit while rising).
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Crit {
    Hop(f64),
    Jump,
    MiniJump,
    Fall,
}

// Criticals (Meteor's) for a hit now: never flying, gliding, riding, in water or lava or on a ladder. A mace (Mace
// smash) hops 1.501 blocks plus Additional height so the server counts a smash; on the ground the Mode; in the air,
// with Only on ground off, a hit waits for the fall. A hop needs the room above you, else Packet's goes back to 0.0625.
fn crit_plan(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module) -> Option<Crit> {
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let item = game.held().map_or("", |s| &*s.item);
    let weapon = ["_sword", "_axe", "_spear", ":mace", ":trident"].iter().any(|w| item.ends_with(w));
    if (m.b("Only with a weapon") && !weapon)
        || p.flying
        || p.fall_flying
        || game.riding.is_some()
        || p.swimming
        || p.fluids.was_touching_water
        || p.is_in_lava()
        || p.last_climbable.is_some()
    {
        return None;
    }
    let extra = m.n("Additional height");
    let room = |h: f64| room_above(game, h);
    if m.b("Mace smash") && item.ends_with(":mace") && room(1.501 + extra) {
        return Some(Crit::Hop(1.501 + extra));
    }
    // In the air, a hit waits until you have fallen for two ticks (a server counts no fall on the first after a jump's
    // top, and Horizon's only after the tick it came in); after that it is critical as it is, unless the next move
    // lands: a hit is judged with the ground of its tick's move, so that one waits too.
    if !p.ground.on_ground {
        return (!m.b("Only on ground") && (p.velocity.y > -0.15 || lands_next(game))).then_some(Crit::Fall);
    }
    Some(match m.p("Mode") {
        "Jump" => Crit::Jump,
        "Mini jump" => Crit::MiniJump,
        _ => Crit::Hop(if room(0.0625 + extra) { 0.0625 + extra } else { 0.0625 }),
    })
}

// Nothing in the way of your box moved `h` blocks up (down if negative).
fn room_above(game: &Game<'_>, h: f64) -> bool {
    use horizon_core::geometry::Vec3;
    game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| {
        horizon_client::collisions::SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: None }
            .unobstructed(p.bounds().expand_towards(Vec3::new(0.0, h, 0.0)))
            .unwrap_or(false)
    })
}

// Falling, the next tick's move (the velocity the tick left you) puts you on the ground.
fn lands_next(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| !p.ground.on_ground && p.velocity.y < 0.0) && !room_above(game, game.player.as_ref().map_or(0.0, |p| p.velocity.y))
}

pub(super) fn attack(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32, crits: bool, rotate: Option<(f32, f32)>) {
    let plan = with(|s| s.module("Criticals").filter(|m| m.on).cloned()).filter(|_| crits).and_then(|m| crit_plan(game, &m));
    let Some(plan) = plan else {
        match rotate {
            Some((yaw, pitch)) => turn_then("Attack", yaw, pitch, move |game| strike(game, id)),
            None => strike(game, id),
        }
        return;
    };
    with(|s| {
        s.crit_target = Some(id);
        s.crit_ticks = 0;
        s.crit_falls = 0;
        s.crit_again = false;
        s.crit_look = rotate;
    });
    if game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.sprinting) && CRIT_SPRINT.swap(CRIT_SPRINT_STOPPED, Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 {
        sprint_command(game, 2);
    }
    start_crit(game, plan);
}

// The hop starts, or the jump, or the wait for the fall.
fn start_crit(game: &mut Game<'_>, plan: Crit) {
    match plan {
        Crit::Hop(height) => {
            CRIT_HOP.store(height.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
            // The look rides on the hop's packets, and the hit follows them.
            if let Some((yaw, pitch)) = with(|s| s.crit_look.take()) {
                turn("Attack", yaw, pitch);
            }
            CRIT_STAGE.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            return;
        }
        Crit::Jump => CRIT_JUMP.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed),
        Crit::MiniJump => {
            if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
                p.velocity.y = 0.25;
            }
        }
        Crit::Fall => {}
    }
    CRIT_STAGE.store(CRIT_FALL, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

// Criticals on your own clicks (the attack hook): the hit the game would make on a mob, nearer than a block, a
// projectile it would turn or an object, waits as Kill Aura's does, and the click does nothing more now; while a hit
// waits, clicks do nothing. None: the game's own attack.
pub(super) fn crit_click(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> Option<bool> {
    let m = with(|s| s.module("Criticals").filter(|m| m.on && !m.b("Only Kill Aura")).cloned())?;
    if game.remote.is_none() || game.spectator() || game.clicks.miss_time > 0 {
        return None;
    }
    if CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) != 0 {
        return Some(false);
    }
    if game.held().is_some_and(|s| horizon_client::spear::Kinetic::of(&s.item).is_some()) {
        return None;
    }
    let (i, distance) = game.mob_hit()?;
    let projectile = game.redirectable_hit().is_some_and(|(_, d)| d <= distance);
    let object = game.remote_object_hit(true).is_some_and(|hit| hit.distance < distance);
    if projectile || object || !game.before_block(distance) {
        return None;
    }
    crit_plan(game, &m)?;
    let id = game.mobs[i].id;
    attack(game, id, true, None);
    Some(false)
}

// Hits wait for the start of the next tick: the game's own attack goes out with the input, before the tick's move
// packet, and modules run after it. By then the server also has the look the last move packet carried. A critical
// hit is marked: the sprint it stopped comes back the tick after it goes. The weapon Auto Weapon wants for a hit goes
// in hand at the start of the next tick, before its move packet as a hotbar key does, and the hit a tick after that
// (Horizon's server hits with what was held as its tick began); it goes back at the start of the tick after the hit,
// or that many ticks later with Back after A delay (`back`: the slot, the weapon's slot it replaces if still held,
// and the tick it may go back). Nothing changes slot after a tick's move packet (Grim's Post) or after a hit in the
// same tick (Grim's PacketOrderE).
struct Strikes {
    queue: Vec<(u32, bool)>,
    weapon: Option<StrikeWeapon>,
    back: Option<(usize, usize, u64)>,
    // Stun slam's mace hit (target, mace slot, the axe hit's tick): it goes at the start of the tick after the axe's.
    slam: Option<(u32, usize, u64)>,
}

// The weapon for the hits waiting: its slot, the delay before it goes back (None: it stays), and the slot it replaced
// once it is in hand.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct StrikeWeapon {
    slot: usize,
    back_after: Option<u64>,
    replaced: Option<usize>,
}

static STRIKES: Mutex<Strikes> = Mutex::new(Strikes { queue: Vec::new(), weapon: None, back: None, slam: None });

fn strikes<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Strikes) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut STRIKES.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// A new world or life, Sunset off: nothing waiting goes out, no slot goes back.
fn drop_strikes() {
    strikes(|s| {
        s.queue.clear();
        s.weapon = None;
        s.back = None;
        s.slam = None;
    });
}

pub(super) fn strike(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    queue_strike(game, id, false);
}

// Decided after the tick's move packet: the hit and its weapon both go at the start of the next tick, the slot first,
// as a hotbar key before a click (a slot change after the move packet is what Grim's Post check flags).
fn queue_strike(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32, critical: bool) {
    let first = strikes(|s| s.queue.is_empty() && s.weapon.is_none());
    let weapon = first
        .then(|| super::sunset_melee::strike_weapon(game, id))
        .flatten()
        .map(|(slot, back_after)| StrikeWeapon { slot, back_after, replaced: None });
    strikes(|s| {
        s.queue.push((id, critical));
        s.weapon = s.weapon.or(weapon);
    });
}

// A hit is on its way: the attack cooldown has not restarted yet, so nothing else may hit this tick.
pub(super) fn strike_waiting() -> bool {
    strikes(|s| !s.queue.is_empty() || s.slam.is_some())
}

// Hits go out this tick (not only their weapon), Stun slam's mace hit among them.
fn strike_due() -> bool {
    strikes(|s| (!s.queue.is_empty() && s.weapon.is_none_or(|w| w.replaced.is_some())) || s.slam.is_some())
}

// The start of a tick after a hit, before any hit or use in it: the hotbar slot the hit's weapon replaced comes back.
fn strike_weapon_back(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let ticks = game.ticks;
    if let Some((slot, weapon, _)) =
        strikes(|s| (s.queue.is_empty() && s.slam.is_none() && s.back.is_some_and(|b| ticks >= b.2)).then(|| s.back.take()).flatten())
        && game.selected == weapon
    {
        hold(game, slot);
    }
}

fn send_strikes(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if strikes(|s| s.queue.is_empty()) {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(slot) = strikes(|s| s.weapon.filter(|w| w.replaced.is_none()).map(|w| w.slot)) {
        let replaced = game.selected;
        hold(game, slot);
        strikes(|s| s.weapon = s.weapon.map(|w| StrikeWeapon { replaced: Some(replaced), ..w }));
        return;
    }
    if let Some(StrikeWeapon { slot, back_after: Some(delay), replaced: Some(replaced) }) = strikes(|s| s.weapon.take())
        && game.selected == slot
    {
        strikes(|s| s.back = s.back.or(Some((replaced, slot, game.ticks + 1 + delay))));
    }
    for (id, critical) in strikes(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.queue)) {
        if game.remote.is_some() {
            strike_now(game, id);
        }
        if critical {
            crit_done();
        }
    }
}

// Stun slam's second hit, at the start of the tick after the axe's: the mace selected, then its hit. Its slot goes back
// at the start of the next tick.
fn send_slam(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let ticks = game.ticks;
    let Some((id, mace, _)) = strikes(|s| s.slam.take_if(|(_, _, at)| ticks > *at)) else {
        return;
    };
    if game.remote.is_none()
        || !game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.id == id && m.alive() && !m.removed)
        || super::sunset_parity::fake(id)
        || !super::sunset_melee::slam_ready(game, id, mace)
    {
        return;
    }
    let axe = game.selected;
    hold(game, mace);
    game.send(S::Attack(play::Attack { id: id as i32 }));
    game.swing_arm();
    game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
    game.reset_attack_strength();
    strikes(|s| s.back = Some(s.back.map_or((axe, mace, ticks + 1), |(slot, _, _)| (slot, mace, ticks + 1))));
}

fn strike_now(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    // Gone since the hit was decided: the id may be someone else's by now. Fake Player's is no one's on the server.
    if !game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.id == id && m.alive() && !m.removed) || super::sunset_parity::fake(id) {
        return;
    }
    // A spear stabs along the look instead, as the game's own left click does.
    if let Some(kinetic) = game.held().and_then(|s| horizon_client::spear::Kinetic::of(&s.item)) {
        if !game.cannot_attack_with_item(game.hand_strength.ticker, 0) {
            game.send(S::PlayerAction(play::PlayerAction { action: 8, pos: [0; 3], direction: 0, sequence: 0 }));
            game.hand_strength.reset_attack();
            game.swing_hand(horizon_client::first_person::Hand::Main, kinetic.attack_animation());
            game.play_at_feet(kinetic.attack_sound);
        }
    } else {
        super::sunset_melee::spear_pass(game, id);
        let slam = super::sunset_melee::stun_slam(game, id);
        game.send(S::Attack(play::Attack { id: id as i32 }));
        game.swing_arm();
        game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
        game.reset_attack_strength();
        // Stun slam: the mace's hit follows at the start of the next tick (send_slam). A slot change after a hit in
        // the same tick is what Grim's PacketOrderE flags, and the axe keeps the shield down for seconds.
        if let Some(mace) = slam {
            let due = game.ticks;
            strikes(|s| s.slam = Some((id, mace, due)));
        }
    }
}

// The Criticals hop, a tick at a time. The regular position packet of a tick
// becomes the hop (see `outgoing`); when a tick has none, this sends it. Waiting
// for the fall, the hit goes on the second tick in a row that took you down off
// the ground (a server counts no fall on the first one after a jump's top), or
// anyway once you land again or a second passes.
pub(super) fn crit_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let stage = CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if stage == 0 {
        return;
    }
    // The tick of the hit had no move packet to keep off the ground: nothing to do.
    if stage == CRIT_LAND {
        CRIT_STAGE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    let ticks = with(|s| {
        s.crit_ticks += 1;
        s.crit_ticks
    });
    if stage == CRIT_FALL {
        let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
            return;
        };
        let (ground, falling) = (p.ground.on_ground, p.position.y < game.previous_position.y);
        let falls = with(|s| {
            s.crit_falls = if falling && !ground { s.crit_falls + 1 } else { 0 };
            s.crit_falls
        });
        // Landed first (the fall's last move would have had the hit judged on the ground): it starts again from the
        // ground, the way Mode makes it critical there.
        if ground && ticks > 3 && !with(|s| s.crit_again) {
            let plan = with(|s| s.module("Criticals").filter(|m| m.on).cloned()).and_then(|m| crit_plan(game, &m));
            if let Some(plan @ (Crit::Hop(_) | Crit::Jump | Crit::MiniJump)) = plan {
                with(|s| {
                    s.crit_again = true;
                    s.crit_ticks = 0;
                });
                start_crit(game, plan);
                return;
            }
        }
        if (falls >= 2 && !lands_next(game)) || (ground && ticks > 3) || ticks > 20 {
            CRIT_STAGE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
            match with(|s| s.crit_target.take().map(|id| (id, s.crit_look.take()))) {
                Some((id, Some((yaw, pitch)))) => turn_then("Attack", yaw, pitch, move |game| crit_strike(game, id)),
                Some((id, None)) => crit_strike(game, id),
                None => crit_done(),
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if ticks > 6 {
        CRIT_STAGE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        with(|s| s.crit_target = None);
        crit_done();
        return;
    }
    if stage < CRIT_HIT && !MOVED_THIS_TICK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
            return;
        };
        let (x, y, z) = (p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z);
        // outgoing makes it the hop and moves the stage on.
        game.send(S::MovePlayerPos(play::MovePlayerPos { x, y, z, flags: 0 }));
    }
    if CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == CRIT_HIT {
        CRIT_STAGE.store(CRIT_LAND, Ordering::Relaxed);
        match with(|s| s.crit_target.take()) {
            Some(id) => crit_strike(game, id),
            None => crit_done(),
        }
    }
}

// A critical hit, with the sprint stopped since it was planned (CRIT_SPRINT): it gives up sprinting's extra
// knockback, as a critical one does in vanilla.
fn crit_strike(game: &mut Game<'_>, id: u32) {
    queue_strike(game, id, true);
}

// The critical hit went, or none will: the sprint Criticals stopped goes back on next tick.
fn crit_done() {
    let _ = CRIT_SPRINT.compare_exchange(CRIT_SPRINT_STOPPED, CRIT_SPRINT_DUE, Ordering::Relaxed, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

// Before the tick after the hit (its own tick's packets have gone): the sprint Criticals stopped goes back on, if you
// still sprint (else the server already has it right).
fn crit_sprint_back(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if CRIT_SPRINT.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == CRIT_SPRINT_DUE {
        CRIT_SPRINT.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.sprinting) {
            sprint_command(game, 1);
        }
    }
}

// START_SPRINTING (1) or STOP_SPRINTING (2) for the player.
fn sprint_command(game: &mut Game<'_>, action: i32) {
    let me = game.remote.as_ref().map_or(0, |r| r.entity_id);
    game.send(S::PlayerCommand(play::PlayerCommand { id: me, action, data: 0 }));
}

pub(super) fn kill_aura(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, crits: bool) {
    super::sunset_aura::tick(game, m, crits);
}

pub(super) fn trigger_bot(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, crits: bool) {
    if !game.native_playing()
        || game.remote.is_none()
        || (game.using.is_some() && !super::sunset_hands::shielding(game))
        || CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) != 0
        || strike_waiting()
    {
        return;
    }
    let Some((i, _)) = game.mob_hit() else {
        return;
    };
    let mob = &game.mobs[i];
    let (id, kind) = (mob.id, kind_of(mob));
    let want = wanted(m, kind, &mob.kind.id);
    let names = game.remote_player_names();
    let friends = with(|s| s.friends.clone());
    let player = kind == Kind::Player;
    if !want || (player && is_friend(&friends, &names, id)) || super::sunset_util::spared(game, m, id, player) {
        return;
    }
    let mut wait = with(|s| s.trigger_wait);
    let ready = cooldown_ready(game, m, &mut wait);
    with(|s| s.trigger_wait = wait);
    if !ready {
        return;
    }
    attack(game, id, crits, None);
    with(|s| s.trigger_wait = m.n("Delay (ticks)") as u32);
}

// A totem in the hotbar goes to the offhand by selecting it and pressing the
// swap key, as a player would; then the old slot comes back.

// Moves a totem from the hotbar to the offhand: select it, swap hands, select
// the old slot again, then give the server a few ticks to answer.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- packets

// What the send hook does with an outgoing packet.
pub(super) enum Out {
    Pass,
    Drop,
    Replace(S),
}

// A move packet taken apart: where (if it says), the look (if it says), and its flags (bit 0 on the ground, bit 1
// against a wall).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
struct Move {
    at: Option<[f64; 3]>,
    look: Option<(f32, f32)>,
    flags: u8,
}

impl Move {
    fn of(packet: &S) -> Option<Self> {
        Some(match packet {
            S::MovePlayerPos(m) => Self { at: Some([m.x, m.y, m.z]), look: None, flags: m.flags },
            S::MovePlayerPosRot(m) => Self { at: Some([m.x, m.y, m.z]), look: Some((m.yaw, m.pitch)), flags: m.flags },
            S::MovePlayerRot(m) => Self { at: None, look: Some((m.yaw, m.pitch)), flags: m.flags },
            S::MovePlayerStatus(m) => Self { at: None, look: None, flags: m.flags },
            _ => return None,
        })
    }
    fn packet(self) -> S {
        let flags = self.flags;
        match (self.at, self.look) {
            (Some([x, y, z]), Some((yaw, pitch))) => S::MovePlayerPosRot(play::MovePlayerPosRot { x, y, z, yaw, pitch, flags }),
            (Some([x, y, z]), None) => S::MovePlayerPos(play::MovePlayerPos { x, y, z, flags }),
            (None, Some((yaw, pitch))) => S::MovePlayerRot(play::MovePlayerRot { yaw, pitch, flags }),
            (None, None) => S::MovePlayerStatus(play::MovePlayerStatus { flags }),
        }
    }
}

// Outgoing packets: Blink holds moves, Anti Hunger hides sprinting and the ground, No Fall claims the ground as you
// fall (or, in No ground, never), Criticals hops, Flight's anti kick sinks, no move claims the ground with a fall that
// is not yours to pay (settle_fall), and the look modules asked for (turn_then) rides along. Each is a change to the
// tick's own move packet, never another one.
pub(super) fn outgoing(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) -> Out {
    if let Some(changed) = super::sunset_world_parity::outgoing(game, packet) {
        return Out::Replace(changed);
    }
    if ANTI_SPRINT.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
        && let S::PlayerCommand(c) = packet
        && (c.action == 1 || c.action == 2)
    {
        return Out::Drop;
    }
    // A teleport: the server goes on counting from where it put you, though the moves after it are held (Blink) or
    // the next one is far away.
    if let S::AcceptTeleportation(t) = packet {
        fall(|f| f.last = Some(t.y));
        // The server set your look: what it has now is not the last one sent.
        set_last_look(None);
    }
    let Some(sent) = Move::of(packet) else {
        return Out::Pass;
    };
    if BLINK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        BLINK_HELD.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return Out::Drop;
    }
    MOVED_THIS_TICK.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return Out::Pass;
    };
    let mut m = sent;
    let here = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    // What a module tells the server of the ground, if it changes it; and whether No Fall is on to spare you the fall.
    let ground;
    let mut spared = false;
    // Criticals: this tick's move is the hop (stage 1: up, 2: half way down, 3: back down, then the hit's tick where
    // it ended), all off the ground. A jump this tick (your key, Auto Jump) would carry it up with you: the hit waits
    // for the jump's fall instead.
    if (1..CRIT_HIT).contains(&CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) && !p.ground.on_ground && p.velocity.y > 0.0 {
        CRIT_STAGE.store(CRIT_FALL, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let stage = CRIT_STAGE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let hopping = (stage > 0 && stage < CRIT_HIT) || stage == CRIT_LAND;
    if hopping {
        let [x, y, z] = m.at.unwrap_or(here);
        let hop = f64::from_bits(CRIT_HOP.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        let lift = if stage == CRIT_LAND { 0.0 } else { hop * f64::from(3 - stage) / 2.0 };
        m.at = Some([x, y + lift, z]);
        m.flags = 0;
        ground = Some(false);
        CRIT_STAGE.store(if stage == CRIT_LAND { 0 } else { stage + 1 }, Ordering::Relaxed);
    } else {
        // Flight's Packet anti kick: the move carries the position, sunk 0.0313 below the last height sent while it
        // is due and you are in the air (Meteor's antiKickPacket).
        if FLY_PACKET.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            fly_down(game, &mut m, here);
        }
        // The server adds each move's drop to the fall, and a move that says you are on the ground costs what has
        // added up beyond three blocks. No Fall's Packet mode claims the ground on every move down, so the count
        // never passes one move's drop (Meteor's waits for 0.5 blocks a tick, which leaves a fall the server counted
        // before to hurt), and one move drops 3.92 at most, which costs nothing. No ground never claims it. Flying that
        // way claims it all the time. settle_fall has the last word.
        // Anti Hunger hides the ground, but not while you break a block: off the ground the server mines five times
        // slower and refuses the break, so the block comes back (Meteor's skips it then too). Nor once the server
        // has counted a fall, or this move adds one: hidden, every jump and step down would add up to one fall that
        // the first move you are on the ground for makes you pay.
        let falling = !p.ground.on_ground && !p.flying && !p.fall_flying;
        let no_fall = NO_FALL.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let paused = game.creative || (NO_FALL_MACE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && game.held().is_some_and(|s| s.item.ends_with(":mace")));
        spared = no_fall != 0 && !paused;
        ground = if FLIGHT_GROUND.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || (GLIDE_GROUND.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && !p.flying) {
            Some(true)
        } else if no_fall == 1 && !paused && falling && p.velocity.y < 0.0 {
            Some(true)
        } else if no_fall == 2 && !paused {
            Some(false)
        } else if ANTI_GROUND.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
            && (p.fall_distance <= 0.0 || p.flying)
            && super::remote::sunset_remote::breaking(game).is_none()
            && fall_counted(&m) == 0.0
        {
            Some(false)
        } else {
            None
        };
        if let Some(g) = ground {
            m.flags = (m.flags & !1) | u8::from(g);
        }
    }
    let told = settle_fall(game, &m, sent.flags & 1 != 0, ground == Some(true) || spared);
    m.flags = (m.flags & !1) | u8::from(told);
    if ground.is_some() {
        horizon_client::player_sync::sunset_sync::told_ground(told);
    }
    // The look a module asked for, else the player's own back after one (not during the Criticals hop, whose hit
    // follows it).
    let own = (game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let last = last_look();
    let look = turns(|t| {
        if let Some(head) = t.queue.first().filter(|_| !t.carried) {
            t.carried = true;
            let look = wire_look(last, own, head.look);
            t.restore = look != own;
            Some(look)
        } else if t.restore && !hopping {
            t.restore = false;
            Some(own)
        } else {
            None
        }
    });
    if let Some(look) = look {
        m.look = Some(look);
    }
    // A look the server already has is left out (as vape-rs's look through the game's own sender never repeats one):
    // the same look twice in a row is what Grim's AimDuplicateLook catches.
    if m.look.is_some() && m.look == last_look() {
        m.look = None;
    }
    if m.look.is_some() {
        set_last_look(m.look);
    }
    if m == sent { Out::Pass } else { Out::Replace(m.packet()) }
}

// The last look a move packet carried to the server (None after a teleport, which sets it).
static LAST_LOOK: Mutex<Option<(f32, f32)>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn last_look() -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    *LAST_LOOK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

fn set_last_look(look: Option<(f32, f32)>) {
    *LAST_LOOK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = look;
}

// The yaw a look asked for goes out as the game's own does: unbounded and continuous, never folded into ±180 (a fold
// is a 360-degree turn to the server, Grim's AimModulo360). It is taken nearest your own yaw (your own exactly when
// that is what was asked), then nearest the last one sent.
fn wire_look(last: Option<(f32, f32)>, own: (f32, f32), asked: (f32, f32)) -> (f32, f32) {
    let wrap = |d: f32| (d + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0;
    let mut yaw = if asked.0 == own.0 { own.0 } else { own.0 + wrap(asked.0 - own.0) };
    if let Some((sent, _)) = last
        && (yaw - sent).abs() > 180.0
    {
        yaw = sent + wrap(yaw - sent);
    }
    (yaw, asked.1.clamp(-90.0, 90.0))
}

// The yaw the next move packet will carry for a look asked now with `yaw`: what a use packet sent with it says.
pub(super) fn wire_yaw(game: &Game<'_>, yaw: f32) -> f32 {
    wire_look(last_look(), (game.yaw, game.pitch), (yaw, 0.0)).0
}

// ---- the fall the server counts
//
// A server adds up the drop of each move told off the ground, and a move told on it costs what that comes to beyond
// three blocks (a point of health for each whole block past that) and starts it again; water, a ladder or creative
// flight start it again too (Entity.checkFallDamage, LivingEntity.handleOnClimbable). Sunset keeps the same count
// of the moves it lets go, so that no move claims the ground with a fall the server would make you pay for that was
// not yours to pay: one it hid the ground you landed on through (No Fall's No ground, the Criticals hop), or one
// Flight, Glide or No Fall would claim the ground on. That fall is kept: every move goes off the ground until
// something starts the count again, or you die.

struct Fall {
    // The server's count, in blocks.
    counted: f64,
    // The height the last move told, or the last teleport put you at; None at first.
    last: Option<f64>,
    // Part of the count is not yours to pay.
    kept: bool,
}

static FALL: Mutex<Fall> = Mutex::new(Fall { counted: 0.0, last: None, kept: false });

// The most the server lets you land with for nothing: four blocks costs a point (LivingEntity.calculateFallPower adds
// 1.0E-6 to the fall). A move at full falling speed drops 3.92.
const FREE_FALL: f64 = 3.99;

fn fall<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Fall) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut FALL.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// What the server will have counted after this move, if it goes off the ground.
fn fall_counted(m: &Move) -> f64 {
    fall(|f| f.counted + drop_of(f, m))
}

fn drop_of(f: &Fall, m: &Move) -> f64 {
    match (f.last, m.at) {
        (Some(last), Some([_, y, _])) => (last - y).max(0.0),
        _ => 0.0,
    }
}

// The count after a move that tells the server `told` of the ground (`real` is what the game would tell it, and
// `claimed` a module claiming it, or No Fall on): the ground the move should tell. Gliding, a move that drops less
// than half a block brings the count down to one (LivingEntity.travelFallFlying), but a steep dive adds up: No Fall
// can't claim the ground in the glide (the server would end it), so the landing is kept.
fn settle_fall(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Move, real: bool, claimed: bool) -> bool {
    let (Some(p), Some(_)) = (game.player.as_ref(), game.remote.as_ref()) else {
        return m.flags & 1 != 0;
    };
    let cleared = fall_cleared(game);
    fall(|f| {
        let drop = drop_of(f, m);
        let counted = if p.fall_flying && drop < 0.5 { (f.counted + drop).min(1.0) } else { f.counted + drop };
        if let Some([_, y, _]) = m.at {
            f.last = Some(y);
        }
        let mut told = m.flags & 1 != 0;
        if cleared {
            (f.counted, f.kept) = (0.0, false);
            return told;
        }
        if told && counted >= FREE_FALL && (f.kept || claimed) {
            told = false;
            f.kept = true;
        } else if !told && real && counted > 0.0 {
            f.kept = true;
        }
        if told {
            (f.counted, f.kept) = (0.0, false);
        } else {
            f.counted = counted;
        }
        told
    })
}

// Water, a ladder or creative flight: the server starts the count again each tick there, moves or no moves.
fn fall_cleared(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let feet = [p.position.x.floor() as i32, p.position.y.floor() as i32, p.position.z.floor() as i32];
    p.fluids.was_touching_water
        || (game.creative && p.flying)
        || game.spectator()
        || game.block_in_tag("minecraft:climbable", &game.block_name(feet))
}

// Death: the next body has fallen nowhere.
fn fall_died() {
    fall(|f| *f = Fall { counted: 0.0, last: None, kept: false });
}

// Flight's Packet anti kick on the move: while it is due and you are in the air, the height sinks 0.0313 below the
// last one sent (a move without a position gets the player's).
fn fly_down(game: &Game<'_>, m: &mut Move, here: [f64; 3]) {
    let mut at = m.at.unwrap_or(here);
    let bits = FLY_LAST_Y.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let last = f64::from_bits(bits);
    let sinking = at[1] >= last || last - at[1] < 0.03130;
    if FLY_DOWN.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && bits != u64::MAX && sinking && in_the_air(game) {
        at[1] = last - 0.03130;
        m.at = Some(at);
    } else {
        FLY_LAST_Y.store(at[1].to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

// ---- the look the server sees
//
// Rotate in Kill Aura, Nuker, Scaffold and the rest: a module asks for a look and hands over what to do once the server
// has it. The look rides on the tick's own move packet, or in a tick without one on the single one Sunset sends at
// its end, and what was asked runs after that packet has gone (Meteor's Rotations). Servers kick for a second move
// packet in a tick, and some check the look of a click.

type Deed = Box<dyn for<'a, 'b> FnOnce(&'a mut Game<'b>) + Send>;

struct Ask {
    who: &'static str,
    look: (f32, f32),
    deeds: Vec<Deed>,
    // Asked this tick: another ask of the same module joins it instead of replacing it.
    fresh: bool,
}

struct Turns {
    // Oldest first, one a module; one look goes out a tick.
    queue: Vec<Ask>,
    // This tick's move packet carried the first ask's look.
    carried: bool,
    // A look went out that is not the player's own: the next move packet puts the player's back.
    restore: bool,
}

static TURNS: Mutex<Turns> = Mutex::new(Turns { queue: Vec::new(), carried: false, restore: false });

fn turns<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Turns) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut TURNS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// The packets that came since the last tick, to what Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura keep track of.
fn combat_packets(game: &Game<'_>, packets: &[horizon_protocol::packets::play::Clientbound]) {
    use horizon_protocol::packets::play::Clientbound as C;
    for packet in packets {
        super::sunset_loot_guard::packet(game, packet);
        super::sunset_prediction::packet(game, packet);
        super::sunset_crystal_aura::packet(game, packet);
        if matches!(packet, C::Login(_) | C::Respawn(_) | C::PlayerPosition(_)) {
            super::sunset_combat_wire::reset_look();
        }
        super::sunset_combat_inventory::packet(game, packet);
        super::recipe_book::sunset_recipes::packet(packet);
        if let C::SetEntityMotion(p) = packet {
            super::sunset_melee::note_velocity(game, p.id, p.velocity);
            if game.remote.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.entity_id == p.id) {
                super::sunset_lag::knocked();
                super::sunset_render::no_slow_knocked();
            }
        }
    }
}

// Crystal Aura, Anchor Aura and the combat macros let go of what they hold: the hand they switched, a look waiting.
fn combat_cleanup(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    super::sunset_combat_control::prepare_cleanup(game);
    super::sunset_combat_macros::reset(game);
    super::sunset_pvp_bot::release(game);
    drop_strikes();
    super::sunset_melee::cancel(game);
    super::sunset_aura::disabled(game, false);
    super::sunset_combat_inventory::cancel(game);
    super::sunset_combat_control::reset();
    super::sunset_crystal_aura::disabled(game);
    super::sunset_anchor_aura::disabled(game);
    super::sunset_cart::reset(game);
}

// turn_then only when no look waits: Crystal Aura, Anchor Aura and the macros switch the hand in `then`, so an ask
// refused changes nothing. Never while Blink holds the moves.
pub(super) fn try_turn_then(who: &'static str, yaw: f32, pitch: f32,
    then: impl for<'a, 'b> FnOnce(&'a mut Game<'b>) + Send + 'static) -> bool {
    if !yaw.is_finite() || !pitch.is_finite() || BLINK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return false;
    }
    let look = (yaw, pitch.clamp(-90.0, 90.0));
    turns(|t| {
        if t.carried || !t.queue.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }
        t.queue.push(Ask { who, look, deeds: vec![Box::new(then)], fresh: true });
        true
    })
}

// A look is waiting to go out, or on its way.
pub(super) fn turn_pending() -> bool {
    turns(|t| t.carried || !t.queue.is_empty())
}

// What `who` asked to look at, and do, is dropped.
pub(super) fn cancel_turns(who: &str) {
    turns(|t| {
        if t.queue.first().is_some_and(|ask| ask.who == who) {
            t.carried = false;
        }
        t.queue.retain(|ask| ask.who != who);
    });
}

// Has the server see the player look at (yaw, pitch), then does `then`. `who` names the module: what it asks again in
// the same tick goes along under its first look, and an ask from an earlier tick still waiting is replaced.
pub(super) fn turn_then(who: &'static str, yaw: f32, pitch: f32, then: impl for<'a, 'b> FnOnce(&'a mut Game<'b>) + Send + 'static) {
    if !yaw.is_finite() || !pitch.is_finite() {
        return;
    }
    let look = (yaw, pitch.clamp(-90.0, 90.0));
    turns(|t| match t.queue.iter_mut().position(|a| a.who == who) {
        Some(i) if t.queue[i].fresh => t.queue[i].deeds.push(Box::new(then)),
        Some(i) => {
            if i == 0 && t.carried {
                // Its look is on the way already: the new ask waits behind it.
                t.queue.push(Ask { who, look, deeds: vec![Box::new(then)], fresh: true });
            } else {
                t.queue[i] = Ask { who, look, deeds: vec![Box::new(then)], fresh: true };
            }
        }
        None => t.queue.push(Ask { who, look, deeds: vec![Box::new(then)], fresh: true }),
    });
}

// A look alone (Anti AFK's spin).
pub(super) fn turn(who: &'static str, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
    turn_then(who, yaw, pitch, |_| {});
}

// Runs what waited for the look this tick's move packet carried.
fn turned(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let ask = turns(|t| std::mem::take(&mut t.carried).then(|| t.queue.remove(0)));
    for deed in ask.map_or_else(Vec::new, |a| a.deeds) {
        deed(game);
    }
}

// The end of the tick: with no move packet in it, one to carry the first look asked for (or the player's own back),
// and what waited for it.
fn end_turns(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    // The look that packet would carry is the one the server has already: nothing to send, and what waited for it goes.
    // Your own look back waits for the next tick, as it would after a packet (Quiver keeps the look up across its
    // let-go).
    let own = (game.yaw, game.pitch);
    let have = last_look();
    let quiet = !MOVED_THIS_TICK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && !BLINK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let already = quiet
        && have.is_some()
        && turns(|t| match t.queue.first().filter(|_| !t.carried).map(|head| wire_look(have, own, head.look)) {
            Some(look) if Some(look) == have => {
                t.carried = true;
                t.restore = look != own;
                true
            }
            None if t.restore && Some(own) == have => {
                t.restore = false;
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        });
    if already {
        turned(game);
    } else if quiet && turns(|t| !t.queue.is_empty() || t.restore) {
        let ground = game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.ground.on_ground);
        // outgoing puts the look in.
        game.send(S::MovePlayerRot(play::MovePlayerRot { yaw: game.yaw, pitch: game.pitch, flags: u8::from(ground) }));
        turned(game);
    }
    turns(|t| {
        for a in &mut t.queue {
            a.fresh = false;
        }
    });
}

fn in_the_air(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let b = p.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    let f = |v: f64| v.floor() as i32;
    for x in f(lo.x - 0.0625)..=f(hi.x + 0.0625) {
        for y in f(lo.y - 0.0625 - 0.55)..=f(hi.y + 0.0625) {
            for z in f(lo.z - 0.0625)..=f(hi.z + 0.0625) {
                if !super::sunset_util::is_air(game, [x, y, z]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

// Where the player is, as one position packet: what Blink held back is a
// single move to here, as the server takes one position packet a tick.
pub(super) fn flush_blink(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if !BLINK_HELD.swap(false, Ordering::Relaxed) || MOVED_THIS_TICK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let flags = u8::from(p.ground.on_ground) | u8::from(p.collision.horizontal) << 1;
    let (x, y, z) = (p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z);
    game.send(S::MovePlayerPos(play::MovePlayerPos { x, y, z, flags }));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands

pub(super) fn chat(game: &mut Game<'_>, message: &str) -> bool {
    if !game.native_window() || !game.native_on(ID) {
        return false;
    }
    // Hidden, the chat is the game's own but for .panic, which brings Sunset back.
    if HIDDEN.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        if message.trim() != ".panic" {
            return false;
        }
        HIDDEN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        say(game, "Back. Everything is still off.");
        return true;
    }
    let Some(rest) = message.strip_prefix('.') else {
        return false;
    };
    // `..text` sends `.text` as a chat message.
    if rest.starts_with('.') || rest.trim().is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    ensure_loaded(game);
    game.ui.chat.add_recent(message);
    let args: Vec<&str> = rest.split_whitespace().collect();
    run(game, &args);
    true
}

    (".debug [chat lines]", "copy a debug report (chat, anticheat flags, the client's state, the last packets sent) to the clipboard, saved in the mod's data folder too"),
    (".scan [plugins|details|channels|commands|status|run] [page]", "show server-reported findings; run optional Extended checks manually"),
