```rs
pub(super) fn row_h(s: &State, hit: Hit) -> f32 {
    match hit {
        Hit::Setting(i, j) if matches!(s.modules[i].settings[j].value, Value::Num { .. }) => slider_h(),
        _ => row_hh(),
    }
}

// The rows of one panel before scrolling: their offset from the top of its
// body, what they are, and how tall the whole body is.
pub(super) fn panel_body(s: &State, c: usize) -> (Vec<(f32, Hit)>, f32) {
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    let mut y = 0.0;
    let query = norm(&s.gui.search);
    let listed = s.listed();
    for (i, m) in s
        .modules
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, m)| m.category == CATEGORIES[c] && listed(m) && (norm(m.name).contains(&query) || norm(aliases(m.name)).contains(&query)))
    {
        rows.push((y, Hit::Module(i)));
        y += row_hh();
        if s.gui.expanded.contains(&i) {
            rows.push((y, Hit::Bind(i)));
            y += row_hh();
            for j in 0..m.settings.len() {
                if m.setting_visible(j) {
                    let hit = Hit::Setting(i, j);
                    rows.push((y, hit));
                    y += row_h(s, hit);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    (rows, y)
}

// How much of a panel's body shows: what is left of the screen under it.
pub(super) fn body_room(s: &State, c: usize) -> f32 {
    (s.gui.view_h - s.gui.panels[c].y - head_h() - 14.0).max(row_hh() * 3.0)
}

// Each row of every panel in view, top to bottom: its rectangle and what it is. One part way in view is drawn cut.
fn panel_rows(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    if super::sunset_dashboard::on() {
        return super::sunset_dashboard::rows(s);
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for c in 0..CATEGORIES.len() {
        let p = s.gui.panels[c];
        let (rows, _) = panel_body(s, c);
        // A search leaves out the panels with nothing that matches.
        if rows.is_empty() && !s.gui.search.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        out.push(([p.x, p.y, panel_w(), head_h()], Hit::Header(c)));
        if p.collapsed {
            continue;
        }
        let room = body_room(s, c);
        for (off, hit) in rows {
            let top = off - super::sunset_smooth::shown(c, p.scroll);
            let rh = row_h(s, hit);
            if top + rh <= 0.0 || top >= room {
                continue;
            }
            out.push(([p.x, p.y + head_h() + top, panel_w(), rh], hit));
        }
    }
    out
}

// A row of a scrolling list, cut to the part of it in view.
pub(super) fn in_view([x, y, w, h]: [f32; 4], [top, bottom]: [f32; 2]) -> Option<[f32; 4]> {
    let (y0, y1) = (y.max(top), (y + h).min(bottom));
    (y1 > y0).then_some([x, y0, w, y1 - y0])
}

// The rows the pointer can hit: only what shows of each.
fn panel_hits(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    let mut body = super::sunset_dashboard::list_y(s).unwrap_or([f32::MIN, f32::MAX]);
    panel_rows(s)
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(r, hit)| {
            if let Hit::Header(c) = hit {
                body = [r[1] + r[3], r[1] + r[3] + body_room(s, c)];
                return Some((r, hit));
            }
            in_view(r, body).map(|r| (r, hit))
        })
        .collect()
}

// What the pointer can hit: the panels' rows, then the settings window over them.
pub(super) fn gui_rows(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    let mut rows = super::sunset_dashboard::hits(s);
    rows.extend(panel_hits(s));
    rows.extend(window_hits(s));
    rows
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Win {
    module: usize,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    scroll: f32,
    // As it last drew: its description's height, its rows' height and how much of them shows.
    about_h: f32,
    content: f32,
    room: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) enum WinRow {
    Group(&'static str),
    Row(Hit),
}

fn win_w(s: &State) -> f32 {
    (panel_w() * 1.6).max(150.0).min(s.gui.view_w - 8.0)
}

// The window's rows under its title and description, each group under its name: the settings, then the bind.
fn win_body(s: &State, i: usize) -> (Vec<(f32, WinRow)>, f32) {
    let m = &s.modules[i];
    let (bind, general): (Vec<usize>, Vec<usize>) =
        (0..m.settings.len()).filter(|&j| m.setting_visible(j)).partition(|&j| m.settings[j].name == "Bind mode");
    let groups = [
        ("General", general.into_iter().map(|j| Hit::Setting(i, j)).collect::<Vec<_>>()),
        ("Bind", std::iter::once(Hit::Bind(i)).chain(bind.into_iter().map(|j| Hit::Setting(i, j))).collect()),
    ];
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    let mut y = 0.0;
    for (name, hits) in groups.into_iter().filter(|(_, hits)| !hits.is_empty()) {
        rows.push((y, WinRow::Group(name)));
        y += row_hh();
        for hit in hits {
            rows.push((y, WinRow::Row(hit)));
            y += row_h(s, hit);
        }
    }
    (rows, y)
}

fn win_frame(s: &State, w: &Win) -> [f32; 4] {
    [w.x, w.y, win_w(s), head_h() + w.about_h + w.content.min(w.room) + body_pad()]
}

fn win_close(frame: [f32; 4]) -> [f32; 4] {
    [frame[0] + frame[2] - head_h(), frame[1], head_h(), head_h()]
}

// The window's rows in view, and where.
fn win_rows(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], WinRow)> {
    let Some(w) = s.gui.window else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let [x, y, ww, _] = win_frame(s, &w);
    let top = y + head_h() + w.about_h;
    win_body(s, w.module)
        .0
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(off, row)| {
            let rh = match row {
                WinRow::Row(hit) => row_h(s, hit),
                WinRow::Group(_) => row_hh(),
            };
            let at = off - super::sunset_smooth::shown(super::sunset_smooth::WINDOW, w.scroll);
            (at + rh > 0.0 && at < w.room).then_some(([x, top + at, ww, rh], row))
        })
        .collect()
}

// What a click on the window hits: before anything under it.
fn window_hits(s: &State) -> Vec<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    let Some(w) = s.gui.window else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let frame = win_frame(s, &w);
    let mut out = vec![(frame, Hit::WinBody), ([frame[0], frame[1], frame[2], head_h()], Hit::WinTitle), (win_close(frame), Hit::WinClose)];
    let top = frame[1] + head_h() + w.about_h;
    out.extend(win_rows(s).into_iter().filter_map(|(r, row)| match row {
        WinRow::Row(hit) => in_view(r, [top, top + w.room]).map(|r| (r, hit)),
        WinRow::Group(_) => None,
    }));
    out
}

// A number field's width, for its text.
fn field_width(game: &Game<'_>, text: &str) -> f32 {
    (game.native_text_width(text) + 6.0).max(24.0)
}

// A description in lines that fit `width`.
pub(super) fn wrap(game: &Game<'_>, text: &str, width: f32) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for word in text.split_whitespace() {
        match lines.last_mut() {
            Some(l) if game.native_text_width(&format!("{l} {word}")) <= width => {
                l.push(' ');
                l.push_str(word);
            }
            _ => lines.push(word.to_owned()),
        }
    }
    lines
}

// The pointer in the GUI's own coordinates, which GUI scale divides.
fn gui_cursor(game: &Game<'_>) -> (f32, f32) {
    let scale = gui_scale();
    (game.cursor.0 / scale, game.cursor.1 / scale)
}

// A panel's scroll moved by some rows: it always starts on a row, and stops at the first that shows the panel's end.
pub(super) fn snap_scroll(rows: &[(f32, Hit)], content: f32, room: f32, scroll: f32, by: i32) -> f32 {
    let max = (content - room).max(0.0);
    let stops = rows.iter().position(|(off, _)| *off >= max - 0.01).map_or(rows.len(), |i| i + 1);
    let Some(last) = stops.checked_sub(1) else {
        return 0.0;
    };
    let at = rows[..stops].iter().position(|(off, _)| *off >= scroll - 0.01).unwrap_or(last);
    rows[(at as i32 + by).clamp(0, last as i32) as usize].0
}

// The wheel over a panel scrolls it: the top one, where panels overlap.
pub(super) fn gui_wheel(game: &Game<'_>, steps: f32) {
    let at = gui_cursor(game);
    with(|s| {
        // An open picker's list scrolls, wherever the pointer is.
        let (view_w, view_h) = (s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h);
        if let Some(menu) = &mut s.gui.profile_menu {
            menu.scroll((-steps * 3.0) as i32, view_w, view_h);
            return;
        }
        if let Some(Editor { module, setting, draft: Ok(draft), list: Some(picker), .. }) = &mut s.gui.editor {
            use super::sunset_picker as pick;
            let count = match &s.modules[*module].settings[*setting].value {
                Value::Text(t) => pick::rows(picker, t, draft.text()).len(),
                _ => 0,
            };
            let max = pick::max_scroll(count, pick::rect(view_w, view_h));
            picker.scroll = (picker.scroll - steps * pick::ROW * 3.0).clamp(0.0, max);
            return;
        }
        // Over the settings window: it scrolls.
        if let Some(w) = s.gui.window
            && inside(win_frame(s, &w), at)
        {
            let max = (w.content - w.room).max(0.0);
            s.gui.window = Some(Win { scroll: (w.scroll - steps * row_hh() * 2.0).clamp(0.0, max), ..w });
            return;
        }
        if super::sunset_dashboard::on() {
            super::sunset_dashboard::wheel(s, steps, at);
            return;
        }
        for c in (0..CATEGORIES.len()).rev() {
            let p = s.gui.panels[c];
            let (rows, content) = panel_body(s, c);
            if rows.is_empty() && !s.gui.search.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let room = body_room(s, c);
            let shown = if p.collapsed { 0.0 } else { content.min(room) + body_pad() };
            if inside([p.x, p.y, panel_w(), head_h() + shown], at) {
                let by = -steps * 2.0;
                let by = if by > 0.0 { by.ceil() } else { by.floor() } as i32;
                s.gui.panels[c].scroll = snap_scroll(&rows, content, room, p.scroll, by);
                return;
            }
        }
    });
}

pub(super) fn inside(r: [f32; 4], (x, y): (f32, f32)) -> bool {
    x >= r[0] && x < r[0] + r[2] && y >= r[1] && y < r[1] + r[3]
}

pub(super) fn hit_at(s: &State, at: (f32, f32)) -> Option<([f32; 4], Hit)> {
    // The last drawn is the one on top, where panels overlap.
    gui_rows(s).into_iter().rfind(|(r, _)| inside(*r, at))
}

pub(super) fn open_gui(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    release_binds();
    if !game.native_playing() {
        return;
    }
    ensure_loaded(game);
    // The menu is drawn with the HUD: opened while F1 hides it, the HUD comes back.
    game.ui.hide_gui = false;
    game.keys.clear();
    game.capture(false);
    with(|s| {
        s.gui.open = true;
        s.gui.closing = false;
        s.gui.drag = None;
        s.binding = None;
    });
    super::sunset_dashboard::opened();
}

pub(super) fn close_gui(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    with(|s| {
        s.gui.profile_menu = None;
        s.gui.open = false;
        s.gui.closing = false;
        s.gui.drag = None;
        s.gui.editor = None;
        s.gui.window = None;
        s.binding = None;
    });
    save(game);
    if game.screen == Screen::Playing {
        game.capture(true);
    }
}

// The number's own line above a slider: clicks lower than this go to the slider, so the end of the track (and its knob,
// which reaches a little above it) slides instead of opening the number for typing.
fn number_band(r: [f32; 4]) -> f32 {
    r[1] + row_hh() - 4.0
}

// Where a slider's track starts in its row, and how long it is.
fn slider_track(r: [f32; 4]) -> (f32, f32) {
    let x0 = r[0] + indent() + 4.0;
    (x0, (r[0] + r[2] - RIGHT_PAD - x0).max(1.0))
}

// A slider's value from the pointer's place along its row.
pub(super) fn slide(s: &mut State, i: usize, j: usize, r: [f32; 4], x: f32) -> bool {
    let Some(setting) = s.modules[i].settings.get_mut(j) else {
        return false;
    };
    if let Value::Num { v, min, max, step } = &mut setting.value {
        let (x0, track) = slider_track(r);
        let t = ((x - x0) / track).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let n = round_to(*min + f64::from(t) * (*max - *min), *step).clamp(*min, *max);
        let changed = (n - *v).abs() > 1e-9;
        *v = n;
        return changed;
    }
    false
}

pub(super) fn gui_open() -> bool {
    with(|s| s.gui.open)
}

// A key while the GUI is open: a bind being chosen, or Esc and the menu key
// closing it. Every key stops here.
pub(super) fn gui_key(game: &mut Game<'_>, name: &str) {
    if with(|s| s.gui.profile_menu.is_some()) {
        let choice = with(|s| {
            if name == "key.keyboard.escape" {
                // Out of a preview first, then the menu closes.
                if !s.gui.profile_menu.as_mut().is_some_and(super::sunset_profile_menu::Menu::back) {
                    s.gui.profile_menu = None;
                }
                return None;
            }
            let (w, h) = (s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h);
            s.gui.profile_menu.as_mut().and_then(|m| m.key(name, w, h))
        });
        if let Some(choice) = choice {
            profile_menu_choice(game, choice);
        }
        return;
    }
    // The editor takes every key: from the window's event already (text_event), or else here (a key without text of
    // its own, as horizon-ctl's are, types its letter).
    if with(|s| s.gui.editor.is_some() || std::mem::take(&mut s.gui.typed)) {
        let control = game.modifiers.control_key();
        with(|s| {
            if std::mem::take(&mut s.gui.typed) {
                return;
            }
            if name == "key.keyboard.escape" {
                s.gui.editor = None;
                return;
            }
            if name.ends_with("enter") {
                apply_editor(s);
                return;
            }
            let Some(Editor { draft: Ok(draft), list, .. }) = s.gui.editor.as_mut() else {
                return;
            };
            if control && name == "key.keyboard.a" {
                draft.key(EditKey::SelectAll);
            } else if let Some(k) = edit_key(name) {
                draft.key(k);
            } else if let Some(c) = key_char(name).filter(|_| !control) {
                draft.insert(&c.to_string());
            }
            if let Some(picker) = list {
                picker.scroll = 0.0;
            }
        });
        return;
    }
    if let Some(i) = with(|s| s.binding) {
        let chosen = match name {
            "key.keyboard.escape" => {
                with(|s| s.binding = None);
                return;
            }
            "key.keyboard.backspace" | "key.keyboard.delete" => None,
            k => Some(k.to_owned()),
        };
        with(|s| {
            set_bind(s, i, chosen);
            s.binding = None;
        });
        save(game);
        return;
    }
    if name == "key.keyboard.escape" && with(|s| s.gui.window.take().is_some()) {
        // Esc closes the settings window before the menu.
        return;
    }
    if name == "key.keyboard.escape" {
        // The first Esc clears a search; the next closes the GUI.
        with(|s| s.gui.select_all = false);
        if with(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.gui.search)).is_empty() {
            with(|s| s.gui.closing = true);
        }
        return;
    }
    if is_menu_key(game, name) {
        with(|s| s.gui.closing = true);
        return;
    }
    let control = game.modifiers.control_key();
    if name.ends_with("enter") {
        // Enter in the search turns on (or off) the module it found.
        if let Some(i) = with(|s| first_match(s)) {
            toggle(game, i, chat_lines("Toggle messages"));
        }
    } else if control && name == "key.keyboard.a" {
        with(|s| s.gui.select_all = !s.gui.search.is_empty());
    } else if name == "key.keyboard.backspace" || name == "key.keyboard.delete" {
        with(|s| {
            if control || s.gui.select_all {
                s.gui.search.clear();
            } else {
                s.gui.search.pop();
            }
            s.gui.select_all = false;
        });
    } else if let Some(c) = key_char(name)
        && !control
    {
        with(|s| {
            if std::mem::take(&mut s.gui.select_all) {
                s.gui.search.clear();
            }
            if s.gui.search.chars().count() < 20 {
                s.gui.search.push(c);
            }
        });
    }
}

// The module a search points at: an exact name, then a name that starts with it, then one that contains it, then
// one known by another name.
fn first_match(s: &State) -> Option<usize> {
    let query = norm(&s.gui.search);
    if query.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let listed = s.listed();
    s.modules
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, m)| listed(m))
        .filter_map(|(i, m)| {
            let name = norm(m.name);
            let rank = if name == query {
                0
            } else if name.starts_with(&query) {
                1
            } else if name.contains(&query) {
                2
            } else if norm(aliases(m.name)).contains(&query) {
                3
            } else {
                return None;
            };
            Some((rank, i))
        })
        .min()
        .map(|(_, i)| i)
}

// A letter, digit or space typed in the click GUI's search.
pub(super) fn key_char(name: &str) -> Option<char> {
    let k = name.strip_prefix("key.keyboard.")?;
    if k == "space" {
        return Some(' ');
    }
    let mut chars = k.chars();
    let c = chars.next()?;
    (chars.next().is_none() && c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()).then_some(c)
}

// A mouse button pressed while the GUI is open (its release is read from
// the held buttons each frame).
pub(super) fn gui_press(game: &mut Game<'_>, button: winit::event::MouseButton) {
    use winit::event::MouseButton;
    let at = gui_cursor(game);
    if with(|s| s.gui.profile_menu.is_some()) {
        if button == MouseButton::Left {
            let choice = with(|s| {
                let (w, h) = (s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h);
                let menu = s.gui.profile_menu.as_mut()?;
                if menu.closes(at, w, h) {
                    s.gui.profile_menu = None;
                    return None;
                }
                menu.click(at, w, h)
            });
            if let Some(choice) = choice {
                profile_menu_choice(game, choice);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    // The Profiles module's row, either button: the list of saved profiles instead of a toggle or settings.
    if with(|s| {
        s.gui.editor.is_none()
            && s.binding.is_none()
            && hit_at(s, at).is_some_and(|(_, hit)| matches!(hit, Hit::Module(i) if s.modules[i].name == "Profiles"))
    }) {
        let result = super::sunset_profiles::Store::new(game.native_data_dir(ID)).and_then(|store| store.list());
        with(|s| {
            let names = result.as_ref().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            let mut menu = super::sunset_profile_menu::Menu::new(names, s.selection.selected(), s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h);
            menu.error = result.err();
            s.gui.profile_menu = Some(menu);
            s.gui.drag = None;
        });
        return;
    }
    // A bind being chosen takes any button but the left one (which clicks as ever).
    let captured = with(|s| {
        let i = s.binding.filter(|_| button != MouseButton::Left && s.gui.editor.is_none())?;
        set_bind(s, i, Some(horizon_client::keybinds::mouse_name(button)));
        s.binding = None;
        Some(())
    });
    if captured.is_some() {
        save(game);
        return;
    }
    let right = match button {
        MouseButton::Left => false,
        MouseButton::Right => true,
        _ => return,
    };
    let mut toggled = None;
    let mut changed = false;
    with(|s| {
        // The editor is in front of everything: its buttons, nothing else; a picker's rows too.
        if let Some(Editor { module, setting, draft: Ok(draft), list: Some(picker), .. }) = &s.gui.editor {
            use super::sunset_picker as pick;
            let r = pick::rect(s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h);
            let area = pick::list_area(r);
            if !right && inside(pick::done_button(r), at) {
                s.gui.editor = None;
            } else if !right && inside(area, at) {
                let (i, j) = (*module, *setting);
                let row = ((at.1 - area[1] + super::sunset_smooth::shown(super::sunset_smooth::PICKER, picker.scroll)) / pick::ROW) as usize;
                if let Value::Text(t) = &s.modules[i].settings[j].value
                    && let Some((name, _)) = pick::rows(picker, t, draft.text()).get(row)
                {
                    let list = pick::clicked(picker, t, name);
                    s.modules[i].settings[j].value = Value::Text(list);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if s.gui.editor.is_some() {
            let (apply, cancel) = editor_buttons(editor_rect(s.gui.view_w, s.gui.view_h));
            if !right && inside(apply, at) {
                apply_editor(s);
                changed = true;
            } else if !right && inside(cancel, at) {
                s.gui.editor = None;
            }
            return;
        }
        let found = hit_at(s, at);
        // A number being typed: a click in its field leaves it be; anywhere else, it is left as it was.
        if let Some(Editor { module, setting, draft: Ok(draft), inline: true, .. }) = &s.gui.editor {
            let in_field = found.is_some_and(|(r, hit)| {
                hit == Hit::Setting(*module, *setting) && at.0 >= r[0] + r[2] - RIGHT_PAD - field_width(game, draft.text()) && at.1 < number_band(r)
            });
            if in_field {
                return;
            }
            s.gui.editor = None;
        }
        let Some((r, hit)) = found else {
            return;
        };
        // Extra Modules is its switches: either button opens them.
        let right = right || matches!(hit, Hit::Module(i) if s.modules[i].name == super::sunset_extra_modules::NAME);
        match (hit, right) {
            (Hit::WinTitle, false) => {
                if let Some(w) = s.gui.window {
                    s.gui.drag = Some(Drag::Window(at.0 - w.x, at.1 - w.y));
                }
            }
            (Hit::WinClose, false) => s.gui.window = None,
            (Hit::WinBody | Hit::WinTitle | Hit::WinClose, _) => {}
            (Hit::Dash(part), right) => super::sunset_dashboard::press(s, part, right),
            (Hit::Header(c), false) => {
                let p = s.gui.panels[c];
                s.gui.drag = Some(Drag::Panel(c, at.0 - p.x, at.1 - p.y));
            }
            (Hit::Header(c), true) => {
                s.gui.panels[c].collapsed = !s.gui.panels[c].collapsed;
                changed = true;
            }
            (Hit::Module(i), false) => toggled = Some(i),
            (Hit::Module(i), true) if super::sunset_dashboard::on() => {
                super::sunset_dashboard::choose(i);
                s.binding = None;
            }
            (Hit::Module(i), true) if s.module("ClickGUI").is_some_and(|m| m.p("Settings") == "Inline") => {
                if let Some(k) = s.gui.expanded.iter().position(|&e| e == i) {
                    s.gui.expanded.remove(k);
                } else {
                    s.gui.expanded.push(i);
                }
            }
            // Its own window, in the middle at first (the same module again closes it).
            (Hit::Module(i), true) => {
                s.gui.window = match s.gui.window {
                    Some(w) if w.module == i => None,
                    _ => Some(Win { module: i, x: (s.gui.view_w - win_w(s)) / 2.0, y: 40.0, scroll: 0.0, about_h: 0.0, content: 0.0, room: 0.0 }),
                };
                s.binding = None;
            }
            (Hit::Bind(i), false) => s.binding = if s.binding == Some(i) { None } else { Some(i) },
            (Hit::Bind(i), true) => {
                s.modules[i].key = None;
                s.binding = None;
                changed = true;
            }
            (Hit::Setting(i, j), right) => {
                let number = match s.modules[i].settings[j].value {
                    Value::Num { v, .. } => Some(v),
                    _ => None,
                };
                // A click on the number: it is typed instead (all of it selected, so typing replaces it).
                if let (Some(v), false) = (number, right)
                    && at.0 >= r[0] + r[2] - RIGHT_PAD - game.native_text_width(&num(v)) - 3.0
                    && at.1 < number_band(r)
                {
                    let mut draft = Draft::new(&num(v));
                    if let Ok(d) = &mut draft {
                        d.key(EditKey::SelectAll);
                    }
                    s.gui.editor = Some(Editor { module: i, setting: j, draft, inline: true, list: None });
                    s.gui.drag = None;
                    s.binding = None;
                } else if number.is_some() && !right {
                    s.gui.drag = Some(Drag::Slider(i, j, r, gui_scale()));
                    changed = slide(s, i, j, r, at.0);
                } else if number.is_some() {
                    // Right click on a slider: back to its default.
                    let fresh = defaults().swap_remove(i).settings.swap_remove(j);
                    s.modules[i].settings[j] = fresh;
                    changed = true;
                } else if let (Value::Text(t), false) = (&s.modules[i].settings[j].value, right) {
                    // A list of blocks, items or entities opens the picker (the draft is its search), other text the
                    // editor.
                    let m = &s.modules[i];
                    let list = super::sunset_picker::list_kind(m.name, m.settings[j].name).map(|k| {
                        if m.name == "Xray" && m.p("List") == "Simple" {
                            super::sunset_picker::short_list(super::sunset_picker::VALUABLES)
                        } else {
                            super::sunset_picker::open(game, k)
                        }
                    });
                    let draft = if list.is_some() { Draft::new("") } else { Draft::new(t) };
                    s.gui.editor = Some(Editor { module: i, setting: j, draft, inline: false, list });
                    s.gui.drag = None;
                    s.binding = None;
                } else {
                    s.modules[i].settings[j].click(right);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    });
    if let Some(i) = toggled {
        toggle(game, i, false);
    } else if changed {
        save(game);
    }
}

// A drag follows the pointer each frame.
pub(super) fn follow_drag(game: &Game<'_>, w: f32, h: f32) {
    let at = gui_cursor(game);
    with(|s| match s.gui.drag {
        Some(Drag::Panel(c, dx, dy)) => {
            let p = &mut s.gui.panels[c];
            p.x = (at.0 - dx).clamp(0.0, (w - panel_w()).max(0.0));
            p.y = (at.1 - dy).clamp(0.0, (h - head_h()).max(0.0));
        }
        Some(Drag::Slider(i, j, r, scale)) => {
            // The look follows as it is dragged, but for what moves the panels: that waits for the release (save).
            let layout = s.modules[i].name == "ClickGUI" && matches!(s.modules[i].settings[j].name, "Panel width" | "GUI scale" | "Text indent");
            if slide(s, i, j, r, game.cursor.0 / scale) && !layout {
                sync_flags(s);
            }
        }
        Some(Drag::Window(dx, dy)) => {
            if let Some(win) = &mut s.gui.window {
                (win.x, win.y) = (at.0 - dx, at.1 - dy);
            }
        }
        None => {}
    });
    // The left button came up: the drag ends where the pointer is.
    if !game.physical_buttons.contains(&winit::event::MouseButton::Left)
        && with(|s| s.gui.drag.take().is_some())
    {
        save(game);
    }
}

// What the menu's text measured: its rows measure the same words every frame. Each entry is by the text and, for a cut,
// the room it was cut to. Kept until the font changes, or there are too many (numbers being dragged).
#[derive(Default)]
struct Measured {
    font: f32,
    widths: std::collections::HashMap<u64, f32>,
    cuts: std::collections::HashMap<(u64, u32), String>,
}

static MEASURED: Mutex<Option<Measured>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn measured<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Measured) -> R) -> R {
    f(MEASURED.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Measured::default))
}

// Once a frame, while the menu draws.
fn check_measured(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let font = game.native_text_width("Mm");
    measured(|m| {
        if m.font != font || m.widths.len() + m.cuts.len() > 4096 {
            *m = Measured { font, ..Measured::default() };
        }
    });
}

fn text_key(text: &str) -> u64 {
    use std::hash::{Hash as _, Hasher as _};
    let mut hasher = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
    text.hash(&mut hasher);
    hasher.finish()
}

// A menu row's text width.
fn width_of(game: &Game<'_>, text: &str) -> f32 {
    let key = text_key(text);
    if let Some(width) = measured(|m| m.widths.get(&key).copied()) {
        return width;
    }
    let width = game.native_text_width(text);
    measured(|m| m.widths.insert(key, width));
    width
}

// The text, cut to `max` wide with "..." when it is wider.
pub(super) fn fit_to(game: &Game<'_>, text: &str, max: f32) -> String {
    let key = (text_key(text), max.to_bits());
    if let Some(cut) = measured(|m| m.cuts.get(&key).cloned()) {
        return cut;
    }
    let cut = if game.native_text_width(text) <= max {
        text.to_owned()
    } else {
        let mut t = text.to_owned();
        while !t.is_empty() && game.native_text_width(&format!("{t}...")) > max {
            t.pop();
        }
        format!("{t}...")
    };
    measured(|m| m.cuts.insert(key, cut.clone()));
    cut
}

// The list picker over the panels: its title, the search box, the rows (a lit mark on the chosen ones, which come
// first) and Done.
fn draw_picker(game: &Game<'_>, w: f32, h: f32, edit: &Editor, picker: &super::sunset_picker::Picker, modules: &[Module], at: (f32, f32), out: &mut Vec<Shape>) {
    use super::sunset_picker as pick;
    let fit = |text: &str, max: f32| fit_to(game, text, max);
    let solid = |rgb: u32| 0xFF00_0000 | rgb;
    let r = pick::rect(w, h);
    let [x, y, rw, _] = r;
    let room = (rw - 16.0).max(0.0);
    let control = control_radius();
    out.push(Shape::Fill([0.0, 0.0, w, h], 0x9000_0000));
    out.push(Shape::Round(r, panel_radius(), 0xF814_1414));
    let m = &modules[edit.module];
    out.push(Shape::Head(fit(&format!("{} / {}", m.name, m.settings[edit.setting].name), room), [x + 8.0, y + 6.0], accent()));
    let search = edit.draft.as_ref().map_or("", Draft::text);
    out.push(Shape::Round([x + 6.0, y + 22.0, rw - 12.0, 16.0], panel_radius(), 0xFF08_0808));
    let (shown, colour) = if search.is_empty() { ("Type to search", 0x909090) } else { (search, 0xFFFFFF) };
    out.push(Shape::Text(fit(shown, room - 4.0), [x + 10.0, y + 22.0 + text_y(16.0)], colour));
    let text = match &m.settings[edit.setting].value {
        Value::Text(t) => t.as_str(),
        _ => "",
    };
    let rows = pick::rows(picker, text, search);
    let area = pick::list_area(r);
    let mut icons = Vec::new();
    let scroll = super::sunset_smooth::shown(super::sunset_smooth::PICKER, picker.scroll).min(pick::max_scroll(rows.len(), r));
    let first = (scroll / pick::ROW) as usize;
    out.push(Shape::ClipStart);
    for (n, (name, have)) in rows.iter().enumerate().skip(first) {
        let ry = area[1] + n as f32 * pick::ROW - scroll;
        if ry >= area[1] + area[3] {
            break;
        }
        let row = [area[0], ry, area[2], pick::ROW];
        if inside(row, at) {
            out.push(Shape::Round(row, control, 0x40FF_FFFF));
        }
        out.push(Shape::Round([area[0] + 3.0, ry + 3.0, 6.0, 6.0], 3.0, if *have { solid(accent()) } else { 0xFF3A_3A3A }));
        // The block's, item's or mob's icon (only the rows on screen are drawn), then its name.
        let icon = pick::icon(game, picker, name, [area[0] + 13.0, ry + 1.0], pick::ROW - 2.0);
        let left = if icon.is_some() { 26.0 } else { 14.0 };
        // An icon can't be cut, so it waits outside the cut part until its row is all in view.
        icons.extend(icon.filter(|_| ry >= area[1] && ry + pick::ROW <= area[1] + area[3]));
        let label = if picker.kind == pick::ListKind::Players { (*name).to_owned() } else { pick::readable(name) };
        out.push(Shape::Text(fit(&label, area[2] - left - 4.0), [area[0] + left, ry + text_y(pick::ROW)], 0xFFFFFF));
    }
    out.push(Shape::ClipEnd([area[0], area[1], area[0] + area[2], area[1] + area[3]]));
    out.extend(icons);
    let chosen = rows.iter().filter(|(_, have)| *have).count();
    let note = format!("{chosen} chosen, {} more. Click to add or take away; Esc closes.", rows.len() - chosen);
    let done = pick::done_button(r);
    out.push(Shape::Text(fit(&note, done[0] - x - 12.0), [x + 8.0, done[1] + text_y(done[3])], 0x909090));
    out.push(Shape::Round(done, panel_radius(), solid(accent())));
    let tw = game.native_text_width("Done");
    out.push(Shape::Text("Done".to_owned(), [done[0] + (done[2] - tw) / 2.0, done[1] + text_y(done[3])], 0xFFFFFF));
}

pub(super) fn draw_gui(game: &Game<'_>, modules: &[Module], w: f32, h: f32, px: f32, out: &mut Vec<Shape>) {
    check_measured(game);
    follow_drag(game, w, h);
    with(|s| {
        use super::sunset_smooth as smooth;
        super::sunset_dashboard::prepare(s);
        let mut targets = [None; smooth::SLOTS];
        for (target, p) in targets.iter_mut().zip(&s.gui.panels) {
            *target = Some(p.scroll);
        }
        targets[smooth::WINDOW] = s.gui.window.map(|w| w.scroll);
        targets[smooth::DASHBOARD] = Some(super::sunset_dashboard::list_scroll());
        targets[smooth::PANE] = Some(super::sunset_dashboard::pane_scroll());
        targets[smooth::PICKER] = s.gui.editor.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.list.as_ref()).map(|p| p.scroll);
        smooth::frame(targets);
    });
    // The panels are as wide as asked, or as wide as lets all of them sit in a row.
    let fits = ((w - 4.0 - 3.0 * (CATEGORIES.len() as f32 - 1.0)) / CATEGORIES.len() as f32).floor();
    let width = f32::from_bits(LOOK[1].load(Ordering::Relaxed)).min(fits).max(50.0);
    let before = LOOK[4].swap(width.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let was = f32::from_bits(before);
    with(|s| {
        s.gui.view_h = h;
        s.gui.view_w = w;
        if before != 0 && was != width {
            // Another width: the panels spread or close up and a layout of your own keeps its shape.
            let k = (width + 3.0) / (was + 3.0);
            for p in s.gui.panels.iter_mut().filter(|p| p.x >= 0.0) {
                p.x = (2.0 + (p.x - 2.0) * k).max(0.0);
            }
        }
        // Panels with no place yet go left to right, in a second row when the
        // window is narrow.
        let mut x = 2.0;
        let mut y = 32.0;
        for p in s.gui.panels.iter_mut().filter(|p| p.x < 0.0) {
            if x + panel_w() > w {
                x = 2.0;
                y += head_h() + 3.0;
            }
            (p.x, p.y) = (x, y);
            x += panel_w() + 3.0;
        }
        for p in &mut s.gui.panels {
            p.x = p.x.clamp(0.0, (w - panel_w()).max(0.0));
            p.y = p.y.clamp(0.0, (h - head_h()).max(0.0));
        }
        // The Dashboard has no panels to keep in order.
        if super::sunset_dashboard::on() {
            return;
        }
        // A scroll past the end (a shorter body, a taller window) comes back.
        for c in 0..CATEGORIES.len() {
            let (rows, content) = panel_body(s, c);
            let room = body_room(s, c);
            s.gui.panels[c].scroll = snap_scroll(&rows, content, room, s.gui.panels[c].scroll, 0);
        }
    });
    // The settings window: its description in lines, sized to what it holds and kept on the screen where it is, 4
    // short of the bottom: a taller one scrolls (three rows at least, moved up if need be). The description takes
    // three lines at most, the last cut short (its module's tooltip has it all).
    let about = with(|s| s.gui.window.map(|w| (s.modules[w.module].about, win_w(s)))).map_or_else(Vec::new, |(text, ww)| {
        let mut lines = wrap(game, text, ww - 2.0 * indent());
        if lines.len() > 3 {
            let rest = lines.split_off(2).join(" ");
            lines.push(fit_to(game, &rest, ww - 2.0 * indent()));
        }
        lines
    });
    let window = with(|s| {
        let mut win = s.gui.window?;
        win.about_h = if about.is_empty() { 0.0 } else { about.len() as f32 * 10.0 + 4.0 };
        win.content = win_body(s, win.module).1;
        win.room = (h - 4.0 - win.y.max(0.0) - head_h() - win.about_h - body_pad()).max(row_hh() * 3.0);
        win.scroll = win.scroll.clamp(0.0, (win.content - win.room).max(0.0));
        let [_, _, ww, wh] = win_frame(s, &win);
        win.x = win.x.clamp(0.0, (w - ww).max(0.0));
        win.y = win.y.clamp(0.0, (h - wh).max(0.0));
        s.gui.window = Some(win);
        Some((win, win_frame(s, &win), win_rows(s), about))
    });
    let at = gui_cursor(game);
    let (rows, binding, hover, editing) =
        with(|s| (panel_rows(s), s.binding, hit_at(s, at).map(|(_, h)| h), s.gui.editor.clone()));
    // Modules whose settings are open (inline or in the window): a mark by the name.
    let open: Vec<usize> = with(|s| s.gui.expanded.iter().copied().chain(s.gui.window.map(|w| w.module)).collect());
    // Each panel's height of rows, room, scroll and whether it is folded.
    let bodies: Vec<(f32, f32, f32, bool)> = with(|s| {
        (0..CATEGORIES.len())
            .filter(|_| !super::sunset_dashboard::on())
            .map(|c| (panel_body(s, c).1, body_room(s, c), super::sunset_smooth::shown(c, s.gui.panels[c].scroll), s.gui.panels[c].collapsed))
            .collect()
    });
    let fit = |text: &str, max: f32| fit_to(game, text, max);
    let solid = |rgb: u32| 0xFF00_0000 | rgb;
    let control = control_radius();
    let dash = super::sunset_dashboard::on();
    // The label on the left of a row, cut short of what sits to its right: whether it had to be.
    let label = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, text: &str, r: [f32; 4], x: f32, right: f32, colour: u32| -> bool {
        let room = r[0] + r[2] - RIGHT_PAD - right - x - 3.0;
        let shown = fit(text, room);
        let cut = shown != text;
        out.push(Shape::Text(shown, [x, r[1] + text_y(row_hh())], colour));
        cut
    };
    // A value in its rounded box at the right of a row; how wide it is.
    let value_box = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, text: &str, r: [f32; 4], colour: u32| -> f32 {
        let text = fit(text, r[2] * 0.5);
        let tw = width_of(game, &text);
        let bw = tw + 8.0;
        let bx = r[0] + r[2] - RIGHT_PAD - bw;
        out.push(Shape::Round([bx, r[1] + 2.0, bw, row_hh() - 4.0], control, 0xFF1E_1E1E));
        out.push(Shape::Text(text, [bx + 4.0, r[1] + text_y(row_hh())], colour));
        bw
    };
    // A number being typed in its slider row: the field's width (the draft and its caret are drawn in it).
    let typing = |i: usize, j: usize| editing.as_ref().filter(|e| e.inline && e.module == i && e.setting == j).and_then(|e| e.draft.as_ref().ok());
    // One row of a panel or of the settings window: what it shows, and its name when it had to be cut short.
    let draw_row = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, r: [f32; 4], hit: Hit, hovered: bool| -> Option<&'static str> {
        let [x, y, rw, rh] = r;
        let setting_x = x + indent() + 4.0;
        match hit {
            Hit::Module(i) => {
                let m = &modules[i];
                // A bound key shows at the row's end.
                let tag = m.key.as_deref().map(|k| fit(&key_label(Some(k)), 30.0)).unwrap_or_default();
                let tag_w = if tag.is_empty() { 0.0 } else { width_of(game, &tag) };
                // The name clears the mark of open settings at any Text indent.
                let name_x = x + indent().max(6.0);
                if open.contains(&i) && !dash {
                    out.push(Shape::Round([name_x - 5.0, y + 3.0, 2.0, rh - 6.0], 1.0, 0xFFE4_E4E4));
                }
                if !tag.is_empty() {
                    out.push(Shape::Text(tag, [x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - tag_w, y + text_y(rh)], 0x707070));
                }
                (label(out, m.name, r, name_x, tag_w, if m.on { accent() } else { 0xE4E4E4 }) && hovered).then_some(m.name)
            }
            Hit::Bind(i) => {
                let waiting = binding == Some(i);
                let key = if waiting { "Press a key or button".to_owned() } else { key_label(modules[i].key.as_deref()) };
                let bw = value_box(out, &key, r, if waiting { accent() } else { 0xC8C8C8 });
                label(out, "Bind", r, setting_x, bw, 0xB4B4B4);
                None
            }
            Hit::Setting(i, j) => {
                let st = &modules[i].settings[j];
                let right = match st.value {
                    Value::Bool(b) => {
                        let (tw, th) = (14.0, 8.0);
                        let (tx, ty) = (x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - tw, y + (rh - th) / 2.0);
                        // Off is the same pill in grey; on follows the accent colour.
                        out.push(Shape::Round([tx, ty, tw, th], control, if b { solid(accent()) } else { 0xFF5A_5A5A }));
                        let knob = th - 2.0;
                        let kx = if b { tx + tw - knob - 1.0 } else { tx + 1.0 };
                        out.push(Shape::Round([kx, ty + 1.0, knob, knob], (control - 1.0).max(0.0), 0xFF10_1010));
                        tw
                    }
                    Value::Num { v, min, max, .. } => {
                        let vw = match typing(i, j) {
                            Some(draft) => {
                                let fw = field_width(game, draft.text());
                                let fx = x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - fw + 3.0;
                                let colour = match (draft.error, draft.selected()) {
                                    (Some(_), _) => 0xFF60_2020,
                                    (None, true) => 0xFF30_60B0,
                                    (None, false) => 0xFF08_0808,
                                };
                                out.push(Shape::Round([fx - 3.0, y + 1.0, fw, row_hh() - 2.0], control, colour));
                                out.push(Shape::Text(draft.text().to_owned(), [fx, y + text_y(row_hh())], 0xFFFFFF));
                                let caret = game.native_text_width(&draft.text()[..draft.caret()]);
                                out.push(Shape::Fill([fx + caret, y + 3.0, 1.0, row_hh() - 6.0], solid(accent())));
                                fw
                            }
                            None => {
                                let value = st.value_text();
                                let vw = width_of(game, &value);
                                out.push(Shape::Text(value, [x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - vw, y + text_y(row_hh())], 0xE4E4E4));
                                vw
                            }
                        };
                        let (tx, track) = slider_track(r);
                        let t = if max > min { ((v - min) / (max - min)) as f32 } else { 0.0 };
                        let ty = y + row_hh();
                        out.push(Shape::Round([tx, ty, track, 2.0], 1.0, 0xFF2A_2A2A));
                        out.push(Shape::Round([tx, ty, track * t, 2.0], 1.0, solid(accent())));
                        out.push(Shape::Round([tx + track * t - 2.5, ty - 1.5, 5.0, 5.0], control.min(2.5), 0xFFE4_E4E4));
                        vw
                    }
                    Value::Pick { .. } => value_box(out, &st.value_text(), r, 0xE4E4E4),
                    Value::Text(_) => {
                        // The text itself: the name keeps its width, the text gets what is left (a quarter at least).
                        let room = x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - setting_x - width_of(game, st.name) - 6.0;
                        let value = fit(&st.value_text(), room.max(rw * 0.25));
                        let vw = width_of(game, &value);
                        out.push(Shape::Text(value, [x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - vw, y + text_y(row_hh())], 0xE4E4E4));
                        vw
                    }
                };
                (label(out, st.name, r, setting_x, right, 0xB4B4B4) && hovered).then_some(st.name)
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    };
    // The pointer's row lit edge to edge, between the lines; at the bottom of a panel, down to its rounded corners.
    let lit = |out: &mut Vec<Shape>, [x, y, rw, rh]: [f32; 4], line: bool, last: bool| {
        let top = if line { px } else { 0.0 };
        let r = [x, y + top, rw, rh - top + if last { body_pad() } else { 0.0 }];
        out.push(Shape::Corners(r, panel_radius(), [false, false, last, last], 0x14FF_FFFF));
    };
    if dash {
        with(|s| super::sunset_dashboard::back(s, game, hover, px, out));
    }
    let mut whole: Option<&str> = None;
    let mut first_row = false;
    // The list the rows scroll in, top and bottom: a row part way out of it is cut.
    let mut body = with(|s| super::sunset_dashboard::list_y(s)).unwrap_or([f32::MIN, f32::MAX]);
    for (k, (r, hit)) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
        let [x, y, rw, rh] = *r;
        let hovered = hover == Some(*hit);
        let cut = !matches!(hit, Hit::Header(_)) && (y < body[0] || y + rh > body[1]);
        if cut {
            out.push(Shape::ClipStart);
        }
        let line = if let Hit::Header(_) = hit {
            first_row = true;
            false
        } else if std::mem::take(&mut first_row) {
            // The header's line is under it already.
            false
        } else if dash && y <= body[0] + 0.01 {
            // The first row of a Dashboard column.
            false
        } else {
            out.push(Shape::Fill([x, y, rw, px], 0x12FF_FFFF));
            true
        };
        if let Hit::Header(c) = *hit {
            let (content, room, scroll, folded) = bodies[c];
            body = [y + rh, y + rh + room];
            let body = if folded || content <= 0.0 { 0.0 } else { content.min(room) + body_pad() };
            out.push(Shape::Round([x, y, rw, rh + body], panel_radius(), bg(0xC00E_0E0E)));
            if body > 0.0 {
                out.push(Shape::Fill([x, y + rh - px, rw, px], 0x24FF_FFFF));
            }
            let name = CATEGORIES[c].label();
            let on = modules.iter().filter(|m| m.category == CATEGORIES[c] && m.on).count();
            let count = format!("{on}");
            let cw = game.native_text_width(&count);
            out.push(Shape::Head(fit(name, rw - indent() - RIGHT_PAD - cw - 3.0), [x + indent(), y + text_y(rh)], 0xFFFFFF));
            out.push(Shape::Text(count, [x + rw - RIGHT_PAD - cw, y + text_y(rh)], 0x808080));
            // The scroll marker: how much of the panel shows, and where.
            if !folded && content > room {
                let thumb = (room * room / content).max(10.0);
                let t = (scroll / (content - room)).min(1.0);
                out.push(Shape::Round([x + rw - 4.0, y + rh + 1.0 + (room - 2.0 - thumb) * t, 2.0, thumb], 1.0, 0x70FF_FFFF));
            }
            continue;
        }
        if dash {
            // A Dashboard row fades as the pointer comes and goes.
            let glow = super::sunset_dashboard::glow(*hit);
            if glow > 0 {
                out.push(Shape::Fill(*r, glow << 24 | 0x00FF_FFFF));
            }
        } else if hovered {
            let last = rows.get(k + 1).is_none_or(|(_, next)| matches!(next, Hit::Header(_)));
            lit(out, *r, line, last);
        }
        let text = if dash && matches!(hit, Hit::Module(_)) { super::sunset_dashboard::module_text(*r) } else { *r };
        if let Some(name) = draw_row(out, text, *hit, hovered) {
            whole = Some(name);
        }
        if cut {
            out.push(Shape::ClipEnd([x, body[0], x + rw, body[1]]));
        }
    }
    // The settings window, over the panels: its title, close button, description, groups and rows.
    if let Some((win, frame, list, about)) = &window {
        let [x, y, ww, wh] = *frame;
        out.push(Shape::Round(*frame, panel_radius(), 0xF812_1212));
        let hh = head_h();
        out.push(Shape::Head(fit(modules[win.module].name, ww - indent() - hh - 4.0), [x + indent(), y + text_y(hh)], accent()));
        // The close button: a cross, lit under the pointer.
        let close = win_close(*frame);
        if hover == Some(Hit::WinClose) {
            out.push(Shape::Corners(close, panel_radius(), [false, true, false, false], 0x24FF_FFFF));
        }
        let (cx, cy, d) = (close[0] + close[2] / 2.0, close[1] + close[3] / 2.0, 3.0);
        for (a, b) in [([cx - d, cy - d], [cx + d, cy + d]), ([cx - d, cy + d], [cx + d, cy - d])] {
            line(out, a, b, 0xFFE4_E4E4, 1.5);
        }
        out.push(Shape::Fill([x, y + hh - px, ww, px], 0x24FF_FFFF));
        for (n, l) in about.iter().enumerate() {
            out.push(Shape::Text(l.clone(), [x + indent(), y + hh + 3.0 + n as f32 * 10.0], 0xA8A8A8));
        }
        let mut line = false;
        let view = [y + hh + win.about_h, y + hh + win.about_h + win.room];
        for (n, (r, row)) in list.iter().enumerate() {
            let cut = r[1] < view[0] || r[1] + r[3] > view[1];
            if cut {
                out.push(Shape::ClipStart);
            }
            match row {
                WinRow::Group(name) => {
                    out.push(Shape::Text((*name).to_owned(), [r[0] + indent(), r[1] + text_y(r[3])], accent()));
                    line = false;
                }
                WinRow::Row(hit) => {
                    if line {
                        out.push(Shape::Fill([r[0], r[1], r[2], px], 0x12FF_FFFF));
                    }
                    let hovered = hover == Some(*hit);
                    if hovered {
                        lit(out, *r, line, n + 1 == list.len() && r[1] + r[3] + body_pad() >= y + wh - 0.5);
                    }
                    if let Some(name) = draw_row(out, *r, *hit, hovered) {
                        whole = Some(name);
                    }
                    line = true;
                }
            }
            if cut {
                out.push(Shape::ClipEnd([r[0], view[0], r[0] + r[2], view[1]]));
            }
        }
        // Its scroll marker.
        let (content, room) = (win.content, win.room);
        if content > room {
            let thumb = (room * room / content).max(10.0);
            let t = (super::sunset_smooth::shown(super::sunset_smooth::WINDOW, win.scroll) / (content - room)).min(1.0);
            out.push(Shape::Round([x + ww - 4.0, y + hh + win.about_h + 1.0 + (room - 2.0 - thumb) * t, 2.0, thumb], 1.0, 0x70FF_FFFF));
        }
    }
    // The hovered module's description, under the pointer.
    if let Some(Hit::Module(i)) = hover
        && with(|s| s.gui.drag.is_none())
        && super::sunset_dashboard::wants_tip(i)
    {
        let text = modules[i].about;
        let about = match whole {
            Some(name) => format!("{name}: {text}"),
            None => text.to_owned(),
        };
        // Wrapped to half the screen and kept on it.
        let lines = wrap(game, &about, (w * 0.5).max(120.0).min(w - 16.0));
        let tw = lines.iter().map(|l| game.native_text_width(l)).fold(0.0, f32::max);
        let th = lines.len() as f32 * 10.0 + 4.0;
        let bx = (at.0 + 8.0).min(w - tw - 8.0).max(0.0);
        let by = (at.1 + 10.0).min(h - th).max(0.0);
        out.push(Shape::Round([bx, by, tw + 8.0, th], panel_radius(), 0xF80A_0A0A));
        for (n, line) in lines.into_iter().enumerate() {
            out.push(Shape::Text(line, [bx + 4.0, by + 3.0 + n as f32 * 10.0], 0xE4E4E4));
        }
    }
    // A setting's name cut short, whole under the pointer.
    if let (Some(Hit::Setting(..)), Some(name)) = (hover, whole) {
        let tw = game.native_text_width(name);
        let bx = (at.0 + 8.0).min(w - tw - 8.0).max(0.0);
        let by = (at.1 + 10.0).min(h - 14.0);
        out.push(Shape::Round([bx, by, tw + 8.0, 14.0], panel_radius(), 0xF80A_0A0A));
        out.push(Shape::Text(name.to_owned(), [bx + 4.0, by + text_y(14.0)], 0xE4E4E4));
    }
    // The list picker, over everything.
    if let Some((edit, picker)) = editing.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.list.as_ref().map(|p| (e, p))) {
        draw_picker(game, w, h, edit, picker, &modules, at, out);
        return;
    }
    // The text editor, over everything.
    if let Some(edit) = editing.filter(|e| !e.inline) {
        let r = editor_rect(w, h);
        let [x, y, rw, _] = r;
        let room = (rw - 16.0).max(0.0);
        out.push(Shape::Fill([0.0, 0.0, w, h], 0x9000_0000));
        out.push(Shape::Round(r, panel_radius(), 0xF814_1414));
        let m = &modules[edit.module];
        out.push(Shape::Head(fit(&format!("{} / {}", m.name, m.settings[edit.setting].name), room), [x + 8.0, y + 6.0], accent()));
        let selected = edit.draft.as_ref().is_ok_and(Draft::selected);
        out.push(Shape::Round([x + 6.0, y + 22.0, rw - 12.0, 16.0], panel_radius(), if selected { 0xFF30_60B0 } else { 0xFF08_0808 }));
        let note = match &edit.draft {
            Ok(draft) => {
                // The end of the text near the caret shows, with the caret at its place.
                let before = &draft.text()[..draft.caret()];
                let mut from = 0;
                while game.native_text_width(&before[from..]) > room - 4.0 {
                    from += before[from..].chars().next().map_or(1, char::len_utf8);
                }
                let shown = fit(&draft.text()[from..], room);
                let caret = game.native_text_width(&before[from..]);
                out.push(Shape::Text(shown, [x + 10.0, y + 22.0 + text_y(16.0)], 0xFFFFFF));
                out.push(Shape::Fill([x + 10.0 + caret, y + 25.0, 1.0, 10.0], solid(accent())));
                draft.error.unwrap_or("Enter or Apply keeps it, Esc or Cancel leaves it as it was")
            }
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        out.push(Shape::Text(fit(note, room), [x + 8.0, y + 41.0], if matches!(&edit.draft, Ok(d) if d.error.is_none()) { 0x909090 } else { 0xFF7070 }));
        let (apply, cancel) = editor_buttons(r);
        for (b, label, colour) in [(apply, "Apply", solid(accent())), (cancel, "Cancel", 0xFF3A_3A3A)] {
            out.push(Shape::Round(b, panel_radius(), colour));
            let tw = game.native_text_width(label);
            out.push(Shape::Text(label.to_owned(), [b[0] + (b[2] - tw) / 2.0, b[1] + text_y(b[3])], 0xFFFFFF));
        }
    }
    // The saved profiles, when the Profiles module's row was clicked.
    with(|s| super::sunset_profile_menu::draw(game, w, h, at, s.selection.selected(), s.gui.profile_menu.as_ref(), out));
    // The Dashboard has its own search box.
    if dash {
        return;
    }
    // The search box, and over it a reminder of the clicks.
    let search = with(|s| s.gui.search.clone());
    let (text, colour) = if search.is_empty() {
        ("Type to search".to_owned(), 0x909090)
    } else {
        (format!("Search: {search}_"), accent())
    };
    let selected = with(|s| s.gui.select_all) && !search.is_empty();
    let lw_ = game.native_text_width(&text);
    out.push(Shape::Round([(w - lw_) / 2.0 - 6.0, 14.0, lw_ + 12.0, 14.0], panel_radius(), if selected { 0xFF30_60B0 } else { bg(0xC00E_0E0E) }));
    out.push(Shape::Text(text, [(w - lw_) / 2.0, 14.0 + text_y(14.0)], if selected { 0xFFFFFF } else { colour }));
    let hint = "Right click: settings   Enter: toggle search result   Esc: close";
    let hw = game.native_text_width(hint);
    out.push(Shape::Text(hint.to_owned(), [(w - hw) / 2.0, 3.0], 0xA0A0A0));
}

// A profile picked in the Profile list: loaded and the list closed, or the error shown in it.
// A saved profile loaded, a preset's preview shown, or the preset taken, from the Profiles row's menu.
fn profile_menu_choice(game: &mut Game<'_>, choice: super::sunset_profile_menu::Choice) {
    use super::sunset_profile_menu::{self as menu, Choice};
    let preset = match choice {
        Choice::Load(name) => return load_profile_from_menu(game, &name),
        Choice::Apply(i) => {
            let result = take_preset(game, i);
            return menu_result(game, result);
        }
        Choice::Preview(i) => i,
    };
    let preview = with(|s| s.preview(&super::sunset_presets::PRESETS[preset]));
    let w = with(|s| s.gui.view_w);
    let preview = preview.map(|p| menu::preview_lines(game, w, preset, &preview_lines(&super::sunset_presets::PRESETS[preset], &p)[1..]));
    with(|s| {
        if let Some(m) = &mut s.gui.profile_menu {
            match preview {
                Ok(lines) => m.preview = Some(menu::Preview { preset, lines }),
                Err(e) => m.error = Some(e),
            }
        }
    });
}

fn load_profile_from_menu(game: &mut Game<'_>, name: &str) {
    let result = profile_action(game, &["load", name]);
    menu_result(game, result);
}

// A load from the Profiles menu: done, the menu closes and the chat says so; else the menu shows why not.
fn menu_result(game: &mut Game<'_>, result: Result<String, String>) {
    match result {
        Ok(message) => {
            with(|s| {
                s.gui.profile_menu = None;
                s.binding = None;
                s.gui.drag = None;
            });
            say(game, &message);
        }
        Err(message) => with(|s| {
            if let Some(menu) = &mut s.gui.profile_menu {
                menu.error = Some(message);
            }
        }),
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/scaffold_bridge.rs`:

```rs
// Scaffold's Legit and Godbridge modes, after vape-rs's (github.com/rdbtCVS/vape-rs, MIT). Both work before the game's
// tick: the sneak, the look and the right click they give are the game's own for that tick, so a block goes with the
// game's sequence number and prediction, before the tick's one move packet.
use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Module, legit_sneak, scaffold_item, scaffold_slot};
use super::sunset_util as util;
use horizon_core::geometry::{Aabb, Vec3};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use winit::event::MouseButton;
use winit::keyboard::KeyCode;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Bridge {
    // Legit: when you were last at an edge, and how long sneak stays once you are past it (picked as sneak starts).
    edge_at: Option<Instant>,
    delay: Duration,
    random: u64,
    // Godbridge, before it takes over: the next block you place by hand behind you, and how many you have placed.
    place: Option<[i32; 3]>,
    placed: u32,
    // Godbridge, bridging.
    line: Option<Line>,
    // When you stopped at the edge (the look goes 2 degrees lower after 300 ms there).
    stalled: Option<Instant>,
    // The block the last right click was for, and the tick: one click a block, half a second for the server.
    clicked: Option<([i32; 3], u64)>,
    // The move keys and right click this tick are Godbridge's: given back after it.
    took: bool,
}

// The bridge: the way it goes (x and z, one of them 1 or -1), on which side of it you walk (and so which strafe key),
// where across the blocks you keep to, and the slot in hand before it took over.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Line {
    step: [i32; 2],
    reversed: bool,
    across: f64,
    slot: usize,
}

static BRIDGE: Mutex<Option<Bridge>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Bridge) -> R) -> R {
    let mut guard = BRIDGE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(guard.get_or_insert_with(Bridge::default))
}

// The way behind you, to the nearest of the four: yaw 0 faces +z, 90 faces -x.
fn behind(yaw: f32) -> [i32; 2] {
    match (yaw + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) {
        a if !(45.0..315.0).contains(&a) => [0, 1],
        a if a < 135.0 => [-1, 0],
        a if a < 225.0 => [0, -1],
        _ => [1, 0],
    }
}

// The yaw that faces back along the bridge (to where it started).
fn back_yaw(step: [i32; 2]) -> f32 {
    (step[0] as f32).atan2(-step[1] as f32).to_degrees()
}

// Turning the look one way turns the walk the same way: +1 when a larger yaw walks you toward +across.
fn across_sign(step: [i32; 2]) -> f64 {
    if step[0] != 0 { f64::from(step[0]) } else { -f64::from(step[1]) }
}

// You walk the bridge back and a strafe key at 45 degrees to it, on the side the look's ray leans away from.
fn across_frac(step: [i32; 2], reversed: bool) -> f64 {
    if reversed == (across_sign(step) > 0.0) { 0.8 } else { 0.2 }
}

// The look for the bridge, turned 20 degrees a block toward the line when you are off it.
fn bridge_yaw(step: [i32; 2], reversed: bool, off_line: f64) -> f32 {
    back_yaw(step) + if reversed { 45.0 } else { -45.0 } + (20.0 * across_sign(step) * off_line) as f32
}

fn angle_between(a: f32, b: f32) -> f32 {
    ((a - b + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0).abs()
}

// The pitch whose ray, from `past` blocks beyond the last block's edge, meets that block's side `drop` below the
// eyes, with `toward` the share of the look that faces back along the bridge.
fn face_pitch(past: f64, toward: f64, drop: f64) -> f32 {
    (toward * drop).atan2(past).to_degrees().min(89.9) as f32
}

// Before the edge, walk on only while the next tick (this speed and a walk's push of 0.1) still stops short of where
// the look can no longer reach the side: else let go and slide up to it.
fn walk_on(past: f64, speed: f64) -> bool {
    past + speed + 0.1 <= 0.26
}

// The block height you stand on (a slab's own block on half a block).
fn under_y(y: f64) -> i32 {
    if (y - y.trunc()).abs() == 0.5 { y.floor() as i32 } else { (y - 1.0).floor() as i32 }
}

fn next_random(b: &mut Bridge) -> u64 {
    if b.random == 0 {
        b.random = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map_or(1, |d| d.as_nanos() as u64);
    }
    b.random = b.random.wrapping_add(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15);
    let mut n = b.random;
    n = (n ^ (n >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9);
    n = (n ^ (n >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
    n ^ (n >> 31)
}

// Nothing under the middle of your feet, 0.2 in from each side, where this tick's motion takes them.
fn at_edge(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else { return false; };
    let feet = p.bounds().deflate(Vec3::new(0.2, 0.0, 0.2)).move_by(Vec3::new(p.velocity.x, 0.0, p.velocity.z));
    let (lo, hi) = (feet.min_position(), feet.max_position());
    let below = Aabb::new(Vec3::new(lo.x, lo.y - 0.5, lo.z), Vec3::new(hi.x, lo.y - 0.001, hi.z));
    horizon_client::collisions::SceneCollisions { world: &game.world, binding: game.collision, subject: None }
        .unobstructed(below)
        .unwrap_or(false)
}

fn climbing(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else { return false; };
    let at = [p.position.x.floor() as i32, p.position.y.floor() as i32, p.position.z.floor() as i32];
    let name = &util::facts(game, at).name;
    ["ladder", "vine", "scaffolding"].iter().any(|e| name.ends_with(e))
}

// Legit (vape-rs's eagle): sneak while not walking forward, on the ground, at the edge of the block under you; once past
// it, sneak stays a moment longer (from Shortest to Longest sneak delay, picked anew as sneak starts). You place.
fn edge_sneak(game: &mut Game<'_>, b: &mut Bridge, delay: (f64, f64)) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else { return; };
    let ground = p.ground.on_ground;
    if !ground || p.flying || climbing(game) {
        legit_sneak(game, false);
        return;
    }
    let forward = super::sunset::move_input(game).0 > 0.0;
    let now = Instant::now();
    let edge = !forward && at_edge(game);
    let lingering = !edge && b.delay > Duration::from_millis(30) && b.edge_at.is_some_and(|at| now - at < b.delay);
    if !(edge || lingering) {
        legit_sneak(game, false);
        return;
    }
    if !game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::ShiftLeft) {
        let (lo, hi) = (delay.0.min(delay.1), delay.0.max(delay.1));
        let span = (hi - lo) as u64 + 1;
        b.delay = Duration::from_millis(lo as u64 + next_random(b) % span);
    }
    if edge {
        b.edge_at = Some(now);
    }
    legit_sneak(game, true);
}

// Before Godbridge takes over: the blocks you place by hand along the way behind you, counted up to Activation blocks.
// Returns the bridge once there are enough and you walk back.
fn count_placed(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, b: &mut Bridge) -> Option<Line> {
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    if !scaffold_item(game, m, game.selected) {
        (b.place, b.placed) = (None, 0);
        return None;
    }
    let step = behind(game.yaw);
    let feet = [p.position.x.floor() as i32, under_y(p.position.y), p.position.z.floor() as i32];
    let along = |at: [i32; 3], n: i32| [at[0] + step[0] * n, at[1], at[2] + step[1] * n];
    let air = |at: [i32; 3]| util::replaceable(game, at);
    let Some(place) = b.place else {
        if p.ground.on_ground {
            b.place = (0..3).map(|n| along(feet, n)).find(|&at| air(at));
            b.placed = 0;
        }
        return None;
    };
    let enough = m.n("Activation blocks");
    if f64::from(b.placed) >= enough {
        if !game.physical_keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyS) || game.keys.contains(&KeyCode::Space) {
            return None;
        }
        (b.place, b.placed) = (None, 0);
        let reversed = ((game.yaw - back_yaw(step) + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0) >= 0.0;
        let cell = f64::from(if step[0] != 0 { place[2] } else { place[0] });
        return Some(Line { step, reversed, across: cell + across_frac(step, reversed), slot: game.selected });
    }
    if !air(place) {
        b.placed += 1;
        let next = along(place, 1);
        if !air(next) {
            (b.place, b.placed) = (None, 0);
        } else if f64::from(b.placed) < enough {
            b.place = Some(next);
        }
        return None;
    }
    // Still air, but you went off its row, to another height or too far from where the counting began: again.
    let across = if step[0] != 0 { 2 } else { 0 };
    let start = (0..3).map(|i| f64::from(place[i] - step_at(step, i) * b.placed as i32 - feet[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    if place[across] != feet[across] || place[1] != feet[1] || start > enough + 2.0 {
        (b.place, b.placed) = (None, 0);
    }
    None
}

fn step_at(step: [i32; 2], axis: usize) -> i32 {
    match axis {
        0 => step[0],
        2 => step[1],
        _ => 0,
    }
}

// Godbridge (vape-rs's GodBridge, straight bridges): no sneak. The look turns to face back along the bridge, 45 degrees
// to one side; S and that side's strafe key walk you along it. At the edge it lets go and slides up to it, and once
// you are past the last block's edge (still on it) the look lowers until the crosshair is on that block's side, and
// a right click puts the next one there. Lasts while S is held and there are blocks.
fn godbridge(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, b: &mut Bridge) {
    let Some(line) = b.line else {
        edge_sneak(game, b, (100.0, 200.0));
        if let Some(line) = count_placed(game, m, b) {
            b.line = Some(line);
            b.stalled = None;
            legit_sneak(game, false);
        }
        return;
    };
    let slot = scaffold_slot(game, m);
    let Some((p, slot)) = game.player.as_ref().filter(|p| !p.flying).zip(slot) else {
        end(game, b);
        return;
    };
    if !game.physical_keys.contains(&KeyCode::KeyS) {
        end(game, b);
        return;
    }
    let (pos, vel, rising) = ([p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z], [p.velocity.x, p.velocity.z], p.velocity.y);
    let step = line.step;
    let (along, across) = if step[0] != 0 { (0, 2) } else { (2, 0) };
    let dir = f64::from(step[0] + step[1]);
    legit_sneak(game, false);
    game.selected = slot;
    // The look along the bridge, back onto the line when off it.
    let yaw = bridge_yaw(step, line.reversed, line.across - pos[across]);
    let rate = (2.0 + angle_between(game.yaw, yaw) / 15.0).min(12.0);
    game.yaw = super::sunset_movement::turn_toward(game.yaw, yaw, rate);
    let turning = angle_between(game.yaw, yaw) > 4.0;
    let ticks = game.ticks;
    // Jumping (vape-rs's GodBridge): while you go up or down, the crosshair on a block's top counts as well as on its
    // side, so the bridge's own look puts a block under you as you clear it, and you land one up.
    let jumped = !(-0.1..=0.1).contains(&rising) && !turning && game.pick().is_some_and(|hit| {
        let at = std::array::from_fn(|i| hit.pos[i] + hit.face[i]);
        let fresh = b.clicked.is_none_or(|(was, tick)| was != at || ticks >= tick + 10);
        hit.face[1] >= 0 && fresh && util::can_place(game, at, true)
    });
    if jumped && let Some(hit) = game.pick() {
        super::remote::sunset_remote::press_use(game);
        b.clicked = Some((std::array::from_fn(|i| hit.pos[i] + hit.face[i]), ticks));
    }
    let y = under_y(pos[1]);
    let cell = |n: i32| {
        let mut at = [pos[0].floor() as i32, y, pos[2].floor() as i32];
        at[along] += step_at(step, along) * n;
        at
    };
    // The last block: the one under you, or the one you just went past.
    let solid = |at: [i32; 3]| !util::replaceable(game, at);
    let last = if solid(cell(0)) { Some(cell(0)) } else { Some(cell(-1)).filter(|&at| solid(at)) };
    let mut walk = !turning;
    let mut pitch = if b.stalled.is_some_and(|at| at.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(300)) { 80.0 } else { 78.0 };
    match last {
        _ if jumped => {}
        Some(last) if !solid(cell_after(last, step, along)) => {
            b.stalled.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
            // How far your middle is past the last block's leading side.
            let edge = f64::from(last[along]) + if dir > 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 };
            let past = (pos[along] - edge) * dir;
            if past > 0.0 && past < 0.29 && !turning {
                let toward = f64::from(game.yaw.to_radians().sin()) * f64::from(step[0]) - f64::from(game.yaw.to_radians().cos()) * f64::from(step[1]);
                let drop = game.eye_position().map_or(1.62, |eye| eye[1] - f64::from(last[1]) - 0.5);
                pitch = face_pitch(past, toward.max(0.1), drop);
                game.pitch = pitch;
                let next = cell_after(last, step, along);
                let face = [step[0], 0, step[1]];
                let fresh = b.clicked.is_none_or(|(at, tick)| at != next || ticks >= tick + 10);
                walk = game.pick().is_some_and(|hit| hit.pos == last && hit.face == face) && fresh && util::can_place(game, next, true);
                if walk {
                    super::remote::sunset_remote::press_use(game);
                    b.clicked = Some((next, ticks));
                }
            } else if past <= 0.0 {
                walk &= walk_on(past, vel[along / 2] * dir);
            } else {
                walk = false;
            }
        }
        Some(_) => b.stalled = None,
        None => walk = false,
    }
    if game.pitch != pitch {
        game.pitch = super::sunset_movement::turn_toward(game.pitch, pitch, 12.0);
    }
    let strafe = if line.reversed { KeyCode::KeyD } else { KeyCode::KeyA };
    for k in [KeyCode::KeyW, KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyD] {
        game.keys.remove(&k);
    }
    if walk {
        game.keys.insert(KeyCode::KeyS);
        game.keys.insert(strafe);
    }
    game.right = false;
    b.took = true;
}

fn cell_after(last: [i32; 3], step: [i32; 2], along: usize) -> [i32; 3] {
    let mut at = last;
    at[along] += step_at(step, along);
    at
}

// Back to waiting for blocks placed by hand, with the slot you had in hand.
fn end(game: &mut Game<'_>, b: &mut Bridge) {
    if let Some(line) = b.line.take() {
        game.selected = line.slot;
    }
    (b.place, b.placed, b.stalled) = (None, 0, None);
}

// Each tick before the game's: Scaffold when Legit or Godbridge is the mode and it may work now, else None.
pub(super) fn pre_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) {
    let Some(m) = m else {
        stop(game);
        return;
    };
    with(|b| match m.p("Mode") {
        "Legit" => {
            if b.line.is_some() {
                end(game, b);
            }
            if scaffold_item(game, m, game.selected) {
                edge_sneak(game, b, (m.n("Shortest sneak delay (ms)"), m.n("Longest sneak delay (ms)")));
            } else {
                legit_sneak(game, false);
            }
        }
        "Godbridge" => godbridge(game, m, b),
        _ => {}
    });
}

// After the game's tick: the keys and right click Godbridge took go back to what you hold.
pub(super) fn post_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if !with(|b| std::mem::take(&mut b.took)) {
        return;
    }
    for k in [KeyCode::KeyW, KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyD] {
        if game.physical_keys.contains(&k) {
            game.keys.insert(k);
        } else {
            game.keys.remove(&k);
        }
    }
    game.right = game.physical_buttons.contains(&MouseButton::Right);
}

// Scaffold off, another mode, Panic or no world: sneak, slot and keys back.
pub(super) fn stop(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let active = with(|b| b.line.is_some() || b.place.is_some() || b.edge_at.is_some() || b.took);
    if !active {
        return;
    }
    with(|b| {
        if game.player.is_some() {
            end(game, b);
        }
        *b = Bridge { random: b.random, took: b.took, ..Bridge::default() };
    });
    legit_sneak(game, false);
    post_tick(game);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn the_bridge_goes_behind_you_and_the_look_faces_back_along_it() {
        assert_eq!(behind(180.0), [0, 1]);
        assert_eq!(behind(0.0), [0, -1]);
        assert_eq!(behind(90.0), [1, 0]);
        assert_eq!(behind(-90.0), [-1, 0]);
        assert_eq!(behind(130.0), [1, 0]);
        for step in [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]] {
            let yaw = back_yaw(step).to_radians();
            // Facing back: the look's flat direction is the bridge's, reversed.
            assert!((f64::from(-yaw.sin()) + f64::from(step[0])).abs() < 1e-6, "{step:?}");
            assert!((f64::from(yaw.cos()) + f64::from(step[1])).abs() < 1e-6, "{step:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn back_and_strafe_at_the_bridge_look_walk_along_it_and_turn_toward_the_line() {
        // The walk of S and a strafe key at yaw `yaw` (A: left, D: right), as the game moves you.
        let walk = |yaw: f32, right: bool| {
            let (s, c) = (f64::from(yaw.to_radians().sin()), f64::from(yaw.to_radians().cos()));
            let strafe = if right { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
            [s + c * strafe, -c + s * strafe]
        };
        for step in [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]] {
            for reversed in [false, true] {
                let w = walk(bridge_yaw(step, reversed, 0.0), reversed);
                let len = (w[0] * w[0] + w[1] * w[1]).sqrt();
                assert!((w[0] / len - f64::from(step[0])).abs() < 1e-6 && (w[1] / len - f64::from(step[1])).abs() < 1e-6, "{step:?} {reversed}");
                // Off the line toward -across: the turned walk leans toward +across.
                let w = walk(bridge_yaw(step, reversed, 0.2), reversed);
                let across = if step[0] != 0 { w[1] } else { w[0] };
                assert!(across > 0.0, "{step:?} {reversed}");
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(across_frac([0, -1], true), 0.8);
        assert_eq!(across_frac([0, 1], true), 0.2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_crosshair_meets_the_side_only_past_the_edge_and_the_walk_stops_short() {
        // From 0.1 past the edge, 2.12 above the side's middle, half the look facing back: steep, under 90.
        let pitch = face_pitch(0.1, 0.707, 2.12);
        assert!(pitch > 85.0 && pitch < 89.9);
        let reach = 0.707 * 2.12 / f64::from(pitch.to_radians().tan());
        assert!((reach - 0.1).abs() < 1e-3);
        assert!(face_pitch(0.0, 0.707, 2.12) <= 89.9);
        // Walking (0.2 a tick) half a block before the edge goes on; at it, let go and slide.
        assert!(walk_on(-0.5, 0.2));
        assert!(walk_on(-0.05, 0.2));
        assert!(!walk_on(0.0, 0.2));
        assert!(walk_on(0.0, 0.0));
        assert_eq!(under_y(65.0), 64);
        assert_eq!(under_y(64.5), 64);
    }
}
```

```rs
// GUI Move: the PlayerInput a tick sends behind a screen says the keys its move took, so the server predicts the move
// that was made (the call again with them passes through here). Debug Report notes the change.
fn sunset_screen_input(game: &mut Game<'_>, input: u8) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<()> {
    match horizon_client::motion::sunset_motion::screen_input(input) {
        Some(changed) => {
            crate::game::sunset_debug::gui_move_input(input, changed);
            std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(game.remote_send_state(changed))
        }
        None => std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(()),
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/screen_keys_hook.rs`:

```rs
// GUI Move: behind a screen the tick's movement takes the move keys held (the call again has them, so it passes
// through here).
// No Slow's Skip (vape-rs's NoSlowdown): the move goes without the item-use slowdown.
// A knockback hit since the last movement (Player.attack): the speed across cut to 0.6 for each, the sprint stopped.
fn sunset_screen_keys(world: &mut MotionWorld<'_, '_, '_>, keys: crate::sprint::Keys, window: i32) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<Result<()>> {
    if world.player.item_use_speed.is_some() && crate::motion::sunset_motion::no_slow_grim() {
        crate::motion::sunset_motion::set_across(None);
        crate::motion::sunset_motion::set_up(None);
    }
    if crate::motion::sunset_motion::no_slow_skip() {
        world.player.item_use_speed = None;
    }
    let hits = crate::motion::sunset_motion::take_attack_slow().min(5);
    if hits > 0 {
        let cut = 0.6f64.powi(hits as i32);
        world.player.velocity.x *= cut;
        world.player.velocity.z *= cut;
        let _ = world.player.set_sprinting(false);
    }
    match crate::motion::sunset_motion::screen_keys(keys) {
        Some(keys) => std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(world.controlled_simulation_tick_with_sprint_window(keys, window)),
        None => std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(()),
    }
}
```
