`mixins/sunset/smooth.rs`:

```rs
// The menu's lists glide to where the wheel put them: their scroll values stay the targets, and what is drawn follows.

use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::time::Instant;

// The panels come first, one for each category.
pub(super) const WINDOW: usize = 6;
pub(super) const DASHBOARD: usize = 7;
pub(super) const PICKER: usize = 8;
pub(super) const PANE: usize = 9;
pub(super) const SLOTS: usize = 10;

// ClickGUI's Animations: Off, and everything is at once where it is going.
static ENABLED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(true);

pub(super) fn set_enabled(on: bool) {
    ENABLED.store(on, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub(super) fn enabled() -> bool {
    ENABLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

// How fast the rest of the way closes, per second: nine tenths of it in about 0.14 s.
const RATE: f32 = 16.0;
// This close, it is there.
const NEAR: f32 = 0.05;

struct Glide {
    shown: [Option<f32>; SLOTS],
    last: Option<Instant>,
}

static GLIDE: Mutex<Glide> = Mutex::new(Glide { shown: [None; SLOTS], last: None });

fn glide<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Glide) -> R) -> R {
    f(&mut GLIDE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()))
}

// One frame's step towards the target: the same glide at any frame rate.
fn step(shown: f32, target: f32, dt: f32) -> f32 {
    let next = shown + (target - shown) * (1.0 - (-dt * RATE).exp());
    if (target - next).abs() < NEAR { target } else { next }
}

// Once a frame, with each list's target (None for one not open: it starts at its target when it opens).
pub(super) fn frame(targets: [Option<f32>; SLOTS]) {
    glide(|g| {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let dt = if enabled() { g.last.map_or(0.0, |t| now.duration_since(t).as_secs_f32()) } else { f32::INFINITY };
        g.last = Some(now);
        for (shown, target) in g.shown.iter_mut().zip(targets) {
            *shown = target.map(|t| shown.map_or(t, |v| step(v, t, dt)));
        }
    });
}

// Where a list is drawn: `target` until the frame has seen it.
pub(super) fn shown(slot: usize, target: f32) -> f32 {
    glide(|g| g.shown[slot]).unwrap_or(target)
}

// The list shows new things (another page): no glide from the old place.
pub(super) fn jump(slot: usize) {
    glide(|g| g.shown[slot] = None);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn it_arrives_and_stays_without_passing_the_target() {
        let (mut v, mut last) = (0.0, 0.0);
        for _ in 0..120 {
            v = step(v, 100.0, 1.0 / 60.0);
            assert!(v >= last && v <= 100.0);
            last = v;
        }
        assert_eq!(v, 100.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_frame_rate_does_not_change_the_speed() {
        let (mut fast, mut slow) = (0.0, 0.0);
        for _ in 0..24 {
            fast = step(fast, 100.0, 1.0 / 240.0);
        }
        for _ in 0..3 {
            slow = step(slow, 100.0, 1.0 / 30.0);
        }
        assert!((fast - slow).abs() < 0.001, "{fast} {slow}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_long_pause_lands_on_the_target() {
        assert_eq!(step(0.0, 100.0, 10.0), 100.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn it_scrolls_back_up_too() {
        let v = step(100.0, 0.0, 1.0 / 60.0);
        assert!(v < 100.0 && v > 0.0);
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/snap_tap.rs`:

```rs
// Snap Tap (SOCD "last input wins", as Razer's Snap Tap and Wooting's Rappy Snappy): of two opposite move keys held at
// once, the one pressed last moves you, and letting go of it hands back to the other while that is still held. The
// key that loses is out of the game's held keys for the tick only, so the movement and the server's input packet
// agree; it goes back after the tick. Neutral: both cancel out, as without it.
use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Category, Module};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use winit::keyboard::KeyCode;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Snap Tap", Category::Movement, "Of two opposite move keys, the last pressed wins.")
            .pick("Mode", &["Last input", "Neutral"])
            .bool("Forward and back", true),
    ]
}

const KEYS: [KeyCode; 4] = [KeyCode::KeyW, KeyCode::KeyS, KeyCode::KeyA, KeyCode::KeyD];

#[derive(Default)]
struct Snap {
    // Which of W, S, A and D were held last tick, and when each was last pressed (a count of presses).
    held: [bool; 4],
    pressed: [u64; 4],
    presses: u64,
    // The keys taken out for this tick, each with the one that won over it.
    took: Vec<(KeyCode, KeyCode)>,
    // The keys that lost last tick, each with the one that won (Debug Report).
    last: Vec<(KeyCode, KeyCode)>,
}

static SNAP: Mutex<Option<Snap>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn snap<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Snap) -> R) -> R {
    f(SNAP.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Snap::default))
}

// The key of each pair that loses to the one pressed after it, with Snap Tap on; held: in the game's keys or on the
// keyboard (behind a screen GUI Move walks you by the keyboard's). A pair pressed in the same tick stays neutral.
fn losers(held: [bool; 4], pressed: [u64; 4], forward_back: bool) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
    let pairs: &[(usize, usize)] = if forward_back { &[(0, 1), (2, 3)] } else { &[(2, 3)] };
    pairs
        .iter()
        .filter(|&&(a, b)| held[a] && held[b] && pressed[a] != pressed[b])
        .map(|&(a, b)| if pressed[a] < pressed[b] { (a, b) } else { (b, a) })
        .collect()
}

// Before the tick: the presses seen since the last one counted, then the losing keys taken out. Returns them, for GUI
// Move's keys behind a screen.
pub(super) fn pre_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) -> Vec<KeyCode> {
    let held = KEYS.map(|k| game.keys.contains(&k) || game.physical_keys.contains(&k));
    let order = snap(|s| {
        // Keys first seen in the same tick share their count.
        let new = std::array::from_fn::<bool, 4, _>(|i| held[i] && !s.held[i]);
        if new.contains(&true) {
            s.presses += 1;
        }
        for i in (0..4).filter(|&i| new[i]) {
            s.pressed[i] = s.presses;
        }
        s.held = held;
        s.pressed
    });
    let Some(m) = m.filter(|m| m.p("Mode") == "Last input") else {
        snap(|s| s.last.clear());
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let lost: Vec<(KeyCode, KeyCode)> = losers(held, order, m.b("Forward and back")).into_iter().map(|(l, w)| (KEYS[l], KEYS[w])).collect();
    let took = lost.iter().filter(|(k, _)| game.keys.remove(k)).copied().collect();
    snap(|s| {
        s.took = took;
        s.last.clone_from(&lost);
    });
    lost.into_iter().map(|(k, _)| k).collect()
}

// The keys that lost last tick, each with the one that won over it.
pub(super) fn last() -> Vec<(KeyCode, KeyCode)> {
    snap(|s| s.last.clone())
}

// After the tick: a key taken out goes back while the one that won over it is still held (a tick that let go of every
// key, a death or a screen, keeps it out).
pub(super) fn post_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    for (key, winner) in snap(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.took)) {
        if game.keys.contains(&winner) {
            game.keys.insert(key);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::losers;

    #[test]
    fn the_last_pressed_of_a_pair_wins() {
        // A held, then D: A loses. D let go: nothing loses, A moves you again.
        assert_eq!(losers([false, false, true, true], [0, 0, 1, 2], true), vec![(2, 3)]);
        assert_eq!(losers([false, false, true, false], [0, 0, 1, 2], true), vec![]);
        // D held, then A: D loses.
        assert_eq!(losers([false, false, true, true], [0, 0, 4, 3], true), vec![(3, 2)]);
        // W then S: W loses, unless forward and back are left out.
        assert_eq!(losers([true, true, false, false], [5, 6, 0, 0], true), vec![(0, 1)]);
        assert_eq!(losers([true, true, false, false], [5, 6, 0, 0], false), vec![]);
        // Pressed in the same tick: neutral.
        assert_eq!(losers([false, false, true, true], [0, 0, 7, 7], true), vec![]);
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/sort_buttons.rs`:

```rs
// Client Sort's buttons, in place of Horizon's one sort button per part of the screen: three small ones stacked down
// its right edge, Sort, Fill Stacks and Restock. A child of the tweaks so it reads Horizon's own list of the parts.
use super::Game;
use horizon_client::hud::{HudBatch, rgba};

const SIDE: f32 = 9.0;
// From the top of one button to the next.
const STEP: f32 = 10.0;
// Their left edge: 4 in from the screen's right one (176), as ClientSort's offset puts them.
const X: f32 = 172.0;

// Each button: its corner, which of the three it is, and the slots of its part. Horizon's parts, and your main
// inventory's always (on a server Horizon gives your own inventory none).
fn buttons(game: &Game<'_>) -> Vec<((f32, f32), usize, Vec<usize>)> {
    let mut parts = game.sort_buttons();
    if game.screen == super::Screen::Inventory
        && game.station.is_none()
        && !game.mount_active()
        && !parts.iter().any(|(_, slots)| slots.first() == Some(&9))
    {
        parts.push(((160.0, game.screen_height() - 95.0), (9..36).collect()));
    }
    parts
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(|((_, y), slots)| (0..3).map(move |op| ((X, y + op as f32 * STEP), op, slots.clone())))
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) fn draw(game: &Game<'_>, batch: &mut HudBatch, ox: f32, oy: f32) {
    let atlas = &game.gui.atlas;
    let dark = rgba(55, 55, 55, 255);
    for ((x, y), op, _) in buttons(game) {
        let (x, y) = (ox + x, oy + y);
        let (cx, cy) = game.cursor;
        let hovered = cx >= x && cx < x + SIDE && cy >= y && cy < y + SIDE;
        batch.fill(atlas, x, y, SIDE, SIDE, dark);
        batch.fill(atlas, x + 1.0, y + 1.0, SIDE - 2.0, SIDE - 2.0, if hovered { rgba(220, 220, 220, 255) } else { rgba(160, 160, 160, 255) });
        match op {
            // Sort: three bars, shorter going down.
            0 => {
                for (i, w) in [5.0, 4.0, 3.0].into_iter().enumerate() {
                    batch.fill(atlas, x + 2.0, y + 2.0 + 2.0 * i as f32, w, 1.0, dark);
                }
            }
            // Fill Stacks: a plus.
            1 => {
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 2.0, y + 4.0, 5.0, 1.0, dark);
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 4.0, y + 2.0, 1.0, 5.0, dark);
            }
            // Restock: an arrow across.
            _ => {
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 2.0, y + 4.0, 5.0, 1.0, dark);
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 5.0, y + 3.0, 1.0, 3.0, dark);
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 4.0, y + 2.0, 1.0, 1.0, dark);
                batch.fill(atlas, x + 4.0, y + 6.0, 1.0, 1.0, dark);
            }
        }
    }
}

// A left press on one of them: its operation queued (true), else false.
pub(crate) fn press(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(r) = game.renderer.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let batch = HudBatch::new([r.config.width, r.config.height]);
    let (ox, oy) = game.inventory_origin(&batch);
    let (cx, cy) = game.cursor;
    let hit = buttons(game).into_iter().find(|((x, y), ..)| {
        let (x, y) = (ox + x, oy + y);
        cx >= x && cx < x + SIDE && cy >= y && cy < y + SIDE
    });
    let Some((_, op, slots)) = hit else {
        return false;
    };
    crate::game::sunset_extras::operate(game, op, &slots);
    true
}
```

`mixins/sunset/swap_keys.rs`:

```rs
// What goes in your main hand for a fight: Shield (Auto block: the shield up while a player who can hit you is near,
// down when an axe or a crit would get through it; Swap key: a shield in hand on a key, from the hotbar or the main
// inventory, and back on the next press), Key Throw's Crossbow key (a crossbow in hand, from the hotbar or the
// inventory, kept loaded while you hold it, put back when you change slot) and Offhand's Double hand (a hotbar totem
// in hand when a blast or a smash near an enemy could take more than the health you have). All of it at the start of
// a tick, before its move packet, and only in a tick no other slot change went in.
use super::sunset::{Category, Module, gui_open, hold, with};
use super::sunset_util as util;
use super::Game;
use horizon_client::items::ItemStack;
use horizon_client::menu::Input;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use winit::event::MouseButton;

const NAME: &str = "Shield";

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new(NAME, Category::Combat, "Blocks with your shield in fights, or swaps one in on a key.")
            .bool("Auto block", true)
            .num("Target distance", 5.0, 1.0, 10.0, 0.5)
            .num("FOV", 90.0, 0.0, 180.0, 5.0)
            .num("Movement threshold", 0.1, 0.0, 10.0, 0.1)
            .num("Sword cooldown correction (%)", 10.0, 0.0, 30.0, 1.0)
            .bool("Disable tracker", true)
            .bool("Swap to sword", false)
            .text("Swap key", "None")
            .bool("From inventory", true),
    ]
}

// An item borrowed into the hand: the slot held before, the hotbar slot it is in, and the inventory slot it came from
// (swapped into the held slot) if it was not in the hotbar.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Borrow {
    previous: usize,
    slot: usize,
    from: Option<usize>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    // Auto block holds the use button (Some(true)) or keeps it up (Some(false)); None: it is yours.
    pressed: Option<bool>,
    // Your last hit: Auto block looks again two ticks after it.
    hit_tick: u64,
    // The tick each player near you last started a swing, and their swing clock last tick.
    swings: Vec<(u32, u64, f32)>,
    // The shield's cooldown (disabled by an axe) seen last tick.
    disabled: bool,
    shield: Option<Borrow>,
    crossbow: Option<Borrow>,
    // The crossbow key holds the use button.
    loading: bool,
    // Double hand: not again before this tick; the pearl cooldown seen last tick.
    double_next: u64,
    pearl_cooling: bool,
}

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn st<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut State) -> R) -> R {
    f(STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(State::default))
}

fn module(name: &str) -> Option<Module> {
    with(|s| s.module(name).filter(|m| m.on).cloned())
}

fn live(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.remote.is_some()
        && game.native_playing()
        && !gui_open()
        && !game.spectator()
        && game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.health.health() > 0.0)
        && util::inventory_idle(game)
}

fn is(stack: Option<&ItemStack>, name: &str) -> bool {
    stack.is_some_and(|s| util::short(&s.item) == name)
}

fn tagged(game: &Game<'_>, item: &str, tag: &str) -> bool {
    game.res.items().item_tags.get(tag).is_some_and(|t| t.contains(item))
}

// Puts `name` in hand: a hotbar one is selected; else, with `inventory`, one from the main inventory changes places
// with what you hold.
fn bring(game: &mut Game<'_>, name: &str, inventory: bool) -> Option<Borrow> {
    if is(game.held(), name) {
        return None;
    }
    let previous = game.selected;
    if let Some(slot) = (0..9).find(|&i| is(game.stack_in(i), name)) {
        hold(game, slot);
        return Some(Borrow { previous, slot, from: None });
    }
    let from = (9..36).find(|&i| is(game.stack_in(i), name)).filter(|_| inventory && !super::sunset_loadouts::locked(previous))?;
    game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), previous as i32, Input::Swap)]);
    Some(Borrow { previous, slot: previous, from: Some(from) })
}

// What `bring` did, undone: the item goes back where it came from, or the slot you held before is held again.
fn put_back(game: &mut Game<'_>, b: Borrow) {
    match b.from {
        Some(from) => {
            game.remote_menu_ops(&[(Some(from), b.slot as i32, Input::Swap)]);
        }
        None if game.selected == b.slot => hold(game, b.previous),
        None => {}
    }
}

// The use button as you hold it.
fn yours(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    let down = game.physical_buttons.contains(&MouseButton::Right);
    let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, down);
}

fn press(game: &mut Game<'_>, down: bool) {
    if st(|s| s.pressed) != Some(down) {
        let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, down);
    }
    st(|s| s.pressed = Some(down));
}

fn let_go(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if st(|s| s.pressed.take()).is_some() {
        yours(game);
    }
}

// The key handler: Shield's Swap key and Key Throw's Crossbow key.
pub(super) fn key(game: &mut Game<'_>, key: &str, pressed: bool) {
    if !pressed || !live(game) {
        return;
    }
    let pressed_key = super::sunset::key_from_text(key);
    let named = |m: &Module, setting: &str| super::sunset::key_from_text(m.t(setting)).is_some_and(|k| Some(k) == pressed_key);
    if let Some(m) = module(NAME).filter(|m| named(m, "Swap key")) {
        match st(|s| s.shield.take()) {
            Some(b) => put_back(game, b),
            None => {
                let b = bring(game, "shield", m.b("From inventory"));
                st(|s| s.shield = b);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(m) = module("Key Throw").filter(|m| named(m, "Crossbow key"))
        && st(|s| s.crossbow.is_none())
    {
        let b = bring(game, "crossbow", m.b("Crossbow from inventory"));
        st(|s| s.crossbow = b);
    }
}

// The start of a tick; `busy`: a slot changed already in it (a hit's weapon, a slot coming back).
pub(super) fn pre_tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, busy: bool) {
    if !live(game) {
        st(|s| {
            s.shield = None;
            s.crossbow = None;
            s.loading = false;
            s.swings.clear();
        });
        let_go(game);
        return;
    }
    let (loaded, kept) = (crossbow(game), swap_key(game));
    let busy = busy || !loaded || !kept;
    note_swings(game);
    let busy = busy || double_hand(game, busy);
    match module(NAME).filter(|m| m.b("Auto block")).and_then(|m| block(game, &m, busy)) {
        Some(down) => press(game, down),
        None => let_go(game),
    }
}

// Swap key's shield: it goes back if you change slot or it leaves your hand. False: a slot changed.
fn swap_key(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(b) = st(|s| s.shield) else {
        return true;
    };
    if module(NAME).is_none() || game.selected != b.slot || !is(game.stack_in(b.slot), "shield") {
        st(|s| s.shield = None);
        if b.from.is_some() && game.selected != b.slot {
            put_back(game, b);
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

// Crossbow key: the use button held until the crossbow is loaded; again after each shot while it is in hand; once you
// hold another slot it goes back. False: a slot changed.
fn crossbow(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> bool {
    let Some(b) = st(|s| s.crossbow) else {
        return true;
    };
    if module("Key Throw").is_none() || game.selected != b.slot || !is(game.held(), "crossbow") {
        if st(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.loading)) {
            yours(game);
        }
        st(|s| s.crossbow = None);
        if game.selected != b.slot && b.from.is_some() {
            put_back(game, b);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    let Some(stack) = game.held() else {
        return true;
    };
    let loaded = stack.data().is_some_and(|d| !d.charged.is_empty());
    let pull = (25 - 5 * stack.enchantment_level("minecraft:quick_charge") as i64).max(1) as u32;
    let drawn = game.using.is_some_and(|(slot, ticks)| slot == game.selected && ticks >= pull);
    if loaded || drawn {
        if st(|s| std::mem::take(&mut s.loading)) {
            yours(game);
        }
    } else if !st(|s| s.loading) {
        let _ = game.play_mouse(MouseButton::Right, true);
        st(|s| s.loading = true);
    }
    true
}

// Each player's swing start, from their swing clock going up from rest.
fn note_swings(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let now = game.ticks;
    st(|s| {
        s.swings.retain(|(id, _, _)| game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.id == *id));
        for mob in game.mobs.iter().filter(|m| m.kind.id == "minecraft:player") {
            let anim = mob.anim.attack_anim;
            match s.swings.iter_mut().find(|(id, _, _)| *id == mob.id) {
                Some((_, at, was)) => {
                    if anim > 0.0 && (*was == 0.0 || anim < *was) {
                        *at = now;
                    }
                    *was = anim;
                }
                None => s.swings.push((mob.id, 0, anim)),
            }
        }
    });
}

// Your hit: Auto block waits two ticks before looking again.
pub(super) fn hit(game: &Game<'_>) {
    st(|s| s.hit_tick = game.ticks);
}

// Auto block, each tick: Some(true) to hold the shield up, Some(false) to keep it down, None to leave the button to you.
fn block(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module, busy: bool) -> Option<bool> {
    // Disable tracker: an axe took the shield out (its cooldown runs): the button is yours, and with Swap to sword the
    // sword comes out.
    let shield_down = game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown("minecraft:shield");
    let newly = shield_down && !st(|s| std::mem::replace(&mut s.disabled, shield_down));
    if !shield_down {
        st(|s| s.disabled = false);
    }
    if m.b("Disable tracker") && shield_down {
        if newly
            && !busy
            && m.b("Swap to sword")
            && let Some(slot) = (0..9).find(|&i| game.stack_in(i).is_some_and(|s| tagged(game, &s.item, "minecraft:swords")))
        {
            hold(game, slot);
        }
        return None;
    }
    if game.ticks < st(|s| s.hit_tick) + 2 {
        return st(|s| s.pressed);
    }
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    let held = game.held().map(|s| s.item.clone());
    let free_hand = held.as_ref().is_none_or(|h| tagged(game, h, "minecraft:swords") || tagged(game, h, "minecraft:axes") || &**h == "minecraft:mace");
    let shield = is(game.held(), "shield") || (is(game.offhand.as_ref(), "shield") && free_hand);
    if !shield || p.fall_flying {
        return None;
    }
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians());
    let look = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let me = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    let target = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| util::player_enemy(game, t))
        .filter(|t| {
            let to = [t.position.x - eye[0], t.position.y + 0.9 - eye[1], t.position.z - eye[2]];
            let len = (to[0] * to[0] + to[1] * to[1] + to[2] * to[2]).sqrt().max(1e-9);
            let angle = ((0..3).map(|i| look[i] * to[i]).sum::<f64>() / len).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos().to_degrees();
            angle <= m.n("FOV")
        })
        .min_by(|a, b| util::dist(me, [a.position.x, a.position.y, a.position.z]).total_cmp(&util::dist(me, [b.position.x, b.position.y, b.position.z])))?;
    let away = util::dist(me, [target.position.x, target.position.y, target.position.z]);
    if away > m.n("Target distance") {
        return None;
    }
    let weapon = target.extra.main_hand.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
    // An axe would take the shield out; anything but a sword or a mace does little.
    if tagged(game, weapon, "minecraft:axes") || !(tagged(game, weapon, "minecraft:swords") || weapon == "minecraft:mace") {
        return Some(false);
    }
    // Your own crit on the way down: no shield in the way of it.
    let strength = super::sunset_melee::slot_strength(game, game.selected, 0.0).unwrap_or(0.0);
    if !p.ground.on_ground && p.fall_distance > 0.0 && strength > 0.94 {
        return Some(false);
    }
    // Their sword charged again (a little early, by the correction), and coming at you or within 3 blocks.
    let swung = st(|s| s.swings.iter().find(|(id, _, _)| *id == target.id).map_or(0, |(_, at, _)| *at));
    let ready = (game.ticks.saturating_sub(swung)) as f64 * 50.0 >= 625.0 * (0.94 - m.n("Sword cooldown correction (%)") / 100.0);
    let motion = [target.position.x - target.previous.x, target.position.y - target.previous.y, target.position.z - target.previous.z];
    let speed = (motion[0] * motion[0] + motion[1] * motion[1] + motion[2] * motion[2]).sqrt();
    let to_me = [me[0] - target.position.x, me[1] - target.position.y, me[2] - target.position.z];
    let coming = speed >= m.n("Movement threshold") / 10.0 && (0..3).map(|i| motion[i] * to_me[i]).sum::<f64>() > 0.0;
    if ready && (coming || away <= 3.0) {
        return Some(true);
    }
    // Going up from a jump, the shield stays up; otherwise it comes down.
    Some(!p.ground.on_ground && p.fall_distance <= 0.0)
}

// Offhand's Double hand, each tick (Reswap delay ticks apart): with a totem in the hotbar but not in hand, an enemy
// player within 10 blocks, and no shield up or combat module's hand in use, the totem goes in hand when a threat could
// take what health you have: a crystal there, a charged anchor within 5 of the enemy, (in the air) obsidian below you
// within 5 of them with room for a crystal (counted at half), their mace on the way down at you (6 and 5 a block
// fallen); scaled by Sensitivity. Also when they hold a sword or axe and you are under one health, and (Pearl) as
// you throw a pearl. True: the slot changed.
fn double_hand(game: &mut Game<'_>, busy: bool) -> bool {
    let cooling = game.cooldowns.is_on_cooldown("minecraft:ender_pearl");
    let thrown = cooling && !st(|s| std::mem::replace(&mut s.pearl_cooling, cooling));
    if !cooling {
        st(|s| s.pearl_cooling = false);
    }
    let Some(m) = module("Offhand").filter(|m| m.b("Double hand")) else {
        return false;
    };
    let on = |name: &str| util::listed(m.t("Double hand on"), name);
    if busy || game.ticks < st(|s| s.double_next) || is(game.held(), "totem_of_undying") || game.using.is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    if super::sunset_combat_control::owner().is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(slot) = (0..9).find(|&i| is(game.stack_in(i), "totem_of_undying")) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };
    let health = f64::from(p.health.health() + p.health.absorption());
    let (me, airborne) = ([p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z], !p.ground.on_ground);
    let enemy = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| util::player_enemy(game, t))
        .map(|t| (t, util::dist(me, [t.position.x, t.position.y, t.position.z])))
        .filter(|(_, d)| *d <= 10.0)
        .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
        .map(|(t, _)| (t.id, [t.position.x, t.position.y, t.position.z], t.extra.main_hand.clone(), t.fall_distance));
    let pearl = thrown && on("pearl");
    let threat = enemy.as_ref().is_some_and(|(_, at, weapon, fall)| {
        let weapon = weapon.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
        let sword = tagged(game, weapon, "minecraft:swords") || tagged(game, weapon, "minecraft:axes");
        let worst = worst_threat(game, &on, *at, me, airborne, weapon == "minecraft:mace", *fall);
        worst * m.n("Double hand sensitivity") >= health || (on("sword") && sword && health < 1.0)
    });
    if !(threat || pearl) {
        return false;
    }
    hold(game, slot);
    st(|s| s.double_next = game.ticks + m.n("Reswap delay (ticks)").max(1.0) as u64);
    true
}

// The most a threat near the enemy at `at` could take from you, each counted by how sure it is.
fn worst_threat(game: &mut Game<'_>, on: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool, at: [f64; 3], me: [f64; 3], airborne: bool, mace: bool, fall: f64) -> f64 {
    use super::sunset_explosive_damage::{Blast, observed_local_damage};
    let mut budget = super::sunset_explosive_policy::Budget::new(24);
    let mut worst: f64 = 0.0;
    let near = |p: [i32; 3]| util::dist(at, util::center_of(p)) < 5.0;
    if on("crystals") {
        let crystals: Vec<[f64; 3]> = game.crystals.iter().map(|c| [c.position.x, c.position.y, c.position.z]).collect();
        for c in crystals {
            worst = worst.max(observed_local_damage(game, Blast::explosion(c, 6.0), &mut budget).unwrap_or(0.0));
        }
    }
    let base = at.map(|v| v.floor() as i32);
    let mut anchors = Vec::new();
    let mut bases = Vec::new();
    for x in -5..=5 {
        for y in -5..=5 {
            for z in -5..=5 {
                let p = [base[0] + x, base[1] + y, base[2] + z];
                if !near(p) || !game.world.loaded(p[0], p[2]) {
                    continue;
                }
                let name = util::short(&util::facts(game, p).name);
                if name == "respawn_anchor" && on("anchors") && charged(game, p) {
                    anchors.push(p);
                } else if name == "obsidian" && on("obsidian") && airborne && f64::from(p[1]) < me[1] && util::is_air(game, [p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2]]) {
                    bases.push(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for p in anchors {
        worst = worst.max(observed_local_damage(game, Blast::anchor(p), &mut budget).unwrap_or(0.0));
    }
    for p in bases {
        let crystal = [f64::from(p[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(p[1]) + 1.0, f64::from(p[2]) + 0.5];
        worst = worst.max(0.5 * observed_local_damage(game, Blast::explosion(crystal, 6.0), &mut budget).unwrap_or(0.0));
    }
    if on("mace") && mace && fall > 1.5 && at[1] > me[1] {
        worst = worst.max(6.0 + fall * 5.0);
    }
    worst
}

fn charged(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    let b = game.world.block(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
    game.pack.assets.registry.state(b).and_then(|s| s.properties.get("charges")).is_some_and(|c| c != "0")
}
```

```rs
// Hand View's No sway: the hands do not lag behind the view as it turns.
fn sunset_sway() -> std::ops::ControlFlow<[f32; 2]> {
    if crate::first_person::sunset_hand_view::NO_SWAY.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break([0.0, 0.0]);
    }
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/sync_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Flight's Packet anti kick asks for the next move packet to carry the position (LocalPlayer.positionReminder = 20).
// And a move packet whose ground Sunset changed: what the server was told, so the game's next update compares with
// that and sends the real ground as soon as Sunset stops changing it (else the server keeps the changed one until
// the next move). The window's thread only.

use std::cell::Cell;

thread_local! {
    static REMIND: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    static GROUND: Cell<Option<bool>> = const { Cell::new(None) };
}

pub fn remind() {
    REMIND.with(|c| c.set(true));
}

pub fn take() -> bool {
    REMIND.with(|c| c.replace(false))
}

pub fn told_ground(on_ground: bool) {
    GROUND.with(|c| c.set(Some(on_ground)));
}

pub fn take_ground() -> Option<bool> {
    GROUND.with(|c| c.take())
}
```

```rs
// Flight: the next move packet carries the position when the anti kick asks for it. A move packet whose ground Sunset
// changed: the game compares with the ground the server was told.
fn sunset_sync(this: &mut PositionSender) {
    if crate::player_sync::sunset_sync::take() {
        this.reminder = 20;
    }
    if let Some(told) = crate::player_sync::sunset_sync::take_ground() {
        this.on_ground = told;
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/target_esp.rs`:

```rs
// Target ESP: a light marker on the one target you are fighting (Kill Aura's, or what the crosshair is on).

use super::Game;
use super::remote_chunks::ChunkFormat;
use super::sunset::{Camera, Canvas, Category, Module, accent, gui_open, own_id};
use super::sunset_target_esp_math::{brackets, clip, eligible, sightline};
use super::sunset_util::dist;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new(
            "Target ESP",
            Category::Render,
            "Marks your target.",
        )
        .pick("Target", &["Combat or crosshair", "Combat", "Crosshair"])
        .bool("Players only", false)
        .bool("Through walls", false)
        .num("Range", 32.0, 4.0, 64.0, 1.0)
        .num("Corner length", 9.0, 3.0, 20.0, 1.0)
        .num("Padding", 3.0, 0.0, 10.0, 1.0)
        .num("Thickness", 1.5, 0.5, 4.0, 0.5)
        .bool("Outline", true)
        .pick("Color", &["Accent", "Custom"])
        .colour("Custom color", "White"),
    ]
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Selected {
    index: usize,
    id: u32,
    // The engine replaces this Arc on every join/respawn/dimension change.
    // Retaining the old Arc prevents address reuse from accepting a new level.
    level: Arc<ChunkFormat>,
}

static SELECTED: Mutex<Option<Selected>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn visible(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.native_playing()
        && !game.ui.hide_gui
        && !gui_open()
        && !game.spectator()
        && game
            .player
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|p| p.health.health() > 0.0)
}

fn accepts(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, mob: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob) -> bool {
    mob.kind.id != "minecraft:armor_stand"
        && eligible(
            mob.id,
            own_id(game),
            mob.health,
            mob.removed,
            mob.is_invisible(),
            mob.kind.id == "minecraft:player",
            m.b("Players only"),
        )
}

// Call after Kill Aura's tick; pass None when Kill Aura is disabled. Selection
// work (including the native crosshair ray test) happens once a tick, not once
// a rendered frame. There is no last-hit memory or search for a nearby target.
pub(super) fn tick(game: &Game<'_>, modules: &[Module], combat_id: Option<u32>) {
    let mut selected = SELECTED.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    *selected = None;
    let Some(m) = modules.iter().find(|m| m.name == "Target ESP" && m.on) else {
        return;
    };
    if !visible(game) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(remote) = game.remote.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    let allowed = |i: usize| {
        let mob = game.mobs.get(i)?;
        if !accepts(game, m, mob) {
            return None;
        }
        let b = mob.bounds();
        let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        let mid = [
            (lo.x + hi.x) / 2.0,
            (lo.y + hi.y) / 2.0,
            (lo.z + hi.z) / 2.0,
        ];
        let (direction, distance) = sightline(eye, mid, m.n("Range"))?;
        // Use the host's voxel traversal and real contextual OUTLINE shapes,
        // including partial slabs/doors/fences. No full-cube approximation.
        // This one center ray runs on the tick, never for every rendered frame.
        if !m.b("Through walls") && game.clip_ray(eye, direction, distance - 0.001).is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(i)
    };
    let combat = if m.p("Target") != "Crosshair" {
        combat_id
            .and_then(|id| game.mobs.iter().position(|mob| mob.id == id))
            .and_then(allowed)
    } else {
        None
    };
    let picked = combat.or_else(|| {
        (m.p("Target") != "Combat")
            .then(|| game.mob_hit())
            .flatten()
            .and_then(|(i, _)| allowed(i))
    });
    if let Some(index) = picked {
        *selected = Some(Selected {
            index,
            id: game.mobs[index].id,
            level: Arc::clone(&remote.chunk_format),
        });
    }
}

// Constant work: one indexed entity lookup, eight projected points, at most
// sixteen clipped rectangles in the existing HUD batch, and no allocations.
pub(super) fn draw(
    game: &Game<'_>,
    cam: &Camera,
    m: &Module,
    viewport: [f32; 2],
    lw: f32,
    out: &mut impl Canvas,
) {
    if !m.on || !visible(game) {
        return;
    }
    let selected = SELECTED.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    let (Some(selected), Some(remote)) = (selected, game.remote.as_ref()) else {
        return;
    };
    if !Arc::ptr_eq(&selected.level, &remote.chunk_format) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(mob) = game
        .mobs
        .get(selected.index)
        .filter(|mob| mob.id == selected.id && accepts(game, m, mob))
    else {
        return;
    };
    let alpha = game.clock.camera_fraction();
    let off = [
        (mob.previous.x - mob.position.x) * (1.0 - alpha),
        (mob.previous.y - mob.position.y) * (1.0 - alpha),
        (mob.previous.z - mob.position.z) * (1.0 - alpha),
    ];
    let b = mob.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    let lo = [lo.x + off[0], lo.y + off[1], lo.z + off[2]];
    let hi = [hi.x + off[0], hi.y + off[1], hi.z + off[2]];
    let mid = [
        (lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0,
        (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0,
        (lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2.0,
    ];
    if dist(cam.eye(), mid) > m.n("Range") {
        return;
    }
    // Skip boxes crossing the camera's near plane rather than emitting huge
    // screen-spanning geometry. The marker returns once all corners project.
    let Some(bounds) = cam.corners(lo, hi).and_then(|points| cam.bounds(&points)) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(rects) = brackets(
        bounds,
        m.n("Thickness") as f32,
        m.n("Padding") as f32,
        m.n("Corner length") as f32,
    ) else {
        return;
    };
    if m.b("Outline") {
        for rect in rects {
            if let Some(rect) = clip(rect, viewport, lw.max(0.5)) {
                out.fill(rect, 0xE010_1010);
            }
        }
    }
    let color = if m.p("Color") == "Custom" {
        m.c("Custom color")
    } else {
        0xFF00_0000 | accent()
    };
    for rect in rects {
        if let Some(rect) = clip(rect, viewport, 0.0) {
            out.fill(rect, color);
        }
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/target_esp_math.rs`:

```rs
// Target ESP's marker on screen (fixed-size corner brackets) and which targets it marks.

// Unit ray and bounded distance for the native block-outline clipper. Invalid
// or zero-length geometry must never enter voxel traversal.
pub(super) fn sightline(eye: [f64; 3], target: [f64; 3], range: f64) -> Option<([f64; 3], f64)> {
    if !eye
        .iter()
        .chain(target.iter())
        .chain([range].iter())
        .all(|v| v.is_finite())
        || range <= 0.0
    {
        return None;
    }
    let delta = std::array::from_fn::<_, 3, _>(|i| target[i] - eye[i]);
    let distance = delta.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
    (distance.is_finite() && distance > 0.001 && distance <= range)
        .then(|| (delta.map(|v| v / distance), distance))
}

pub(super) fn eligible(
    id: u32,
    own: Option<u32>,
    health: f32,
    removed: bool,
    invisible: bool,
    player: bool,
    players_only: bool,
) -> bool {
    Some(id) != own
        && health.is_finite()
        && health > 0.0
        && !removed
        && !invisible
        && (!players_only || player)
}

// Bounds are [left, top, right, bottom]. The arms stay at the actual projected
// corners: clipping must not turn an offscreen target into a screen-edge box.
pub(super) fn brackets(
    bounds: [f32; 4],
    thickness: f32,
    padding: f32,
    length: f32,
) -> Option<[[f32; 4]; 8]> {
    if !bounds
        .iter()
        .chain([thickness, padding, length].iter())
        .all(|v| v.is_finite())
        || thickness <= 0.0
        || padding < 0.0
        || length <= 0.0
        || bounds[2] - bounds[0] < 2.0
        || bounds[3] - bounds[1] < 2.0
    {
        return None;
    }
    let [l, t, r, b] = [
        bounds[0] - padding,
        bounds[1] - padding,
        bounds[2] + padding,
        bounds[3] + padding,
    ];
    let thick = thickness.min((r - l) / 4.0).min((b - t) / 4.0);
    let arm = length.min((r - l) / 4.0).min((b - t) / 4.0).max(thick);
    Some([
        [l, t, arm, thick],
        [l, t + thick, thick, arm - thick],
        [r - arm, t, arm, thick],
        [r - thick, t + thick, thick, arm - thick],
        [l, b - thick, arm, thick],
        [l, b - arm, thick, arm - thick],
        [r - arm, b - thick, arm, thick],
        [r - thick, b - arm, thick, arm - thick],
    ])
}

pub(super) fn clip(rect: [f32; 4], viewport: [f32; 2], grow: f32) -> Option<[f32; 4]> {
    if !rect
        .iter()
        .chain(viewport.iter())
        .chain([grow].iter())
        .all(|v| v.is_finite())
        || viewport[0] <= 0.0
        || viewport[1] <= 0.0
        || rect[2] <= 0.0
        || rect[3] <= 0.0
        || grow < 0.0
    {
        return None;
    }
    let l = (rect[0] - grow).max(0.0);
    let t = (rect[1] - grow).max(0.0);
    let r = (rect[0] + rect[2] + grow).min(viewport[0]);
    let b = (rect[1] + rect[3] + grow).min(viewport[1]);
    (r > l && b > t).then_some([l, t, r - l, b - t])
}
```

`mixins/sunset/text_edit.rs`:

```rs
// A text setting's draft while the GUI's editor is open (Rust's pull request #4): one line, edited at its caret,
// and the setting only changes when Apply is clicked.

pub(super) const MAX_BYTES: usize = 4096;

// One line, of at most MAX_BYTES bytes.
pub(super) fn check(text: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if text.len() > MAX_BYTES {
        Err("4096 bytes at most")
    } else if text.chars().any(|c| c.is_control() || matches!(c, '\u{2028}' | '\u{2029}')) {
        Err("one line, no control characters")
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(super) enum EditKey {
    Left,
    Right,
    Home,
    End,
    Backspace,
    Delete,
    SelectAll,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Draft {
    text: String,
    // A byte offset on a character boundary.
    caret: usize,
    selected: bool,
    pub(super) error: Option<&'static str>,
}

impl Draft {
    pub(super) fn new(text: &str) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
        check(text)?;
        Ok(Self { text: text.to_owned(), caret: text.len(), selected: false, error: None })
    }
    pub(super) fn text(&self) -> &str {
        &self.text
    }
    pub(super) fn caret(&self) -> usize {
        self.caret
    }
    pub(super) fn selected(&self) -> bool {
        self.selected && !self.text.is_empty()
    }
    fn previous(&self) -> usize {
        self.text[..self.caret].char_indices().next_back().map_or(0, |(i, _)| i)
    }
    fn next(&self) -> usize {
        self.caret + self.text[self.caret..].chars().next().map_or(0, char::len_utf8)
    }
    // Typed text at the caret (over the whole text when it is selected); refused whole if it would break the rules.
    pub(super) fn insert(&mut self, text: &str) {
        let kept = if self.selected { 0 } else { self.text.len() };
        if let Err(e) = check(text).and_then(|()| if kept + text.len() > MAX_BYTES { Err("4096 bytes at most") } else { Ok(()) }) {
            self.error = Some(e);
            return;
        }
        if self.selected {
            self.text.clear();
            self.caret = 0;
        }
        self.text.insert_str(self.caret, text);
        self.caret += text.len();
        self.selected = false;
        self.error = None;
    }
    pub(super) fn key(&mut self, key: EditKey) {
        use EditKey::*;
        let selected = std::mem::take(&mut self.selected);
        match key {
            SelectAll => self.selected = true,
            Left => self.caret = if selected { 0 } else { self.previous() },
            Right => self.caret = if selected { self.text.len() } else { self.next() },
            Home => self.caret = 0,
            End => self.caret = self.text.len(),
            Backspace | Delete if selected => {
                self.text.clear();
                self.caret = 0;
            }
            Backspace => {
                let at = self.previous();
                self.text.replace_range(at..self.caret, "");
                self.caret = at;
            }
            Delete => {
                let end = self.next();
                self.text.replace_range(self.caret..end, "");
            }
        }
        self.error = None;
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/text_hook.rs`:

```rs
// Sunset's text, in Sunset's font.
fn sunset_text_hook(game: &Game<'_>, batch: &mut HudBatch, text: &str, at: [f32; 2], rgb: u32, shadow: bool) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<()> {
    if !horizon_client::font::sunset_font::enabled() {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    horizon_client::font::sunset_font::sync(&game.gui.atlas.font, batch.scale);
    // Each glyph on whole screen pixels, and a soft shadow a screen pixel away in place of Minecraft's hard one.
    let snap = |v: f32| (v * batch.scale).round() / batch.scale;
    let (x, y) = (snap(at[0]), snap(at[1]));
    let [_, r, g, b] = rgb.to_be_bytes();
    let color = rgba(r, g, b, 0xFF);
    let styled = horizon_client::font::sunset_font::text(text);
    if shadow {
        batch.text_styled(&game.gui.atlas, &styled, x + 1.0 / batch.scale, y + 1.0 / batch.scale, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0x60), false);
    }
    batch.text_styled(&game.gui.atlas, &styled, x, y, color, false);
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/timer.rs`:

```rs
// Timer: the frame's elapsed time, scaled.
fn sunset_timer_hook(this: &mut FixedStep, elapsed: std::time::Duration) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<u32> {
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    let m = f32::from_bits(sunset_timer::MULT.load(Relaxed));
    if m == 1.0 || sunset_timer::BUSY.swap(true, Relaxed) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    let ticks = this.advance(elapsed.mul_f32(m));
    sunset_timer::BUSY.store(false, Relaxed);
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(ticks)
}
```

`mixins/sunset/util.rs`:

```rs
// Shared helpers for Sunset's modules, ported from Meteor's BlockUtils,
// InvUtils, PlayerUtils and TargetUtils: placing blocks, finding items in the
// hotbar, picking targets, seeing a block through the world.

use super::sunset::{Camera, Canvas, Module, hold, look_at, say, toggle, turn_then, with};
use super::sunset_visual::{Look, draw_box};
use super::{Game, Screen};
use horizon_protocol::packets::{
    Empty,
    play::{self, Serverbound as S},
};
use std::sync::Mutex;

// The next block-action sequence number, from the game's own counter.
pub(super) fn sequence(game: &mut Game<'_>) -> i32 {
    super::remote::sunset_remote::next(game)
}

// Boxes the modules want drawn this frame: where they will place or break.
static SHOW: Mutex<Vec<([i32; 3], u32)>> = Mutex::new(Vec::new());

pub(super) fn show_clear() {
    SHOW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clear();
}

pub(super) fn show(pos: [i32; 3], argb: u32) {
    let mut v = SHOW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if v.len() < 600 {
        v.push((pos, argb));
    }
}

pub(super) fn draw_shown(cam: &Camera, out: &mut impl Canvas, lw: f32) {
    for &(p, c) in SHOW.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).iter() {
        let lo = [f64::from(p[0]), f64::from(p[1]), f64::from(p[2])];
        draw_box(cam, out, &Look::BOXED, lo, [lo[0] + 1.0, lo[1] + 1.0, lo[2] + 1.0], c, lw);
    }
}

// ---- block searches spread over ticks

// About how many blocks a search reads in one tick: Block ESP's whole cube (65 blocks a side) takes a second instead
// of one long tick.
const SWEEP_BUDGET: usize = 12_000;
// What a search keeps, nearest first; the drawing stops at the module's Max long before.
const SWEEP_KEEP: usize = 16_384;

// A search of the blocks round the player (Block ESP, Hole ESP, Tunnel ESP, Void ESP, Light Overlay), a slice of
// columns (one x) at a time over as many ticks as it takes; each whole pass replaces what the last one found.
pub(super) struct Sweep<V> {
    // The last whole pass: where, and what the search noted there, nearest its centre first.
    pub(super) found: Vec<([i32; 3], V)>,
    next: Vec<([i32; 3], V)>,
    centre: [i32; 3],
    radius: i32,
    // The next slice while a pass runs.
    x: Option<i32>,
    // The settings the search is for, and the tick its last pass ended (0: none yet).
    key: u64,
    done: u64,
}

impl<V> Default for Sweep<V> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl<V> Sweep<V> {
    pub(super) const fn new() -> Self {
        Self { found: Vec::new(), next: Vec::new(), centre: [0; 3], radius: 0, x: None, key: 0, done: 0 }
    }

    // One tick of the search round `at`, `radius` slices each way. A pass starts `every` ticks after the last one
    // ended, when the player is `moved` blocks from where it was made, or at once when `key` (what it looks for)
    // changes. `slice(centre, x, out)` searches the slice at `x` and says how many blocks it read. True when a pass
    // ended this tick.
    pub(super) fn tick(
        &mut self,
        ticks: u64,
        at: [i32; 3],
        radius: i32,
        key: u64,
        every: u64,
        moved: i32,
        mut slice: impl FnMut([i32; 3], i32, &mut Vec<([i32; 3], V)>) -> usize,
    ) -> bool {
        if key != self.key {
            self.found.clear();
            self.x = None;
        }
        if self.x.is_none() {
            let far = (0..3).any(|i| (at[i] - self.centre[i]).abs() >= moved);
            if self.done != 0 && key == self.key && ticks.saturating_sub(self.done) < every && !far {
                return false;
            }
            (self.key, self.centre, self.radius, self.x) = (key, at, radius, Some(at[0] - radius));
            self.next.clear();
        }
        let mut read = 0;
        while let Some(x) = self.x.filter(|x| *x <= self.centre[0] + self.radius) {
            read += slice(self.centre, x, &mut self.next);
            self.x = Some(x + 1);
            if self.next.len() > 2 * SWEEP_KEEP {
                self.nearest();
            }
            if read >= SWEEP_BUDGET {
                return false;
            }
        }
        self.nearest();
        std::mem::swap(&mut self.found, &mut self.next);
        self.next.clear();
        self.done = ticks.max(1);
        self.x = None;
        true
    }

    // The pass so far, nearest first and cut to what is kept.
    fn nearest(&mut self) {
        let c = self.centre;
        let far = |p: &[i32; 3]| (0..3).map(|i| i64::from(p[i] - c[i]).pow(2)).sum::<i64>();
        self.next.sort_unstable_by_key(|(p, _)| far(p));
        self.next.truncate(SWEEP_KEEP);
    }
}

// ---- names and lists

pub(super) fn short(name: &str) -> &str {
    name.strip_prefix("minecraft:").unwrap_or(name)
}

// Whether `name` is in a comma separated list (`obsidian, minecraft:anvil`).
pub(super) fn listed(list: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    let name = short(name);
    list.split(',').any(|x| short(x.trim()) == name)
}

// A name passes a module's list: on it in List mode Whitelist, not on it in Blacklist.
pub(super) fn passes(m: &Module, list: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    listed(m.t(list), name) != (m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist")
}

// A mob a module with kind switches wants: its kind switched on, with the Entities list adding mob types to that
// (List mode Whitelist) or taking them out of it (Blacklist).
pub(super) fn kind_wanted(of_kind: bool, list: &str, blacklist: bool, id: &str) -> bool {
    if blacklist { of_kind && !listed(list, id) } else { of_kind || listed(list, id) }
}

pub(super) fn toggle_off(game: &mut Game<'_>, name: &str) {
    if let Some(i) = with(|s| s.find(name)) {
        if with(|s| s.modules[i].on) {
            toggle(game, i, false);
        }
    }
}

// ---- blocks

pub(super) fn facts<'a>(game: &'a Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> &'a horizon_items::blocks::StateFacts {
    game.res.facts().get(game.world.block(p[0], p[1], p[2]))
}

pub(super) fn is_air(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    game.res.facts().is_air(game.world.block(p[0], p[1], p[2]))
}

// `BlockState.canBeReplaced`: air, fluids, plants.
pub(super) fn replaceable(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    is_air(game, p) || facts(game, p).replaceable
}

pub(super) fn center_of(p: [i32; 3]) -> [f64; 3] {
    [f64::from(p[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(p[1]) + 0.5, f64::from(p[2]) + 0.5]
}

pub(super) fn dist(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2) + (a[2] - b[2]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

pub(super) fn player_pos(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    let p = game.player.as_ref()?;
    Some([p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z])
}

pub(super) fn block_pos(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<[i32; 3]> {
    let p = player_pos(game)?;
    Some([p[0].floor() as i32, p[1].floor() as i32, p[2].floor() as i32])
}

// The block the feet are in: on a slab, soul sand, a path, carpet or snow, the block of the position is the one stood
// on, so it is the one above.
pub(super) fn feet_block(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<[i32; 3]> {
    let p = block_pos(game)?;
    Some(if replaceable(game, p) { p } else { [p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2]] })
}

// `PlayerUtils.centerPlayer`: on the middle of its block. The move packet of
// the tick carries it (the server takes one a tick).
pub(super) fn center_player(game: &mut Game<'_>) {
    if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
        p.position.x = p.position.x.floor() + 0.5;
        p.position.z = p.position.z.floor() + 0.5;
    }
}

// A solid-ish block in the way between the eyes and `to`, sampled along the line.
pub(super) fn clear_line(game: &Game<'_>, to: [f64; 3], except: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return false;
    };
    let d = dist(eye, to);
    let steps = (d * 8.0).ceil().max(1.0) as i32;
    for i in 1..steps {
        let t = f64::from(i) / f64::from(steps);
        let at = [
            (eye[0] + (to[0] - eye[0]) * t).floor() as i32,
            (eye[1] + (to[1] - eye[1]) * t).floor() as i32,
            (eye[2] + (to[2] - eye[2]) * t).floor() as i32,
        ];
        if at != except && !is_air(game, at) && facts(game, at).full_collision {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

// Meteor's `isOutOfRange`, the other way round: within `range` of the eyes,
// and either in plain sight or within `walls`.
pub(super) fn in_reach(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], range: f64, walls: f64) -> bool {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return false;
    };
    let c = center_of(p);
    let d = dist(eye, c);
    if d > range {
        return false;
    }
    clear_line(game, c, p) || d <= walls
}

// ---- placing

// The directions a block can be clicked from: where the neighbour is, and the
// face of it that points back.
const SIDES: [([i32; 3], i32); 6] = [
    ([0, -1, 0], 1),
    ([0, 1, 0], 0),
    ([0, 0, -1], 3),
    ([0, 0, 1], 2),
    ([-1, 0, 0], 5),
    ([1, 0, 0], 4),
];

// `BlockUtils.getPlaceSide`: a neighbour to click, the one the eyes face most.
pub(super) fn place_side(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> Option<([i32; 3], i32)> {
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let c = center_of(p);
    let look = [c[0] - eye[0], c[1] - eye[1], c[2] - eye[2]];
    let mut best: Option<(f64, usize)> = None;
    for (i, (d, _)) in SIDES.iter().enumerate() {
        let n = [p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2]];
        if is_air(game, n) {
            continue;
        }
        let f = facts(game, n);
        // A block you would open instead of placing against, or a fluid.
        if f.block_entity || f.fluid_level > 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let relevancy = look[0] * f64::from(d[0]) + look[1] * f64::from(d[1]) + look[2] * f64::from(d[2]);
        if best.is_none_or(|(b, _)| relevancy > b) {
            best = Some((relevancy, i));
        }
    }
    best.map(|(_, i)| {
        let (d, face) = SIDES[i];
        ([p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2]], face)
    })
}

pub(super) fn has_support(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    place_side(game, p).is_some()
}

// Entities that stop a block going in: the player and the living things.
fn obstructed(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    let lo = [f64::from(p[0]), f64::from(p[1]), f64::from(p[2])];
    let hi = [lo[0] + 1.0, lo[1] + 1.0, lo[2] + 1.0];
    let hits = |a: horizon_core::geometry::Aabb| {
        let (l, h) = (a.min_position(), a.max_position());
        l.x < hi[0] && h.x > lo[0] && l.y < hi[1] && h.y > lo[1] && l.z < hi[2] && h.z > lo[2]
    };
    if game.player.as_ref().is_some_and(|pl| hits(pl.bounds())) {
        return true;
    }
    game.mobs.iter().any(|m| m.alive() && !m.removed && hits(m.bounds()))
}

// `BlockUtils.canPlaceBlock`.
pub(super) fn can_place(game: &Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], check_entities: bool) -> bool {
    p[1] >= -64 && p[1] < 320 && replaceable(game, p) && (!check_entities || !obstructed(game, p))
}

// `BlockUtils.place`: puts the block in hotbar `slot` (or the offhand's, slot OFFHAND) at `p`, clicking a
// neighbour (or the position itself when there is none, an air place).
pub(super) fn place_block(game: &mut Game<'_>, p: [i32; 3], slot: usize, rotate: bool, check_entities: bool) -> bool {
    if (slot > 8 && slot != OFFHAND) || game.remote.is_none() || !can_place(game, p, check_entities) {
        return false;
    }
    if game.eye_position().is_none() {
        return false;
    }
    let (neighbor, face) = place_side(game, p).unwrap_or((p, 1));
    let hit = if neighbor == p {
        let c = center_of(p);
        [c[0], c[1] + 0.5, c[2]]
    } else {
        let c = center_of(p);
        let d = [neighbor[0] - p[0], neighbor[1] - p[1], neighbor[2] - p[2]];
        [c[0] + f64::from(d[0]) * 0.5, c[1] + f64::from(d[1]) * 0.5, c[2] + f64::from(d[2]) * 0.5]
    };
    let cursor = [
        (hit[0] - f64::from(neighbor[0])) as f32,
        (hit[1] - f64::from(neighbor[1])) as f32,
        (hit[2] - f64::from(neighbor[2])) as f32,
    ];
    turned_to(game, "Place", rotate, hit, move |game| {
        let before = game.selected;
        let offhand = slot == OFFHAND;
        if !offhand {
            hold(game, slot);
        }
        let seq = sequence(game);
        game.send(S::UseItemOn(play::UseItemOn {
            hand: i32::from(offhand),
            pos: neighbor,
            face,
            cursor,
            inside: false,
            world_border: false,
            sequence: seq,
        }));
        game.swing_arm();
        game.send(S::Punch(Empty));
        if !offhand {
            hold(game, before);
        }
    });
    true
}

// Does `deed`, after the server's look has turned to `at` when `rotate` says so (see turn_then).
pub(super) fn turned_to(
    game: &mut Game<'_>,
    who: &'static str,
    rotate: bool,
    at: [f64; 3],
    deed: impl for<'a, 'b> FnOnce(&'a mut Game<'b>) + Send + 'static,
) {
    match game.eye_position().filter(|_| rotate) {
        Some(eye) => {
            let (yaw, pitch) = look_at(eye, at);
            turn_then(who, yaw, pitch, deed);
        }
        None => deed(game),
    }
}

// ---- items

// The first hotbar slot whose item matches.
pub(super) fn find_hotbar(game: &Game<'_>, want: impl Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    (0..9).find(|&i| {
        game.inventory
            .get(i)
            .and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
            .is_some_and(|s| want(short(&s.item)))
    })
}

// The offhand, as a slot place_block takes.
pub(super) const OFFHAND: usize = 40;

// `InvUtils.findInHotbar`: the offhand first, then the hand, then the rest of the hotbar.
pub(super) fn find_held(game: &Game<'_>, want: impl Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    if game.offhand.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| want(short(&s.item))) {
        return Some(OFFHAND);
    }
    let hand = game.inventory.get(game.selected).and_then(|s| s.as_ref()).is_some_and(|s| want(short(&s.item)));
    if hand { Some(game.selected) } else { find_hotbar(game, want) }
}

// Anywhere in the inventory (0 to 35): hotbar first.
pub(super) fn find_inventory(game: &Game<'_>, want: impl Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    (0..36).find(|&i| {
        game.inventory
            .get(i)
            .and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
            .is_some_and(|s| want(short(&s.item)))
    })
}

// ---- targets

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(super) struct Target {
    pub id: u32,
    pub pos: [f64; 3],
    pub prev: [f64; 3],
    pub health: f32,
    pub lo: [f64; 3],
    pub hi: [f64; 3],
    pub player: bool,
    pub kind: String,
}

pub(super) fn mob_target(m: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob) -> Target {
    let b = m.bounds();
    let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
    Target {
        id: m.id,
        pos: [m.position.x, m.position.y, m.position.z],
        prev: [m.previous.x, m.previous.y, m.previous.z],
        health: m.health,
        lo: [lo.x, lo.y, lo.z],
        hi: [hi.x, hi.y, hi.z],
        player: m.kind.id == "minecraft:player",
        kind: m.kind.id.to_string(),
    }
}

// Every other player the client knows of, friends left out.
pub(super) fn other_players(game: &Game<'_>) -> Vec<Target> {
    let names = game.remote_player_names();
    let friends = with(|s| s.friends.clone());
    game.mobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|m| m.kind.id == "minecraft:player" && m.alive() && !m.removed)
        .filter_map(|m| {
            let name = names.iter().find(|(i, _)| *i == m.id).map(|(_, n)| n.clone())?;
            if friends.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name)) {
                return None;
            }
            Some(mob_target(m))
        })
        .collect()
}

// A player Crystal Aura and Anchor Aura may hurt: listed as playing in survival or adventure, not a friend, and on no
// team that keeps you from hurting them.
pub(super) fn player_enemy(game: &Game<'_>, mob: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob) -> bool {
    if mob.kind.id != "minecraft:player"
        || !mob.health.is_finite()
        || !mob.alive()
        || mob.removed
        || Some(mob.id) == super::sunset::own_id(game)
        || game.riding == Some(mob.id)
        || !matches!(super::remote::sunset_combat_remote::player_mode(game, mob.id), Some(0 | 2))
    {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(name) = game.remote_player_name(mob.id) else {
        return false;
    };
    if with(|s| s.friends.iter().any(|friend| friend.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))) {
        return false;
    }
    horizon_client::scoreboard::teams_allow_damage(
        game.score.board.players_team(&game.options.player_name()),
        game.mob_team(mob.id),
    )
}

// The key or mouse button a text setting names is held.
pub(super) fn setting_key_down(game: &Game<'_>, module: &Module, setting: &str) -> bool {
    let Some(name) = super::sunset::key_from_text(module.t(setting)) else {
        return false;
    };
    game.physical_keys.iter().chain(game.keys.iter()).any(|key| horizon_client::keybinds::key_name(*key) == Some(name.as_str()))
        || game.physical_buttons.iter().any(|button| horizon_client::keybinds::mouse_name(*button) == name)
}

// Where a look (yaw, pitch) meets the face (0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east) of block `clicked`, within
// `range` and reach; None if it meets anything else first.
pub(super) fn block_contact(game: &Game<'_>, look: (f32, f32), clicked: [i32; 3], face: i32, range: f64) -> Option<[f64; 3]> {
    block_hit(game, look, clicked, range).filter(|hit| hit.0 == face).map(|hit| hit.1)
}

// The face (0 down .. 5 east) and point where the look from your eyes first meets the block at `clicked`, within
// `range`: for a click that any face of the block takes (an end crystal on obsidian).
pub(super) fn block_hit(game: &Game<'_>, look: (f32, f32), clicked: [i32; 3], range: f64) -> Option<(i32, [f64; 3])> {
    if !look.0.is_finite() || !look.1.is_finite() || !range.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(look.0).to_radians(), f64::from(look.1).to_radians());
    let direction = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let hit = game.clip_ray(game.eye_position()?, direction, range.min(game.reach())).filter(|hit| hit.pos == clicked)?;
    let face = match hit.face {
        [0, -1, 0] => 0,
        [0, 1, 0] => 1,
        [0, 0, -1] => 2,
        [0, 0, 1] => 3,
        [-1, 0, 0] => 4,
        [1, 0, 0] => 5,
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some((face, hit.point))
}

pub(super) fn every_living(game: &Game<'_>) -> Vec<Target> {
    game.mobs.iter().filter(|m| m.alive() && !m.removed).map(mob_target).collect()
}

// What to call an entity: a player's name, a custom name, or what it is.
pub(super) fn display_name(game: &Game<'_>, mob: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob) -> String {
    let mut name = String::new();
    name_into(game, mob, &mut name);
    name
}

// The same, written over `out`: Nametags reuse one buffer for every mob of every frame.
pub(super) fn name_into(game: &Game<'_>, mob: &horizon_client::mobs::Mob, out: &mut String) {
    out.clear();
    if let Some(n) = game.remote_player_name(mob.id).or(mob.custom_name.as_deref()) {
        out.push_str(n);
        return;
    }
    // "minecraft:zombie_villager" as "Zombie Villager".
    for (i, part) in short(&mob.kind.id).split('_').enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(' ');
        }
        let mut c = part.chars();
        if let Some(f) = c.next() {
            out.extend(f.to_uppercase());
            out.push_str(c.as_str());
        }
    }
}

// Who the targeting modules leave alone: with Anti bot, a player the server's player list does not show or with a name
// no account could have; with Ignore teams, anyone on your own scoreboard team.
pub(super) fn spared(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, id: u32, player: bool) -> bool {
    // A name no account could have: 3 to 16 letters, digits or _, with the . or * Bedrock players get from Geyser.
    if player
        && m.b("Anti bot")
        && game.remote_player_name(id).is_some_and(|n| {
            let core = n.strip_prefix(['.', '*']).unwrap_or(n);
            !(3..=16).contains(&core.len()) || !core.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_')
        })
    {
        return true;
    }
    if player
        && m.b("Anti bot")
        && let Some(online) = game.remote_online_names()
        && game.remote_player_name(id).is_none_or(|n| !online.iter().any(|o| o == n))
    {
        return true;
    }
    m.b("Ignore teams")
        && horizon_client::scoreboard::teams_allied(game.score.board.players_team(&game.options.player_name()), game.mob_team(id))
}

pub(super) const PRIORITIES: &[&str] = &["Lowest distance", "Highest distance", "Lowest health", "Closest angle"];

// `TargetUtils.getPlayerTarget`: the best player within `range` by priority.
pub(super) fn player_target(game: &Game<'_>, range: f64, priority: &str) -> Option<Target> {
    let eye = game.eye_position()?;
    let mut list: Vec<Target> = other_players(game)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|t| t.health > 0.0 && dist(eye, t.pos) <= range)
        .collect();
    sort_targets(game, &mut list, priority);
    list.into_iter().next()
}

pub(super) fn sort_targets(game: &Game<'_>, list: &mut [Target], priority: &str) {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    let angle = |t: &Target| {
        let (yaw, pitch) = look_at(eye, [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + (t.hi[1] - t.lo[1]) / 2.0, t.pos[2]]);
        let dy = ((yaw - game.yaw + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0).abs();
        f64::from(dy + (pitch - game.pitch).abs())
    };
    match priority {
        "Highest distance" => list.sort_by(|a, b| dist(eye, b.pos).total_cmp(&dist(eye, a.pos))),
        "Lowest health" => list.sort_by(|a, b| a.health.total_cmp(&b.health)),
        "Closest angle" => list.sort_by(|a, b| angle(a).total_cmp(&angle(b))),
        _ => list.sort_by(|a, b| dist(eye, a.pos).total_cmp(&dist(eye, b.pos))),
    }
}

// A comma list's choices as Pick values need 'static: these are the shared ones.
pub(super) const TRAP_BLOCKS: &str = "obsidian,crying_obsidian,netherite_block";

// A module's own chat line, unless ClickGUI's Module messages is off.
pub(super) fn report(game: &mut Game<'_>, msg: &str) {
    if super::sunset::chat_lines("Module messages") {
        say(game, msg);
    }
}

pub(super) fn inventory_idle(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    super::sunset::inventory_idle(game)
}

// The world or server played, as a number for file names: the world's folder in single player, the address on a server.
pub(super) fn world_hash(game: &Game<'_>) -> Option<u64> {
    let r = game.remote.as_ref()?;
    let address = horizon_client::net::shown_address(&r.session.address);
    let name = if address == "local" { game.world_root.display().to_string() } else { address };
    // FNV-1a.
    Some(name.bytes().fold(0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325_u64, |h, b| (h ^ u64::from(b)).wrapping_mul(0x0100_0000_01b3)))
}

pub(super) fn in_world(game: &Game<'_>) -> bool {
    game.native_playing() && game.remote.is_some() && game.player.is_some() && game.screen == Screen::Playing
}

// The most damage the nearest end crystal would do to something standing at `at`
// (a power 6 blast with nothing in the way and no armour: Meteor's DamageUtils
// without the raycast).
pub(super) fn crystal_damage(game: &Game<'_>, at: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    let mut worst: f64 = 0.0;
    for c in &game.crystals {
        let from = [c.position.x, c.position.y, c.position.z];
        let d = dist(from, at) / 12.0;
        if d > 1.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let impact = 1.0 - d;
        worst = worst.max(((impact * impact + impact) / 2.0 * 7.0 * 12.0 + 1.0).floor());
    }
    worst
}
```

`mixins/sunset/vanish.rs`:

```rs
// Anti Vanish (Meteor's AntiVanish): a player who leaves the tab list with no chat line about them has likely gone
// into vanish, and one who comes back with none has come out of it. Completion check also asks the server which
// names a command (/msg) completes: a name it completes that the tab list doesn't show is online but hidden.
// Watched players narrows all of it to some names; Server watchlists gives a server its own.

use super::Game;
use super::sunset::{Category, Module, with};
use horizon_protocol::buf::{Reader, Writer};
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::Serverbound as S;
use std::sync::Mutex;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Anti Vanish", Category::Player, "Reports vanished players.")
            .num("Interval", 100.0, 20.0, 600.0, 10.0)
            .text("Watched players", "")
            .text("Server watchlists", "")
            .bool("Completion check", false)
            .text("Command", "msg"),
    ]
}

// Sunset's completion requests: the game numbers its own up from 0.
const ASK: i32 = -0x5355;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Vs {
    // The server joined last (its address as typed), the ticks since the last check, the tab list's names then
    // (None before the first) and the hidden names the completions showed last.
    server: String,
    timer: u32,
    tab: Option<Vec<String>>,
    hidden: Vec<String>,
}

static VS: Mutex<Option<Vs>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn vs<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Vs) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = VS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(g.get_or_insert_with(Vs::default))
}

// A connection starts: everything known is the last server's.
pub(super) fn connecting(address: &str) {
    vs(|v| {
        *v = Vs {
            server: address.to_owned(),
            ..Vs::default()
        }
    });
}

// An address without its port, for comparing.
fn host(address: &str) -> &str {
    let address = address.trim();
    match address.rsplit_once(':') {
        Some((host, port)) if port.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) => host,
        _ => address,
    }
}

// Whether the module tells you about `name` here: the server's own watchlist if it has one, else Watched players
// (everyone when empty).
fn watched(m: &Module, server: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    let list = m
        .t("Server watchlists")
        .split(';')
        .filter_map(|entry| entry.split_once('='))
        .find(|(s, _)| host(s).eq_ignore_ascii_case(host(server)))
        .map_or(m.t("Watched players"), |(_, names)| names);
    list.trim().is_empty() || list.split(',').any(|n| n.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: Option<&Module>) {
    let Some(m) = m.filter(|_| game.remote.is_some()) else {
        vs(|v| {
            v.timer = 0;
            v.tab = None;
            v.hidden.clear();
        });
        return;
    };
    let due = vs(|v| {
        v.timer += 1;
        v.timer >= m.n("Interval") as u32
    });
    if !due {
        return;
    }
    let now = super::remote::sunset_remote::tab_names(game);
    // A leave or join message names the player: the newest chat lines are where it would be.
    let chat = game.remote_chat(20).unwrap_or_default();
    let quiet = |name: &str| !chat.iter().any(|line| line.contains(name));
    let (server, before) = vs(|v| {
        v.timer = 0;
        (v.server.clone(), v.tab.replace(now.clone()))
    });
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for name in before.iter().flatten().filter(|n| !now.contains(n)) {
        if watched(m, &server, name) && quiet(name) {
            lines.push(format!("{name} left the tab list with no leave message: gone into vanish?"));
        }
    }
    for name in now.iter().filter(|n| before.as_ref().is_some_and(|b| !b.contains(n))) {
        if watched(m, &server, name) && quiet(name) {
            lines.push(format!("{name} came back to the tab list with no join message: out of vanish?"));
        }
    }
    if m.b("Completion check") {
        let mut w = Writer::new();
        w.varint(ASK);
        w.string(&format!("/{} ", m.t("Command").trim().trim_start_matches('/')));
        game.send(S::Unknown(horizon_protocol::ids::play::serverbound::COMMAND_SUGGESTION, w.data));
    }
    for line in lines {
        super::sunset_util::report(game, &line);
    }
}

// The server's completions for Sunset's request (true: the game never sees them): names it completes that the tab
// list doesn't show, each told once while it stays hidden.
pub(super) fn completions(game: &mut Game<'_>, data: &[u8]) -> bool {
    let mut r = Reader::new(data);
    if r.varint().ok() != Some(ASK) {
        return false;
    }
    let names = (|| {
        r.varint().ok()?;
        r.varint().ok()?;
        let n = r.count(4096).ok()?;
        let mut names = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        for _ in 0..n {
            names.push(r.string(256).ok()?);
            if r.bool().ok()? {
                r.nbt().ok()?;
            }
        }
        Some(names)
    })()
    .unwrap_or_default();
    let tab = super::remote::sunset_remote::tab_names(game);
    let own = game.options.player_name();
    let Some(m) = with(|s| s.module("Anti Vanish").filter(|m| m.on).cloned()) else {
        return true;
    };
    let hidden: Vec<String> = names
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|n| n.len() <= 16 && !n.contains(' ') && *n != own && !tab.contains(n))
        .collect();
    let (server, new) = vs(|v| {
        let new: Vec<String> = hidden.iter().filter(|n| !v.hidden.contains(n)).cloned().collect();
        v.hidden = hidden;
        (v.server.clone(), new)
    });
    for name in new.iter().filter(|n| watched(&m, &server, n)) {
        super::sunset_util::report(game, &format!("{name} is online but not in the tab list: in vanish?"));
    }
    true
}
```

```rs
// Anti Vanish's completion requests are answered to it, not to the chat box.
fn sunset_vanish_completions(game: &mut crate::game::Game<'_>, data: &[u8]) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<()> {
    if crate::game::sunset_server_scan::completions(data) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(());
    }
    if crate::game::sunset_vanish::completions(game, data) {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(());
    }
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(())
}
```

`mixins/sunset/vehicle.rs`:

```rs
// Entity Control (Meteor's, which takes in Boat Fly): the boat you drive goes where you look at the speed you set,
// flies up with Jump and down with Sprint, and holds its height otherwise. Horizon simulates a driven boat on the
// client and sends it once a tick (MoveVehicle), so the boat's own tick is where its motion is replaced. Animals
// are driven by the server from your input on Horizon's server, and need a saddle on any server, so this is boats.

use super::sunset::{Category, Module, with};
use super::Game;
use horizon_core::geometry::Vec3;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering::Relaxed};
use winit::keyboard::KeyCode;

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Entity Control", Category::Movement, "Drives and flies boats.")
            .bool("Lock yaw", true)
            .bool("Speed", true)
            .num("Horizontal speed", 10.0, 1.0, 50.0, 0.5)
            .bool("Only on ground", false)
            .bool("In water", true)
            .bool("Fly", false)
            .num("Vertical speed", 6.0, 0.5, 20.0, 0.5)
            .num("Fall speed", 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 0.1)
            .bool("Anti fly kick", true)
            .num("Delay", 40.0, 1.0, 79.0, 1.0),
    ]
}

// Ticks until the next anti kick sink.
static SINK_IN: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

// What the driven boat's motion this tick becomes, from the motion its own tick gave it (`velocity`), whether it
// stands on something and is in water; None when Entity Control is off.
pub(super) fn boat(game: &Game<'_>, velocity: Vec3, on_ground: bool, in_water: bool) -> Option<(Vec3, Option<f32>)> {
    with(|s| s.module("Entity Control").filter(|m| m.on).map(|m| drive(game, m, velocity, on_ground, in_water)))
}

fn drive(game: &Game<'_>, m: &Module, velocity: Vec3, on_ground: bool, in_water: bool) -> (Vec3, Option<f32>) {
    let held = |k: KeyCode| game.keys.contains(&k) || game.physical_keys.contains(&k);
    let mut v = velocity;
    if m.b("Speed") && (!m.b("Only on ground") || on_ground || m.b("Fly")) && (m.b("In water") || !in_water) {
        // The keys' direction turned by the view (PlayerUtils.getHorizontalVelocity).
        let (f, s) = (f64::from(held(KeyCode::KeyW)) - f64::from(held(KeyCode::KeyS)), f64::from(held(KeyCode::KeyA)) - f64::from(held(KeyCode::KeyD)));
        let len = f.hypot(s);
        let (x, z) = if len > 0.0 {
            let r = f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians();
            let (f, s) = (f / len, s / len);
            (s * r.cos() - f * r.sin(), f * r.cos() + s * r.sin())
        } else {
            (0.0, 0.0)
        };
        let speed = m.n("Horizontal speed") / 20.0;
        v = Vec3::new(x * speed, v.y, z * speed);
    }
    if m.b("Fly") {
        let up = m.n("Vertical speed") / 20.0;
        v.y = if held(KeyCode::Space) { up } else { 0.0 } - if held(KeyCode::ControlLeft) { up } else { m.n("Fall speed") / 20.0 };
        // Vanilla kicks a vehicle that floats 80 ticks running; a move down 0.0313 or more starts that count again.
        let left = SINK_IN.load(Relaxed);
        if m.b("Anti fly kick") && !on_ground && !in_water && left == 0 {
            v.y = v.y.min(-0.0313);
            SINK_IN.store(m.n("Delay") as u32, Relaxed);
        } else {
            SINK_IN.store(left.saturating_sub(1), Relaxed);
        }
    }
    (v, m.b("Lock yaw").then_some(game.yaw))
}
```
