`mixins/sunset/visual.rs`:

```rs
// How things are drawn, the way Meteor's ESP, Tracers and Nametags let you choose: a colour palette, 3D or 2D
// boxes, lines, sides or both, a fill opacity and a fade near you; and the cheap ways every drawing module offers
// (an outline, Potato).

use super::sunset::{Camera, Canvas, Kind, Module, Setting, Value, line, outline};
use super::sunset_util::dist;

pub(super) const PALETTE: &[&str] = &[
    "White", "Gold", "Red", "Orange", "Yellow", "Lime", "Green", "Cyan", "Blue", "Purple", "Pink", "Gray", "Black", "Sunset Orange",
];

pub(super) fn palette(name: &str) -> u32 {
    match name {
        "Gold" => 0xFFFF_B020,
        "Sunset Orange" => 0xFFDB_5000,
        "Red" => 0xFFFF_4040,
        "Orange" => 0xFFFF_A030,
        "Yellow" => 0xFFFF_FF50,
        "Lime" => 0xFF90_FF40,
        "Green" => 0xFF50_FF50,
        "Cyan" => 0xFF50_FFFF,
        "Blue" => 0xFF50_80FF,
        "Purple" => 0xFFB0_50FF,
        "Pink" => 0xFFFF_70C0,
        "Gray" => 0xFFA0_A0A0,
        "Black" => 0xFF10_1010,
        _ => 0xFFFF_FFFF,
    }
}

impl Module {
    // A colour setting: a choice from the palette.
    pub(super) fn colour(mut self, name: &'static str, default: &str) -> Self {
        let i = PALETTE.iter().position(|p| *p == default).unwrap_or(0);
        self.settings.push(Setting {
            name,
            value: Value::Pick { i, of: PALETTE },
        });
        self
    }
    // Its colour, as ARGB.
    pub(super) fn c(&self, name: &str) -> u32 {
        palette(self.p(name))
    }
}

// Which kinds of entity a module draws and in what colours, read once a frame instead of once a mob.
pub(super) struct Kinds {
    want: [bool; 3],
    colour: [u32; 3],
    friend_colours: bool,
    // Mob types drawn whatever their kind (the Entities list), or left out (List mode Blacklist).
    extra: String,
    blacklist: bool,
}

impl Kinds {
    pub(super) fn of(m: &Module) -> Self {
        Self {
            want: [m.b("Players"), m.b("Hostiles"), m.b("Passive")],
            colour: [m.c("Players color"), m.c("Hostiles color"), m.c("Passive color")],
            friend_colours: m.b("Show friend colors"),
            extra: m.t("Entities").to_owned(),
            blacklist: m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist",
        }
    }
    pub(super) fn wants(&self, kind: Kind, id: &str) -> bool {
        super::sunset_util::kind_wanted(self.want[kind as usize], &self.extra, self.blacklist, id)
    }
    pub(super) fn colour(&self, kind: Kind, friend: bool) -> u32 {
        if friend && self.friend_colours { 0xFF55_FFFF } else { self.colour[kind as usize] }
    }
}

// The colour fading in as something comes near, from `fade` blocks in.
pub(super) fn faded(argb: u32, distance: f64, fade: f64) -> u32 {
    if fade <= 0.0 || distance >= fade {
        return argb;
    }
    let a = ((argb >> 24) as f64 * (distance / fade).clamp(0.1, 1.0)).round() as u32;
    (a << 24) | (argb & 0x00FF_FFFF)
}

// Green when far, red when close (Meteor's tracers by distance).
pub(super) fn distance_colour(distance: f64) -> u32 {
    let t = (distance / 60.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let (r, g) = (((1.0 - t) * 255.0) as u32, (t * 255.0) as u32);
    0xFF00_0040 | (r << 16) | (g << 8)
}

const EDGES: [(usize, usize); 12] = [
    (0, 1),
    (2, 3),
    (4, 5),
    (6, 7),
    (0, 2),
    (1, 3),
    (4, 6),
    (5, 7),
    (0, 4),
    (1, 5),
    (2, 6),
    (3, 7),
];

// A box's faces: the corners round each (bit 1 of a corner index is x at its high end, bit 2 y, bit 4 z), and the
// side of the box the camera must be on to see it (axis, high end).
const FACES: [([usize; 4], usize, bool); 6] = [
    ([0, 2, 6, 4], 0, false),
    ([1, 3, 7, 5], 0, true),
    ([0, 1, 5, 4], 1, false),
    ([2, 3, 7, 6], 1, true),
    ([0, 1, 3, 2], 2, false),
    ([4, 5, 7, 6], 2, true),
];

// The ways a module can draw a thing (its Mode): a 3D box, the 2D box round it on screen, that box's outline alone,
// or Potato, one small square on its middle, the least work there is.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Draw {
    Box3d,
    Box2d,
    Outline,
    Potato,
}

// How a module draws its boxes, read once a frame from its Mode and Shape mode (or its Fill switch).
pub(super) struct Look {
    pub(super) draw: Draw,
    sides: bool,
    lines: bool,
    fill: f64,
}

impl Look {
    pub(super) fn of(m: &Module) -> Self {
        let draw = match m.p("Mode") {
            "2D box" => Draw::Box2d,
            "Outline" => Draw::Outline,
            "Potato" => Draw::Potato,
            _ => Draw::Box3d,
        };
        // Without a Shape mode: lines and a light fill, unless a Fill switch is off.
        let (sides, lines, fill) = match m.setting("Shape mode") {
            Some(_) => (m.p("Shape mode") != "Lines", m.p("Shape mode") != "Sides", m.n("Fill opacity")),
            None => (m.setting("Fill").is_none() || m.b("Fill"), true, 40.0 / 255.0),
        };
        Self { draw, sides, lines, fill }
    }
    // Lines and a light fill in 3D: the boxes modules show where they place or break, a throw's landing.
    pub(super) const BOXED: Self = Self { draw: Draw::Box3d, sides: true, lines: true, fill: 40.0 / 255.0 };
}

// Potato: one small square on `at`. True when it was on screen.
pub(super) fn potato(cam: &Camera, out: &mut impl Canvas, at: [f64; 3], argb: u32, lw: f32) -> bool {
    let half = 2.0 * lw;
    match cam.project(at).filter(|p| cam.on_screen(*p, half)) {
        Some([x, y]) => {
            out.fill([x - half, y - half, half * 2.0, half * 2.0], argb);
            true
        }
        None => false,
    }
}

// A box in the world as the module's Look says. True when any of it was on screen (what a Max counts). A 3D box's
// sides are its faces turned to the camera (at most three, none from inside it), its edges the lines; a corner
// behind the camera leaves out the faces and edges it belongs to. The 2D modes need the whole box in front.
pub(super) fn draw_box(cam: &Camera, out: &mut impl Canvas, look: &Look, lo: [f64; 3], hi: [f64; 3], argb: u32, lw: f32) -> bool {
    let mid = [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, (lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2.0];
    if look.draw == Draw::Potato {
        return potato(cam, out, mid, argb, lw);
    }
    if !cam.sees(mid, dist(lo, hi) / 2.0) {
        return false;
    }
    let fill = (((argb >> 24) as f64 * look.fill).round() as u32) << 24 | (argb & 0x00FF_FFFF);
    if look.draw == Draw::Box3d {
        let pts = cam.points(lo, hi);
        let eye = cam.eye();
        let mut drawn = false;
        for (face, axis, high) in FACES.iter().filter(|_| look.sides) {
            let facing = if *high { eye[*axis] > hi[*axis] } else { eye[*axis] < lo[*axis] };
            if let (true, [Some(a), Some(b), Some(c), Some(d)]) = (facing, face.map(|i| pts[i])) {
                out.quad([a, b, c, d], fill);
                drawn = true;
            }
        }
        for (a, b) in EDGES.iter().filter(|_| look.lines) {
            if let (Some(p), Some(q)) = (pts[*a], pts[*b]) {
                line(out, p, q, argb, lw);
                drawn = true;
            }
        }
        return drawn;
    }
    let Some(pts) = cam.corners(lo, hi) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(r) = cam.bounds(&pts) else {
        return false;
    };
    if look.sides && look.draw != Draw::Outline {
        out.fill([r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]], fill);
    }
    if look.lines || look.draw == Draw::Outline {
        outline(out, r, argb, lw, false);
    }
    true
}
```

`mixins/sunset/water_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Clear Water's switches, read by the mesher's hook (on its worker threads)
// and set by the game. Every water sprite is laid out again at each lower
// opacity next to the block sprites, so fainter water is only another layer on
// its vertices: no texture reload, the world is just rebuilt.
use std::sync::RwLock;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering::Relaxed};

// Opacity steps: copies at 0/20, 1/20 ... 19/20 of the water's own alpha; STEPS is the water as it is.
pub const STEPS: usize = 20;
pub const SPRITES: [&str; 3] = ["minecraft:block/water_still", "minecraft:block/water_flow", "minecraft:block/water_overlay"];
pub static LEVEL: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(STEPS as u32);
// How far the water's colour goes towards its brightest channel, in hundredths.
pub static TINT: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
// Each water sprite's own layer and its copies' layers, faintest first.
static LAYERS: RwLock<[(u32, [u32; STEPS]); 3]> = RwLock::new([(u32::MAX, [0; STEPS]); 3]);

pub fn on() -> bool {
    (LEVEL.load(Relaxed) as usize) < STEPS || TINT.load(Relaxed) > 0
}
pub fn set_layers(sprite: usize, own: u32, copies: [u32; STEPS]) {
    if let Ok(mut l) = LAYERS.write() {
        l[sprite] = (own, copies);
    }
}
// A sprite's frames with every pixel's alpha at step/STEPS of its own.
pub fn faded(frames: &[Vec<u8>], step: usize) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
    let scale = |a: u8| (u32::from(a) * step as u32 / STEPS as u32) as u8;
    frames.iter().map(|f| f.chunks_exact(4).flat_map(|p| [p[0], p[1], p[2], scale(p[3])]).collect()).collect()
}
// A section's water drawn with the copy at the chosen opacity and its tint lightened.
pub fn clear(mesh: &mut super::SectionMesh) {
    let (level, tint) = (LEVEL.load(Relaxed) as usize, TINT.load(Relaxed).min(100));
    let Ok(layers) = LAYERS.read() else {
        return;
    };
    for v in &mut mesh.translucent {
        let own = u32::from(v.layer & !super::OPAQUE_LAYER);
        let Some((_, copies)) = layers.iter().find(|(l, _)| *l == own) else {
            continue;
        };
        if level < STEPS {
            v.layer = v.layer & super::OPAQUE_LAYER | copies[level] as u16;
        }
        if tint > 0 {
            let rgb = [0, 8, 16].map(|s| v.color >> s & 255);
            let top = rgb.into_iter().max().unwrap_or(0);
            let lit = rgb.map(|c| c + (top - c) * tint / 100);
            v.color = v.color & 0xFF00_0000 | lit[0] | lit[1] << 8 | lit[2] << 16;
        }
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/water_sprites.rs`:

```rs
// Clear Water: a water sprite is laid out at every lower opacity just before itself, so its own layer follows them.
fn sunset_water_sprites(this: &mut Sprites, name: &str, decoded: &crate::sprite_cache::Decoded) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<Result<u32>> {
    use crate::mesher::sunset_water as w;
    let Some(sprite) = w::SPRITES.iter().position(|s| *s == name) else {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    };
    let path = name.trim_start_matches("minecraft:");
    let mut copies = [0; w::STEPS];
    for (step, layer) in copies.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let mut copy = decoded.clone();
        copy.frames = w::faded(&decoded.frames, step);
        copy.opaque = false;
        copy.has_transparent |= step == 0;
        copy.translucent = step > 0;
        match this.register(&["sunset:", path, "_", &step.to_string()].concat(), copy) {
            Ok(l) => *layer = l,
            Err(e) => return std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(Err(e)),
        }
    }
    w::set_layers(sprite, this.native.len() as u32, copies);
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(())
}
```

```rs
#[derive(Default)]
struct Ws {
    cooldowns: Vec<(u32, u32)>,
    flame_ticks: u32,
    fill_timer: u32,
    proof_timer: u32,
    // Spawner Alerts: the dimension, and each spawner found in it with its label.
    spawner_dim: &'static str,
    spawners: Vec<([i32; 3], String)>,
}

static WS: Mutex<Option<Ws>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn ws<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Ws) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = WS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(g.get_or_insert_with(Ws::default))
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, mods: &[Module]) {
    ws(|w| {
        w.cooldowns.retain_mut(|(_, t)| {
            *t = t.saturating_sub(1);
            *t > 0
        });
        w.flame_ticks += 1;
    });
    let get = |n: &str| mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == n && m.on);
    // Spawner Alerts starts over in each world and dimension, and once turned off.
    let dim = game.dim.id();
    if game.player.is_none() || get("Spawner Alerts").is_none() || ws(|w| w.spawner_dim) != dim {
        ws(|w| {
            w.spawners.clear();
            w.spawner_dim = dim;
        });
    }
    if !in_world(game) {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Shearer") {
        auto_shearer(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Nametag") {
        auto_nametag(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Breed") {
        auto_breed(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Auto Mount") {
        auto_mount(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Flamethrower") {
        flamethrower(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Bow Aimbot") {
        bow_aimbot(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Liquid Filler") {
        liquid_filler(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Spawn Proofer") {
        spawn_proofer(game, m);
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Spawner Alerts") {
        spawner_alerts(game, m);
    }
    super::sunset_base_finder::tick(game, get("Base Finder"));
}

// Within `range` of the player as the shape says: a ball, or a cube.
fn in_shape(shape: &str, me: [f64; 3], p: [i32; 3], range: f64) -> bool {
    let c = center_of(p);
    if shape == "Uniform cube" {
        (c[0] - me[0]).abs() <= range && (c[1] - me[1]).abs() <= range && (c[2] - me[2]).abs() <= range
    } else {
        dist(me, c) <= range
    }
}

fn liquid_filler(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if ws(|w| {
        if w.fill_timer < m.n("Delay (ticks)") as u32 {
            w.fill_timer += 1;
            true
        } else {
            w.fill_timer = 0;
            false
        }
    }) {
        return;
    }
    let list = if m.p("List mode") == "Whitelist" { m.t("Whitelist") } else { m.t("Blacklist") }.to_owned();
    let white = m.p("List mode") == "Whitelist";
    let slot = find_hotbar(game, |n| {
        let is_block = game.res.items().get(&format!("minecraft:{n}")).is_some_and(|i| i.block.is_some());
        is_block && (listed(&list, n) == white)
    });
    let Some(slot) = slot else {
        return;
    };
    let (Some(eye), Some(at)) = (game.eye_position(), block_pos(game)) else {
        return;
    };
    let (range, walls) = (m.n("Place range"), m.n("Walls range"));
    let shape = m.p("Shape");
    let which = m.p("Place in");
    let (rh, rv) = ((range + 1.0).ceil() as i32, range.ceil() as i32);
    let mut found: Vec<[i32; 3]> = Vec::new();
    for x in at[0] - rh..=at[0] + rh {
        for y in at[1] - rv..=at[1] + rv {
            for z in at[2] - rh..=at[2] + rh {
                let p = [x, y, z];
                if is_air(game, p) {
                    continue;
                }
                let name = facts(game, p).name.clone();
                let ok = match which {
                    "Water" => &*name == "minecraft:water",
                    "Lava" => &*name == "minecraft:lava",
                    _ => &*name == "minecraft:water" || &*name == "minecraft:lava",
                };
                if !ok || !can_place(game, p, true) {
                    continue;
                }
                let c = center_of(p);
                let out = !in_shape(shape, eye, p, range) || (!clear_line(game, c, p) && !in_shape(shape, eye, p, walls));
                if !out {
                    found.push(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    match m.p("Sort") {
        "Top down" => found.sort_by_key(|p| -p[1]),
        "Bottom up" => found.sort_by_key(|p| p[1]),
        "Closest" => found.sort_by(|a, b| dist(eye, center_of(*a)).total_cmp(&dist(eye, center_of(*b)))),
        "Furthest" => found.sort_by(|a, b| dist(eye, center_of(*b)).total_cmp(&dist(eye, center_of(*a)))),
        _ => {}
    }
    let mut count = 0;
    for p in found {
        if count >= m.n("Max blocks per tick") as u32 {
            break;
        }
        if place_block(game, p, slot, m.b("Rotate"), true) {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
}

fn spawn_proofer(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if ws(|w| {
        if w.proof_timer < m.n("Place delay") as u32 {
            w.proof_timer += 1;
            true
        } else {
            false
        }
    }) {
        return;
    }
    let list = m.t("Blocks").to_owned();
    let Some(slot) = find_hotbar(game, |n| listed(&list, n)) else {
        report(game, "None of the chosen blocks are in your hotbar.");
        toggle_off(game, "Spawn Proofer");
        return;
    };
    let (Some(eye), Some(at)) = (game.eye_position(), block_pos(game)) else {
        return;
    };
    let (range, walls) = (m.n("Place range"), m.n("Walls range"));
    let limit = m.n("Light level") as u8;
    let mode = m.p("Mode");
    let r = range.ceil() as i32;
    let mut spots: Vec<([i32; 3], u8)> = Vec::new();
    for x in at[0] - r..=at[0] + r {
        for y in at[1] - r..=at[1] + r {
            for z in at[2] - r..=at[2] + r {
                let p = [x, y, z];
                if !is_air(game, p) {
                    continue;
                }
                let below = [x, y - 1, z];
                let f = facts(game, below);
                if is_air(game, below) || !f.solid_render || f.name.ends_with("bedrock") || f.name.ends_with("barrier") {
                    continue;
                }
                let light = game.world.light(x, y, z);
                let (block, sky) = (light & 0x0F, light >> 4);
                if block > limit {
                    continue;
                }
                let always = sky <= limit;
                if (always && mode == "Potential") || (!always && mode == "Always") {
                    continue;
                }
                if !can_place(game, p, true) {
                    continue;
                }
                let c = center_of(p);
                if dist(eye, c) > range || (!clear_line(game, c, p) && dist(eye, c) > walls) {
                    continue;
                }
                spots.push((p, light));
            }
        }
    }
    if spots.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    // A light source goes in one a tick, the darkest first.
    let light_source = game
        .inventory
        .get(slot)
        .and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
        .and_then(|s| game.res.items().get(&s.item))
        .and_then(|i| i.block)
        .is_some_and(|b| game.res.facts().get(b).emission > 0);
    let mut placed = 0;
    if light_source {
        spots.sort_by_key(|(_, l)| (l & 0x0F).max(l >> 4));
        placed = m.n("Blocks per tick") as u32 - 1;
    }
    for (p, _) in spots {
        if placed >= m.n("Blocks per tick") as u32 {
            break;
        }
        if place_block(game, p, slot, m.b("Rotate"), true) {
            placed += 1;
        }
    }
    ws(|w| w.proof_timer = 0);
}

// The tool in the hotbar for entity `want`, switched to now.
fn use_on(game: &mut Game<'_>, slot: usize, id: u32, centre: [f64; 3], rotate: bool) {
    turned_to(game, "Use on", rotate, centre, move |game| {
        let before = game.selected;
        hold(game, slot);
        game.send(S::Interact(play::Interact { id: id as i32, hand: 0, location: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], secondary: false }));
        game.swing_arm();
        hold(game, before);
    });
}

fn cooling(id: u32) -> bool {
    ws(|w| w.cooldowns.iter().any(|(i, _)| *i == id))
}

fn cool(id: u32, ticks: u32) {
    ws(|w| w.cooldowns.push((id, ticks)));
}

fn centre(t: &Target) -> [f64; 3] {
    [(t.lo[0] + t.hi[0]) / 2.0, (t.lo[1] + t.hi[1]) / 2.0, (t.lo[2] + t.hi[2]) / 2.0]
}

// Auto Breed: the nearest listed animal of the age wanted, not fed before (or not within Breeding interval), fed the
// food its kind takes from the hotbar (or the off hand's, with Hand Off hand).
fn auto_breed(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    let (age, list) = (m.p("Age"), m.t("Entities"));
    let off = m.p("Hand") == "Off hand";
    let mut near: Vec<(f64, u32, [f64; 3], usize)> = Vec::new();
    for mob in game.mobs.iter().filter(|x| x.alive() && !x.removed && !cooling(x.id) && listed(list, &x.kind.id)) {
        let baby = mob.is_baby();
        if (age == "Adult" && baby) || (age == "Baby" && !baby) {
            continue;
        }
        let b = mob.bounds();
        let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        let at = [(lo.x + hi.x) / 2.0, (lo.y + hi.y) / 2.0, (lo.z + hi.z) / 2.0];
        let d = dist(eye, at);
        let food = |n: &str| mob.kind.food.iter().any(|f| f.as_str() == n || short(f) == short(n));
        let slot = if off {
            game.offhand.as_ref().filter(|s| food(&s.item)).map(|_| game.selected)
        } else {
            find_hotbar(game, food)
        };
        if let Some(slot) = slot.filter(|_| d <= m.n("Range")) {
            near.push((d, mob.id, at, slot));
        }
    }
    let Some(&(_, id, at, slot)) = near.iter().min_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0)) else {
        return;
    };
    let wait = if m.b("Continuous breeding") { m.n("Breeding interval") as u32 } else { u32::MAX };
    cool(id, wait);
    if off {
        turned_to(game, "Auto Breed", true, at, move |game| {
            game.send(S::Interact(play::Interact { id: id as i32, hand: 1, location: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], secondary: false }));
            game.swing_arm();
        });
    } else {
        use_on(game, slot, id, at, true);
    }
}

fn auto_shearer(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let range = m.n("Distance");
    let anti = m.b("Anti break");
    let slot = find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "shears");
    let Some(slot) = slot else {
        return;
    };
    if anti {
        if let Some(s) = game.inventory.get(slot).and_then(|s| s.as_ref()) {
            let max = game.res.items().get(&s.item).map_or(0, |i| i.max_damage);
            if max > 0 && s.damage + 1 >= max {
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    let target = game
        .mobs
        .iter()
        .find(|s| {
            s.kind.id == "minecraft:sheep"
                && s.alive()
                && !s.removed
                && !s.extra.sheared
                && !s.is_baby()
                && !cooling(s.id)
                && dist(game.eye_position().unwrap_or([0.0; 3]), [s.position.x, s.position.y, s.position.z]) <= range
        })
        .map(mob_target);
    if let Some(t) = target {
        use_on(game, slot, t.id, centre(&t), m.b("Rotate"));
        cool(t.id, 20);
    }
}

fn auto_nametag(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(slot) = find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "name_tag") else {
        report(game, "No name tag in your hotbar.");
        toggle_off(game, "Auto Nametag");
        return;
    };
    let range = m.n("Range");
    let (list, blacklist) = (m.t("Entities").to_owned(), m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist");
    let eye = game.eye_position().unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
    let mut candidates: Vec<Target> = every_living(game)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|t| !t.player && dist(eye, t.pos) <= range && !cooling(t.id))
        .filter(|t| listed(&list, &t.kind) != blacklist)
        .filter(|t| {
            let named = game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.custom_name.is_some());
            !named || m.b("Renametag")
        })
        .collect();
    sort_targets(game, &mut candidates, "Lowest distance");
    if let Some(t) = candidates.into_iter().next() {
        use_on(game, slot, t.id, centre(&t), m.b("Rotate"));
        cool(t.id, 20);
    }
}

fn auto_mount(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if game.riding.is_some() || game.keys.contains(&winit::keyboard::KeyCode::ShiftLeft) {
        return;
    }
    if game.held().is_some_and(|s| short(&s.item).ends_with("_spawn_egg")) {
        return;
    }
    let (list, blacklist) = (m.t("Entities").to_owned(), m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist");
    let eye = game.eye_position().unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
    let saddled = |t: &Target| game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.extra.saddled);
    let pick = every_living(game).into_iter().find(|t| {
        if t.player || dist(eye, t.pos) > 4.0 || cooling(t.id) || listed(&list, &t.kind) == blacklist {
            return false;
        }
        // Saddled-only rides.
        let rideable_needs_saddle = ["pig", "skeleton_horse", "strider", "zombie_horse"].iter().any(|k| short(&t.kind) == *k);
        if rideable_needs_saddle && !saddled(t) {
            return false;
        }
        !(short(&t.kind) != "llama" && m.b("Check saddle") && !saddled(t))
    });
    if let Some(t) = pick {
        let id = t.id as i32;
        turned_to(game, "Auto Mount", m.b("Rotate"), centre(&t), move |game| {
            game.send(S::Interact(play::Interact { id, hand: 0, location: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], secondary: false }));
            game.swing_arm();
        });
        cool(t.id, 20);
    }
}

fn flamethrower(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let range = m.n("Distance");
    let (list, blacklist) = (m.t("Entities").to_owned(), m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist");
    let anti = m.b("Anti break");
    let eye = game.eye_position().unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
    let ticks = ws(|w| w.flame_ticks);
    if ticks < m.n("Tick interval") as u32 {
        return;
    }
    let target = every_living(game).into_iter().find(|t| {
        !t.player
            && dist(eye, t.pos) <= range
            && listed(&list, &t.kind) != blacklist
            && (m.b("Target babies") || !game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.is_baby()))
            && !game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.is_on_fire())
    });
    let Some(t) = target else {
        return;
    };
    let slot = find_hotbar(game, |n| n == "flint_and_steel" || n == "fire_charge");
    let Some(slot) = slot else {
        return;
    };
    if anti {
        if let Some(s) = game.inventory.get(slot).and_then(|s| s.as_ref()) {
            let max = game.res.items().get(&s.item).map_or(0, |i| i.max_damage);
            if max > 0 && s.damage + 1 >= max {
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    let Some((below, point)) = fire_spot(game, eye, &t) else {
        return;
    };
    // The look goes to the point clicked, as a real click's does: a look through the mob is a click on the mob, and
    // Horizon's server leaves a block use alone while you look at one.
    let cursor = [(point[0] - f64::from(below[0])) as f32, 1.0, (point[2] - f64::from(below[2])) as f32];
    turned_to(game, "Flamethrower", m.b("Rotate"), point, move |game| {
        let before = game.selected;
        hold(game, slot);
        let seq = sequence(game);
        game.send(S::UseItemOn(play::UseItemOn { hand: 0, pos: below, face: 1, cursor, inside: false, world_border: false, sequence: seq }));
        game.swing_arm();
        hold(game, before);
    });
    ws(|w| w.flame_ticks = 0);
}

// Where to click to set `t` alight: the top of a block under its feet with air above (where the fire goes), at the
// point nearest your eyes that the mob does not hide and that is within reach. The block and the point.
fn fire_spot(game: &Game<'_>, eye: [f64; 3], t: &Target) -> Option<([i32; 3], [f64; 3])> {
    let y = t.lo[1].floor() as i32;
    let grown = (t.lo.map(|v| v - 0.05), t.hi.map(|v| v + 0.05));
    let mut best: Option<(f64, [i32; 3], [f64; 3])> = None;
    for x in t.lo[0].floor() as i32..=(t.hi[0] - 1e-6).floor() as i32 {
        for z in t.lo[2].floor() as i32..=(t.hi[2] - 1e-6).floor() as i32 {
            let below = [x, y - 1, z];
            if !is_air(game, [x, y, z]) || is_air(game, below) || !facts(game, below).full_collision {
                continue;
            }
            let (fx, fz) = (f64::from(x), f64::from(z));
            let nearest = [eye[0].clamp(fx + 0.01, fx + 0.99), eye[2].clamp(fz + 0.01, fz + 0.99)];
            let points = [0.01, 0.5, 0.99].into_iter().flat_map(|a| [0.01, 0.5, 0.99].map(|b| [fx + a, fz + b]));
            for [px, pz] in points.chain([nearest]) {
                let point = [px, f64::from(y), pz];
                let d = dist(eye, point);
                if d > 4.5 || best.is_some_and(|b| b.0 <= d) || crosses(eye, point, grown.0, grown.1) {
                    continue;
                }
                best = Some((d, below, point));
            }
        }
    }
    best.map(|(_, below, point)| (below, point))
}

// Whether the segment from `a` to `b` passes through the box from `lo` to `hi`.
fn crosses(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3], lo: [f64; 3], hi: [f64; 3]) -> bool {
    let (mut t0, mut t1) = (0.0_f64, 1.0_f64);
    for i in 0..3 {
        let d = b[i] - a[i];
        if d.abs() < 1e-12 {
            if a[i] < lo[i] || a[i] > hi[i] {
                return false;
            }
            continue;
        }
        let (u, v) = ((lo[i] - a[i]) / d, (hi[i] - a[i]) / d);
        t0 = t0.max(u.min(v));
        t1 = t1.min(u.max(v));
        if t0 > t1 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

// ---- Bow Aimbot

fn bow_aimbot(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    use winit::event::MouseButton;
    if !(game.physical_buttons.contains(&MouseButton::Right) || game.right) || !game.native_playing() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(stack) = game.held() else {
        return;
    };
    let item = short(&stack.item);
    if item != "bow" && item != "crossbow" {
        return;
    }
    if !game.creative && find_inventory(game, |n| n.ends_with("arrow")).is_none() {
        return;
    }
    let eye = match game.eye_position() {
        Some(e) => e,
        None => return,
    };
    let range = m.n("Range");
    let (list, blacklist) = (m.t("Entities").to_owned(), m.p("List mode") == "Blacklist");
    let own = game.remote.as_ref().map(|r| r.entity_id as u32);
    let friends = super::sunset::with(|s| s.friends.clone());
    let names = game.remote_player_names();
    let mut cands: Vec<Target> = every_living(game)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|t| Some(t.id) != own && dist(eye, t.pos) <= range && listed(&list, &t.kind) != blacklist)
        .filter(|t| clear_line(game, centre(t), [i32::MIN; 3]))
        .filter(|t| m.b("Nametagged") || !game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.custom_name.is_some()))
        .filter(|t| m.b("Babies") || !game.mobs.iter().find(|x| x.id == t.id).is_some_and(|x| x.is_baby()))
        .filter(|t| !(t.player && names.iter().any(|(i, n)| *i == t.id && friends.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(n)))))
        .collect();
    sort_targets(game, &mut cands, m.p("Priority"));
    let Some(t) = cands.into_iter().next() else {
        return;
    };
    let ticks = game.using.map_or(0, |(_, t)| t);
    let power = {
        let f = f64::from(ticks) / 20.0;
        ((f * f + f * 2.0) / 3.0).min(1.0) as f32
    };
    let (rx, rz) = (t.pos[0] - eye[0], t.pos[2] - eye[2]);
    let ry = t.pos[1] + (t.hi[1] - t.lo[1]) / 2.0 - eye[1];
    let h = (rx * rx + rz * rz).sqrt();
    // Meteor's ballistic pitch: g = 0.006 per tick per tick squared, speed in blocks.
    let g = 0.006;
    let v = f64::from(power);
    let v2 = v * v;
    let pitch = -((v2 - (v2 * v2 - g * (g * h * h + 2.0 * ry * v2)).sqrt()) / (g * h)).atan().to_degrees();
    let (yaw, flat_pitch) = super::sunset::look_at(eye, [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + (t.hi[1] - t.lo[1]) / 2.0, t.pos[2]]);
    game.yaw = yaw;
    game.pitch = if pitch.is_nan() { flat_pitch } else { pitch as f32 };
}

// ---- Spawner Alerts

// A spawner's label: what it spawns (from its next spawn's entity id, "unknown" when it has none) and its kind.
fn spawner_label(entity: &BlockEntity) -> Option<String> {
    let (data, kind) = match entity {
        BlockEntity::Spawner(s) => (s.next_data(), "spawner"),
        BlockEntity::TrialSpawner(s) => (s.next_spawn_data.as_ref(), "trial spawner"),
        _ => return None,
    };
    let mob = match data.and_then(|d| d.entity.get(&JavaString::from("id"))) {
        Some(Tag::String(id)) => short(&String::from_utf16_lossy(&id.0)).replace('_', " "),
        _ => "unknown".into(),
    };
    Some(format!("{mob} {kind}"))
}

// Twice a second: each spawner within range not found before gets its chat line.
fn spawner_alerts(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    if game.ticks % 10 != 0 {
        return;
    }
    let me = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    let range = m.n("Range");
    let mut found = Vec::new();
    ws(|w| {
        for (&(x, y, z), entity) in &game.world.block_entities {
            let at = [f64::from(x) + 0.5, f64::from(y) + 0.5, f64::from(z) + 0.5];
            if dist(me, at) > range || w.spawners.iter().any(|(pos, _)| *pos == [x, y, z]) {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(label) = spawner_label(entity) {
                found.push(format!("{label} at {x} {y} {z}, {:.0} blocks away", dist(me, at)));
                w.spawners.push(([x, y, z], label));
            }
        }
    });
    for line in found {
        report(game, &line);
    }
}

// Each found spawner within range: its label over it, with how far it is.
pub(super) fn spawner_labels(game: &Game<'_>, cam: &Camera, range: f64, out: &mut impl Canvas) {
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_ref() else {
        return;
    };
    let me = [p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z];
    ws(|w| {
        for (pos, label) in &w.spawners {
            let at = [f64::from(pos[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(pos[1]) + 1.3, f64::from(pos[2]) + 0.5];
            let d = dist(me, at);
            let Some([x, y]) = cam.project(at).filter(|_| d <= range) else {
                continue;
            };
            let text = format!("{label} {d:.0}m");
            let tw = game.native_text_width(&text);
            out.fill([x - tw / 2.0 - 2.0, y - 2.0, tw + 4.0, 12.0], 0x7800_0000);
            out.text(&text, [x - tw / 2.0, y], 0xFFAA00);
        }
    });
}
```

`mixins/sunset/world_parity.rs`:

```rs
// Meteor's movement and world modules (batch F), written fresh from what they do: Enderman Look, Click TP, Auto
// Sign, Build Height and Trident Boost.

use super::sunset::{Category, Module, look_at, turn};
use super::sunset_util::*;
use super::Game;
use horizon_protocol::packets::play::{self, Serverbound as S};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

// Auto Sign and Build Height on, for what goes out (read where the module list may be locked).
static SIGN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static HEIGHT: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub(super) fn defaults() -> Vec<Module> {
    vec![
        Module::new("Enderman Look", Category::World, "Looks at or away from endermen.")
            .pick("Look mode", &["Away", "At"])
            .bool("Stun hostiles", true),
        Module::new("Click TP", Category::Movement, "Teleports you to the block you right-click.")
            .num("Max distance", 8.0, 1.0, 9.5, 0.5),
        Module::new("Auto Sign", Category::World, "Writes your first sign's text on every sign.")
            .num("Delay", 10.0, 0.0, 100.0, 1.0),
        Module::new("Build Height", Category::World, "Lets you place against the build limit."),
        Module::new("Trident Boost", Category::Movement, "Boosts riptide.")
            .num("Boost", 2.0, 0.1, 10.0, 0.1),
    ]
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Wp {
    // Auto Sign: the first text written and its side, and the signs waiting to be written with it.
    sign_text: Option<[String; 4]>,
    signs: VecDeque<play::SignUpdate>,
    sign_timer: u32,
    // Click TP: use held last tick; Trident Boost: riptide's ticks last tick.
    using: bool,
    spin: i32,
}

static WP: Mutex<Option<Wp>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn wp<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Wp) -> R) -> R {
    f(WP.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).get_or_insert_with(Wp::default))
}

pub(super) fn tick(game: &mut Game<'_>, mods: &[Module]) {
    let get = |n: &str| mods.iter().find(|m| m.name == n && m.on);
    SIGN.store(get("Auto Sign").is_some(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    HEIGHT.store(get("Build Height").is_some(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    // Auto Sign closes the sign editor's screen, so it runs with that screen open.
    match get("Auto Sign").filter(|_| game.remote.is_some() && game.player.is_some()) {
        Some(m) => auto_sign(game, m),
        None => wp(|w| {
            w.sign_text = None;
            w.signs.clear();
        }),
    }
    if !in_world(game) {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(m) = get("Enderman Look") {
        enderman_look(game, m);
    }
    match get("Click TP") {
        Some(m) => click_tp(game, m),
        None => wp(|w| w.using = game.right),
    }
    let spin = game.player.as_ref().map_or(0, |p| p.auto_spin_attack_ticks);
    let started = wp(|w| std::mem::replace(&mut w.spin, spin) == 0 && spin > 0);
    if let Some(m) = get("Trident Boost").filter(|_| started) {
        // Riptide's push has just been given: more of it.
        if let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() {
            p.velocity = p.velocity.scale(m.n("Boost"));
        }
    }
}

// What goes out: Auto Sign keeps the first text you write; Build Height turns a click on the top of a block at the build
// limit into one on its underside, which the server takes.
pub(super) fn outgoing(game: &Game<'_>, packet: &S) -> Option<S> {
    match packet {
        S::SignUpdate(p) if SIGN.load(Ordering::Relaxed) => {
            wp(|w| {
                if w.sign_text.is_none() && p.lines.iter().any(|l| !l.is_empty()) {
                    w.sign_text = Some(p.lines.clone());
                }
            });
            None
        }
        S::UseItemOn(p) if HEIGHT.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && p.face == 1 && p.pos[1] + 1 >= top(game) => {
            Some(S::UseItemOn(play::UseItemOn { face: 0, ..p.clone() }))
        }
        _ => None,
    }
}

// One above the highest block the dimension holds.
fn top(game: &Game<'_>) -> i32 {
    game.world.chunks.iter().next().map_or(320, |(_, c)| c.max_y())
}

// ---- Enderman Look

// An enderman takes being looked in the eyes as a stare (Enderman.isBeingStaredBy): the view within a narrow cone of
// its eyes, closer the narrower.
fn stared(eye: [f64; 3], look: [f64; 3], at: [f64; 3]) -> bool {
    let to = [at[0] - eye[0], at[1] - eye[1], at[2] - eye[2]];
    let d = dist(eye, at);
    d > 0.0 && (look[0] * to[0] + look[1] * to[1] + look[2] * to[2]) / d > 1.0 - 0.025 / d
}

fn enderman_look(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    // A carved pumpkin (or creative) and nothing happens.
    if game.creative || game.armor[0].as_ref().is_some_and(|s| short(&s.item) == "carved_pumpkin") {
        return;
    }
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians());
    let look = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let away = m.p("Look mode") == "Away";
    for e in game.mobs.iter().filter(|x| x.alive() && !x.removed && short(&x.kind.id) == "enderman") {
        let head = [e.position.x, e.position.y + 2.55, e.position.z];
        if !clear_line(game, head, [i32::MIN; 3]) {
            continue;
        }
        // extra.flag: the enderman is screaming (angry).
        let angry = e.extra.flag;
        let (y, p) = look_at(eye, head);
        if away && angry && m.b("Stun hostiles") || !away && !angry {
            turn("Enderman Look", y, p);
            return;
        }
        if away && stared(eye, look, head) {
            turn("Enderman Look", game.yaw, 90.0);
            return;
        }
    }
}

// ---- Click TP

// Items a right click uses: Click TP leaves those (and blocks to place) to the game.
const USED: &str = "bow,crossbow,trident,shield,spyglass,ender_pearl,ender_eye,snowball,egg,fishing_rod,wind_charge,splash_potion,lingering_potion,experience_bottle,fire_charge,flint_and_steel,bucket,water_bucket,lava_bucket,goat_horn,brush,mace,lead,name_tag,saddle";

// A right click (each press) on a block within Max distance: you stand on it (beside it for a side), one move away, as
// the server allows a move of up to 10 blocks in a tick. A held block, something to use, or a block that does something
// when clicked is left to the game.
fn click_tp(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    let pressed = wp(|w| !std::mem::replace(&mut w.using, game.right)) && game.right;
    if !pressed {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(info) = super::sunset::item_info(game, game.selected) {
        if info.block.is_some() || info.food.is_some() || info.consumable.is_some() || listed(USED, &info.id) {
            return;
        }
    }
    let Some(eye) = game.eye_position() else {
        return;
    };
    let (yaw, pitch) = (f64::from(game.yaw).to_radians(), f64::from(game.pitch).to_radians());
    let look = [-yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(), -pitch.sin(), yaw.cos() * pitch.cos()];
    let range = m.n("Max distance") + 3.0;
    let mut last = eye.map(|v| v.floor() as i32);
    let mut hit = None;
    for i in 1..=(range * 20.0) as i32 {
        let t = f64::from(i) / 20.0;
        let at = [0, 1, 2].map(|k| (eye[k] + look[k] * t).floor() as i32);
        if at == last {
            continue;
        }
        if !is_air(game, at) && facts(game, at).full_collision {
            hit = Some((at, [at[0] - last[0], at[1] - last[1], at[2] - last[2]]));
            break;
        }
        last = at;
    }
    let Some((block, step)) = hit else {
        return;
    };
    let f = facts(game, block);
    let name = short(&f.name);
    if f.block_entity || ["door", "button", "lever", "gate", "anvil", "table", "bed"].iter().any(|k| name.contains(k)) {
        return;
    }
    // On top of it; a side clicked: on top of the block beside it, Meteor's way.
    let to = [f64::from(block[0]) + 0.5 - f64::from(step[0].signum()), f64::from(block[1]) + 1.0, f64::from(block[2]) + 0.5 - f64::from(step[2].signum())];
    let to = if step[1] != 0 { [f64::from(block[0]) + 0.5, f64::from(block[1]) + 1.0, f64::from(block[2]) + 0.5] } else { to };
    let Some(p) = game.player.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    if dist([p.position.x, p.position.y, p.position.z], to) > m.n("Max distance") {
        return;
    }
    p.position.x = to[0];
    p.position.y = to[1];
    p.position.z = to[2];
    p.velocity = p.velocity.scale(0.0);
}

// ---- Auto Sign

// A sign's editor opening once a text is kept: closed at once, the text sent for it after Delay ticks (some servers
// refuse a sign written too soon after the click).
fn auto_sign(game: &mut Game<'_>, m: &Module) {
    if let Some(lines) = wp(|w| w.sign_text.clone())
        && let Some(edit) = game.sign_edit.take()
    {
        let (x, y, z) = edit.pos;
        game.capture(true);
        wp(|w| w.signs.push_back(play::SignUpdate { pos: [x, y, z], lines, front: edit.front }));
    }
    let next = wp(|w| {
        if w.signs.is_empty() {
            w.sign_timer = 0;
            return None;
        }
        w.sign_timer += 1;
        if f64::from(w.sign_timer) <= m.n("Delay") {
            return None;
        }
        w.sign_timer = 0;
        w.signs.pop_front()
    });
    if let Some(p) = next {
        game.send(S::SignUpdate(p));
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::stared;

    #[test]
    fn a_stare_is_a_narrow_cone_at_the_eyes() {
        let eye = [0.0, 1.62, 0.0];
        assert!(stared(eye, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], [0.0, 1.62, 10.0]));
        assert!(!stared(eye, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], [2.0, 1.62, 10.0]));
        assert!(!stared(eye, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.62, 10.0]));
    }
}
```

`mixins/sunset/xray.rs`:

```rs
// Xray: while a section mesh is built, only the listed blocks are there. Clear Water: the built mesh's water is
// drawn fainter and lighter.
fn sunset_xray_hook(this: &mut Mesher<'_>, region: &[[Option<&Chunk>; 3]; 3], sy: i32) -> std::ops::ControlFlow<SectionMesh> {
    use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
    let (xray, water) = (sunset_xray::ON.load(Relaxed), sunset_water::on());
    if !(xray || water) || sunset_xray::meshing() {
        return std::ops::ControlFlow::Continue(());
    }
    if let Some(c) = region[1][1].filter(|_| xray) {
        sunset_xray::set_origin([c.x * 16, c.min_y() + sy * 16, c.z * 16]);
    }
    sunset_xray::set_meshing(true);
    let mut mesh = this.mesh(region, sy);
    sunset_xray::set_meshing(false);
    if water {
        sunset_water::clear(&mut mesh);
    }
    std::ops::ControlFlow::Break(mesh)
}
```

`mixins/sunset/xray_flags.rs`:

```rs
// Xray's switches, read by the mesher's hooks (on its worker threads) and set
// by the game. While a thread builds a section mesh, blocks that are not on
// the list (or at a remembered place) read as air.
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{LazyLock, RwLock};

pub static ON: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
pub static VISIBLE: LazyLock<RwLock<HashSet<u32>>> = LazyLock::new(|| RwLock::new(HashSet::new()));
// Blocks shown wherever they are, whatever they are: the ones the player placed (Show placed blocks).
pub static PLACED: LazyLock<RwLock<HashSet<[i32; 3]>>> = LazyLock::new(|| RwLock::new(HashSet::new()));
static ANY_PLACED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
thread_local! {
    pub static MESHING: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    // The lowest corner of the section being meshed, in blocks.
    static ORIGIN: Cell<[i32; 3]> = const { Cell::new([0; 3]) };
}
pub fn meshing() -> bool {
    MESHING.with(Cell::get)
}
pub fn set_meshing(v: bool) {
    MESHING.with(|b| b.set(v));
}
pub fn set_origin(at: [i32; 3]) {
    ORIGIN.with(|o| o.set(at));
}
pub fn set_placed(at: HashSet<[i32; 3]>) {
    ANY_PLACED.store(!at.is_empty(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut set) = PLACED.write() {
        *set = at;
    }
}
fn placed(at: [i32; 3]) -> bool {
    ANY_PLACED.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && PLACED.read().is_ok_and(|set| set.contains(&at))
}
// One block state as the mesh builder sees it, at a place in the world.
pub fn filter(v: u32, at: [i32; 3]) -> u32 {
    if v == 0 || !ON.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || !meshing() {
        return v;
    }
    match VISIBLE.read() {
        Ok(set) if !set.contains(&v) && !placed(at) => 0,
        _ => v,
    }
}
// A whole section's states (the one being meshed).
pub fn filter_all(out: &mut [u32; 4096]) {
    if !ON.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || !meshing() {
        return;
    }
    let [x0, y0, z0] = ORIGIN.with(Cell::get);
    let any = ANY_PLACED.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let (Ok(set), Ok(places)) = (VISIBLE.read(), PLACED.read()) else {
        return;
    };
    for (i, v) in out.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let (x, y, z) = (i as i32 & 15, i as i32 >> 8, i as i32 >> 4 & 15);
        if *v != 0 && !set.contains(v) && !(any && places.contains(&[x0 + x, y0 + y, z0 + z])) {
            *v = 0;
        }
    }
}
```

`tools/audit.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re, pathlib, sys, json
base = pathlib.Path.home()/".cache/tmp/meteor-src/meteor-client/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules"
sol = pathlib.Path.home()/"dev/horizon-meteor/mixins/sunset"
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]','',s.lower())
# ours
ours = {}
for f in sol.glob("*.rs"):
    src = f.read_text()
    for m in re.finditer(r'Module::new\("([^"]+)"[^;]*?(?=Module::new\(|\n    \]\n)', src, re.S):
        name = m.group(1)
        names = re.findall(r'\.(?:bool|num|pick|text)\(\s*"([^"]+)"', m.group(0))
        ours[norm(name)] = (name, names)
mis = {}
total_m = total_o = 0
for f in sorted(base.rglob("*.java")):
    src = f.read_text()
    t = re.search(r'super\(Categories\.\w+, "([^"]+)"', src)
    if not t: continue
    key = norm(t.group(1))
    sets = re.findall(r'\.name\("([^"]+)"\)', src)
    sets = list(dict.fromkeys(sets))
    total_m += 1
    if key in ours:
        have = {norm(x) for x in ours[key][1]}
        missing = [s for s in sets if norm(s) not in have]
        mis[ours[key][0]] = (len(sets), len(ours[key][1]), missing)
for name,(n,o,missing) in sorted(mis.items()):
    print(f"{name}: meteor {n}, ours {o}; missing: {', '.join(missing) if missing else '-'}")
```

`tools/bench.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# What each drawing module costs in a crowded scene (200 mobs, 100 chests, a field of ore under the platform), off, in
# its default mode, its outline mode and Potato: frames a second and the game's main thread's CPU time a frame (the
# median of four 2 s samples, and in brackets what it adds to the "off" sample just before). Runs on the test
# machine, next to verify.py, whose helpers it uses.
# Usage: bench.py CTL_PATH [module names...]; bench.py CTL_PATH --all: the same scene with every module that leaves the
# world and the player alone on at once (EVERYTHING), against all off, ROUNDS times each; bench.py CTL_PATH --menu: the
# menu shut, open in the Dropdown style and open in the Dashboard style.
import json, os, sys, time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import verify as v  # noqa: E402

# Module, its .t name, the modes to time (default first), and what it needs set up.
RUNS = [
    ("ESP", "esp", ["3D box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Tracers", "tracers", ["Lines", "Potato"]),
    ("Nametags", "nametags", ["Full", "Potato"]),
    ("Storage ESP", "storageesp", ["3D box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Block ESP", "blockesp", ["Box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Hole ESP", "holeesp", ["3D box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Breadcrumbs", "breadcrumbs", ["Line", "Potato"]),
    ("Waypoints", "waypoints", ["Full", "Potato"]),
    ("Trajectories", "trajectories", ["Line", "Potato"]),
    ("Light Overlay", "lightoverlay", ["Cross", "Potato"]),
    ("Tunnel ESP", "tunnelesp", ["Box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Void ESP", "voidesp", ["Box", "Outline", "Potato"]),
    ("Radar", "radar", ["Round", "Potato"]),
]
ROUNDS = 4
# Every module that neither moves the player, changes the world nor talks: the "everything on" scene.
EVERYTHING = ["esp", "tracers", "nametags", "storageesp", "blockesp", "holeesp", "tunnelesp", "voidesp", "lightoverlay",
              "breadcrumbs", "waypoints", "trajectories", "radar", "logoutspots", "blockoverlay", "targetesp", "handview",
              "norender", "fullbright", "atmosphere", "clearwater", "shulkerpeek", "spawneralerts", "basefinder",
              "antivanish", "deathlocation", "killaura", "triggerbot", "criticals", "offhand", "autoarmor", "autoweapon",
              "autoeat", "autoreplenish", "autotool", "fastplace", "autorespawn", "antihunger", "sprint", "nofall",
              "noslow", "velocity", "safewalk", "step", "nojumpdelay"]
# Settings that make the scene show everything: every kind of mob, mobs' name tags.
EXTRA = {"tracers": [("hostiles", "true"), ("passive", "true")], "nametags": [("mobs", "true")]}


def game_thread():
    """The game's main thread's schedstat file: the frame and the HUD are drawn on it."""
    sock = os.path.join(v.session_dir(), "c.sock").encode()
    for pid in filter(str.isdigit, os.listdir("/proc")):
        try:
            with open(f"/proc/{pid}/cmdline", "rb") as f:
                args = f.read().split(b"\0")
        except OSError:
            continue
        if args[0].endswith(b"horizon-client") and sock in args:
            return f"/proc/{pid}/task/{pid}/schedstat"
    raise RuntimeError("no game process")


def cpu_ns(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return int(f.read().split()[0])


def sample(path, seconds=2.0):
    """Frames a second, and the main thread's CPU milliseconds a frame (steady while other work shares the
    machine, unlike the frame rate)."""
    a, ca = v.ctl("status"), cpu_ns(path)
    time.sleep(seconds)
    b, cb = v.ctl("status"), cpu_ns(path)
    frames = max(b["frames"] - a["frames"], 1)
    return frames / max(b["uptime_seconds"] - a["uptime_seconds"], 1e-6), (cb - ca) / 1e6 / frames


def med(xs):
    return sorted(xs)[len(xs) // 2]


def settle():
    v.wait(30)


def scene():
    x0, y, z0 = v.X0, v.Y, v.Z0
    root = os.path.join(v.world_dir(), "datapacks", "sunset_bench")
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "data", "sunset_bench", "function"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(root, "pack.mcmeta"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"pack": {"description": "Sunset bench", "min_format": 121, "max_format": 121}}, f)
    lines = [f"fill {x0-16} {y-6} {z0-16} {x0+16} {y-2} {z0+16} minecraft:diamond_ore"]
    for i in range(200):
        kind = "husk" if i % 2 else "pig"
        lines.append(f"summon {kind} {x0 - 10 + i % 20 + 0.5} {y + 1} {z0 + 6 + i // 20} {v.HUSK}")
    for i in range(100):
        lines.append(f"setblock {x0 - 9 + (i % 10) * 2} {y + 4} {z0 + 6 + (i // 10) * 2} minecraft:chest")
    with open(os.path.join(root, "data", "sunset_bench", "function", "scene.mcfunction"), "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    with open(os.path.join(root, "data", "sunset_bench", "function", "clear.mcfunction"), "w") as f:
        f.write(f"fill {x0-16} {y-6} {z0-16} {x0+16} {y-2} {z0+16} minecraft:air\nkill @e[type=!player]\n")
    v.cmd("reload")
    v.wait(20)
    v.cmd("difficulty easy", "gamemode creative", "function sunset_bench:scene", "item replace entity @s hotbar.0 with minecraft:snowball 16")
    v.wait(40)
    # A trail for Breadcrumbs and a few waypoints.
    v.toggle("breadcrumbs", True)
    for i in range(60):
        v.cmd(f"tp @s {x0 + 0.5 + (i % 12) - 6} {y + 1} {z0 + 0.5 - i // 12}")
    v.toggle("breadcrumbs", False)
    for i in range(5):
        v.cmd(f"tp @s {x0 + 0.5 + i * 3 - 6} {y + 1} {z0 + 20.5}")
        v.say(f".waypoint add bench{i}")
    v.cmd(f"tp @s {x0 + 0.5} {y + 1} {z0 + 0.5} 0 15")
    v.wait(40)


def unscene():
    for i in range(5):
        v.say(f".waypoint remove bench{i}")
    v.cmd("function sunset_bench:clear", "difficulty peaceful")


def everything(path):
    """All of EVERYTHING on against all off: frames a second and the main thread's ms a frame, ROUNDS samples each."""
    v.setting("nametags", "mobs", "true")
    v.setting("tracers", "hostiles", "true")
    v.setting("tracers", "passive", "true")
    got = {"off": [], "on": []}
    for _ in range(ROUNDS):
        for state in got:
            for key in EVERYTHING:
                v.toggle(key, state == "on")
            settle()
            got[state].append(sample(path, 4.0))
    for key in EVERYTHING:
        v.toggle(key, False)
    for state, xs in got.items():
        print(f"everything {state}: {med([f for f, _ in xs]):.0f} fps {med([m for _, m in xs]):.3f} ms", flush=True)


def menu(path):
    """The menu shut and open in each ClickGUI Style: the main thread's ms a frame, ROUNDS samples each."""
    got = {"shut": [], "Dropdown": [], "Dashboard": []}
    for _ in range(ROUNDS):
        for state in got:
            if state != "shut":
                v.setting("clickgui", "style", state)
                v.say(".menu")
            settle()
            got[state].append(sample(path))
            if state != "shut":
                v.close_menu()
    v.say(".reset clickgui")
    for state, xs in got.items():
        extra = med([xs[i][1] - got["shut"][i][1] for i in range(ROUNDS)])
        print(f"menu {state}: {med([f for f, _ in xs]):.0f} fps {med([m for _, m in xs]):.3f} ms ({extra:+.3f})", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    only = sys.argv[2:]
    v.arena()
    v.ctl("options-set", "maxFps", "260")
    v.ctl("options-set", "enableVsync", "false")
    scene()
    if only == ["--menu"]:
        menu(game_thread())
        unscene()
        sys.exit(0)
    if only == ["--all"]:
        if os.environ.get("HOLD"):
            for key in EVERYTHING:
                v.toggle(key, True)
            print("held on", flush=True)
            time.sleep(float(os.environ["HOLD"]))
            for key in EVERYTHING:
                v.toggle(key, False)
        else:
            everything(game_thread())
        unscene()
        sys.exit(0)
    # The HUD's own text off, so only the module timed draws.
    v.say(".t hud")
    path = game_thread()
    for name, key, modes in RUNS:
        if only and name not in only:
            continue
        for k, val in EXTRA.get(key, []):
            v.setting(key, k, val)
        # Off and each mode in turn, ROUNDS times: other work on the machine comes and goes over minutes, so each
        # mode is set against the "off" just before it.
        got = {m: [] for m in ["off", *modes]}
        for _ in range(ROUNDS):
            for mode in got:
                v.toggle(key, mode != "off")
                if mode != "off":
                    v.setting(key, "mode", mode)
                settle()
                got[mode].append(sample(path))
        v.toggle(key, False)
        v.say(f".reset {key}")
        cells = []
        for mode in got:
            fps = med([f for f, _ in got[mode]])
            ms = med([m for _, m in got[mode]])
            extra = med([got[mode][i][1] - got["off"][i][1] for i in range(ROUNDS)])
            cells.append(f"{mode} {fps:.0f} fps {ms:.2f} ms" + ("" if mode == "off" else f" ({extra:+.2f})"))
        print(f"{name}: " + ", ".join(cells), flush=True)
    unscene()
    v.say(".reset hud")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Cuts the menu and HUD fonts (all SIL Open Font License 1.1, licences in assets/licenses/) down to the characters Sunset
# draws, in a Medium and a bolder weight (for headers), with no hinting. Each is kept as assets/<name>.ttf and
# assets/<name>-bold.ttf, and written as Rust byte arrays, with the list of fonts and each one's size, to
# mixins/sunset/font_data.rs. Variable fonts are set to the weight first (fontTools instancer).
# Usage: font.py   (the sources are listed below)
# The size of each font makes a line of text as wide as Inter's at 8.0.
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib import instancer

Z = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
C = os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/tmp/fonts")
# (resource name, label in HUD > Font, regular file, its weight if variable, bold file, its weight if variable)
FONTS = [
    ("sora", "Sora", f"{C}/Sora.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Sora.ttf", 700),
    ("inter", "Inter", f"{Z}/inter-zorin-os/Inter-Medium.ttf", None, f"{Z}/inter-zorin-os/Inter-SemiBold.ttf", None),
    ("poppins", "Poppins", f"{C}/Poppins-Medium.ttf", None, f"{C}/Poppins-SemiBold.ttf", None),
    ("outfit", "Outfit", f"{C}/Outfit.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Outfit.ttf", 700),
    ("manrope", "Manrope", f"{C}/Manrope.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Manrope.ttf", 700),
    ("geist", "Geist", f"{C}/Geist.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Geist.ttf", 700),
    ("montserrat", "Montserrat", f"{C}/Montserrat.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Montserrat.ttf", 700),
    ("jakarta", "Plus Jakarta Sans", f"{C}/PlusJakartaSans.ttf", 500, f"{C}/PlusJakartaSans.ttf", 700),
    ("lexend", "Lexend", f"{C}/Lexend.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Lexend.ttf", 700),
    ("rubik", "Rubik", f"{C}/Rubik.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Rubik.ttf", 700),
    ("grotesk", "Space Grotesk", f"{Z}/space-grotesk-zorin-os/SpaceGrotesk-Medium.ttf", None, f"{Z}/space-grotesk-zorin-os/SpaceGrotesk-Bold.ttf", None),
    ("redhat", "Red Hat Display", f"{C}/RedHatDisplay.ttf", 500, f"{C}/RedHatDisplay.ttf", 700),
    ("comfortaa", "Comfortaa", f"{C}/Comfortaa.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Comfortaa.ttf", 700),
    ("quicksand", "Quicksand", f"{C}/Quicksand.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Quicksand.ttf", 700),
    ("nunito", "Nunito", f"{C}/Nunito.ttf", 500, f"{C}/Nunito.ttf", 700),
    ("jetbrains", "JetBrains Mono", f"{Z}/jetbrains-mono-zorin-os/JetBrainsMono-Medium.ttf", None,
     f"{Z}/jetbrains-mono-zorin-os/JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", None),
]
SAMPLE = "Kill Aura Trigger Bot Aim Assist Criticals Auto Totem Weapon Flight Speed Sprint Scaffold Reverse Step Nametags Storage ESP"
here = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
unicodes = "U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+2013,U+2014,U+2018,U+2019,U+201C,U+201D,U+2022,U+2026,U+2190-2193,U+2212,U+00D7"


def cut(src, weight, name):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        if weight is not None:
            font = TTFont(src)
            instancer.instantiateVariableFont(font, {"wght": weight}, inplace=True)
            src = os.path.join(d, "instance.ttf")
            font.save(src)
        out = os.path.join(d, f"{name}.ttf")
        subprocess.run(["pyftsubset", src, f"--unicodes={unicodes}", "--layout-features=", "--no-hinting",
                        "--drop-tables+=GSUB,GPOS,GDEF,kern,STAT,fvar,avar,gvar,HVAR,MVAR", f"--output-file={out}"], check=True)
        return open(out, "rb").read(), TTFont(out)


def advance(font):
    cmap, hmtx = font.getBestCmap(), font["hmtx"]
    return sum(hmtx[cmap[ord(c)]][0] for c in SAMPLE) / font["head"].unitsPerEm


os.makedirs(os.path.join(here, "assets"), exist_ok=True)
body, sizes, total = [], {}, 0
for name, label, regular, wr, bold, wb in FONTS:
    for file, src, weight in ((name, regular, wr), (f"{name}-bold", bold, wb)):
        data, font = cut(src, weight, file)
        open(os.path.join(here, "assets", f"{file}.ttf"), "wb").write(data)
        total += len(data)
        if file == name:
            sizes[name] = advance(font)
        body.append(f"pub const UI_{file.upper().replace('-', '_')}: &[u8] = &[")
        for j in range(0, len(data), 24):
            body.append("    " + ", ".join(str(b) for b in data[j:j + 24]) + ",")
        body.append("];")
head = ["// The menu and HUD fonts, Medium and a bolder weight each (all SIL Open Font License 1.1, in assets/licenses/), cut down",
        "// by tools/font.py: the names HUD > Font offers, and every font's bytes and size in GUI pixels.",
        'pub const LABELS: [&str; %d] = [%s, "Minecraft"];' % (len(FONTS) + 1, ", ".join(f'"{f[1]}"' for f in FONTS)),
        "// (resource name, regular, bolder, size)",
        "pub const FONTS: [(&str, &[u8], &[u8], f32); %d] = [" % len(FONTS)]
for name, *_ in FONTS:
    size = round(8 * sizes["inter"] / sizes[name], 1)
    head.append(f'    ("{name}", UI_{name.upper()}, UI_{name.upper()}_BOLD, {size}),')
    print(f"{name}: size {size}")
head.append("];")
open(os.path.join(here, "mixins", "sunset", "font_data.rs"), "w").write("\n".join(head + body) + "\n")
print(total, "bytes of fonts")
```

`tools/matrix.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# The test matrix: the whole of verify.py on each test server in turn (servers.sh): start it, join it as Tester, run
# every test, keep the log in ~/hzmeteor/matrix/<server>.log, stop it. tools/matrix_report.py then makes the table
# (docs/test-matrix.md). On the test machine, in ~/hzmeteor, with Sunset built with the probe staged next to it:
#   ./matrix.sh [server...]      (default: horizon vanilla paper purpur folia spigot)
H=~/hzmeteor
cd $H || exit 1
mkdir -p matrix

world() {
	case "$1" in
	horizon) echo $H/srv/world ;; vanilla) echo $H/vanilla/world ;; *) echo $H/servers/$1/world ;;
	esac
}

for name in ${@:-horizon vanilla paper purpur folia spigot}; do
	port=$(./servers.sh port "$name") || continue
	./ctl quit >/dev/null 2>&1
	./servers.sh start "$name"
	# Up once it takes connections (Spigot and Folia take longest).
	for _ in $(seq 120); do
		(echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port) 2>/dev/null && break
		sleep 2
	done
	sleep 5
	if ./run-join.sh 127.0.0.1:$port >/dev/null && ./ctl wait-ready 120 >/dev/null && ./ctl wait 60 >/dev/null; then
		echo "$(date '+%F %T') $name: started" >&2
		SERVER=127.0.0.1:$port WORLD=$(world "$name") timeout 21600 python3 verify.py $H/ctl > matrix/$name.log 2>&1
	else
		echo "could not join $name on port $port" > matrix/$name.log
	fi
	./ctl quit >/dev/null 2>&1
	./servers.sh stop "$name"
	echo "$(date '+%F %T') $name: $(tail -1 matrix/$name.log)" >&2
	sleep 5
done
```

`tools/matrix_report.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# The test matrix's table from matrix.sh's logs: one row a test, one column a server, each cell PASS, FAIL or SKIP
# with what the test measured (cut short), then the kicks. Usage: matrix_report.py LOG... > table.md (a log's name
# without .log names its column).
import os, re, sys

LINE = re.compile(r"^(PASS|FAIL|SKIP) (.+?) - (.*)$")


def cell(result, note, room=110):
    note = note.replace("|", "/").strip()
    if len(note) > room:
        note = note[:room - 3].rstrip() + "..."
    return f"**{result}** {note}"


def main(paths):
    servers, rows, order, kicks, totals = [], {}, [], {}, {}
    for path in paths:
        name = os.path.basename(path).rsplit(".", 1)[0]
        servers.append(name)
        with open(path, errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.rstrip("\n")
                if m := LINE.match(line):
                    result, test, note = m.groups()
                    if test not in rows:
                        rows[test] = {}
                        order.append(test)
                    rows[test][name] = (result, note)
                elif line.startswith("KICKED during "):
                    kicks.setdefault(name, []).append(line[len("KICKED during "):])
                elif re.match(r"^\d+/\d+ passed$", line):
                    totals[name] = line
    print("| Test | " + " | ".join(servers) + " |")
    print("|---|" + "---|" * len(servers))
    for test in order:
        cells = [cell(*rows[test][s]) if s in rows[test] else "not run" for s in servers]
        print(f"| {test} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
    print()
    print("| Totals | " + " | ".join(totals.get(s, "did not finish") for s in servers) + " |")
    print("|---|" + "---|" * len(servers))
    for s in servers:
        for k in kicks.get(s, []):
            print(f"\nKicked on {s} during {k}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`tools/pack.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Packs the mod as dist/sunset-<version>.hnmod: horizon-native.json and
# mixins/sunset/ (only .rs and .toml), as Horizon's launcher reads it. Debug
# Report's commit line gets the commit packed (with -dirty for local changes).
import json, pathlib, subprocess, zipfile

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
manifest = json.loads((root / "horizon-native.json").read_text())
out = root / "dist" / f"sunset-{manifest['version']}.hnmod"
out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
git = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
commit = (git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD") or "unknown") + ("-dirty" if git("status", "--porcelain") else "")
UNPACKED = 'const COMMIT: &str = "unpacked";'
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    z.write(root / "horizon-native.json", "horizon-native.json")
    for f in sorted((root / "mixins" / "sunset").iterdir()):
        if f.name == "debug.rs":
            text = f.read_text()
            assert UNPACKED in text, "debug.rs lost its COMMIT line"
            z.writestr(f"mixins/sunset/{f.name}", text.replace(UNPACKED, f'const COMMIT: &str = "{commit}";'))
        elif f.suffix in (".rs", ".toml"):
            z.write(f, f"mixins/sunset/{f.name}")
(out.parent / "sunset.hnmod").write_bytes(out.read_bytes())
print(out)
```

`tools/probe/probe.rs`:

```rs
// One line a frame: unix time, game tick, yaw, pitch, the partial tick, the eyes where the frame draws them,
// then for each mob within 24 blocks its id and the centre and half sizes of its box where the frame draws it.

use super::Game;
use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::io::Write as _;
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

static OUT: OnceLock<Option<Mutex<std::fs::File>>> = OnceLock::new();

pub(super) fn frame(game: &Game<'_>) {
    let out = OUT.get_or_init(|| {
        let path = std::env::var_os("SUNSET_PROBE")?;
        std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path).ok().map(Mutex::new)
    });
    let (Some(out), Some(p)) = (out, game.player.as_ref()) else {
        return;
    };
    let a = game.clock.camera_fraction();
    let lerp = |x: f64, y: f64| x + a * (y - x);
    let was = game.previous_position;
    let now = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).map_or(0.0, |d| d.as_secs_f64());
    let mut line = String::new();
    let _ = write!(
        line,
        "{now:.6} {} {} {} {a:.5} {:.5} {:.5} {:.5}",
        game.ticks,
        game.yaw,
        game.pitch,
        lerp(was.x, p.position.x),
        lerp(was.y, p.position.y) + f64::from(p.dimensions.eye_height),
        lerp(was.z, p.position.z),
    );
    for m in &game.mobs {
        let (dx, dz) = (m.position.x - p.position.x, m.position.z - p.position.z);
        if dx * dx + dz * dz > 24.0 * 24.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let b = m.bounds();
        let (lo, hi) = (b.min_position(), b.max_position());
        let off = [lerp(m.previous.x, m.position.x) - m.position.x, lerp(m.previous.y, m.position.y) - m.position.y, lerp(m.previous.z, m.position.z) - m.position.z];
        let _ = write!(
            line,
            " {} {:.5} {:.5} {:.5} {:.4} {:.4}",
            m.id,
            (lo.x + hi.x) / 2.0 + off[0],
            (lo.y + hi.y) / 2.0 + off[1],
            (lo.z + hi.z) / 2.0 + off[2],
            (hi.x - lo.x) / 2.0,
            (hi.y - lo.y) / 2.0,
        );
    }
    line.push('\n');
    // How walking looks in this frame: whether a screen is open, the view bob and walk distance the camera and hand
    // move by, the own model's limb swing speed and position, and each other player's limb swing as seen here.
    let _ = write!(
        line,
        "walk {} {} {:.5} {:.5}",
        game.ticks,
        u8::from(game.screen != super::Screen::Playing),
        game.avatar.interpolated_bob(a as f32),
        game.avatar.backwards_interpolated_walk_distance(a as f32),
    );
    if let Some(m) = game.player_model.as_ref() {
        let _ = write!(line, " {:.5} {:.5} {:.3}", m.limb_speed, m.limb_position, m.body_yaw);
    }
    for m in game.mobs.iter().filter(|m| m.kind.id.ends_with("player")) {
        let _ = write!(line, " p{} {:.5} {:.5}", m.id, m.limb_speed, m.limb_position);
    }
    line.push('\n');
    if let Ok(mut f) = out.lock() {
        let _ = f.write_all(line.as_bytes());
    }
}

```

`tools/probe/wire.rs`:

```rs
// The probe's packet log: every move packet, every end of a client tick and every accepted teleport (a server's
// correction, or a /tp) as they go on the wire (after Sunset has changed them), so verify.py can count the move
// packets in a tick and the times a server put the player back. Lines "send <kind>" in the SUNSET_PROBE file; a move
// packet's line ends with the height it says (or "-") and its on-ground flag (0 or 1), so the falls the server counts
// can be added up. Packets are known by their ids, read off packets of each kind made here. And "order <kind>" lines
// for the client's own hits (attack, a spear's stab), move packets (move) and tick ends, in the order they go, for the
// check that a hit goes before its tick's move packet as vanilla sends it: those skip the single player server's
// packets (its threads are named horizon-lan-... and horizon-local-...), so they hold in single player too. And a
// "pkt <id>" line for every packet the client sends (the same threads skipped), to count all of them in a tick. And an
// "input <flags>" line for each PlayerInput (the move keys the server predicts the move from; the same threads skipped),
// and a "look <yaw> <pitch>" line after each move packet that carries a look (the same threads skipped).

use std::io::Write as _;
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

const KINDS: [&str; 6] = ["pos", "posrot", "rot", "status", "tickend", "teleport"];

static OUT: OnceLock<Option<(Mutex<std::fs::File>, [i32; 9])>> = OnceLock::new();

// The packet id at the start of an encoded packet (a VarInt), and its length.
fn id(body: &[u8]) -> Option<(i32, usize)> {
    let mut value = 0i32;
    for (i, b) in body.iter().take(5).enumerate() {
        value |= i32::from(b & 0x7F) << (7 * i);
        if b & 0x80 == 0 {
            return Some((value, i + 1));
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn sent(body: &[u8]) {
    let out = OUT.get_or_init(|| {
        use crate::packets::play::{self, Serverbound as S};
        let path = std::env::var_os("SUNSET_PROBE")?;
        let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path).ok()?;
        let made = [
            S::MovePlayerPos(play::MovePlayerPos { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0, flags: 0 }),
            S::MovePlayerPosRot(play::MovePlayerPosRot { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0, yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, flags: 0 }),
            S::MovePlayerRot(play::MovePlayerRot { yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, flags: 0 }),
            S::MovePlayerStatus(play::MovePlayerStatus { flags: 0 }),
            S::ClientTickEnd(crate::packets::Empty),
            S::AcceptTeleportation(play::AcceptTeleportation { id: 0, x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0, yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0 }),
            S::Attack(play::Attack { id: 0 }),
            S::PlayerAction(play::PlayerAction { action: 8, pos: [0; 3], direction: 0, sequence: 0 }),
            S::PlayerInput(play::PlayerInput { flags: 0 }),
        ];
        Some((Mutex::new(file), made.map(|p| id(&p.encode()).map_or(-1, |(id, _)| id))))
    });
    let (Some((file, ids)), Some((got, start))) = (out, id(body)) else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(mut f) = file.lock() else {
        return;
    };
    let own = !std::thread::current().name().is_some_and(|n| n.starts_with("horizon-lan") || n.starts_with("horizon-local"));
    if own {
        let _ = f.write_all(format!("pkt {got}\n").as_bytes());
    }
    let Some(i) = ids.iter().position(|x| *x == got) else {
        return;
    };
    if i < KINDS.len() {
        let _ = f.write_all(format!("send {}{}\n", KINDS[i], moved(i, &body[start..])).as_bytes());
    }
    if own && let Some((yaw, pitch)) = looked(i, &body[start..]) {
        let _ = f.write_all(format!("look {yaw:.2} {pitch:.2}\n").as_bytes());
    }
    if i == 8 {
        if own && let Some(flags) = body.get(start) {
            let _ = f.write_all(format!("input {flags}\n").as_bytes());
        }
        return;
    }
    let order = match i {
        0..=3 => "move",
        4 => "tickend",
        6 => "attack",
        // PlayerAction's action comes first: 8 is a spear's stab.
        7 if body.get(start) == Some(&8) => "stab",
        _ => return,
    };
    if own {
        let _ = f.write_all(format!("order {order}\n").as_bytes());
    }
}

// " <y> <ground>" for a move packet (its fields after the id: x y z as doubles, then the look as two floats, then the
// flags byte), else nothing.
fn moved(kind: usize, body: &[u8]) -> String {
    let (y, flags) = match kind {
        0 => (Some(8), 24),
        1 => (Some(8), 32),
        2 => (None, 8),
        3 => (None, 0),
        _ => return String::new(),
    };
    let Some(&flags) = body.get(flags) else {
        return String::new();
    };
    let y = y.and_then(|at| body.get(at..at + 8)).and_then(|b| b.try_into().ok()).map(f64::from_be_bytes);
    format!(" {} {}", y.map_or("-".to_string(), |y| format!("{y:.5}")), flags & 1)
}

// The look a move packet carries (posrot: after x y z; rot: first), as two floats.
fn looked(kind: usize, body: &[u8]) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    let at = match kind {
        1 => 24,
        2 => 0,
        _ => return None,
    };
    let float = |from: usize| body.get(from..from + 4).and_then(|b| b.try_into().ok()).map(f32::from_be_bytes);
    Some((float(at)?, float(at + 4)?))
}

```

```rs
fn probe_wire(body: &[u8]) {
    crate::connection::probe_wire::sent(body);
```
